article_content: A recent report has revealed that small-scale family farmers, who contribute to producing roughly a third of the world's food supply, received just 0.3% of all global climate finance in 2021. The study, put together by a network representing over 35 million smallholder farmers in Africa, Asia, Latin America, and the Pacific, exposes a serious gap in climate funding for those most vital to food security. These findings come on the eve of the COP28 summit, where leaders are expected to finalize an international plan for climate adaptation. The UAE, hosting COP28, is pushing for food and agriculture to become central to climate strategies and is calling on governments to increase funding to overhaul global food systems. According to research by Climate Focus, the agricultural and food sector received $8.4 billion in public international climate finance in 2021—about half of what was allocated to the energy sector. Nations facing high climate risks and food insecurity, such as Zambia and Sierra Leone, only received about $20 million each. Only 2% (or roughly $2 billion) of public climate funding reached smallholder family farmers and rural communities worldwide, a tiny portion considering their estimated annual need is $170 billion in Sub-Saharan Africa alone. Titled 'Untapped Potential,' the report emphasizes that just 19% of international public climate finance aimed at food and agriculture supported sustainable or resilient practices—amounting to $1.6 billion, while experts say $300-350 billion is needed each year. Hakim Baliriane, who heads the Eastern and Southern Africa Small-Scale Farmers Forum, warned that climate change has added 122 million people to the number affected by hunger since 2019, and that solving this crisis requires removing barriers that prevent family farmers from accessing support. The report points out that 80% of climate finance in agri-food is funneled through government institutions and international NGOs, making it hard for farmer groups to access because of complex requirements. Family farmers, often without adequate resources or infrastructure, are critical in growing staple crops and supporting rural economies: farms smaller than two hectares account for a third of the world’s food, and those under five hectares produce over half of staple crops globally. It is estimated that more than 2.5 billion people depend on family farms for their livelihoods. Experts and farmer leaders are calling for climate policies that prioritize nature-positive, diverse food systems and direct more funding to support initiatives like agroecology. Alberto Broch, president of COPROFAM, called for policymakers to include family farmers' voices and ensure they get access to funding, saying that over 600 million family farms are already involved in building resilient and sustainable food systems. Esther Penunia of the Asian Farmers Association urged a rethink in climate finance to empower family farmers and support agroecological practices, highlighting that working with nature and local communities is essential for food production in a changing climate.

Imaaradka Carabta oo martigelinaya COP28 waxay dhisayaan dedaalka in cunto iyo beeraha lagu xoojiyo dadaalka la dagaalanka isbeddelka cimilada, waxayna ku boorinayaan dowladaha inay kordhiyaan maalgelinta si dib-u-habeyn loogu sameeyo nidaamka cuntada ee dunida. Dalalka dhibaatada ugu badan uu isbeddelka cimiladu la leh iyo dalalka cunto yari ka jirto sida Zambia iyo Sierra Leone ayaa midkiiba helay $20 milyan oo kaliya. Kaliya 2% (ama qiyaastii $2 bilyan) maalgelinta cimilada dadweynaha ayaa gaartay beeraleyda qoysaska yar-yar iyo bulshooyinka miyiga adduunka, taasoo aad uga yar baahida sanadlaha ah ee lagu qiyaasay $170 bilyan ee Koonfurta-Saaxil ee Afrika oo kaliya. Warbixinta magaca la baxay 'Awood aan la Furin,' waxay tilmaantay in kaliya 19% maalgelinta cimilada ee caalamiga ah ee cuntada iyo beeraha la siiyay barnaamijyada waara ama u adkeysan kara cimilada—oo gaaraya $1.6 bilyan, halka khubaradu sheegeen in loo baahan yahay $300-350 bilyan sanad walba. Hakim Baliriane, madaxa Ururka Beeraleyda Yar-yar ee Bariga iyo Koonfurta Afrika, ayaa sheegay in isbeddelka cimiladu ku kordhiyay tirada dadka la ildaran gaajada boqol iyo laba iyo labaatan milyan tan iyo 2019, waxaana uu carabka ku dhuftay in xal loo heli karo arrintan oo kaliya marka la fududeeyo in beeraleydu helaan taageero. Warbixintu waxay xustay in 80% maalgelinta cimilada ee agri-cuntada loo mariyo dowladaha iyo ururada caalamiga ah ee NGO-yada, taasoo adkeyneysa in ururrada beeraleydu si toos ah u helaan sababo la xiriira shuruudo adag. Beeraleyda qoysaska, oo inta badan aan laheyn agab, teknoolajiyad ama kaabeyaasha lagama maarmaanka ah, ayaa door weyn ku leh soo saarista dalagga ugu muhiimsan iyo dhaqaale dhaqan miyiga: beeraha ka yar laba hektar waxay soo saaraan saddex meelood meel cuntooyinka dunida, beero ka yar shan hektarna waxay soo saaraan in kabadan kala bar dalagga caalamka. Waxaa la saadaalinayaa in ka badan 2.5 bilyan oo qof ay noloshoodu ku tiirsan tahay beeraleyda qoyska. Khubarada iyo madaxda ururada beeraleydu waxay dalbanayaan in la hormariyo siyaasado cimilada oo mudnaanta siiya nidaamyo cunto oo dabiici ah oo kala duwan lana kordhiyo maalgelinta lagu taageerayo agroecology. Alberto Broch, madaxweynaha COPROFAM, ayaa ugu baaqay madaxda inay codka beeraleyda la maqlo lana xaqiijiyo in ay si toos ah u helaan maalgelin, isagoo xusay in in kabadan 600 milyan oo beeraley qoys ah ay horey ugu jiraan dhismaha nidaamyo cunto waara oo u adkeysan kara cimilada. Esther Penunia oo ka socota Ururka Beeraleyda Aasiya, ayaa ku baaqday in dib loo eego doorka maalgelinta cimilada si loo taagero beeraleyda qoysaska laguna horumariyo agroecology, iyadoo aad uga digtay in la shaqeynta dabiiciga iyo bulshada deegaanka uu furaha u yahay sugnaanta cunto ee cimiladu isbedleyso.

article_content: Coca-Cola has faced accusations of supporting the regime of King Mswati III, the absolute monarch of Swaziland (now known as Eswatini). The Swaziland Democracy Campaign, an organization that seeks to end the monarchy’s rule, has urged the multinational beverage company to withdraw from the country immediately. Coca-Cola operates its largest production facility in Africa in Swaziland. King Mswati III, who leads one of the world’s poorest nations despite his own substantial personal wealth—estimated at £64 million ($100 million)—has visited Coca-Cola’s headquarters in Atlanta, Georgia. Mary Pais Da Silva, a spokesperson for the Swaziland Democracy Campaign, told The Guardian that, 'Coca-Cola must know they are doing business with the wrong people. Their presence does not benefit the local economy, as profits do not help average Swazis, while the king grows wealthier. No one should do business with Swaziland's current regime.' Activists claim Coca-Cola contributes up to 40% of Swaziland’s gross domestic product. The company states, however, that King Mswati does not receive profits from its local operations. Lucky Lukhele, from the Swaziland Solidarity Network, likened cooperation with Mswati’s regime to supporting apartheid in South Africa, stating, 'There is no such thing as a middle ground.' Coca-Cola established its Swaziland base in 1987 after leaving apartheid-era South Africa. A Coca-Cola spokesperson emphasized the company’s commitment to high ethical standards. Sherree Shereni said, 'King Mswati III does not receive any profits or dividends from Conco Swaziland, Coca-Cola's concentrate production plant. Through the Coca-Cola Africa Foundation, founded in Swaziland in 2001, the population has benefited from initiatives in water stewardship, health, education, and entrepreneurship.' Campaigners have criticized Mswati’s lavish lifestyle and demanded democratic reforms. The king personally appoints his cabinet and rules through informal consultations. Authorities suppressed a series of protests against his rule the previous year. Political opposition parties are banned, and activists often face arrest or assault. Despite criticism, King Mswati III receives support from neighboring South Africa, which recently provided Swaziland with a £215 million loan. Swaziland became independent from Britain in 1968. Most citizens live in poverty, and the country suffers from one of the world’s highest HIV/AIDS rates. Some studies estimate that up to 40% of the population may be living with the disease.

article_content:
People across the Americas recently witnessed a rare annular solar eclipse, where the Moon moved in front of the Sun but didn't block it completely. This happened because the Moon was at its farthest distance from Earth, making the Sun look like a bright ring—often called the 'ring of fire.' 

The event took place on October 14, starting in Oregon and traveling through several other US states, including California, Nevada, Utah, New Mexico, and Texas, before appearing in parts of Central and northern South America. Those in the direct path saw the full ring effect, while others experienced a partial eclipse.

Dr. Nicola Fox from NASA explained that although total solar eclipses show the Sun's corona and are thrilling to watch, annular eclipses are even less common and create a striking visual. 

NASA advised using certified solar viewing glasses for eye protection and warned viewers not to look at the Sun with regular sunglasses or through devices like cameras or telescopes without special filters because it could cause severe eye injury.

article_content: Recently surfaced photographs show Hollywood icon Mickey Rooney receiving medical treatment for a head wound, raising concerns that he may have suffered elder abuse before his death. Rooney, who passed away earlier this year at 93, is seen in one image receiving stitches for a significant cut. Another photo from January 2012 depicts him with a missing tooth and additional facial injuries. The images have been published amidst claims that Rooney was mistreated in the years preceding his death in April. The National Enquirer reports that he was treated for a head injury in December 2011, and soon after, appeared with other visible injuries. According to the Enquirer, members of Rooney’s family are preparing to submit documentation to law enforcement that they hope will clarify the circumstances surrounding his passing. Meanwhile, his eighth wife, Jan Chamberlin, firmly denies any allegations of abuse or mistreatment, stating: 'I deny each and every allegation that I mistreated Mickey. We were married for almost 40 years and I would never harm him.' Despite a career spanning 361 films over 80 years, Rooney’s estate was reportedly valued at just $18,000 at the time of his death. The actor is laid to rest alongside Hollywood legends like Rudolph Valentino, Douglas Fairbanks, Jayne Mansfield, and Charlie Chaplin at Hollywood Forever Cemetery. Reportedly, divisions within his family were evident, as separate funerals were held on April 19. At the time of his death, Rooney was living with his stepson Mark and Mark's wife, Charlene. In September 2011, it was reported that Rooney filed a lawsuit in Los Angeles Superior Court, accusing his stepson Christopher Aber, Christina Aber, and others, of elder abuse and fraud over the prior decade. The legal dispute concluded with a court judgment resolving the matter, in which abuse claims were withdrawn. According to the Hollywood Reporter, Christopher Aber and his wife admitted no wrongdoing although Aber was asked to pay $2.865 million, a ruling that was ultimately not enforced.

article_content: Canadian officials have uncovered a coordinated disinformation effort believed to be linked to the Chinese government. The campaign, known as 'spamouflage', targeted a number of political figures, including Prime Minister Justin Trudeau and Conservative leader Pierre Poilievre. According to Global Affairs Canada, social media bots posted thousands of misleading comments in both English and French, aiming to damage the reputation of politicians who are critical of Beijing. Some attacks reportedly featured AI-generated deepfake videos that falsely accused politicians of criminal or ethical misconduct, with these accusations attributed to a critic of China's Communist Party residing in Canada. The campaign relied on a network of new or hacked social media accounts to distribute propaganda across platforms such as Facebook, X/Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, Medium, Reddit, TikTok, and LinkedIn. These accounts also spread false claims about the Hawaii wildfires, including conspiracy theories about a secret U.S. military weapon. Canada's Rapid Response Mechanism, tasked with monitoring foreign disinformation, detected the spamouflage activity in August, with a significant increase in early September. After notifying the relevant platforms, many of the posts and accounts were removed. Canadian authorities worked with technology companies and the Australian Strategic Policy Institute to analyze the campaign and its goals. Politicians who were targeted were informed and advised on steps to protect themselves against further interference. Ongoing fears about election interference prompted the Canadian government to launch a formal inquiry into potential meddling by foreign powers, specifically China and Russia. The Chinese government has denied any involvement. The BBC has sought a comment from the Chinese embassy in Canada.

article_content: Once dismissed, wedged wellington boots have rapidly become a sought-after style. Darcey Bussell, the former prima ballerina and Strictly Come Dancing judge, was recently seen walking her dogs in a pair of waterproof boots with a raised heel. Hunter, a Royal Warrant holder and the Queen's bootmaker, now makes its own version of the wedge wellington. Although the Queen herself has not been seen in them, she prefers her classic flat-heeled boots for now. Other celebrities—including Kerry Katona, Tulisa, Sadie Frost, Halle Berry, Nancy Dell'Ollio, and Katie Price—have also embraced these leg-lengthening boots. This trend took off in 2010 when entrepreneurs pitched wedge wellies on BBC2’s Dragon’s Den, securing a £65,000 investment from retail expert Theo Paphitis, who praised their design as both practical and stylish. Today, the WedgeWelly brand offers a wide variety of colors, sizes, and patterns, including options for wide calves and shorter Chelsea-boot styles. Darcey Bussell favored the shiny black ‘Legend Unique’ boot, which sells for £40, while Hunter’s ‘Melrose Tall Wellington’ is priced at £115 and their high-heeled ‘Fulbrooke Tall Wellington’ at £125. Other retailers such as ASOS offer alternatives, like a pink wedge welly for £40. With such stylish options, some might say it’s almost a shame to wear them in the mud. At events like Glastonbury, even Nancy Dell'Ollio keeps her wedge wellies clean with some helpful friends.

article_content: When Marissa Mayer became Google's first female engineer in 1999, she built her career by embracing risk—often taking on challenges before she felt entirely prepared. Mayer credits her success to pushing through discomfort, a mindset that’s followed her into leadership roles. At 37, Mayer continued her bold approach as Yahoo’s CEO, a surprise appointment that quickly attracted attention. Her brief maternity leave after having a son triggered discussions about the expectations and realities for working mothers in demanding jobs, especially those with significant resources. Growing up in Wisconsin, Mayer developed interests ranging from music to debate, defying the usual stereotypes of tech professionals. Not originally immersed in computers, she discovered computer science in college, veering from a possible medical path. At Google, she managed major projects and openly embraced both her love for technology and fashion, challenging preconceived notions about women in her field. Famed for her high energy and demanding work schedule, Mayer does not subscribe to classic definitions of burnout, instead arguing that resentment—rather than fatigue—causes people to burn out. Mayer encourages others to prioritize passion over gender, seeing herself foremost as a passionate professional. While she supports equality, she has expressed hesitation about the term ‘feminist,’ favoring positivity and opportunity-oriented approaches. Her leadership style is notable for its detail-oriented, data-driven nature—famously insisting on testing small design changes for user appeal. Some praise, while others criticize, this precision-focused management. Throughout her tech career, Mayer has consistently defied expectations and led with her own unique vision, impacting every company she’s worked for.

Mayer waxay guusheeda sabab ugu sheegtay in ay ka gudubto raaxo la’aanta, maskaxdana taas ay xambaarsaneyd jagooyinkeedii hogaamineed. Mayer waxaa laga yaqaanaa tamar badan iyo jadwal shaqo oo adag, waxayna ka weerartaa fikradda caadiga ah ee burnout, iyadoo aaminsan in caajiskaasi ka dhasho dareen caddaalad darro oo aan laga helin daal kaliya. Mayer dadka kale waxay kula talisaa in la raaco waxa qofku xiiseynayo halkii laga eegi lahaa jinsiga, iyadoo nafta u aragta shaqaale jecel shaqadiisa. Qaarkood way bogaadiyeen halka kuwa kale ay dhaliil u jeediyeen sida ay u faahfaahsan tahay. article_content: Michael Cull, a 66-year-old pensioner from Fraserburgh in Aberdeenshire, is grappling with a rare and severe form of elephantiasis affecting his left leg. Once an engineer for NASA, Cull now finds daily life nearly impossible—the affected limb is around two feet wider than his right and continues to grow, making walking extremely difficult. Elephantiasis, a condition most often found in tropical countries, is believed to be almost unheard of in Scotland, and Cull may be the only person in the country experiencing it. His leg is so swollen that ordinary trousers don't fit and his shoes wear out in weeks, adding to his expenses. Additionally, he faces frequent public ridicule, with people calling him 'Elephant Man.' Cull's struggle began a decade ago when, after being hit by a car in London, he noticed his left knee swelling. Doctors initially dismissed the issue as a sports injury, later suggesting lymphedema, but no treatment helped. Only after seeing a specialist in Dundee did the possibility of elephantiasis arise. Frustrated by a lack of definitive diagnosis or treatment, Cull sought the opinion of a private consultant, who recommended surgery to remove tissue and carry out skin grafts. However, Cull says NHS doctors have not acted on these private findings. The swelling now extends to his pelvis, and basic activities like bathing, climbing stairs, or cooking have become major ordeals. He has had to stop working due to health and safety concerns and relies on special seating when using public transport. Despite his condition, Cull faces high costs for custom clothing and shoes, and social stigma every time he leaves home. He admits the public attention and name-calling lead to significant depression. Cull believes the NHS has failed him, citing multiple hospital referrals and a lack of clear treatment options. He's reached out to NHS leaders for an investigation and even considered traveling to India for surgery, though the expense is beyond his means. 'I've paid into the NHS all my life. I shouldn't have to pay thousands abroad for care,' he says. Elephantiasis is caused by a parasitic worm, typically passed through mosquito bites in tropical areas. According to the World Health Organization, around 1.4 billion people in 73 countries are at risk, with over 120 million currently infected and approximately 40 million suffering disability as a result. The most widely known person with a form of the disease was Joseph Merrick—the 'Elephant Man'—who became famous in Victorian-era Britain. An NHS Grampian spokesperson stated they could not comment on individual cases but encouraged Cull to consult with his doctor, adding that the practice is open to further discussions with him.

Cull, oo hore uga shaqeeyay NASA, noloshiisa ayaa aad u adkaatay—lugta waxyeellaysan ayaa waxaa la eg laba lugood oo kale oo weynaanteedu sii kordheyso maalintiiba maalinta ka dambeysa, taasoo socodka uga dhigtay mid aad u adag. Cudurka elephantiasis, oo badanaa laga helo dalalka kuleylaha, ayaa la rumeysan yahay inuu ku yar yahay Scotland, waxaana la maleynayaa in Cull uu yahay qofka kaliya ee dalkaas ku qaba. Lugtiisa oo aad u bararan ayaa ka dhigtay in funaanadaha caadiga ah aysan u galin, kabihiisuna dhowr toddobaad mooyee ma qaataan, taasoo kharash dheeri ah ku keentay. Waxa kale oo uu la kulmaa sumcad xumo joogto ah, iyadoo dad badan ugu yeeraan 'Elephant Man.' Dhibaatada Cull waxay bilaabatay toban sano ka hor markii uu gaariga ku dhuftay London, kadibna uu la dareemay barar jilibka bidix. Dhakhaatiirta ayaa markii hore u heystay dhaawac ciyaareed, dabadeed waxay sheegeen inuu lymphedema qabo, balse wax daawo ah kuma helin. Kaliya kadib markuu la kulmay khabiir ku takhasusay magaalada Dundee ayay suuragal noqotay in cudurka elephantiasis laga shakiyo. Cull ayaa markii uu ka daalay maqnaanshaha ogaansho iyo daaweyn sax ah, la tashaday dhakhtar gaar ah oo soo jeediyay in lugta la qalliyo oo la isticmaalo maqaar xiran. Si kastaba, Cull wuxuu sheegay in dhakhaatiirta NHS aysan wax tallaabo ah ka qaadin talooyinka gaarka ah. Bararku hadda wuxuu gaaray bowdadiisa, hawlo fudud sida qubayska, fuulista jaranjarada, ama cunno karintu waxay noqdeen caqabad weyn. Wuxuu qasbay inuu shaqadiisa ka tago sababo la xiriira badbaadada iyo caafimaadka, waxa uuna ku tiirsan yahay kursiga dadka naafada ah marka uu isticmaalo gaadiidka dadweynaha. Inkasta oo uu xanuunsan yahay, Cull wuxuu la kulmaa kharash badan oo dhar iyo kabo ah, iyo sumcad-xumo mar kasta oo uu bannaanka u baxo. Wuxuu qirtay in dareenka dadku iyo magacyada xun ee loo yeedho ay niyad jab ku ridayaan. Cull wuxuu aaminsan yahay in NHS ay ku fashilantay daryeelkiisa, isaga oo tilmaamay inuu marar badan isbitaalo la geeyay laakiin wali aan helin daaweyn cad. Wuxuu cabashadiisa u gudbiyay madaxda NHS iyo xitaa wuxuu tixgeliyay in qalliin lagu sameeyo India, inkastoo kharashkaasi ka badan yahay intuu sida caadiga ah heli karo. ‘Waan bixinayay NHS tan iyo yaraanteyda. Ma ahan inaan kumanaan gini dibadda ku bixiyo daryeelka,’ ayuu yiri. Elephantiasis waxaa keena jeermis yar oo caarooyinka (mosquitoes) ay gudbiyaan, waxaana caadi ahaan laga helaa dalalka kuleylaha. Sida ay sheegtay Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO), ku dhowaad 1.4 bilyan oo qof ayaa halis ugu jira cudurkan 73 waddan oo kala duwan, in ka badan 120 milyan-na waxaa haatan uu si joogto ah ugu dhacay, iyadoo qiyaastii 40 milyan ay la liitaan naafo iyo jirro daran. Qofka ugu caansan ee lagu yaqaanay cudurkan wuxuu ahaa Joseph Merrick—'Elephant Man'—oo sumcad ka helay Ingiriiska xilligii boqortooyada Victoria. Afhayeen u hadlay NHS Grampian ayaa sheegay inaysan ka hadli karin xaaladaha shaqsiyaadka, balse wuxuu ugu baaqay Cull inuu la xiriiro dhakhtarkiisa, iyagoo intaas ku daray in xarunta caafimaadku diyaar u tahay inay arrintan kala hadasho.

article_content: A recent survey highlights which careers are considered most attractive in a potential partner. The Valentine's Day Dream Date poll finds that many men are especially interested in women who work as human rights lawyers or journalists—professions associated with fairness, composure, intelligence, and a vibrant work life. Conversely, women searching for their perfect partner tend to prefer men in fields like medicine, architecture, or creative disciplines. They appreciate qualities such as nurturing support, authority, and creativity. Career paths like photography and graphic design are also popular for those seeking imaginative and passionate partners. This research was conducted by matchmaker and author Mary Balfour, who has been running the matchmaking agency Drawing Down the Moon in Britain for 30 years. Over a year, her team interviewed 615 women (ages 24–68) and 489 men (ages 30–72) about the profession they desired most in a future partner. According to the survey, qualities like personal fulfillment, creativity, compassion, and professional authority weigh as much as financial success when it comes to attraction. The agency relies on thorough interviews and typically admits applicants with strong academic or creative credentials, yet also welcomes successful individuals who have flourished outside traditional education routes. Among male singles, top-rated female professions included: human rights lawyer, journalist, web designer, photographer, marketer, and public relations specialist. Women seeking men found doctors, architects, creative professionals, filmmakers, academics, and entrepreneurs most appealing. These roles are admired for their problem-solving abilities, supportive natures, artistic style, and exciting lifestyles. In summary, the survey suggests a shift among singles toward valuing careers that demonstrate empathy, creativity, and genuine passion—prioritizing these traits above income and status alone.

article_content: The image of the wife in the mid-20th century is often a stereotype, but real women of that time dealt with heavy social expectations. While many worked during wartime, after the war they were pressured to focus on home life—keeping house, raising well-adjusted children, and serving dinner on time. This impossible standard led some to rely on medication or alcohol to cope. Although a few challenged these roles, their stories were rarely told on screen, and sometimes it cost them personally. Cultural perceptions do shift. In 2023, notable films like Bradley Cooper’s 'Maestro', Sofia Coppola’s 'Priscilla', Christopher Nolan’s 'Oppenheimer', and Michael Mann’s 'Ferrari' have given wives more agency and complexity. Even as supporting characters, these women now hold presence and depth. For decades, Hollywood executives doubted that audiences wanted women-centered stories, despite hit exceptions like 'Barbie.' It’s gratifying when films about men feature memorable women who have an impact. Consider Reese Witherspoon’s portrayal of June Carter Cash in 'Walk the Line' or Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor’s Oracene Price in 'King Richard'—both show women’s power and nuance even in supporting roles. Male filmmakers’ treatment of wives in film is telling; ideal portrayals show both partners as full people. In 'The Right Stuff' (1983), the astronaut wives had unique personalities on screen, resisting the usual depiction as faceless helpers. 'Maestro' by Bradley Cooper highlights Leonard Bernstein’s marriage to Felicia Montealegre, portrayed by Carey Mulligan. Mulligan depicts Montealegre as one who loves Bernstein deeply, accepting his sexual orientation and enduring the strain it imposed. The point is clear: even the best choices in marriage can still invite pain. Movies frequently show women enduring infidelity, but each situation is unique. In 'Oppenheimer,' Emily Blunt’s portrayal of Kitty Oppenheimer—a scientist and activist—reveals a woman handling a volatile marriage yet standing strong for her family. Her independence, once discouraged, becomes her strength. In 'Ferrari,' Penélope Cruz’s Laura Ferrari balances hurt with practical decisions, ultimately saving her husband’s company while asserting her own power. With 'Priscilla,' Sofia Coppola puts a wife’s experience at the center, chronicling Priscilla Presley’s transformation from a teenager enamored with Elvis to a self-assured woman able to walk away. Cailee Spaeny’s performance shows Priscilla’s growth, culminating in her decision to leave—set poignantly to Dolly Parton’s 'I Will Always Love You.' Sometimes real strength lies in moving on. Correction, November 21: The article previously misstated Felicia Montealegre’s birthplace. It is Costa Rica.

Badi haweenkani waxay shaqeyn jireen xilliyadii dagaalka, balse dagaalkii kadib waxaa laga rabay iney guriga diiradda saaraan: guriga nadiifinta, korinta carruurta si wanaagsan iyo diyaarin cuntada waqtigeeda. Sanadkii 2023, aflaam muhiim ah sida 'Maestro' ee Bradley Cooper, 'Priscilla' ee Sofia Coppola, 'Oppenheimer' ee Christopher Nolan, iyo 'Ferrari' ee Michael Mann waxay dumarka xaasaska ah siinayaan awood iyo aragti cusub. Xitaa haddii ay door dambe leeyihiin, waxay kaga muuqdaan filimada xoog iyo qoto dheer. Sanadihii hore, madaxda filimada ee Hollywood waxay ka baqayeen in sheekooyinka dumarka aysan xiiso lahayn, inkastoo 'Barbie' ay muujisay in dadku daneynayaan. Tusaale ahaan, Reese Witherspoon oo June Carter Cash ka kaca 'Walk the Line' iyo Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor oo Oracene Price ka jisha 'King Richard', labadooduba waxay muujinayaan awoodda haweenka xitaa marka la mid yahay. Qaabka filim sameeyayaasha u saameeyaan doorka xaasaska ayaa muujinaya macne badan; muuqaalka ugu wanaagsan wuxuu tusayaa labada lamaane oo si buuxda ugu jira noloshooda. Filimada intooda badan waxay muujinayaan haween dulqaadanaya khiyaamo, balse waayo-aragnimada kasta waa foojignaan. 'Oppenheimer', Emily Blunt waxay Kitty Oppenheimer (saynisyahano iyo dhaqdhaqaaqe) kaga dhigtay haweeney la tacaaleysa nolosha adag, balse si joogto ah qoyskeeda ugu taagan, waxaanna madaxbannaanideedu noqotaa xooggeeda. 'Ferrari', Penélope Cruz oo Laura Ferrari mataleysa waxay ka sii raynaysaa dhaawaca, ugu dambeyntiina waxey badbaadisaa shirkadda ninkeeda iyadoo awooddeeda muujineysa. 'Priscilla' ee Sofia Coppola waxay xudunta saartaa waayo-aragnimada xaasnimada, iyadoo tusineysa Priscilla Presley sida ay uga soo bilowdo gabar yar oo Elvis jecel una baddasho haweeney go’aan adag leh. Cailee Spaeny waxay muujinaysaa korriimada Priscilla, ugu dambeynna waxay go'aansanaysaa inay iska tagto Elvis iyadoo heesta Dolly Parton 'I Will Always Love You' la dhegaysto. article_content: A black-tie event with an unusual twist took place at New York's Coney Island beach, where around 200 people dressed in elegant tuxedos and ball gowns gathered for a memorable evening. Some participants accessorized their suits with inflatable arm bands, while others changed into swimming trunks for the beach festivities. The party also featured a lively conga line danced in the water and playful sandcastle building on shore. Improv Everywhere regularly creates joyful and chaotic scenes in public places across the United States.

article_content: Teens are at risk of long-term spinal damage from spending hours hunched over screens, new research shows. While addicted teenagers might ignore such warnings, this information could prove valuable for parents. According to a British Chiropractic Association (BCA) study, four in ten teenagers report back or neck pain after long periods in front of TVs or computer screens. The survey of more than 460 parents with children aged 11 to 16 found that over one in seven parents believe their child's discomfort is linked to laptop, tablet, or computer use. The study also reveals that 23% of teens spend two to four hours per day watching TV, and 25% spend the same amount of time on a laptop, tablet, or computer. By contrast, 33% spend two or more hours on gaming consoles, while just 12% spend that time cycling. Notably, 21% of parents said their child does not own a bicycle. Nearly half the parents surveyed (46%) admitted their children do not get enough exercise, even though NHS guidelines recommend at least one hour of physical activity each day for young people aged five to eighteen. The BCA is encouraging parents to limit their children's time spent using technology. To mark Chiropractic Awareness Week, BCA chiropractor Rishi Loatey said, 'We are seeing more young people under 16 with back and neck pain, often because of technology. Young people are increasingly sedentary, which harms their posture. Hunched sitting positions put a lot of strain on the neck. By learning how to sit properly and staying active, young people can be healthier and avoid pain. It's important for parents to seek professional help if their children experience pain—if left untreated, such problems can become chronic later in life.'

Inkasta oo dhallinyarada la qabatimay technology-du ay iska indhatiri karaan digniinta, haddana xogtan waalidiinta ayaa laga yaabaa inay waxtar u yeelato. Daraasad ay sameysay Ururka British Chiropractic Association (BCA) ayaa muujisay in afar ka mid ah toban dhallinyaro ah ay sheegteen xanuun dhabarka ama qoorta ah kadib waqti badan oo TV-ga ama shaashadaha kombuyuutarada lagu qaatay. Sahankan oo lagu sameeyay in ka badan 460 waalidiin oo carruurtoodu da’doodu u dhaxayso 11 ilaa 16 sano, ayaa lagu ogaaday in wax ka badan hal waalid oo toddobadii ah uu aaminsan yahay in xanuunka carruurtoodu uu la xiriiro isticmaalka laptop, tablet, ama computer. Daraasaddu waxay sidoo kale ogaatay in 23% dhallinyarada ay laba ilaa afar saac maalintii daawadaan TV-ga, halka 25% ay waqti la mid ah ku qaataan isticmaalka laptop, tablet, ama computer. Sidoo kale, 33% ayaa laba saacadood ama in ka badan ku bixiyaa ciyaarista consoles game-ka, halka 12% kaliya ay waqti intaa la eg fuulaan baaskiil. Intaa waxaa dheer, 21% waalidiinta ayaa sheegay in carruurtoodu aysan xitaa lahayn baaskiil. Ku dhowaad kala bar waalidiinta la wareystay (46%) waxay qireen in carruurtoodu aysan helin jimicsi ku filan, inkastoo tilmaamaha NHS ay sheegayaan in dhalinyarada da’doodu u dhaxayso 5 ilaa 18 sano ay u baahan yihiin ugu yaraan hal saac oo dhaqdhaqaaq jireed ah maalintii. BCA ayaa hadda ku dhiirrigelinaysa waalidiinta in ay xaddidaan waqtiga carruurtoodu ku qaataan technology-ga. Markii la xusayey Todobaadka Wacyigelinta Chiropractic, dhakhtar ka tirsan BCA oo la yiraahdo Rishi Loatey ayaa yiri, 'Waxaan aragnay caruur ka yar 16 sano oo qaba xanuunada dhabarka iyo qoorta oo badi technology ay u sabab tahay. Dhallinyaradu waxay noqdeen kuwo aad u fadhiya, taasoo dhaawac u geysanaysa hab-fadhiistooda. Fadhiista qalloocan waxa uu culays badan saaraya qoorta. Barashada sida saxda ah ee loo fadhiisto iyo in la ahaado mid firfircoon waxay dhallinyarada ka caawinaysaa inay caafimaad yeeshaan oo xanuunka ka badbaadaan. Waa muhiim in waalidiintu la tashadaan khabiir marka xanuunku bilaabmo—haddii aan la daaweyn, xanuunadani waxa ay isu bedeli karaan dhibaatooyin daba-dheer mustaqbalka.'

article_content: Recent findings show that Mohamed is the most common baby boy's name in Israel, but it was omitted from the country’s official baby names list. The Population and Immigration Authority, which publishes an annual ranking of the top ten names for newborns, excluded Arabic names like Mohamed—which should be number one—and Ahmed, which would have placed ninth. In the announcement made before the Jewish New Year, the authority only listed Hebrew boys' names: Yosef, Daniel, Uri, Itai, Omer, Adam, Noam, Ariel, Eitan, and David, with no Arabic names featured. For girls, Tamar claimed the top spot, overtaking Noa after 14 years, while recognized names included Shira, Adele, Talya, Yael, Lian, Miriam, Maya, and Avigayil. Notably, names like Lian, Miriam (Maryam), and Maya are popular across both Jewish and Arab families. Israeli news outlet Haaretz criticized the omission and highlighted that Arabic names such as Mohamed actually top the real statistics. The Population and Immigration Authority responded, stating the focus was on Hebrew names due to media demand, and denied any intent to conceal information, with spokesperson Sabine Hadad stressing, 'There is no plot to deliberately hide information.' This practice follows last year’s trend, when a similar list omitted all mention of Arabic names. According to official reports, 176,230 babies were born in Israel this year—90,646 boys and 85,584 girls. Israel's population now stands at 8.18 million, with more than six million Jews.
translated_content: Warbixin cusub ayaa daaha ka qaaday in magaca Maxamed yahay magaca wiilasha ugu badan ee la siiyo carruurta Israel, balse la waayay liiska rasmiga ah ee magacyada sanadkan. Hay’adda Dadweynaha iyo Socdaalka Israel oo soo saarta liiska tobanka magac ee ugu caansan ilmaha cusub sanad kasta, ayaa magacyada Carabiga sida Maxamed, oo noqon lahaa kan koowaad, iyo Axmed, oo galayo kaalinta sagaalaad, liiskaba ka saartay. Liiska ay hay’addu horay ugu dhawaaqday kahor sannadka cusub ee Yahuudda waxaa lagu xusay magacyada wiilasha Yuhuudeed: Yosef, Daniel, Uri, Itai, Omer, Adam, Noam, Ariel, Eitan, iyo David, mana jirin magac Carabi ah oo ku jira. Magacyada gabdhaha, Tamar ayaa noqotay midka ugu sarreeya, iyada oo bedeshay Noa oo 14 sano hoggaaminayay, waxaana magacyada kale ee liiska ku jira kamid ah: Shira, Adele, Talya, Yael, Lian, Miriam, Maya, iyo Avigayil. Magacyada Lian, Miriam (Maryam), iyo Maya waa magacyo ay si isku mid ah u isticmaalaan Yuhuudda iyo Carabtu. Wargeyska Haaretz ayaa dhaleeceeyay in magacyada Carabiga laga reebay liiska, isagoo xusay in magaca Maxamed uu yahay midka runta ah ee ugu badan carruurta dhashay. Hay’adda dadweynaha iyo socdaalku waxay sheegtay in liiska lagu saleeyay danaha warbaahinta ee magacyada Yuhuudeed, islamarkaana aysan jirin wax qorshe ah oo xog lagu qarinayo, sida uu caddeeyay afhayeenka Sabine Hadad oo yiri: 'Ma jirto shirqool xog lagu qarinayo.' Arrintan ayaa la mid ah sidii sanadkii hore oo liiskii magacyada aysan ku jirin Carabi. Sida rasmiga ah, sanadkan Israel waxaa lagu dhashay 176,230 carruur ah—90,646 wiilal ah iyo 85,584 gabdhood ah. Wadarta dadka Israel waa 8.18 milyan, waxaana ka mid ah in ka badan lix milyan oo Yuhuud ah.

Spring Airlines, China's top budget airline, has launched a new recruitment drive to hire married women with children as flight attendants, referring to the position as 'flight aunties.' The airline is targeting college-educated women aged 25 to 45, giving special preference to those who are married and have children.

Unlike most traditional Chinese carriers that focus on hiring young women based on appearance—sometimes even running beauty contests—Spring Airlines is shifting gears. After conducting a survey that showed 72% of passengers prefer experienced attendants, the company decided to increase the age limit for new hires from 35 to 45.

Spring Airlines believes having flight attendants from a wider age range will enhance passenger service, combining the enthusiasm of younger staff with the reliability and maturity of older attendants. The airline emphasizes its commitment to offering women of all ages the chance to pursue a career in aviation.

article_content: President Barack Obama expressed that current U.S. intelligence does not indicate North Korea is capable of fitting a nuclear warhead onto a missile, directly countering recent assessments from the Pentagon's intelligence division. He further warned that the regime’s ongoing threats and confrontational actions are worsening its isolation both globally and in the region. A Pentagon intelligence analysis released last week asserted with 'moderate confidence' that North Korea may have developed nuclear weapons for missile delivery, though the report cast doubt on the technical reliability of such capability. Officials from the U.S. defense and intelligence communities later clarified that North Korea has not fully demonstrated these capabilities. Speaking to NBC News, Obama said, 'Based on our current intelligence assessments, we do not believe North Korea is able to mount a nuclear warhead on a ballistic missile.' In response to recent provocations, the U.S. moved additional missile defense systems to Guam, aiming to fortify its defenses. This step followed heightened North Korean threats after fresh U.N. sanctions and the start of annual U.S.-South Korea joint military exercises. Pyongyang reacted to growing international pressure and sanctions by increasing its belligerent rhetoric and taking concrete steps, such as restricting activity at the Kaesong Industrial Complex, pledging to resume operations at a closed nuclear reactor, and deploying mobile missiles. These moves have further raised tensions on the Korean Peninsula. Obama commented that Kim Jong Un's recent actions are reminiscent of his predecessors, reiterating that the U.S. does not and will not reward provocative behaviors. 'Making threats cannot be the basis for negotiation,' he stated. Asked about the North Korean leader's stability, Obama declined to assess Kim Jong Un personally but described the government’s actions as intentionally provocative. While expecting more such moves, Obama stressed the hope for a diplomatic resolution that could improve living conditions for North Koreans. On the diplomatic front, Secretary of State John Kerry visited South Korea, China, and Japan to emphasize that Pyongyang must demonstrate a true commitment to denuclearization and reduce threats for meaningful talks with the United States to be possible. North Korea continues to claim that its nuclear program serves as a defensive deterrent, dismissing U.S. dialogue initiatives as disingenuous unless Washington alters its policy stance. Analysts like Daniel Pinkston from the International Crisis Group believe that North Korea's precondition of being accepted as a nuclear state makes genuine talks impossible for the United States and the United Nations. The North Korean government has also blocked South Korean personnel access to the shared Kaesong Industrial Complex and pulled out its workers, without any sign of shifting position despite overtures from Seoul for dialogue.

article_content: Joyce Moore, an 83-year-old grandmother, died from carbon monoxide poisoning after a faulty insulation job in her home. The tragedy occurred when HIS Energy employees, installing insulation as part of a government scheme, blocked the boiler flue without warning Joyce or her son, Bob Moore. That evening, when the heating was turned on, toxic gas filled the house. The court heard that HIS Energy, managed by Neville Wilshire—a multimillionaire and former star of the BBC series The Call Centre—had not included carbon monoxide safety in their risk protocols and failed to label the boiler as unsafe. The supervisor on site contacted the head office about the issue, but the safety manager was unavailable, and no immediate action was taken. Bob Moore recalled a brief warning from a worker not to use the heating, though he was not told about the risk. When he turned on the heating, both he and two paramedics suffered carbon monoxide poisoning, and his mother was found dead upstairs. Judge Charles Garside, QC, condemned HIS Energy's inadequate safety standards and fined the company £500,000 for health and safety violations, stating that Bob Moore was 'as much a victim as if his mother had been murdered by an intruder.' However, the company went into liquidation soon after prosecution began, raising questions about the payment of the fine. Months after this fatal incident, another firm run by Wilshire was also fined £225,000 for making cold calls to households that had opted out. Joyce Moore was a retired pub landlady who lived with her son in Middleton, Greater Manchester, and had recently returned from visiting her grandchildren in Australia.

article_content: Nearly two-thirds of financial services firms have begun implementing artificial intelligence (AI) and aim to leverage it across their entire value chain within the next two years, according to a recent report by Capgemini. The report highlights that large-scale cloud adoption is essential if companies are to fully realize the benefits of their AI investments. However, many firms have experienced only limited impact from AI so far, mainly because they have yet to implement cloud technology at scale. "One in two banks and insurers have not transitioned their core business applications to the cloud," the report noted. Capgemini’s findings show that 91% of banks and insurance companies have now started their cloud transformation, a substantial increase from just 37% in 2020. Despite this progress, more than half of surveyed firms have only migrated a small portion of their core applications to the cloud, indicating that true cloud adoption at scale remains limited. Anuj Agarwal, Capgemini Industry Platform Leader for Banking - India, emphasized the importance of this transition, stating, "Today, we see fintechs specializing in numerous areas that leverage AI to add significant value to banks. This includes automation, personalized customer experience, improved fraud prevention, and better risk management." India, with one of the world’s highest levels of AI skilled workforce and government-driven data initiatives, continues to see significant investment and demand in AI, positioning it well for fintech innovation, Agarwal added. The report also notes that in wealth management, 60% of firms see value in using cloud-based fraud detection to drive better, data-driven risk management. Among retail banking leaders, 39% prioritize moving complex credit risk management to the cloud to speed up loan decision-making with automated processes and advanced analytics. Capgemini’s report draws from global data, two primary research surveys, and thirty interviews with financial service executives across 20 countries—including the US, Canada, UK, France, Germany, Spain, the Netherlands, UAE, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, China, India, and Australia. In summary, scalable and modular cloud-based platforms are expected to play a key role in helping financial firms extract maximum value from AI and drive forward the sector’s digital transformation.

Warbixintu waxay muujinaysaa in hirgelinta daruuraha (cloud) ballaaran ay lama huraan u tahay si shirkadaha ay u helaan dhammaan faa’iidooyinka maalgashiga AI. Natiijooyinka Capgemini waxay muujinayaan in 91% bangiyada iyo shirkadaha caymiska ay bilaabeen safarkooda daruuraha, taasoo ah koror weyn oo ka timid 37% sanadkii 2020. Anuj Agarwal, Madaxa Barnaamijka Warshadaha ee Capgemini ee Bangiyada – Hindiya, ayaa carabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda arrintan, isagoo yiri, "Maanta, waxaan aragnaa shirkadaha fintech oo diiradda saaraya dhowr meelood oo ay AI-ga uga faa’iideeyaan bangiyada. Tani waxa ka mid ah otomaatiga, khibradda macaamiisha ee gaar ah, horumarinta ka hortagga khiyaamada, iyo maaraynta khatarta oo ka wanaagsan." Hindiya oo leh mid ka mid ah heerarka ugu sarreeya ee xirfadda AI-ga iyo barnaamijyada dowladda ee dhiirrigelinaya xog ururinta, waxay sii wadaa maalgelin iyo baahi weyn oo AI ah, taasoo suurtagal u ah hal-abuurnimada fintech, ayuu intaasi ku daray Agarwal. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale xustay in maamulka hantida, 60% shirkadaha ay qiimo weyn u arkaan adeegsiga baarista khiyaamada ee daruuraha si ay u xoojiyaan go’aan qaadashada khatarta oo ku saleysan xog. Hogaamiyayaasha bangiyada tafaariiqda, 39% ayaa mudnaanta siinaya in la wareejiyo maaraynta khatarta deymanka ee adag daruuraha si degdeg loogu go’aansado amaah iyadoo la adeegsanayo hab otomaatig ah iyo falanqeyn casri ah. Warbixinta Capgemini waxay ka faa’iidaysatay xog caalami ah, laba sahamin cilmiyeed oo waaweyn iyo soddon wareysi oo lala yeeshay madaxda adeegyada maaliyadeed ee ka kala socda 20 dal—oo ay ka mid yihiin Maraykanka, Kanada, UK, Faransiiska, Jarmalka, Isbayn, Nederland, Imaaraadka, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Shiinaha, Hindiya, iyo Australia. If you have half an hour to spare, consider watching this remarkable concert by Jonathan Richman with Modern Lovers members Brennan Totten and Andy Paley. The show originally aired on April 28, 1986, as 'Qui Té por de Jonathan Richman?' ('Who's Afraid of Jonathan Richman?') on TV3's (Televisió de Catalunya) program Arsenal.

While the exact recording date is unclear—some sources claim 1984, others point to April 10, 1986—the video itself indicates it was filmed at the Otto Zutz Club in Barcelona on April 10, 1986.

This concert stands out for being broadcast in Catalan, a language with a complex political history in Spain and spoken by a cultural minority. Seeing the title 'Who's Afraid of Jonathan Richman?' in Catalan is particularly notable.

During the energetic performance with his bandmates, Richman also appears in short skits, narrates stories about his first guitar, and discusses his fame—an unusual level of openness for an artist known for his reticence offstage.

The show opens with Richman attempting Spanish phrases such as 'Hola, aquí Jonathan Richman' and other simple greetings. The setlist features fan favorites like 'The Tag Game', 'Ice Cream Man', 'This Kind of Music', 'I'm A Little Dinosaur', 'Give Paris a Chance', 'That Summer Feeling', and standout covers of 'Wipe Out' and 'La Bamba', both featuring JoJo on saxophone.

This thirty-minute episode provides a rare glimpse into Richman's authentic enthusiasm and musical charm. Enjoy watching the full show!

Haddii aad haysato nus saac ah, isku day inaad daawato bandhiggan cajiibka ah ee uu qabtay Jonathan Richman oo ay la socdaan xubnaha Modern Lovers, Brennan Totten iyo Andy Paley. Bandhiggan waxaa markii ugu horreysay la baahiyay 28-da Abriil, 1986, wuxuuna cinwaankiisu ahaa 'Qui Té por de Jonathan Richman?' ('Yaa ka Baqanaya Jonathan Richman?'), oo ka baxay barnaamijka Arsenal ee TV3 (Televisió de Catalunya).

Inkasta oo taariikhda duubista la isku khilaafsan yahay—ilo qaar waxay sheegayaan 1984, halka kuwo kalena ay sheegaan 10-ka Abriil, 1986—muuqaalka laftiisa ayaa muujinaya in lagu duubay Otto Zutz Club ee magaalada Barcelona, 10-ka Abriil, 1986.

Bandhiggan waxa uu caan ku yahay in lagu baahiyay af Catalan, oo ah luqad si weyn muhiim ugu ah siyaasadda Spain, kana mid ah afafka ay ku hadlaan bulshooyin yar. Waa arrin la yaab leh in cinwaanka 'Yaa ka Baqanaya Jonathan Richman?' lagu soo bandhigay af Catalan.

Inta lagu jiro heesaha firfircoon ee uu la wado kooxdiisa, Richman waxa uu sameeyaa skits kooban, waxa uu ka sheekeynayaa gitaar-kiisii ​​ugu horreeyay, sidoo kalena waxa uu ka hadlayaa caan-imaadkiisa—oo ah mid dhif ah oo laga helo fanaankan inta badan aan warbaahinta la hadlin marka uu ka baxo masraxa.

Bandhiggu waxa uu ku bilaabanayaa Jonathan oo isku dayaya inuu hadlo Isbaanish, isagoo adeegsanaya salaamo iyo erayo fudud sida 'Hola, aquí Jonathan Richman.' Heesaha la qaadayo waxa ka mid ah 'The Tag Game', 'Ice Cream Man', 'This Kind of Music', 'I'm A Little Dinosaur', 'Give Paris a Chance', 'That Summer Feeling', iyo kuwo kale oo cajiib ah sida 'Wipe Out' iyo 'La Bamba' oo JoJo ku ladhan tahay saxophone.

Bandhiggan soddon daqiiqo ah waxa uu kuu furaa daah-furnaan iyo xiiso toos ah oo ku saabsan Richman. Ku raaxayso daawashadiisa!

article_content: PARIS, France -- Brian Lima, Samoa's center, will miss the remainder of the Rugby World Cup after being handed a three-week suspension for a dangerous tackle on England star Jonny Wilkinson. Lima attended a hearing regarding the incident, which occurred during Saturday's Pool A match in Nantes. As the only player to participate in five World Cups, Lima received the ban after being cited for the tackle. Jonny Wilkinson was uninjured, and referee Alan Lewis took no action against Lima during the match. England won 44-22, eliminating Samoa from the tournament. World Cup judicial officer Professor Lorne Crerar upheld the suspension following a complaint by match citing commissioner Steven Hines. This means the 35-year-old Lima will miss Samoa's final match against the United States on Wednesday, with two additional weeks added to his suspension. Lima is expected to retire from international rugby after this tournament. Although he has 48 hours to appeal the decision, it is unlikely a hearing will be arranged before the match. Samoa will head home following their match against the United States, ending a World Cup campaign widely regarded as their most disappointing.

Lima ayaa ka soo qaybgalay dhegeysi la xiriiray falkaas oo dhacay intii lagu jiray ciyaartii Group A ee Sabtidii ka dhacday Nantes. Lima, oo ah ciyaaryahanka kaliya ee ka qaybqaatay shan Koob Adduun, ayaa lagu ganaaxay kaddib markii lagu eedeeyay tackle-kii uu sameeyay. article_content: Google has started talks with most of the world’s leading automakers in hopes of putting self-driving cars on the road by 2020. Chris Urmson, director of Google’s self-driving car project, stated, 'We’d be remiss not to talk to the biggest auto manufacturers. They have a lot to offer.' Companies in these discussions include General Motors Co, Ford Motor Co, Toyota Motor Corp, Daimler AG, and Volkswagen AG. Google has not decided whether it will manufacture its own self-driving vehicles or focus on providing systems and software to established automakers. Google’s self-driving prototype cars were built in Detroit by engineering and specialty manufacturing firm Roush. Jon Lauckner, chief technology officer of GM, said the company is open to working with Google on self-driving cars. Urmson believes fully autonomous vehicles could be production-ready within five years, sharing a similar view to Elon Musk, CEO of Tesla Motors, who believes a lack of clear federal regulations might delay the rollout until 2022 or 2023. Urmson said Google does not anticipate significant regulatory obstacles and has been regularly briefing the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. Google is refining self-driving technology with suppliers such as Continental AG, Robert Bosch, ZF, and LG Electronics. The prototype cars use Nvidia microprocessors. Continental began discussions with Google in 2012 to supply tires, electronics, and other components. Soon, Google will deploy a fleet of fully-functioning prototypes. These pod-like cars lack a steering wheel, brakes, and accelerator pedal, relying instead on buttons to start and end trips, and a computer system that processes data from radar, lasers, and cameras. Passengers set destinations via maps or commands. The cars are expected to be electric and travel up to 100 miles before recharging. The front of the vehicle features soft, foam-like material instead of a standard bumper and a flexible windscreen for pedestrian safety. Prototypes are currently limited to 25 mph and operate on specifically mapped routes, with the potential for expansion as mapping improves. Advanced sensors provide a 360-degree view, allowing the car to detect people, vehicles, road signs, markings, and traffic lights. Urmson noted the prototype’s basic design is intended for testing and will evolve, saying, 'Airliners today don’t look like the Wright brothers’ flyer.' Self-driving cars, he explained, could transform transportation, providing mobility to individuals like the blind, elderly, and disabled. Urmson also emphasized the complexity and innovation found in the auto industry, especially in Detroit.

Chris Urmson, agaasimaha mashruuca baabuurta iswada ee Google, ayaa yiri, 'Waan qaldanaan lahayn in aanan la hadlin shirkadaha waaweyn ee baabuurta. Wax badan bay ku soo kordhinayaan.' Shirkadaha wadahadalada lala leeyahay waxaa kamid ah General Motors Co, Ford Motor Co, Toyota Motor Corp, Daimler AG, iyo Volkswagen AG. Google waxay la shaqeyneysaa shirkado ay ka mid yihiin Continental AG, Robert Bosch, ZF, iyo LG Electronics si loo horumariyo tignoolajiyada baabuurta iswada. Baabuurtaasi waxay isticmaalaan microprocessor-ka Nvidia. Continental waxay Google kala hadashay sannadkii 2012 sidii loo siin lahaa taayirro, elektronik iyo qaybaha kale ee baabuurta. Rakaabka waxay meelaha ay doonayaan ku dooranayaan khariidadda ama amaro ahaan. Baabuurtaasi waxay yihiin kuwo koronto ku shaqeeya isla markaana safri kara ilaa 100 mayl ka hor intaysan dib u dallacin. Hore baabuurka waxaa kaga yaal walax laami ah oo jilicsan iyo daaqad la laabi karo si loo badbaadiyo dadka wadada maraya. Baabuurta tijaabada ah waxa la xadiday 25 mph, waxayna ku socdaan wadooyin si gaar ah loogu sameeyay khariidadda Google, iyadoo suurtagal ah in la ballaariyo mustaqbalka marka khariidadaha la balaariyo. Dareemayaal heer sare ah ayaa ka dhiga gaariga inuu si buuxda u arko 360-degree, taasoo u suurta galinaysa inuu garto dadka, gaadiidka kale, calaamadaha wadada, iyo iftiinka taraafikada. Baabuurta iswada waxay bedeli karaan qaabka gaadiidka, oo waxay fursad siin karaan dadka indhaha la', da'da iyo naafada ah inay si fudud u safraan. Urmson wuxuu sidoo kale tusaale u soo qaatay hal-abuurka ka jira shirkaadaha baabuurta, gaar ahaan Detroit.

article_content: Reports have surfaced of an alleged blasphemous incident at the Kartarpur Sahib Gurudwara in Pakistan, where a dance party was organized and alcohol was consumed within the sacred premises. Indian politician Manjinder Singh Sirsa of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) strongly condemned the event, urging the Pakistan government to take strict action against those responsible, including members of the local Kartarpur administration. Jathedar Giani Harpreet Singh of Takht Damdama Sahib described the incident as ‘unfortunate’ and reiterated the demand for accountability, emphasizing the religious significance of Kartarpur Sahib to Sikhs globally. Gurcharan Singh Grewal, spokesperson for the Sikh Gurudwara Prabandhak Committee (SGPC), also called for prompt action and urged the Jathedar of Akal Takht Kartarpur Sahib to clarify his position to help prevent future incidents. A similar controversy arose in 2021 when a Pakistani model’s photoshoot without covering her head at the Gurdwara drew widespread social media criticism. SGPC President Harjinder Singh Dhami and Delhi Sikh Gurdwara Management Committee President Harmeet Singh Kalka have taken note of the recent incident, highlighting potential violations of Sikh ‘maryada’ (code of conduct) and the need for stricter management of religious sites. Given the immense spiritual importance of the Kartarpur Sahib Gurudwara to Sikhs worldwide, any perceived disrespect at the site elicits strong reactions from the community.

Siyaasiga Hindiya ee Manjinder Singh Sirsa oo ka tirsan xisbiga BJP ayaa si adag u cambaareeyay falkan, isagoo ugu baaqay dowladda Pakistan in ay tallaabo adag ka qaaddo kuwa ku lugta leh, oo ay ku jiraan maamulka maxalliga ah ee Kartarpur. Gurcharan Singh Grewal, afhayeenka Guddiga Maamulka Gurudwara Sikh (SGPC), ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqay in si degdeg ah loo qaado tallaabooyin, isagoo ugu baaqay Jathedar-ka Akal Takht Kartarpur Sahib inuu caddeeyo mowqifkiisa si laga hortago dhacdooyin mustaqbalka ah. Xiisad la mid ah ayaa horay uga dhacday 2021 markaasoo sawirro ay qaadday gabadh Pakistani ah oo aan madaxeedu daboolnayn laga qaaday Gurdwara taasoo keentay dhaleeceyn weyn baraha bulshada. Madaxweynaha SGPC Harjinder Singh Dhami iyo Madaxweynaha Guddiga Maamulka Gurudwara ee Delhi Harmeet Singh Kalka ayaa adkeeyay muhiimada ilaalinta nidaamka 'maryada' ee Sikh-yada iyo baahida loo qabo in si hufan loo maamulo goobaha diimaha. Kartarpur Sahib Gurudwara waxa ay qiime diimeed aad u weyn ugu leedahay Sikh-yada dunida oo dhan. Xadgudub kasta oo lagula kaco goobtan, waxaa dhasha falcelin adag oo ay muujiyaan bulshada Sikh.

article_content: In September, just a couple of months before he won this year's Booker Prize, Paul Lynch, 46, posted a photo featuring five of the six shortlisted authors: Sarah Bernstein (Study for Obedience), fellow Irish writer Paul Murray (The Bee Sting), Chetna Maroo (Western Lane), himself (for his fifth novel, Prophet Song), and Paul Harding (This Other Eden). Lynch wrote, 'This is a wondrous moment for me and I’m so pleased to be sharing it with these superb writers, including my friend Paul Murray. Seamus Heaney wrote in North: "Expect aurora borealis in the long foray…" Last night, there was light in the sky.' Irish writers have long shone in the literary sky of the Booker Prize since it began in 1969. Lynch is the fifth Irish writer to win, for his novel depicting a dystopian Ireland where democratic rights are threatened by a totalitarian regime. Previous Irish winners include British-Irish novelist Iris Murdoch (The Sea, The Sea, 1978), Roddy Doyle (Paddy Clarke Ha Ha Ha, 1993), John Banville (The Sea, 2005), and Anne Enright (The Gathering, 2007). In 2018, Anna Burns from Northern Ireland won for Milkman. The strong presence of Irish writers is also visible in the entries for the Prize: since its inception, 37 Irish authors have reached the longlist. In the past 15 years, at least one Irish writer has made it to the longlists annually. This year, four out of the 13 longlisted authors were Irish, the highest number in a single year, including Lynch, Murray, Elaine Feeney (How to Build a Boat), and Sebastian Barry (Old God's Time). This marked Barry’s fifth Booker nomination and Murray’s second, after previously being longlisted in 2010 for Skippy Dies. Irish literary achievement extends beyond the Booker Prize. Four Irish writers — William Butler Yeats (1923), George Bernard Shaw (1925), Samuel Beckett (1969), and Seamus Heaney (1995) — have won the Nobel Prize in Literature. Yeats was an early admirer of Rabindranath Tagore's work, and they developed a friendship in the early 1900s which led to collaborations, including translation projects. Tagore won the Nobel Prize in 1913, a decade before Yeats. British writer Thomas Hardy, who was also nominated that year, once dismissed Tagore's success as largely due to Yeats. Irish literature has often been shaped by challenging circumstances. The 19th century was marked by the Great Famine, while the 20th saw strict censorship and strong influence from the Catholic Church. This adversity gave rise to diverse writing: Bram Stoker's gothic horror, Oscar Wilde's stories and plays, James Joyce's modernism, Yeats’ spiritual poetry, Samuel Beckett's absurdist plays, and Edna O’Brien’s radical memoirs. These trailblazers paved the way for a more emancipated generation: Colm Tóibín, Banville, Emma Donoghue, Tana French, Eimer McBride, Sally Rooney, and Claire Keegan. This year's winner Paul Lynch, based in Dublin, started his career as a journalist and film critic for The Sunday Tribune. His debut novel, Red Sky in Morning (2013), followed an auction among six publishers, launching his writing career. Lynch began working on Prophet Song in 2018. Speaking about the book, he describes it as an attempt at 'radical empathy.' After his win, Lynch told The Guardian he never aimed for happy endings or easy answers: 'Too often writers of political fiction believe they have the answers, they know what needs fixing.' Lynch, however, wanted readers to confront harsh realities rather than look away.

Lynch wuxuu qoray, 'Waa waqti cajiib ah aniga, aad ayayna ii farxad gelinaysaa inaan la wadaago qoraayaashan kartida badan, oo uu ka mid yahay saaxiibkay Paul Murray. Seamus Heaney wuxuu ku qoray North: "Sug iftiin waqooyi mida dabeecadda dheer..." Habeenkii hore, cirka iftiin baa ka muuqday.' Qoraayaasha Irish-ka ah waxay muddo dheer ka ifayeen abaalmarinta Booker tan iyo markii la bilaabay 1969. Lynch waa qoraagii shanaad ee Irish ah ee ku guuleysta, wuxuuna buugiisa Prophet Song ku muujiyay Ireland mustaqbal madow leh oo xuquuqda dimuqraadiyada ay khatar ku jirto xukun kali-talis ah darteed. Qoraayaashii hore ee Irish-ka ahaa ee guuleystay waxaa ka mid ah: Iris Murdoch (The Sea, The Sea, 1978), Roddy Doyle (Paddy Clarke Ha Ha Ha, 1993), John Banville (The Sea, 2005), iyo Anne Enright (The Gathering, 2007). Sannadkii 2018, Anna Burns oo ka soo jeeda Waqooyiga Ireland ayaa ku guuleysatay Milkman. Qoraayaashu Irish waxay sidoo kale si xooggan uga muuqdaan tartamada abaalmarinta: tan iyo bilawgeedii, 37 qoraa Irish ah ayaa gaaray liiska dheer ee abaalmarinta. 15 sano ee u dambeysay, ugu yaraan hal qoraa Irish ah ayaa sanad walba liiska gaaban galay. Sanadkan, afar ka mid ah 13-kii qoraa ee liiska dheer waxaa ahaayeen Irish—taasoo ah tirada ugu badan hal sano—oo ay ka mid yihiin Lynch, Murray, Elaine Feeney (How to Build a Boat), iyo Sebastian Barry (Old God’s Time). Barry waxaa tani u aheyd markiisii shanaad ee Booker, Murray-na tan labaad, isagoo markii hore la liistay 2010 (Skippy Dies). Guusha suugaanta Irish-ka ah ma eka abaalmarinta Booker. Afar qoraa Irish—William Butler Yeats (1923), George Bernard Shaw (1925), Samuel Beckett (1969) iyo Seamus Heaney (1995)—ayaa ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Nobel ee Suugaanta. Yeats wuxuu ahaa taageere hore ee shaqada Rabindranath Tagore, waxayna saaxiibtinimo la yeesheen horraantii 1900-meeyadii taasoo horseeday iskaashi, oo ay ku jirto turjumaad. Tagore wuxuu Nobel ku guuleystay 1913, toban sano ka hor Yeats. Qoraa British ah Thomas Hardy—oo sidoo kale lagu magacaabay sanadkaa—wuxuu ku tilmaamay guusha Tagore in ay badankeed ka timid taageerada Yeats. Suugaanta Irish-ka badanaa waxa ay ku korodhay duruufo adag. Qarnigii 19aad waxaa asqaaday aafo badan iyo macaluul, halka qarnigii 20aad la kulmay xeerar adag iyo saameyn xooggan oo kaniisada Catholic ah. Dhibahan waxay kor u qaadeen suugaan kala duwan: cabsi-gelinta gothic ee Bram Stoker, sheekooyinka iyo riwaayadaha Oscar Wilde, casriyeynta James Joyce, gabayada ruuxiga ah ee Yeats, riwaayadaha absurd-ka Beckett, iyo xusuus-qorka Edna O'Brien. Qoraa-yashan hore waxay fureen waddada jiilka cusub ee xor ah: Colm Tóibín, Banville, Emma Donoghue, Tana French, Eimer McBride, Sally Rooney, iyo Claire Keegan. Paul Lynch, guuleystaha sanadkan oo fadhigiisu yahay Dublin, wuxuu barnaamijkiisii suugaaneed ka bilaabay wargeyska The Sunday Tribune oo uu ahaa tifaftire filimo. Buuggiisa ugu horeeyay, Red Sky in Morning (2013), waxa uu ahaa mid loollan adag kaga jiray lix daabacayaal, taasoo si wanaagsan u billaawday xirfaddiisa. Lynch wuxuu shaqada Prophet Song bilaabay 2018. Isagoo ka hadlayay buugga, wuxuu sheegay inuu ka rabo 'xasaasiyad baaxad leh.' Markii uu guuleystay kaddib, Lynch wuxuu u sheegay The Guardian inuusan marna jeclayn in uu dhiso dhamaad farxad leh ama xal fudud: 'Badanaa, qoraayaasha sheekooyinka siyaasadda waxay u arkaan in ay iyagu hayaan jawaabaha la baahan yahay.’ Wuxuu rabay in akhristayaashu ay dhab ahaan wajahan dhibaatooyinka halkii ay indhaha ka qabsan lahaayeen.

article_content: A plunging neckline that dips several inches below a woman's chest is the latest low-cut fashion trend, popular among celebrities like Kim Kardashian, Rita Ora, and Sienna Miller. But will this bold style catch on in everyday life? Kate Hudson, 35, was one of the stars to wear this look on the red carpet, with a striking white gown cut to the navel at the Golden Globes. Sienna Miller and Jennifer Lopez also wore similar outfits at the event. Off the red carpet, Kim Kardashian, 34, went out in New York without a bra, despite the cold weather. Rita Ora drew attention and over 400 complaints when she appeared on BBC1's The One Show in a white blazer buttoned only at the stomach, with nothing underneath. To see if this trend works for everyday women, writer Deni Kirkova, 24, from London, tried out the deep neckline while walking through Kensington High Street to see how the public would react. The plunging neckline trend has grown over recent months, helped by stars like Miranda Kerr and Cara Delevingne. The article explores whether the look suits those outside celebrity circles. During her experiment, Deni wore a black outfit from New Look and H&M while walking through Kensington High Street. The public's reactions ranged from compliments to remarks about the outfit being revealing, especially considering the cold. Fashion experts noted that confidence and considering body shape are important for this look. Celebrity stylist Claire Wacey recommended the trend for those with a toned bust and suggested using tape for support, aiming to keep the style elegant. Fashion writer Simon Glazin said that adding a blazer can make the plunging neckline more wearable and sophisticated for non-celebrities. Deni felt both confident and self-conscious during the experiment, highlighting ongoing conversations about fashion and body positivity. The article features opinions from various passers-by and encourages personal choice and empowerment in fashion.

article_content: Meiran Galis is the CEO and cofounder of Scytale, specializing in security compliance and passionate about supporting the growth of SaaS companies.  There was a time when information security and compliance for small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) seemed novel. Each business navigated unique cybersecurity challenges, often struggling due to the lack of standardization across industries, constant changes in the threat landscape, and increasing demands from customers and regulators.  Today, artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming integral to business operations. This integration brings forward new questions: What are the potential downsides of using AI, and what new risks does it create? As AI capabilities expand rapidly, so do concerns about the need for stronger AI compliance regulations. While taking calculated risks can enable progress—especially in industries that leverage generative AI (GenAI)—we need to be clear on what these risks are.  Why is regulating artificial intelligence necessary? I believe it’s vital to participate in the ongoing conversation about AI regulation. There may be opposing perspectives, but at a minimum, clear rules or guidelines are needed for the development, deployment, and application of GenAI. My main concern involves using GenAI as a “black box”—where data goes in, and an output comes out, but businesses lack visibility into the decision-making process. This lack of transparency becomes a significant concern when sensitive data, like protected health information (PHI) or personally identifiable information (PII), is involved.  If GenAI processes or makes decisions based on sensitive data, what are the risks to privacy, security, or the potential for errors and biases? With so many unanswered questions and limited transparency, relying solely on GenAI is risky.  However, shunning GenAI is not the solution. AI is already transforming business practices and brings significant benefits. Yet, without effective regulation, AI’s strengths can be misused or become liabilities. With great power comes great responsibility. The emerging era of defined AI compliance regulations calls for responsible use and proactive ownership of AI’s advantages.  Are there any recent developments in AI regulation? Let’s explore.  Three regions—the US, EU, and China—have made the most significant moves in implementing AI compliance regulations. According to Stanford University's 2023 AI Index, 37 AI-related bills were passed into law worldwide in 2022. Their approaches differ:  - Market-Driven (US): Regulations are often reactive, introduced after issues emerge. - Rights-Based (EU): Focuses on individual rights, as seen in the GDPR. - State-Driven (China): The government guides and funds AI development as part of a national strategy.  Rather than dissecting legislative details, it’s important to consider how these frameworks might shape future business practices regarding AI.  What can we expect from new AI compliance regulations? The regulation of AI is complex and evolving, but businesses shouldn't wait to act. Managing risk has always been essential—even more so as organizations leverage AI advances. Here are some potential regulatory measures:  - Regulation to prevent malicious uses of AI (e.g., deepfakes or AI-generated propaganda), with clear guidelines for acceptable AI use in fields like politics and journalism. - New or enhanced ethical frameworks outlining responsible AI development and deployment principles—this has been the preferred route for regulating security standards. - The creation of dedicated regulatory agencies to oversee and enforce AI compliance.  How should organizations prepare? Organizations should remain proactive and vigilant regarding information security, whether or not they use AI. Complacency is risky. Simple, consistent steps—such as setting internal AI use policies, strengthening governance, and fostering human accountability—can make a significant difference. Staying informed and adaptable will be key as the regulatory landscape develops.  Exciting advancements lie ahead—as do new rules.  Forbes Technology Council is an invitation-only community for leading CIOs, CTOs, and technology executives.
translated_content: Meiran Galis waa agaasimaha guud iyo aasaasaha Scytale, kuna takhasusay waafaqsanaanta amniga, waxna ka taraya kobcinta shirkadaha SaaS.  Waxaa jiray xilli amniga macluumaadka iyo waafaqsanaanta shirkadaha yaryar iyo kuwa dhexdhexaadka ah (SMBs) lagu tiri jiray fikrad cusub. Shirkad kastaa waxay la kulmi jirtay caqabado amni oo u gaar ah, marar badanna way ku adkaan jirtay la’aanta halbeegyo la isku waafaqsan yahay, isbedelka degdegga ah ee khataraha, iyo kororka baahida macaamiisha iyo xeer-dejiyeyaasha.  Hadda, sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) wuxuu noqday mid muhiim u ah ganacsiyada. Tani waxay dhalisay su’aalo cusub: Maxaa khasaaro ka imaan kara isticmaalka AI, maxaase khataro cusub oo uu keeni karaa? Maaddaama awoodda AI si xawli ah u kortay, welwelka la xiriira xeerar waafaqsan AI ayaa kasii xoogaysanaya. Halista la oggol yahay mararka qaar hormar bay keentaa—gaar ahaan warshadaha isticmaala generative AI (GenAI)—laakiin waxay muhiim tahay in la fahmo qatarta jirta.  Maxay muhiim u tahay in la xakameeyo AI? Waxaan qabaa in la qayb qaato dooda xeerarka AI ay lama huraan tahay. Aragtiyo kala duwan way jiraan, laakiin ugu yaraan waa lagama maarmaan in la helo sharciyo ama tilmaamo cad oo kuu qeexaya horumarinta, hirgelinta, iyo isticmaalka GenAI. Waxa igu weyn welwel ahaan waa in GenAI loo adeegsado 'sanduuq madow'—xog la galiya, natiijana lagu soo saaro, iyadoo aan si buuxda loo fahmin waxa ka socda dhexda. La’aanta hufnaantani waxay arrin weyn tahay marka xog xasaasi ah sida PHI ama PII la shaqaynayo.  Haddii GenAI ay shaqeyso ama go’aan ka gaarto xog xasaasi ah, maxay yihiin halista asturnaanta, amniga, ama khaladaadka iyo eexda iman kara? Su’aalo badan iyo hufnaan la’aan darteed, ku tiirsanaanta kaliya GenAI waa khatar.  Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ka baaqsashada GenAI xal ma aha. AI durbaba wuxuu bedelayaa dhaqanka ganacsiga wuxuuna leeyahay faa’iidooyin muuqda. Laakiin la’aanta xeerar waxtar leh, xooggiisa waxaa laga yaabaa in si xun loo adeegsado ama uu khatar u noqdo. Marka la leeyahay awood weyn, mas’uuliyad weyni waa ay la socotaa. Waqtigan xeerarka AI waxa uu u baahan yahay in si mas’uuliyad leh loo maareeyo lana xakameeyo faa’iidooyinkiisa.  Miyaan horumaro cusub oo xeerar AI ah jirin? Aan eegno.  Saddexda gobol—Mareykanka, Midowga Yurub (EU), iyo Shiinaha—ayaa kaalmo weyn ka qaatay hirgelinta xeerar waafaqsan AI. Sida uu sheegay Stanford University's 2023 AI Index, 37 sharci oo la xiriira AI ayaa la ansixiyay adduunka 2022. Hababkoodu waa kala duwan yihiin:  - Mareykanka: Hab suuq-ku-xiran; xeerar inta badan la hirgeliyo marka ay dhibaato dhacdo. - EU: Hab xuquuq-ku-xiran; xooggu saaranyahay ilaalinta xuquuqda shaqsiyeed (tusaale GDPR). - Shiinaha: Hab dowlad-ku-xiran; dowladda ayaa si weyn u hagta oo maalgashata horumarinta AI.  Taa beddelkeeda, wuxuu muhiim u yahay sidii xeerarkani u saameyn doonaan habka mustaqbalka ee AI loo isticmaali doono ganacsiyada.  Maxaynu ka filan karnaa xeerarka AI? Xeer dejinta AI wali waa geedi socod adag, balse shirkaduhu waa inay ka hawlgalaan. Maaraynta khataraha weligeed ma noqon mid xun—gaar ahaan marka la isticmaalayo tignoolajiyada AI. Talooyin la filan karo waxaa kamid ah:  - Xeerar la dhigo si looga hortago adeegsiga xun ee AI (tusaale deepfakes ama borobogaando AI), iyadoo lasiiyo tilmaamo cad sida loo adeegsan karo AI meelaha siyaasadda ama saxaafadda. - Sameynta ama dheereynta xeerar anshaxeed oo qeexaya horumarka iyo adeegsiga mas’uuliyadda leh ee AI—waa habkii hore loogu tijaabiyay xeerarka amniga. - Abuurka hay’ado gaar ah oo ilaaliya fulinta iyo kormeerka xeerarka AI.  Sidee shirkaduhu ugu diyaar garoobi karaan? Waa in shirkadahu si feejigan u ekaadaan oo horey uga shaqeeyaan amniga xogtooda, inay isticmaalaan AI ama kale. Dayacaaddu waa khatar. Tilaabooyin fudud oo joogto ah—sida sameynta xeerar gudaha ah oo u gaar ah AI-da, xoojinta isla xisaabtanka, iyo maamul wanaagga—waxa ay wax badan ka tarayaan. La soco macluumaadka cusub oo la sii jaanqaad horumarka.  Waa xilli xiise leh—iyo xeerar cusub oo la socda!  Forbes Technology Council waa bulsho casri ah oo loogu talagalay madaxda ugu sareysa CIO-yada, CTO-yada, iyo hogaamiyayaasha teknoolajiyadda.

article_content: Manchester United and Liverpool are competing for Norwegian teenage football sensation Martin Odegaard. The two rivals were among those closely watching the 15-year-old's international debut this week, when Odegaard became Norway’s youngest-ever player after coming on against the UAE. While it’s easy to forget his youth, Odegaard’s shirt number is also his age. The secret is out about the Stromsgodset midfielder, as scouts from Barcelona, Real Madrid, and Juventus joined English club representatives in the stands at Stavanger. These top European clubs will again attend when Odegaard and Norway face England at Wembley next week. Abel Hernandez is set to complete a club-record £10 million move from Palermo to Hull City on Friday, but a work permit hearing may prevent his immediate debut. While the transfer fee, close to £10 million, has been agreed, Hernandez still needs necessary paperwork before finalizing the deal. Hernandez, who has completed a medical and agreed personal terms, has 14 Uruguay caps and played at the World Cup in Brazil. Manager Steve Bruce does not expect work permit problems, but the delay means Hernandez will miss Sunday’s match at Aston Villa. Meanwhile, Bruce is searching for a replacement for injured Robert Snodgrass, with West Ham’s Mo Diame and Manchester United’s Tom Cleverley among his top targets. Sunderland defender Valentin Roberge could return to France, with Ligue 1 club Reims in talks for the former Maritimo signing. His departure could make way for Celtic’s Virgil van Dijk to arrive at Sunderland. Celtic are open to selling the 23-year-old Dutch centre-back, seeking a fee of around £8 million but may accept £6 million due to missing out on Champions League qualification. Southampton are also interested in Van Dijk. James McArthur is expected to choose Crystal Palace over Leicester City, despite both clubs making bids for the Wigan midfielder. Selhurst Park appears to be his likely destination. Metalist Kharkiv winger Sebastian Blanco is set to sign with West Brom for £2 million, becoming their 11th signing of the summer.
