article_content: Amid ongoing struggles with severe air pollution in multiple Indian cities, the government has found that several leading car manufacturers—including Hyundai, Kia, Honda Cars, Renault, Skoda Auto, Volkswagen India, and Nissan—were producing fleets with emission levels higher than allowed by current standards, according to a TOI report. The Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) has recommended hefty penalties, amounting to hundreds of crores of rupees, for these violations. This move is a result of the implementation of stricter Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) norms, which have been in effect since January 2023. These norms restrict the overall CO2 emissions from a manufacturer's fleet, factoring in both the weight and sales numbers of each model. With major metropolitan areas—such as Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, along with cities in Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana, and Uttar Pradesh—battling hazardous pollution and record-breaking Air Quality Index (AQI) levels, the issue has drawn serious concern from the Supreme Court. The court has called on both central and state authorities to take swift action and levy fines against those who violate pollution norms. Under the Energy Conservation (Amendment) Bill 2022, adopted by Parliament in December 2022, car companies exceeding their assigned emission norms face significant fines: Rs 25,000 per unit sold if fleet emissions are 0–4.7g/km above the cap, and Rs 50,000 per vehicle if emissions surpass the cap by more than 4.7g/km. According to BEE's data, Kia will face the largest penalty at Rs 373 crore for excess fleet emissions (7.7g/km above the limit during January–March 2023). Hyundai is close behind, with Rs 370 crore in penalties for exceeding its cap by 4.4g/km. Other penalties include Honda Cars (Rs 103 crore, 17g/km above), Renault (Rs 75 crore, 15g/km above), Nissan (Rs 41 crore, 15g/km above), Skoda Auto Volkswagen (Rs 59 crore, 1.1g/km above), and Force Motors (Rs 0.7 crore, 46g/km above). Mahindra & Mahindra may also face penalties, although the company says its vehicles remained within the limits during the period in question. Most companies declined to comment, except Nissan, which stated they have not yet received any official government notification regarding these penalties. In contrast to those penalized, several carmakers—including Maruti Suzuki, Tata Motors, MG Motor, Toyota Kirloskar, Mercedes-Benz, Jaguar Land Rover, Volvo Auto, and FCA India—remained well below their CO2 emission targets. Many of these have managed to do so by including CNG, hybrid, and electric vehicles in their product lines.

article_content: The Republican Party continues to face difficulties connecting with African-American voters, a challenge that was heightened by the controversy involving Cliven Bundy. Bundy, once presented as a hardworking rancher challenging federal authorities, was later revealed to have racist views. Support from armed militias and certain right-wing commentators further linked him to extremist elements, which has alienated many, particularly African-Americans. Strong criticisms of President Obama by some conservative figures have contributed to a sense of exclusion among minorities. Andrew Napolitano of Fox News, for instance, made public statements questioning Obama's fitness for office, reflecting a rhetoric that some believe undermines the GOP’s relationship with minority communities. Some observers argue that the Republican National Committee often blames the mainstream media rather than taking responsibility. Rev. Tony Minor of the People For the American Way’s African American Ministers in Action has pointed out that silence from GOP leaders on these issues diminishes hopes for stronger relationships. While some conservatives, such as Sen. Dean Heller, initially supported Bundy, many distanced themselves following his remarks. The RNC’s Sean Spicer has at times deflected concerns by focusing criticism on Democrats, sidestepping discussion about Republican outreach. Political scientist Larry Sabato stresses the necessity for the GOP to reach out more effectively and work on positive engagement with minority voters, noting that incidents perceived as insulting damage the party’s chances. Commentators like Marc Lamont Hill have highlighted that certain mainstream Republican positions resemble Bundy’s controversial comments. Crystal Wright, a conservative Republican, has urged the party to genuinely include minorities and women at all levels to prevent future missteps. Within the GOP, there are differing views on how to address these issues. Tara Wall, a senior Republican National Committee staffer, disagreed with some criticisms and pointed to media coverage as a contributing factor. The RNC has emphasized the importance of making African-American leaders visible in significant decision-making roles, not just outreach, underlining the need for greater transparency. In conclusion, the Republican Party’s efforts to win over African-American voters continue to face obstacles, exacerbated by figures like Cliven Bundy and the reactions that followed.

article_content: Victoria Beckham, known for her poised demeanor and renowned fashion sense, drew global attention by participating in Vogue.com’s '73 Questions' video series. In the film, she welcomed the Vogue team into her pristine Dover Street store, dressed in an all-white ensemble from her own collection, and revealed personal details ranging from her favorite drink to the reason she rarely smiles. Comedian Holly Burn crafted a parody of Victoria’s interview, playfully imitating her mannerisms and style while adding comedic twists. Dressed similarly to Victoria, Burn led viewers through a corner shop, reflecting the original video’s format but answering questions with tongue-in-cheek humor. For example, where Victoria says she checks on her kids first thing in the morning, Holly claims she eats a Pop-Tart. Throughout the parody, Holly showcased store items with playful exaggeration, selecting Gillette shaving foam as her 'favorite item.' When asked what superpower she would like, she jokingly replied, 'I would like to be able to count again,' before ultimately storming out of the shop at the last question. Amy Dallmeyer co-produced the spoof video. Victoria responded to the parody by tweeting a link with a smirking emoji, demonstrating she enjoyed the lighthearted homage. Victoria Beckham launched her fashion brand in 2008, opening her flagship Dover Street store in September. Her company has experienced significant growth, and she reportedly aspires to open additional stores in the United States and Japan. The Vogue '73 Questions' format is known for being tailored to each celebrity, with previous features including Sarah Jessica Parker and Blake Lively.

A live CBS report in Chicago was unexpectedly cut short when a protester interrupted reporter Jay Levine as he covered President Obama’s fundraising visit. The protester, clad in a hooded sweatshirt, grabbed the microphone and shouted accusations against Obama.

While CBS ended its live feed, NBC Chicago captured the chaos and the reactions of their reporter, Mary Ann Ahern. Both she and her cameraman turned to the disturbance as the situation escalated. Eventually, someone held the protester to the ground, while Levine appeared shaken. Soon, three mounted police officers arrived to restore order and remained nearby as Levine resumed his report. With a brief joke about his new escort, he continued broadcasting. Clips of the incident from both networks were later shared online.

article_content: The families of three firefighters who died in a warehouse blaze have criticized the chief fire officer of Warwickshire Fire and Rescue Service after he welcomed the acquittal of three senior colleagues who were previously charged with manslaughter. Graeme Smith, the Chief Fire Officer, stated that Adrian Ashley, Paul Simmons, and Timothy Woodward were wrongly treated like criminals following the 2007 fire at Atherstone-on-Stour. A jury at Stafford Crown Court found watch manager Ashley and station manager Woodward not guilty of gross negligence manslaughter after a six-week trial concerning the deaths of Ashley Stephens, Darren Yates-Badley, John Averis, and Ian Reid. Simmons had already been acquitted by the judge during the trial. Despite a £4.7 million, five-year investigation, police never found the arsonists responsible. Instead, efforts focused on the managers who allowed firefighters to enter the warehouse, despite all employees being accounted for. After the verdict, Mr. Smith asserted that the case should never have gone to court, calling for an inquiry into the prosecution of the firefighters. At a press conference, relatives of Mr. Stephens, Mr. Reid, and Mr. Yates-Badley expressed disappointment in the fire service's support following the November 2 fire at a vegetable packing plant. The family of Mr. Averis attended but did not make any statements. Julie Reid, widow of Ian Reid, said she was devastated by the acquittals. She questioned why Chief Fire Officer Smith believed the case was unnecessary, arguing that all actions must be accountable and that firefighters are not above the law. Mrs. Reid noted that a legal process must be followed and, even if the jury did not find guilt in this instance, the process itself could lead to improved safety for future incidents. She emphasized that firefighters' lives are not worth less than those of the public, nor worth risking for material goods. Mrs. Reid described the lack of support from the service after charges were brought, and expressed how her loss and grief are ongoing. Paul Stephens, father of Ashley Stephens and a firefighter present at the scene, echoed these feelings in a statement, noting that the images from the night had left deep emotional scars and that support from the service had diminished after the investigation began. Mandy Baylis, mother of Darren Yates-Badley, shared her continuing grief and feelings of abandonment by the fire service community. Chief Fire Officer Smith, speaking to the media at the trial's conclusion, reiterated that the case should not have gone to court and criticized the police investigation as misdirected. He emphasized that the true perpetrators—the arsonists—remained at large while the officers were treated like criminals. He added that Warwickshire Fire and Rescue Service and the Chief Fire Officers' Association would seek a formal investigation into why the charges were brought. Some fear the case may make firefighters hesitant to take action, while police maintain the investigation was justified and hope the tragedy prompts lessons to be learned. The Fire Brigades Union condemned the lack of prosecutions against the arsonists compared to the intense focus on the firefighters. Andy Dark, the union's assistant general secretary, noted this was the first prosecution of its kind, casting a shadow over the service and leaving firefighters frustrated with police and prosecutors, while the arsonists remain free.

article_content: The Maharashtra government, led by Eknath Shinde, is under considerable pressure as the demand for reservation and a sense of betrayal by political leaders have brought the Maratha community together, despite its economic divisions. Marathas constitute roughly 33% of Maharashtra's estimated 120 million people and include sub-groups such as the Kunbis, who are largely farmers. The Marathas have significant political representation; since Maharashtra's formation in 1960, at least 14 of the 20 chief ministers have come from this community. Many Marathas are also influential in sugar cooperatives and educational institutions. However, the community experiences a significant economic divide. Farmers, particularly from drought-hit regions like Marathwada, are leading calls for reservation and OBC status. Activist Manoj Jarange led protests in September and October, demanding Kunbi certificates for all Marathas to enable them to access reservation benefits under the OBC category. A government survey indicates that Marathas hold about 14% of government jobs, but are underrepresented in higher-ranking positions. Similarly, although many Marathas serve in the police, most are in lower ranks. Experts attribute this to ongoing reliance on agriculture, which has declined, worsening economic conditions. Many Marathas blame political leaders for not supporting the community’s advancement. Writer Sadanand More observes that while some Marathas have prospered, the majority remain poor and dependent on farming. He explains that family land divisions have shrunk individual holdings, contributing to poverty, and calls for both reservation and a focus on agriculture revitalization. Despite their political clout, many Marathas are disillusioned with leaders across parties, feeling their interests have not been addressed. This has led nearly 500 villages to bar politicians from entering. Rajendra Kunjir, coordinator of the Maratha Kranti Morcha, says there is a growing belief that politicians use the community for votes without resolving quotas. He notes that during recent protests, leaders were reluctant to engage, intensifying frustration. Other community leaders assert that the government is stalling, aiming to postpone action until after state and national elections to avoid backlash from the Marathas if the issue is unresolved. Some experts, like Pravin Gaikwad of the Sambhaji Brigade, advocate focusing on skill-based education for upliftment rather than relying entirely on reservations. Gaikwad points out that privatization has reduced government jobs, limiting the impact of reservation, and that Marathas already benefit from nearly 8% of the state’s 10% EWS quota. He urges the community to improve its competitiveness through education and skills development.

Marathadu waxay yihiin ku dhawaad 33% dadka Maharashtra oo lagu qiyaaso 120 milyan, waxaana ka mid ah kooxaha-hoosaad sida Kunbi oo badankood yihiin beeraley. Marathadu waxay leeyihiin matalaad siyaasadeed oo ballaaran; tan iyo markii Maharashtra la aasaasay sanadka 1960, ugu yaraan 14 madaxwaynaha 20 ayaa ka soo jeeda bulshadaas. Qaar badan oo Maratha ah ayaa saameyn ku leh iskaashatooyinka sonkorta iyo xarumaha waxbarasho. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, bulshadu waxay la kulantaa farqi dhaqaale oo weyn. Sahan dowladeed ayaa muujiyay in Marathadu haystaan qiyaastii 14% shaqooyinka dowlada, balse ay ka liitaan jagooyinka sare. Sidoo kale, Marathadu waa kuwa ugu badan ee booliska ka tirsan, hase ahaatee, intooda badan waa darajo hoose. article_content:
Steven Williams, a 29-year-old patient, expressed concern over the quality and portion sizes of meals during his eight-day stay at Southmead Hospital in Bristol, following foot surgery. Williams described the food as inadequate and lacking nutritional balance, sharing photos that showed small portions—including a roast dinner with just one floret of broccoli, two potatoes, two pieces of cauliflower, and fatty beef. He also received a half-plate of chilli con carne on another day; when he asked for a different topping for a baked potato, he was given a small cheese sandwich instead. Williams felt there was little variety and reported that sometimes only limited meal options were available. He mentioned that his family had to bring food from home as even his two-year-old daughter would not be satisfied with the portions provided.

Southmead Hospital, managed by North Bristol NHS Trust, opened in May and has been awarded the Soil Association’s Food for Life silver catering award. Despite this recognition, Williams’ complaints and photos highlighted his dissatisfaction. Simon Wood, Director of Facilities at the NHS Trust, apologized, saying the meals shown were not typical and that portion sizes should have been larger. He stated steps are being taken to address the issue with ward staff and encouraged patients with concerns to speak with staff so issues can be resolved during their stay.

Nationally, hospital nutrition continues to be a concern. BAPEN reports that 40% of adult hospital patients and 15% of children are malnourished on admission, with many patients continuing to lose weight while in hospital. The British Dietetic Association (BDA) provides nutritional guidelines: adults should consume 1,810–2,550 calories a day, with those at nutritional risk needing 2,250–2,625 calories. Protein recommendations stand at 1g of protein per kilogram of body weight per day, and main meals should provide at least 15g of protein. Despite these guidelines, food intake in hospitals sometimes falls below recommended levels, especially among elderly patients.

article_content: In the Philippines, radio broadcaster Juan Jumalon, widely recognized as DJ Johnny Walker, was fatally shot while giving a live broadcast from his home studio, according to police. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has forcefully condemned this act; since he took office in June 2022, this marks the fourth journalist killed, as reported by the National Union of Journalists of the Philippines. The journalists' union stressed the gravity of the attack taking place in Jumalon's own residence, which also served as his radio station. The incident happened at approximately 5:30 a.m. local time while Jumalon was streaming live on Facebook. Police sources, cited by local media, said the suspected shooter asked to come into the broadcast room to make an important announcement before opening fire. Police have secured CCTV footage from the scene and have started investigating. Jumalon's radio programs were typically broadcast on the 94.7 Gold Mega Calamba FM Facebook page, which has close to 2,400 followers. After the shooting, Jumalon's wife rushed him to the hospital; however, he was pronounced dead on arrival. Authorities stated there were no prior reports of threats against him. President Marcos Jr. further stated on X that he has ordered law enforcement to carry out a comprehensive investigation to quickly hold those responsible to account. Freedom House, a US-based organization, continues to classify the Philippines as one of the world’s most dangerous places for journalists.

Madaxweynaha Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ayaa si xooggan u cambaareeyay falkaasi; tan iyo markii uu xafiiska la wareegay bishii Juun 2022, waxay tani ka dhigantahay saxafiyeedii afraad ee la dilo, sida uu sheegay Ururka Qaranka ee Saxafiyiinta Philippines. article_content: Finland is set to install barriers at four out of its eight border crossings with Russia starting at midnight, aiming to curb the number of asylum seekers entering the country. The Finnish Border Guard announced that these barriers will be positioned at Vaalimaa, Nuijamaa, Imatra, and Niirala, all located in southeastern Finland. Matti Pitkaniitty, head of international affairs for the Border Guard, stated that the goal is to physically block entry at these locations. This move follows changes in Russia's approach at the border, with Finnish officials alleging that Moscow is allowing or ignoring crossings by undocumented migrants—a claim Russia denies. The four crossings scheduled for closure are the busiest between the two countries, each handling about 3,000 crossings daily, along the 1,340-kilometer border Finland shares with Russia. Following Russia's invasion of Ukraine and Finland's decision to join NATO, Prime Minister Petteri Orpo accused Moscow of attempting to destabilize Finland in response. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen supported Finland’s action, calling Russia’s alleged manipulation of migrants 'shameful' and fully backing the Finnish response. Neighboring Norway, which also borders Russia, has indicated readiness to close its Arctic crossing if needed. As of Saturday, asylum seekers arriving from Russia will only be able to submit applications at two points: Salla and Vartius, both in the north. These restrictions come amid rising friction since Finland ended its non-alignment policy to join NATO in April 2023, following Russia’s attack on Ukraine. The Finnish Border Guard has reported increased arrivals of undocumented migrants, mainly from Africa and the Middle East. Helsinki’s ombudsman for non-discrimination has stressed that Finland remains bound by international and EU agreements to consider asylum claims. Meanwhile, Finland is building a 200-kilometer fence along part of the border, planned for completion by 2026.

Ilaalada Xuduudaha Finland ayaa shaaciyay in xannibaadahan la dhigi doono Vaalimaa, Nuijamaa, Imatra iyo Niirala, kuwaasoo dhamaantood ku yaal koonfur-bari Finland. article_content: During a visit to San Francisco, Chinese President Xi Jinping shared that China may soon send new giant pandas to the United States. He emphasized the pandas' role as 'envoys of friendship' between the two countries and acknowledged the enthusiasm from Californians, particularly those in San Diego, about their possible arrival. Xi made these comments following a face-to-face meeting with President Joe Biden, where both leaders aimed to ease tensions between their nations. Although specifics like the timeline and exact location were not announced, Xi hinted that San Diego could receive the next pair of pandas. Giant pandas have symbolized friendship between China and the U.S. since Beijing first gifted a pair to the Smithsonian National Zoo in Washington in 1972. Since then, China has loaned pandas to various American zoos, funneling the proceeds into conservation efforts. Recently, the National Zoo's three pandas—Mei Xiang, Tian Tian, and their cub Xiao Qi Ji—departed for China. Now, only four pandas remain in the U.S., all at the Atlanta Zoo. Xi remarked that many Americans, especially children, felt sad saying goodbye to the pandas and visited the zoo to see them off. He noted that the San Diego Zoo and California residents are looking forward to having pandas once again. Xi was attending an Indo-Pacific summit and held extensive talks with President Biden at the Filoli Historic House & Garden. The two agreed to enhance cooperation on anti-narcotics efforts, restart high-level military dialogue, and support more exchanges between citizens of both countries. In recent years, as bilateral relations cooled, discussions in China about returning the pandas grew, with some unverified social media claims alleging mistreatment in U.S. zoos. The relationship is now showing signs of improvement. The National Zoo's panda exchange agreement with the China Wildlife Conservation Association expired in December due to unsuccessful renewal negotiations. The San Diego Zoo returned its pandas in 2019, and Memphis Zoo sent its last panda back to China earlier this year.

article_content: Aliens: Colonial Marines delivers some enjoyment for fans, but ultimately doesn't meet the lofty hopes set for it. The game is placed after the classic film Aliens, letting players step into the role of Corporal Winter, a Marine sent to uncover what happened aboard the USS Sulaco and on LV-426. From stepping onto the ship and spotting familiar details, like the shattered Bishop android and personal marine lockers, the game pours on nostalgia and references. However, this dedication to the franchise can’t disguise the technical shortcomings. Visuals seem pulled from a bygone era, hiding large areas behind a bluish haze and offering muddled, sometimes absent, textures. While the shoot-and-move gameplay isn’t terrible, it's hindered by odd design choices. The motion tracker, which makes a famous blip when danger approaches, sits on the screen at all times. This removes suspense, making each mission feel more like target practice than an intense battle for survival. Facing human mercenaries from Weyland Industries instead of aliens also feels out of sync with the universe. The game does improve a little further in, offering moments like defending Hadley's Hope or sneaking past noise-sensitive aliens. Multiple types of Xenomorphs show the developer’s attention to the original movies. Unfortunately, poor AI drags things down, as enemies move awkwardly and teammates are often unhelpful, missing targets or fleeing at the worst times. Where the game shines is in multiplayer. Playing alongside friends changes the atmosphere, bringing in genuine teamwork whether you're covering each other during hacks or splitting duties around the map. Cooperative and competitive online modes create a dynamic, tactical back-and-forth, especially in Survivor mode—a highlight where humans try to outlast relentless Xenos. After such a long wait, fans were hoping for something timeless, which Colonial Marines isn’t. Still, it provides some fun moments and a welcome, if imperfect, journey for die-hard followers until a truly classic sequel emerges.

Markaad markabka gasho oo aad aragto waxyaabaha la yaqaan, sida Bishop android-ka ee jabay iyo almaaradaha askarta, ciyaartu waxay ku sii xoojisaa xusuusta iyo tixraaca filamka. article_content: Japanese Deputy Finance Minister Kenji Kanda resigned on Monday after admitting that his company repeatedly failed to pay taxes, intensifying criticism of Prime Minister Fumio Kishida's unpopular government. Kanda, responsible for government bonds and monetary policy, is the third member of Kishida's Cabinet to step down within two months following a September Cabinet reshuffle. Prime Minister Kishida told reporters he accepts responsibility for appointing Kanda. "I must apologize to the people that a vice finance minister had to resign so soon after joining the Cabinet," he said. "I am determined to focus more seriously on our work to regain the public's trust." Kanda, who previously worked as a tax accountant before becoming a lawmaker, admitted that land and property owned by his company were seized by authorities four times between 2013 and 2022 due to unpaid fixed asset taxes. His admission came in response to a weekly magazine report that revealed the tax issues. Last week, opposition lawmakers strongly questioned Kanda over the scandal during parliamentary sessions, halting discussions on other key policy matters. Reports indicate that while Kishida and his party were initially slow to respond and reluctant to act, mounting criticism prompted Kanda's resignation, which was submitted to Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki and later approved by the Cabinet, according to Chief Cabinet Secretary Hirokazu Matsuno. Kishida is aiming to call a snap election before his term as head of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party ends in September, in a bid to secure another term as Japan's leader. However, he faces low approval ratings and ongoing public dissatisfaction with his government's performance, including criticism over slow economic measures, issues with digitalizing the health insurance system, and perceptions of indecisiveness. Since the Cabinet reshuffle in September, two other vice ministers have also resigned amid scandals. A vice education minister stepped down after acknowledging an extramarital affair, and a vice justice minister resigned over an alleged election law violation. Kenta Izumi, leader of the main opposition Constitutional Democratic Party, said Kanda's departure was unavoidable but came too late, questioning Kishida’s responsibility for his appointment.

Kanda, oo xilkiisa ka masuul ahaa bonds-ka dowladda iyo siyaasadda lacagaha, waa wasiirkii saddexaad ee xukuumadda Kishida ee is casila laba bilood gudahood tan iyo dib-u-habayntii golaha wasiirada bishii Sebtember. Ra’iisul Wasaare Kishida wuxuu saxaafadda u sheegay inuu masuul ka yahay magacaabista Kanda. Wararka dalka kasoo baxayay ayaa sheegaya in Kishida iyo xisbigiisu markii hore gaabiyeen jawaabta oo ay diideen inay marka hore tallaabo dhaqso ah qaadaan, balse cadaadiskii isa soo taray ayaa ugu dambeyn horseeday iscasilada Kanda, taasoo uu si toos ah ugu gudbiyay Wasiirka Maaliyadda Shunichi Suzuki kadibna Golaha Wasiiradu ansixiyeen, sida uu sheegay Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Wasiirrada Hirokazu Matsuno. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu wajahaya taageero hoose iyo cabashooyin bulshada ka imaanaya oo la xariira sida xukuumaddiisu ugu liidato wax ka qabashada arrimaha dhaqaalaha, dhibaatooyinka dijitalkeyn la’aanta nidaamka caymiska caafimaadka, iyo muuqaal la’aanta go'aan qaadasho. Tan iyo dib-u-habayntii Golaha Wasiirada Sebtember, labo wasiir ku xigeen oo kale ayaa iscasilay ka dib fadeexado. article_content: Barcelona and Real Madrid clash this Saturday in the first of four highly anticipated 'El Clasico' matches over 18 days, with these games set to shape their seasons in both La Liga and the Champions League. Barcelona visit Santiago Bernabeu holding an eight-point lead at the top of La Liga, with seven games left to play. A win moves them significantly closer to the Spanish title. Jose Mourinho’s Real Madrid have a clear motivation: to disrupt Barcelona’s campaign in La Liga and establish momentum ahead of the Copa del Rey final and the Champions League semifinals. If Barcelona wins, they would complete a league double over Madrid after a 5-0 triumph at the Nou Camp earlier this season—Mourinho’s heaviest defeat as a manager. Still stung by that loss, Mourinho declined all questions at Friday’s press conference, delegating media duties to assistant Aitor Karanka. Many journalists left when Mourinho refused to answer their questions. Karanka stated, “Every time he talks, things get blown out of context. He prefers to stay calm; this is our usual approach.” Cristiano Ronaldo, Real Madrid’s star striker with 28 league goals this season, believes they can overturn the previous result at home: “This is a completely different game. We must be confident because Barcelona aren’t invincible,” he told AFP. Barcelona have won the last five El Clasico matches, outscoring Madrid 16-2. Still, coach Pep Guardiola warns against complacency: “We can’t go to the Bernabeu thinking a loss doesn’t matter. We have a chance to make a decisive step toward the league title.” Guardiola faces defensive selection issues, with captain Carles Puyol injured and Eric Abidal recovering from surgery. He must choose whether to play Sergio Busquets in central defense or turn to Gaby Milito. Barcelona’s attacking power, led by Lionel Messi—who has scored a club record 48 goals this season—will attract special attention. Messi, who shone in the earlier victory, seeks his first goal against a Mourinho-managed team. Elsewhere in La Liga, Valencia look to consolidate third place as they visit bottom side Almeria, following their 5-0 win over Villarreal last weekend.

Barcelona ayaa u safreysa Santiago Bernabeu iyadoo hogaanka La Liga ku heysa sideed dhibcood, todoba kulanna ay ka harsan yihiin. Guul waxay ku dhownaan laheyd hanashada horyaalka Spain. Real Madrid—oo uu hogaamiyo Jose Mourinho—waxay doonayaan inay carqaladeyaan qorshaha Barcelona ee horyaalka iyo inay dhisaan kalsooni kahor finalka Copa del Rey iyo semi-finalka Champions League. Haddii Barcelona badiso, waxay dhameystiri doonaan labada guul ee horyaalka ay Real Madrid ka gaareen xilli ciyaareedkan, kaddib markii ay Nou Camp 5-0 ku xasuusiyeen—taasoo ahayd guuldarradii ugu xumeyd ee Mourinho uu la kulmay xirfadiisa. Isagu wuxuu jecel yahay inuu deganaado; sidaas ayaan u shaqeynaa.” Cristiano Ronaldo—xiddiga ugu goolasha badan Real Madrid xilli ciyaareedkan (28 gool)—wuxuu aaminsan yahay in natiijada la bedeli karo marka ay ciyaarayaan Bernabeu: “Tani waa ciyaar gebi ahaanba ka duwan tii hore. Waa in aan is aaminnaa maxaa yeelay Barcelona ma aha koox aan la jabin karin,” ayuu AFP u sheegay. Barcelona ayaa badisay shantii El Clasico ee ugu dambeysay, iyaga oo 16-2 kaga badiyay Madrid. Dhinaca kale ee La Liga, Valencia ayaa la ciyaareysa kooxda ugu hooseysa Almeria, iyagoo doonaya inay xoojiyaan kaalinta 3-aad kaddib markii ay 5-0 uga badiyeen Villarreal toddobaadkii la soo dhaafay.

article_content: Stuart Hazell, the 37-year-old step-grandfather accused of murdering 12-year-old Tia Sharp, remains under constant surveillance in Belmarsh Prison. He is kept in isolation in this high-security prison in south east London, after other inmates allegedly threatened him. Hazell is in a secure wing of the Category A facility, separated from other prisoners. The Ministry of Justice has not confirmed his exact location. On August 15, Hazell appeared at the Old Bailey through a video link, facing charges of murdering Tia Sharp between August 2 and 11. He confirmed his identity at the brief hearing. Meanwhile, Tia’s mother, Natalie Sharp, and her partner, David Niles, visited a memorial near their New Addington home to mourn her. Tia’s school, Raynes Park High in Merton, has also received flowers and messages. Hazell is expected to enter his plea in November, and his trial is scheduled for January 2013 before a High Court judge. He is represented by Lord Alex Carlile QC, with legal aid. A pathologist found no major injuries on Tia’s body, which was discovered in her grandmother’s attic eight days after she was reported missing. Forensic experts believe suffocation is possible, but decomposition made analysis difficult. Police have not excluded the possibility that Tia may have been alive during their early searches of her grandmother’s home. Christine Sharp, Tia’s grandmother and Hazell’s partner, and a neighbour, Paul Meehan, were arrested but later released on bail. A Serious Case Review has been started to examine the role of local agencies in Tia’s care. Merton Council confirmed this is routine and expressed condolences to the family. The review will involve police, healthcare, and local authorities. Tia’s biological father, Steve Carter, has publicly called for justice for his daughter and shared memories of her.

article_content: Recent reports of Hamas accepting bitcoin donations prompted nearly 100 members of the U.S. Congress to advocate for a crackdown on illicit cryptocurrency use. However, evidence suggests these concerns may be overstated. According to the U.S. Treasury, as of May 2022, Hamas had approximately $500 million in cash. Matthew Levitt, director of the counter-terrorism program at the Washington Institute, estimates Hamas’ annual budget at over $300 million. Most funding comes from allies such as Iran and Qatar, as well as misappropriated international aid, not mainly from cryptocurrency. The Wall Street Journal reported that since 2019, Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad (PIJ) received nearly $135 million in crypto donations via public bitcoin wallet addresses. This figure was later retracted due to inaccuracies. While some, like Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen, argue cryptocurrency is a tool for terrorism financing, the situation is more complex. Crypto donations left digital traces, enabling Israeli authorities and Binance to track and seize funds. As a result, Hamas removed its wallet address from public platforms after expressing concerns about donor prosecution. In August, U.S. officials ordered Binance to freeze nearly 70 accounts linked to PIJ, further disrupting illicit crypto activity. After the October Hamas assault, the U.S. Treasury sanctioned a Gaza-based crypto exchange. While crypto can be used for illicit funding, blockchain technology offers a transparent, publicly accessible ledger of transactions. Wallets identified by alphanumeric addresses instead of names may appear anonymous, but all transactions are traceable. For instance, in 2018, Canadian authorities arrested a criminal who sold drugs and guns on AgoraMarket after CipherTrace tracked his crypto transactions from there to his personal wallet and Coinbase account. Critics note criminals may use tools like mixers and rotating addresses to hide activity, but law enforcement and cybersecurity firms such as Chainalysis, CipherTrace, and TRM Labs are developing ways to counter these efforts. Crypto’s image as a haven for criminals results mainly from regulatory shortcomings rather than issues with the technology itself. The Financial Action Task Force is beginning to expand its blockchain guidelines, whereas traditional banking oversight has long been established. Traditional banking faces challenges auditing global transactions, as noted by Peter Dittus of the Bank for International Settlements. Developing a regulatory system tailored to crypto’s features, rather than imposing outdated banking rules, could enhance efforts to combat online financial crimes. A modern regulatory framework leveraging blockchain transparency and law enforcement expertise could greatly reduce illicit activity, though the challenge remains significant.

Si kastaba, caddeymaha cusub waxay muujinayaan in cabashooyinkaas la fogaaday. Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Mareykanka waxay sheegtay in bishii May 2022, Hamas ay haysatay qiyaastii $500 milyan oo lacag caddaan ah. Matthew Levitt, Agaasimaha barnaamijka ka hortagga argagixisada ee Washington Institute, wuxuu qiyaasayaa in miisaaniyadda sannadlaha ah ee Hamas ay ka badan tahay $300 milyan. Inta badan lacagtaas waxay ka timaadaa xulafada sida Iran iyo Qatar, iyo deeqo caalami ah oo si khaldan loo adeegsaday, balse kuma tiirsana cryptocurrency. Wargeyska Wall Street Journal ayaa sheegay in laga soo bilaabo 2019, Hamas iyo kooxda xulafada la ah ee PIJ ay heleen ku dhowaad $135 milyan oo deeqo crypto ah iyadoo la isticmaalayo ciwaano bitcoin oo la shaaciyay, balse tiradan waxaa la laalay kadib markii lagu ogaaday qalad xisaabeed. In kastoo ay jiraan qaar sida Janet Yellen oo ah Xoghayaha Maaliyadda Mareykanka, oo aaminsan in cryptocurrency-ga loo adeegsado maalgelinta argagixisada, xaaladdu waa mid adag. Deeqaha crypto-ga waxay reebeen raadad dijital ah taasoo u sahashay Israa’iil iyo shirkadda Binance inay helaan oo xayiraan lacagtaas. Hamas waxay ka saartay ciwaankeedii bitcoin bogagga dadweynaha kadib markii ay ka baqday in dadka deeqda bixiyey la maxkamadeeyo. Bishii Agoosto, Mareykanku wuxuu ku amray Binance inay xayiraan ku dhowaad 70 xisaab oo lala xiriiriyay PIJ, taasoo caraaleedisay howlaha crypto-ga ee sharci darrada ah. Weerarkii Hamas kadib, Treasury-ga Mareykanka wuxuu cunaqabateyn saaray is-weydaarsiga crypto ee Gaza ku yaal. In kasta oo cryptocurrency lagu fulin karo maalgelin sharci darro ah, teknolojiyada blockchain-ka waxay siisaa furanan iyo ilaalin xisaabeed oo loo wado dadweynaha. Boorsoyinka lambarka ah waxay muuqan karaan kuwo qarsoon, balse dhammaan dhaqdhaqaaqa waa la heli karaa. Tusaale ahaan, sanadkii 2018, booliiska Kanada waxay xireen dambiile iibin jiray daroogo iyo hub suuqa madow ee AgoraMarket markay shirkadda CipherTrace ay daba-gashay dhaqaaqiisa crypto oo ay la ogaatay inuu u wareejiyey boorsadiisa iyo akoonkiisa Coinbase. Dhaliilayaasha crypto-ga waxay sheegaan in dambiyada laga yaabo inay isticmaalaan aalado si ay uga dhuuntaan raadraaca, sida mixers iyo cinwaano is bedbeddela, balse hay'adaha amniga iyo shirkadaha sida Chainalysis, CipherTrace iyo TRM Labs waxay horumariyaan xeelado looga hortago. Sumcada crypto-ga ee ah in dambiyada lagu dhuunto waxay sabab u tahay daldaloolo xagga xeerarka ah balse ma aha cilad farsamo ahaan. Hay’adda FATF ayaa billowday inay balaariso hagitaannada blockchain-ka, halka nidaamka bangiyada dhaqameed uu horumar sameeyay sanado badan. Bangiyada dhaqameedka waxay la tacaalayaan kormeeridda dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsi ee dunida, sida uu sheegay Peter Dittus, Bank for International Settlements. Samaynta nidaam sharci oo gaar ah looguna talagalay crypto-ga halkii la adeegsan lahaa xeerar hore waxay fududayn kartaa la dagaallanka dambiyada lacagta ee online-ka ah. Nidaam sharci oo casri ah oo kaashanaya caddeynta blockchain-ka iyo khibradda laamaha amniga wuxuu caawin karaa in la yareeyo ficillada sharci darrada ah, in kastoo ay jiraan caqabado waaweyn.

article_content: The relationship between China and the United States is 'the most important' bilateral relationship in the world, according to Victor Zhikai Gao, a former official of China's foreign ministry and current director of the Beijing Private Equity Association. Gao told CNN's Christiane Amanpour that the United States should approach Beijing with respect, avoiding an abrasive tone in diplomacy. He made these remarks ahead of talks between President Barack Obama and Chinese President Hu Jintao. Gao pointed out that China is now the top creditor nation to the United States, holding foreign reserves exceeding $2 trillion, most of which are in US dollar assets. He reiterated his view that US-China relations are the most important bilateral ties globally. President Obama is focusing on moving past disagreements with China as he seeks cooperation on key issues such as the global economy, climate change, and nuclear proliferation. He is also turning to China for leadership regarding regimes like Myanmar and Sudan, which are close to Beijing and important energy suppliers. Some critics argue that President Obama is minimizing the traditional US commitment to promoting human rights and democracy in order to secure China's assistance on other policy goals. Obama, however, maintains that the US 'will never waver in speaking up for the fundamental values that we hold dear.' Gao acknowledged persistent global concerns about China’s human rights record, admitting improvements still need to be made. 'But if you compare today’s situation to 30, 20, or even 10 years ago, China has made significant progress,' he said. He emphasized that China and its people admire America, but China’s foreign policy is guided by non-interference in other nations’ internal affairs. Gao argued that it would be unbalanced for only the US to raise human rights issues regarding China. Addressing US concerns over alleged Chinese currency manipulation to keep exports cheap, Gao said that since the outbreak of the financial crisis, China has continued to purchase US Treasury bonds, demonstrating a responsible approach to dollar-related matters. Gao concluded by stating that China does not wish to be an adversary of the United States, and both countries should offer mutual respect and incentives to work towards global peace and prosperity.

article_content: The 'Ring of Fire' solar eclipse will occur on October 14, 2023, but there will be no Sutak period in India as the eclipse will not be visible there. This astronomical event will be observable across parts of North and South America, such as the USA, Canada, and several Latin American and Caribbean countries. The eclipse is referred to as the 'Ring of Fire' because the Moon covers the center of the Sun while leaving its outer edges visible, creating a bright ring effect. This happens when the Moon is farther from Earth and appears smaller in the sky. October 2023 is significant for featuring both a solar and a lunar eclipse within two weeks. The solar eclipse on October 14 coincides with Sarva Pitru Amavasya, a day of religious importance in India, but the event itself is not considered auspicious. Sutak restrictions, which are observed 12 hours before a visible solar eclipse, are not necessary in India since the eclipse will not be seen there. In the USA, the eclipse can be observed from 9:13 a.m. to 12:03 p.m. local time, while other countries in the Americas will see it at varying times. In India, the eclipse is due to start at 11:29 p.m. IST, with its peak at 1:45 a.m. IST, but it won’t be visible anywhere in India. Traditional advice suggests people in the zodiac signs Aries (Mesh), Cancer (Kark), Libra (Tula), and Capricorn (Makar) be cautious during the eclipse, though this is based on traditional beliefs. The article also includes summaries of unrelated business news, such as Apple’s record-setting revenue in India, demographic trends among luxury car buyers, and updates on the proposed Sony-Zee corporate merger.

article_content: Since 1995, delegates from United Nations member states have met each year at the Conference of the Parties (COP) to discuss climate policy. A major achievement occurred at COP21 in Paris in 2015, where the Paris Agreement was reached. For the first time, all UN countries committed to lowering greenhouse gas emissions, with the target of limiting global warming to below 2°C by 2100. This marked a shift from mere statements to concrete commitments witnessed internationally—a significant diplomatic accomplishment led by France and the European Union, which persuaded key polluting nations to participate. But in the eight years since, progress has stalled. Later COPs have brought only modest results, with meaningful climate initiatives increasingly happening outside the COP forum through other organizations, state-level efforts, or rising public demand. It's clear that while governments set policies, businesses must adapt and innovate to meet climate targets. At the same time, the current COP format seems increasingly outdated and ineffective. The forthcoming COP28 in the United Arab Emirates—a nation with some of the world’s highest CO2 emissions per capita and a top oil producer—highlights these shortcomings. The UAE, home to about 10 million people, emits roughly 22 tonnes of CO2 per person each year and ranks as the seventh-largest oil producer globally. Questions of credibility arise with the UAE hosting COP28, especially as Sultan Al-Jaber, the CEO of the state oil company ADNOC, also serves as conference president. Calls from hundreds of European and US legislators to reconsider his role have so far gone unheeded. Facing these issues, the authors suggest reimagining the global approach to climate action. Rather than depending solely on cumbersome and broad COP summits, they propose more flexible, region-focused partnerships and institutions to help achieve the goals set by the Paris Agreement. Europe, which played a leading role at COP21, is urged to help build these new frameworks that deliver measurable, locally effective climate outcomes. Rather than endorsing COP28, the authors recommend supporting countries and organizations as they create innovative, regionally relevant strategies for environmental progress. They believe Europe now has the chance to lead by example, reflect its core values, and motivate global citizens to advance the fight against climate change.
translated_content: Tan iyo 1995, wakiillo ka socday dalalka xubnaha ka ah Qaramada Midoobay waxay sannad kasta isugu yimaadaan Shirweynaha Xisbiga (COP) si ay uga wada hadlaan siyaasadda cimilada. Guul weyn ayaa la gaaray intii lagu jiray COP21 ee Paris sannadkii 2015, markaas oo la gaaray Heshiiska Paris. Markii ugu horreysay, dhammaan waddamada Qaramada Midoobay waxay si rasmi ah ugu heshiiyeen in ay yareeyaan gaaska aqalka dhaxanta, iyagoo bartilmaameedsanaya in kulaylka guud ee dunidu aanu dhaafin 2°C marka la gaaro 2100. Tani waxay isu rogtay lafdhabar beddel ah oo ka soo wareegtay hadallo kaliya una gudubtay ballanqaadyo cad oo heer caalami ah—guul diplomasiyadeed oo uu hormuud ka yahay Faransiiska iyo Midowga Yurub, kuwaasoo ku guuleystay inay qanciyaan waddamada sifada sare wasakheeya inay qaybqaataan. Laakiin siddeed sano kadib, horumarku wuu yaraaday. Shirarkii COP ee xigay waxay keeneen natiijooyin aan weynayn, halka dadaallada waaweyn ee la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada ay hadda inta badan ka socdaan meel ka baxsan COP iyada oo loo marayo ururo kale, juhdiyo heer dowladeed, ama cadaadis dadweyne oo soo kordhay. Waa muuqataa in dawladuhu ay dejinayaan siyaasadda, laakiin shirkadu waa inay la jaanqaadaan oo hal-abuur la yimaadaan si loo fuliyo yoolalka cimilo. Dhanka kale, qaabka hadda ee shirarka COP wuxuu noqday mid waqti dhaafay oo aan waxtar badan lahayn. Shirweynaha soo socda ee COP28 oo ka dhici doona Imaaraadka Carabta—waddan leh heerka ugu sarreeya wasakhowga qof kasta iyo ka mid ah dalalka ugu badan ee shidaalka dhoofiya—ayaa tusaale u ah dhibaatooyinkan. UAE, oo leh ku dhowaad 10 milyan oo qof, waxay qofkiiba masaxdaa ilaa 22 tan oo CO2 ah sannadkiiba, waxayna tahay dalka toddobaad ee adduunka ugu sareeya soosaarka saliidda. Su’aalo ku saabsan sumcadda ayaa abuurmaya iyadoo UAE la martigelinayo COP28, gaar ahaan maadaama Sultan Al-Jaber, oo ah Maareeyaha Guud ee shirkadda saliidda hoose ee ADNOC, uu sidoo kale yahay guddoomiyaha shirka. Baaqyo ka yimid boqolaal xildhibaan oo Yurub ah iyo Maraykan ah oo codsanaya in la beddelo doorashadiisa wali lama dhagaysan. Iyadoo laga duulayo caqabadahan, qorayaashu waxay soo jeedinayaan in la beddelo habka caalamiga ah ee la dagaallanka isbeddelka cimilada. Halkii la sugi lahaa shirar ballaaran oo gaabis ah sida COP, waxay taageerayaan in la hirgeliyo iskaashiyo iyo hay’ado goboleed oo dabacsan si looga miro dhaliyo ujeedooyinkii Heshiiska Paris. Yurub, oo hormuud ka ahayd COP21, waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay kaalin ku leedahay abuurista qaabab cusub oo rasmiga ah oo keenaya natiijooyin la taaban karo oo waafajinaya xaaladaha deegaanka ee gobollada. Taa beddelkeeda, qorayaashu waxay talo ku bixinayaan in la xoojiyo dadaallada dalalka iyo ururrada si ay u abuuraan xeelado cusub oo wax ku ool ah oo deegaanka u gaar ah. Waxay rumaysan yihiin in Yurub hadda u furan tahay fursad ay ku noqoto hormuud, ku cabbirto qiyamkeeda, isla markaana dhiirrigeliso muwaadiniinta caalamka inay hormuud u noqdaan dagaalka ka dhanka ah isbeddelka cimilada.

article_content: Eicher Motors’ shares jumped 2.6%, reaching Rs 3,675 on the NSE Monday, outperforming the general market trend. This rise followed the company’s announcement of record-breaking results for the September 2023 quarter: consolidated net profit rose 55% year-on-year to Rs 1,016 crore, revenue increased 17% to Rs 4,115 crore, and EBITDA grew 32% to Rs 1,087 crore. Major brokerages reacted favorably. Jefferies, CLSA, and Nuvama all reaffirmed their buy recommendations, elevating their price targets to Rs 4,650, Rs 4,252, and Rs 4,200, respectively. CLSA commended strong motorcycle demand for Royal Enfield and highlighted plans for new models, while Nuvama expects consistent growth from premiumization and gradual acceptance of electric two-wheelers, projecting a 10% annual revenue increase through FY26. Motilal Oswal stood apart with a neutral stance and a Rs 3,800 price target, citing concerns about a weaker product mix and exports potentially restricting profit margin growth. Still, Motilal Oswal acknowledged that new product launches, stable commodities, and increasing exports should continue to drive Eicher’s performance. Even with healthy financials, Eicher’s stock has lagged behind the Nifty Auto Index this year, mainly due to fiercer competition. Nevertheless, most analysts are confident in Eicher’s premium market presence, expected new product momentum, and strong brand appeal of Royal Enfield.

article_content: Sandy Busby, the son of legendary former Manchester United manager Sir Matt Busby, has passed away at the age of 76. Tributes have poured in following his passing on Monday evening at around 7:15pm. Manchester United chief executive Ed Woodward expressed his condolences in a statement, saying: 'I am shocked and saddened by the news of Sandy's death. He was a genuine person with a deep love for the club that his father helped establish in the hearts of millions worldwide. Sandy understood better than almost anyone what the United way means, and his enthusiasm, wit, and affection for the club will be greatly missed. Our thoughts are with Irene and his family at this sad time.' Former United player Norman Whiteside also paid tribute on Twitter: 'So sorry to hear about the passing of Sandy Busby. What a lovely gent. RIP.' TV presenter and Manchester United fan Eamonn Holmes added: 'Sandy Busby's death was so unexpected. Thoughts to his lovely family.' Sandy Busby, who once played for Blackburn Rovers and was pictured in action against Everton, remained a passionate supporter of Manchester United. Earlier this summer, Busby expressed his enthusiastic support for Louis van Gaal's appointment as United manager, stating that his father would have been delighted with the decision. He remarked: 'Oh, I'm sure he would. This club is enormous, with a global fanbase, and it would be great to see Mr. Van Gaal succeed. From the way he's talking, he's going to play attacking football, and that's what we want—it's what this club stands for.'

article_content: Scientists are increasingly concerned about the silence of the Cascadia Subduction Zone, a large fault stretching approximately 1,000 kilometers from Northern Vancouver Island in Canada to Cape Mendocino in California. This immense fault off the Pacific Northwest coast is typically expected to produce small tremors or signals as stress is released. Recently, however, scientific teams from North America and Japan have reported an unprecedented lack of such activity, which is uncommon compared to other fault zones worldwide. The Cascadia Subduction Zone is where the Juan de Fuca plate slides beneath the North American plate. This movement usually generates earthquakes. Using ships and advanced underwater seismographs, researchers like Professor Doug Toomey from the University of Oregon have closely monitored the region for several years. Their sensitive instruments have so far found the fault to be abnormally quiet, indicating it might be 'locked' and accumulating strain. A study published by a Japanese-Canadian research team in the Bulletin of the Seismological Society of America suggests that the absence of recent seismic events could mean the fault has remained sealed and is building up pressure since the last massive quake more than 300 years ago. Experts warn that, because energy is not being frequently released, the risk of a future large and possibly destructive earthquake is increasing. Geological records show that major earthquakes along Cascadia appear about every 400 to 600 years. The last major seismic event occurred in January 1700, evidence for which has been found in destroyed coastal forests and historic Japanese tsunami records. Given these factors, authorities and scientists are urging residents in the region to remain alert and prepared for a potential major earthquake.

Khadkan weyn ee dillaaca ee ku yaalla xeebaha Waqooyiga Badhtamaha Baasifiga, waxaa badanaa laga filaa in uu sameeyo garaac ama muujinyooyin ifinaya in xoog laga sii daayo hoosta dhulka. Hase yeeshee, kooxo ka kala socda Waqooyiga Ameerika iyo Jabaan ayaa tilmaamaya inaan la helin wax dhaqdhaqaaq muhiim ah, taas oo ah arrin aan caadi ahayn marka la barbar dhigo meelaha kale ee dillaaca dhulka. Kala-go’ga Cascadia waa meesha uu jir dhulweynaha Juan de Fuca hoos ugu riixo dhulweynaha Waqooyiga Ameerika. Dhaqaaqani wuxuu sida caadiga ah keenaa dhulgariir. Iyagoo adeegsanaya maraakiib iyo qalab casri ah oo lagu xiro hoosta badda, cilmi-baarayaal uu hoggaaminayo Professor Doug Toomey oo ka tirsan Jaamacadda Oregon ayaa dhowr sano si taxaddar leh ula socday gobolka. Qalabkoodu wuxuu muujiyay aamusnaan aan caadi ahayn, taasoo muujinaysa in dillaaca uu yahay mid aad u 'xiran' oo xoog urursanaya. Warbixin ay wada daabaceen koox Japan iyo Kanada iskaashanaya, kana soo baxday jariidada Bulletin of the Seismological Society of America, ayaa sheegtay in maqnaanshaha dhulgariirro waaweyn ay muujin karto in dillaacu uu xirmanaa oo uu ururunayo cadaadis tan iyo dhulgariirkii ugu dambeeyay ee weyn ee dhacay in ka badan 300 sano ka hor. Khubaradu waxay ka digayaan in maadaama aan xoogga si joogto ah loo sii dayn, khatarta dhulgariir weyn oo dhibaato leh ay sii kordhayso. Xogaha dhulka-baarista ayaa muujinaya in dhulgariirrada waaweyn ee ka dhaca Kala-go’ga Cascadia ay dhacaan qiyaastii 400 illaa 600 sano kasta. Dhulgariirkii ugu dambeeyay ee weyn wuxuu dhacay Janaayo 1700, taas oo laga xaqiijiyay burburka kaymaha xeebaha iyo wixii tsunami ah ee diiwaanka Jabaan. Marka la eego arrimahan, hay’adaha iyo khubaradu waxay ku talinayaan in shacabka gobolku ay had iyo jeer feejignaan iyo diyaar garow u yeeshaan dhulgariirro waaweyn ee iman kara.

article_content: Former Labour ministers may soon face police questioning over Britain’s alleged involvement in the rendition of terror suspects to Libya under Colonel Gaddafi. Scotland Yard has opened an investigation into claims that MI6 officers illegally transferred suspects to Libya, where they were reportedly jailed and tortured. It is likely that former Foreign Secretary Jack Straw and other officials could be asked about their approval of actions by the Secret Intelligence Service. Libyan rebel commander Abdel Hakim Belhadj and Sami al-Saadi are at the center of the allegations. The investigation is expected to delay the official inquiry led by Sir Peter Gibson into all claims of British complicity in torture during the War on Terror. Sources in Whitehall have indicated that the inquiry may be put on hold indefinitely while the police investigation proceeds. Meanwhile, the Director of Public Prosecutions, Keir Starmer, has confirmed that no MI5 or MI6 officers will face charges over separate, long-running investigations into complicity in torture. One case, brought by Binyam Mohamed, alleged that MI5 knew he was being mistreated when it gave information to his U.S. captors. Investigators confirmed MI5 shared information with the U.S. but found there was ‘insufficient evidence’ any officer knew of Mohamed’s torture at the time. Prosecutors also found insufficient evidence to bring charges against an MI6 officer involved in the interrogation of a detainee at Bagram Air Base, Afghanistan, in January 2002. Foreign Minister William Hague reiterated the government’s intention to ‘draw a line’ under claims of intelligence agencies’ involvement in the torture of suspects held overseas. However, investigators were unable to locate key witnesses in some cases and stated there was ‘no realistic prospect’ of conviction. The most recent rendition claims surfaced last year after secret documents were found in Gaddafi’s former intelligence headquarters, reportedly implicating UK intelligence in the capture and transfer of suspect Abdel Hakim Belhadj. Another CIA document suggested Britain arranged the transfer of Abu Munthir from Hong Kong to Tripoli. Legal representatives for Belhadj and al-Saadi, Leigh Day & Co, maintain that the lives of their clients and families have been irreversibly affected by the crimes committed by the Gaddafi regime.

Scotland Yard ayaa bilowday baaris la xiriirta eedeymo sheegaya in saraakiisha MI6 si sharci darro ah ugu wareejiyeen eedeysanayaal Libya, halkaas oo la xidhay laguna jirdilay. Waxaa suuragal ah in Wasiirkii Arrimaha Dibadda ee hore Jack Straw iyo saraakiil kale laga waraysto ogolaanshahooda ku aaddan tallaabooyinka Sirdoonka Qarsoon. Hogaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka Libya Abdel Hakim Belhadj iyo Sami al-Saadi ayaa ah kuwa ugu waaweyn ee eedeymaha la xiriira. Baaritaankani wuxuu dib u dhigi doonaa baaritaanka rasmiga ah ee uu hoggaaminayo Sir Peter Gibson ee la xiriira dhammaan eedeymaha la xariira lug-galka Britain ee jirdilka xilligii Dagaalka ka dhanka ah Argagixisada. Si kastaba, baarayaashu ma aysan helin markhaatiyo muhiim ah qaar ka mid ah kiisaska waxa ayna sheegeen in aysan jirin rajo dhab ah oo lagu gaadhi karo xukun. Eedeymaha ugu dambeeyay ee wareejinta ayaa soo baxay sanadkii hore markii dukumiintiyo qarsoodi ah laga helay xaruntii hore ee sirdoonka Gaddafi, kuwaas oo la sheegay inay UK ku lug leedahay qabashada iyo wareejinta eedeysane Abdel Hakim Belhadj. Dukumiinti kale oo CIA ah ayaa tilmaamay in Britain abaabushay wareejinta Abu Munthir laga keenay Hong Kong loona diray Tripoli. Qareenada Belhadj iyo al-Saadi ee Leigh Day & Co, ayaa sheegay in nolosha macaamiishooda iyo qoysaskoodu si aan laga soo kaban karin u saameysay dhibaatooyinkii ka dhacay xilligii xukunka Gaddafi.

article_content: It was almost a birthday party to remember for all the wrong reasons. While leaning forward to blow out the candles on her 50th birthday cake, Shelley Meyer, wife of Ohio State football coach Urban Meyer, accidentally caught her hair on fire. The moment was captured on camera by their daughter Nicki, who posted the photo to social media with the message: 'You know you're 50 when your hair catches fire. Shelley Meyer, girl on fire—literally. The most beautiful mommy in the world! Never a dull moment. #typical.' Shelley Meyer appeared amused and later shared more pictures of the incident, assuring everyone she was unharmed. Shelley is also celebrating her 25th wedding anniversary with Urban Meyer this year. The couple, considered the first family of Ohio college football, laughed off the episode, with Shelley tweeting the picture herself. Before joining Ohio State, Urban Meyer served as head coach of the Florida Gators from 2005 to 2010, and is known for saying, 'run like your hair's on fire.' Currently, Urban Meyer is preparing for the upcoming Sugar Bowl, where his fourth-seeded Ohio State Buckeyes (12-1) will face Nick Saban's top-seeded Alabama Crimson Tide (12-1) on New Year's Day. This semifinal matchup features two of college football's most storied programs. Nick Saban has become one of the most successful coaches of this era, winning three national titles at Alabama and a BCS championship at LSU. Meyer won two national championships at Florida and is now two wins away from another title with the Buckeyes. Nicki Meyer posted photos with her mother to Instagram in celebration of Shelley's birthday. Urban and Shelley Meyer were seen singing 'Carmen Ohio' with the Ohio State team after a win against the Illinois Fighting Illini on November 3, 2012, at Ohio Stadium in Columbus, Ohio. The Meyer family, including children Gigi and Nate, have often celebrated big wins together, such as during Urban Meyer's tenure as Florida Gators head coach in 2010.

article_content: Dubai is rapidly establishing itself as a leading destination for global investors, a trend highlighted at GITEX 2023 where top industry figures convened to assess new opportunities across the Middle East and North Africa. This gathering brought together innovators and thought leaders who showcased technology advancements and business prospects in the region. Key participants, such as Fadi Ghandour (founder of Aramex and chairman of Wamda), shared their entrepreneurial experiences to provide insights relevant to the growth of fintech. Alongside GV Ravishankar from PeakXV Partners, the discussions explored expanding fintech into untapped markets, with cross-border partnerships—especially between India and the Middle East—at the forefront. Ferdinand Reynolds, representing SuperSeed Ventures, stressed that an active presence in Dubai is indispensable due to the market's dynamic developments. Panelists concurred that businesses must bring not only capital but also tailored solutions that align closely with regional demands. Fadi Amoudi, CEO of robotics company iQ, described Dubai's evolving environment for startups, highlighting supportive measures like the 'Hideaway' initiative for SMEs, which aims to propel economic growth by backing promising companies. Despite a positive third quarter in 2023, MENA's total venture investment through September amounted to $1.4 billion, reflecting a 44% year-on-year decrease—a pattern consistent with a 42% dip worldwide. MAGNiTT CEO Philip Bahoshy remains cautiously optimistic, noting that recent gains follow previously low levels. Amoudi observed that competition is increasing, particularly within sectors such as consumer internet innovation. Businesses new to Dubai must prove their value to break into markets traditionally dominated by established players, and securing investments requires a well-differentiated offering. Speakers emphasized the importance of building partnerships with local experts to navigate market complexities, which is particularly vital for fintech ventures. Rapid regulatory adaptation was highlighted as essential for fostering innovation and protecting consumers. Entrepreneurs are counseled to expect extended timelines when finalizing deals in the region, with emphasis on building trust-based relationships. Effectively communicating the unique benefits of their solutions is vital to attract collaborators and investors. Ghandour highlighted the Middle East's significant growth prospects, pointing to Saudi Arabia's booming e-commerce sector as an example. Dubai's authorities continue to introduce changes to aid entrepreneurs, including relaxing the sponsorship requirement for many business types. Nevertheless, the likelihood of securing funding depends largely on the quality and originality of the business proposition. Although the investment climate remains relatively steady, recent positive developments suggest optimism for the region's future. Business leaders stress the need for realistic planning, robust financial management, and a clear focus on value creation. Overall, Dubai’s reputation as a thriving investment hub is bolstered by its commitment to innovation, policy support, and the energetic participation seen at GITEX 2023.

article_content: Martha Ryan was surprised to learn about the number of pregnant homeless women in San Francisco. While volunteering at a local shelter during her master’s program in public health, she encountered three pregnant women in one evening. This experience made her realize that many poor women lack access to health care, making them vulnerable during pregnancy. Ryan noticed that none of the women she met had received prenatal care, increasing the chances of delivering unhealthy babies. Unhealthy births add to the challenges faced by homeless mothers and can lead to increased dependence on public services. Ryan believed preventive care would be more effective and less costly for society. Motivated to help, she learned grant writing and secured $52,000 to launch the Homeless Prenatal Program in 1989. Since then, her nonprofit has provided prenatal care to thousands of homeless women in San Francisco. However, Ryan quickly realized prenatal care alone was insufficient. The program expanded to offer services addressing housing, mental health, substance use, and domestic violence. Ryan emphasized that addressing these additional issues was crucial for lasting change. Currently, the program serves over 3,600 families each year and provides a variety of free services that help families break the cycle of poverty. Ryan explained that opportunities and support can empower people to change their lives. Her program’s average annual cost is less than $5,000 per family, compared to the city’s $6,647 annual average for medical care alone for chronically homeless individuals. The program also helps keep children out of foster care, benefiting families and society. Since its founding, HPP has assisted more than 80,000 families and has earned the trust of government agencies, which provide more than half its funding. The remainder comes from individual and corporate donors. Clients also trust the program, as shown by the story of Carrie Hamilton, a former meth addict and client who is now a case manager and health educator for HPP. Hamilton’s experience overcoming addiction and homelessness—and later joining the staff—inspires current clients. Nearly a third of HPP’s staff are former clients. Ryan believes connecting clients with staff who have similar experiences creates immediate trust and hope. She credits the resilience of these women as key to the program’s success. Ryan finds inspiration in the ability of the women she serves to overcome adversity and change their lives. For more information or to get involved, visit the Homeless Prenatal Program website.
translated_content: Martha Ryan aad bay ula yaabtay tirada haweenka uurka leh ee hoy la’aanta ah ee ku sugan San Francisco. Intii ay ka shaqeyneysay xarun hoy ah xilli ay baraneysay caafimaadka bulshada, waxay hal habeen la kulantay saddex haween uur leh. Khibraddan waxay siisay faham cusub oo ah in haweenka saboolka ah ay badanaa la’aadaan daryeel caafimaad, taasoo uga dhigaysa kuwo nugul inta ay uurka leeyihiin. Ryan waxay ogaatay in midkoodna aysan helin daryeelka uurka, taasoo khatar u sii yeelaysa caafimaadka ilmaha. Ilmo caafimaad xumo ku dhasha wuxuu sii kordhinayaa dhibaatooyinka hooyooyinka hoy la’aanta ah, kana dhigaya kuwo sii tiirsanaanaya adeegyada danta guud. Ryan waxay aaminsanayd in daryeelka ka hortagga ah uu ka waxtar badan yahay, sidoo kalena ka kharash yar yahay bulshada. Si ay u caawiso haweenkaas, waxay baratay sida loo qoro deeqaha waxayna heshay $52,000 si ay u bilowdo Barnaamijka Hooyada Hoy La’aanta ah sanadkii 1989. Si kastaba, Ryan waxay si dhaqso ah u ogaatay in daryeelka uurka keliya uusan ku filnayn. Barnaamijku wuxuu ballaariyay adeegyada si uu u daboolo arrimaha hoy la’aanta, caafimaadka dhimirka, balwadda, iyo rabshadaha qoyska. Ryan waxay xustay in la tacaalidda arrimahan kale ay muhiim u tahay isbeddel waara. Waqtigan, barnaamijku wuxuu u adeegaa in ka badan 3,600 qoys sannadkiiba, isagoo bixiya adeegyo kala duwan oo lacag la’aan ah si qoysaska looga saaro saboolnimada. Ryan waxay sharaxday in fursadaha iyo taageerada la siiyo ay dadka ka caawinayaan inay noloshooda beddelaan. Celceliska kharashka sannadlaha ah ee barnaamijka waa wax ka yar $5,000 qoyskiiba, halka magaalada San Francisco ay celcelis ahaan ku bixiso $6,647 sannadkiiba daryeel caafimaad oo keliya qof hoy la’aan ah. Barnaamijku sidoo kale wuxuu ka caawiyaa carruurta inay ka baxsadaan daryeelka xanaanada, taas oo faa’iido u ah qoysaska iyo bulshada. Tan iyo markii la aasaasay, HPP waxay caawisay in ka badan 80,000 qoys waxayna kasbatay kalsoonida hay’adaha dowladda, taas oo ka hesha in ka badan kala bar miisaaniyada sanadlaha ah. Inta hartana waxay ka timaadaa deeqaha shakhsiyaadka iyo shirkadaha. Macaamiisha sidoo kale way kalsooni ku qabaan barnaamijka, taas oo tusaale u ah sheekada Carrie Hamilton, oo horey u ahayd daroogo isticmaale iyo macmiil, hadda ka tirsan shaqaalaha HPP oo ah maamule kiis iyo bare caafimaad. Khibradeeda ka guuleysiga balwadda iyo hoy la’aanta, kadibna ku biirista shaqaalaha, waxay dhiirrigelisaa hooyooyinka hadda la tacaalaya xaalado la mid ah. Ku dhowaad saddex-meelood meel shaqaalaha HPP waa dad horey uga mid ahaa macaamiisha. Ryan waxay aaminsan tahay in xiriirka lala yeesho shaqaale la soo maray waayo la mid ah ay abuureyso kalsooni iyo rajo degdeg ah. Waxay ku faantaa adkeysiga dumarkaasi inuu furaha u yahay guusha barnaamijka. Ryan waxay dhiirrigelisaa kartida haweenka ay caawiso ee la dagaalaya duruufo adag oo noloshooda beddela. article_content: UpFront examines issues of discrimination and secularism in France following the government’s ban on the abaya in public schools. As the new school year begins, the French government has banned the abaya—a full-length robe commonly worn by Muslim women—from public schools. This decision has generated significant controversy in France, with several opponents protesting outside schools and questioning the motives behind the new rule. Why is this decision so contentious, and what can be justified under France’s laws on secularism? On UpFront, Marc Lamont Hill speaks with French journalist and filmmaker Rokhaya Diallo to discuss the reasons for and consequences of banning the abaya in public schools. Follow Al Jazeera English for more coverage.

article_content: As Russian missiles continue to pummel Avdiivka, residents like Hanna face daily peril. Hanna refuses to leave her elderly, immobile mother behind; her mother, 71, wants nothing more than to sleep in her own bed. Together, the two endure on a fifth-floor apartment as bombs and air strikes persist. Avdiivka is a crucial eastern Ukrainian town directly on the front line. Years of fighting, sharply intensified by Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion, have reduced its population from over 30,000 to about 1,000. President Volodymyr Zelensky calls the ongoing fight for Avdiivka 'particularly tough.' Hanna recounts how frequent strikes leave windows and doors broken beyond quick repair. Known as the gateway to Donetsk (controlled by Russian forces and their proxies since 2014), Avdiivka’s capture would move the conflict line, making Ukrainian recapture of territory more difficult. With the last shops gone, remaining citizens rely on Points of Invincibility—government set-ups providing basics such as food, heat, and power. Volunteer nurse Maryna, whose own home was destroyed, now lives in one of these shelters. Still, safety is relative. Maryna talks about sleepless nights amid near-daily missile barrages. Her son already escaped; she hopes to join him soon. Evacuations are led by the White Angels, a specialist police squad. Their task is dangerous, and persuading the remaining residents to evacuate is often challenging. Last week, 50 more people were evacuated as attacks surged. Maryna reminisces about Avdiivka before war, a town with parks and lively festivals. Now, hiding in a basement, she worries whether there will be anything left to come back to, expressing the deep sense of loss felt by the few who remain.
translated_content: Iyadoo gantaallada Ruushku si joogto ah u garaacayaan Avdiivka, qaar ka mid ah dadka reer deegaanka sida Hanna ayaa wajahaya khatar maalinkasta ah. Hanna ma dooneyso inay ka tagto hooyadeed oo da' ah oo aan si fudud u socon karin; hooyadeed, oo 71 jir ah, waxay kaliya rabtaa inay seexato sariirteeda. Dagaallo socday sanado badan, oo aad uga sii darey tan iyo duullaankii dhameystiran ee Ruushku qaaday 2022, ayaa keenay in dadweynihii ka badnaa 30,000 ay hoos ugu dhacaan ilaa qiyaastii 1,000 oo kaliya. Haddii Avdiivka la qabsado, waxay u ogolaanaysaa Ruushka inuu hoos u riixo safka dagaalka, taasoo Adkaynaysa in ciidamada Ukraine dib ula wareegaan dhulka laga qabsaday. Kadib burburka dukaanka ugu dambeeyay, dadka haray waxay kaliya ku tiirsan yihiin Goobaha Adkeysiga—kuwaas oo ay dowladdu u dhistay si ay ugu helaan raashin, kulayl, iyo koronto. Maryna oo ah kalkaaliso iskaa wax u qabso ah, gurigeedana laga burburiyey, hadda waxay degan tahay mid kamid ah goobahaas. Badbaado dhab ahna ma jirto. Maryna waxay sheegtay in habeen walba ay la kulantaan gantaallo aan kala joogsi lahayn, taasoo keentay hurdo la'aan. Wiilkeedii wey ka cararay magaalada, iyaduna waxay rajaynaysaa inay isaga raacdo. Soo daadgureynta dadka waxa hoggaamiya White Angels, oo ah cutub ka tirsan booliska gaar ah. Shaqadoodu waa khatar waxayna had iyo jeer la kulmaan dhibaatooyin ku saabsan ka dhaadhicinta dadka inay ka baxaan magaalada. Usbuucii hore, waxay badbaadiyeen 50 qof, iyadoo weerarrada ay sii kordhayaan. Maryna waxay xasuusataa Avdiivka intaan dagaalku dhicin—magaalo leh jardiinooyin, suuqyo badan, iyo xaflado. Hadda waxay ku dhuumanaysaa dhulka hoostiisa, iyadoo ka baqaysa in wax laga soo laabto aysan jirin, iyadoo muujinaysa dareen weyn oo murugo ah.

article_content: Lee Jordan, 50, told CNN about how he lost more than half of his body weight after reuniting with his high school sweetheart, now his wife, Beth (formerly Beth Schwein). As a teenager, Lee weighed 165 pounds, but his weight surged to 453 pounds in his twenties due to consuming 8,000–12,000 calories daily. He recognized the need to transform his life after reconnecting with Beth. With her support, he lost 275 pounds. Today, the married couple run a fitness company together in Jacksonville Beach, Florida. Beth saw only Lee, with love and acceptance, motivating him to make significant changes. Prior to his transformation, Lee suffered from diabetes, lung disease, sleep apnea, high blood pressure, and high cholesterol. He required oxygen therapy both at home and at work. Doctors once told Lee he had just two years to live. Beth's support helped him lose enough weight to qualify for gastric bypass surgery and overhaul his diet. Lee and Beth first met in 1979 at a church youth group in Washington. Although they dated and hoped to marry, they eventually went separate ways due to diverging life choices. Lee struggled with emotional eating habits, consuming large amounts of food every day. Beth eventually married and started a family, but after feeling unfulfilled, she contacted Lee in 2004, encouraged by her aunt’s dying wish. Beth, who had overcome a severe back injury and became a certified fitness expert, met Lee again in 2008, and decided to help him address his obesity. As Lee’s health improved, he and Beth rekindled their romantic relationship. After Beth’s divorce, Lee proposed in 2012 at the same Starbucks where they had reconnected in 2008. They married soon after. Lee now weighs 178 pounds, down from his heaviest. His waist size has gone from 72 inches to 34 inches. Both Lee and Beth are certified fitness trainers and regularly participate in races and triathlons together. Lee credits love, acceptance, and encouragement for his dramatic health turnaround. All his previous health problems have been reversed.

article_content: Dominique Strauss-Kahn, former chief of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), is expected to take on an economic advisory role for the Serbian government. Strauss-Kahn, who is due to stand trial in France related to allegations of involvement in a prostitution ring, may face up to 10 years in prison if convicted. His appointment is likely to be officially announced next week, according to an official in the Serbian Deputy Prime Minister's office, who told CNN that the details are still being finalized and more information will be available on Tuesday. The official stated that Strauss-Kahn will visit Serbia occasionally but is not expected to reside there. Asked about the decision to bring him on board, she emphasized his expertise in economics. The Serbian government has declined to provide further details before the formal announcement. Once considered a potential French presidential candidate, Strauss-Kahn resigned from his IMF role in 2011 after being charged with sexually assaulting a hotel maid in New York City, charges that were later dismissed and settled out of court. In France, judicial authorities have accused him of being centrally involved in organizing parties during which alleged prostitution occurred, leading to his prosecution. Strauss-Kahn admits attending parties but maintains he did not know the women involved were prostitutes. He is known for offering economic advice, sometimes free of charge, to developing countries and has recently worked with South Sudan's government.
