article_content: A remarkable photograph has captured radio signals glowing blue from Voyager 1, the spacecraft now nearly 12 billion miles from Earth. While Voyager 1 is not directly visible, scientists can detect its radio emissions. The signal was detected as a blue dot by the Very Long Baseline Array (VLBA), a network of powerful radio telescopes. This image is believed to have been taken on February 21, 2013. Suzanne Dodd, project manager for Voyager at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, California, described the image as Voyager's radio signal seen by the world's most sensitive ground-based telescopes. On the same day, NASA announced that Voyager 1 had sent back audio recordings from its plasma wave instrument as it entered a new frontier, believed to be interstellar space—the first spacecraft ever to do so. The recording consists of rising tones produced by the vibration of dense, ionized gas in space. At a news conference, Don Gurnett, principal investigator for the Voyager plasma wave experiment, emphasized the historic nature of this event, noting it was the first time scientists had recorded sounds from interstellar space. NASA confirmed that Voyager 1 crossed into interstellar space after analyzing data from two separate periods—October-November 2012 and April-May 2013—when the plasma wave instrument detected increasing plasma densities. The time lag in confirmation was due to the challenge of precisely defining the boundary and gathering sufficient evidence. Despite some ongoing scientific debate, NASA celebrated the achievement. Ed Stone, chief scientist for the Voyager mission, called it a milestone and the beginning of a new journey. Voyager 1 will study particles and phenomena in this unexplored part of the universe and transmit data back to Earth. Both Voyager 1 and Voyager 2 continue to be monitored by a dedicated team. Each message from Voyager 1, powered by plutonium and roughly the size of a subcompact car, takes about 17 hours to reach Earth due to its vast distance. Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 used Saturn's gravity to gain speed and escape the solar system. Voyager 2 was the first and only probe to visit Uranus and Neptune. Both spacecraft carry gold-plated discs containing greetings, music, and photographs from Earth, intended for any potential intelligent life they may encounter. Some scientists, such as Lennard Fisk and Harvard astrophysicist Jonathan McDowell, remain cautious, noting the expected changes in magnetic field at the interstellar boundary have not yet been clearly observed. However, a solar eruption provided crucial data, leading NASA to conclude that Voyager 1 crossed into interstellar space in August 2012. Voyager 1 and Voyager 2 continue to operate, but their nuclear power sources are expected to last until around 2025, after which the spacecraft will fall silent.
translated_content: Sawir cajiib ah ayaa qabtay shucaaca raadyaha ee Voyager 1 oo hadda ku sugan meel ku dhow 12 bilyan mayl oo ka fog Dhulka. Inkasta oo aan si toos ah loo arki karin Voyager 1, saynisyahannadu waxay ogaan karaan shucaaca raadyaha. Calaamaddu waxaa lagu arkay dhibic buluug ah oo uu qabtay Very Long Baseline Array (VLBA), oo ah shabakad teleskoobo raadiyaha aad u xoogan. Sawirkani waxaa la aaminsan yahay in la qaaday 21-kii Febraayo, 2013. Suzanne Dodd, maamulaha mashruuca Voyager ee NASA ee Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Pasadena, California, ayaa ku tilmaamtay sawirka inuu yahay calaamadda raadyaha Voyager ee ay qabteen teleskoobada dhulka ugu xasaasisan. Isla maalintaas, NASA waxay shaacisay in Voyager 1 ay dib ugu soo celisay Dhulka duubisyo maqal ah oo uu qabtay qalabka cabbiraadda mowjadda plasma ee ay la kulantay xuduud cusub, taasoo la rumaysan yahay inay tahay bannaanka xiddigaha dhexdooda—waxaana noqoneysa dayax-gacmeedkii ugu horreeyay ee halkaas gaadha. Duubistu waxay ka kooban tahay dhawaaqyo koraya oo ka dhashay gariirka gaaska ionised ah ee cufan. Shir jaraa’id, Don Gurnett, madax-baaraha tijaabada mowjadda plasma ee Voyager, ayaa muujiyay in dhacdadani ay tahay mid taariikhi ah isagoo xusay inay tahay markii ugu horreysay ee saynisyahannadu duubaan dhawaaq ka yimid bannaanka xiddigaha. NASA waxay xaqiijisay in Voyager 1 ay gashay bannaanka xiddigaha kadib falanqayn xog ka timid laba waqti oo kala duwan—Oktoobar-Nofeembar 2012 iyo Abriil-May 2013—markaas oo qalabka plasma uu ogaaday cufnaanta sii kordheysa. Dib-u-dhacu xaqiijinta waxaa dhaliyay caqabadda lagu qeexayo xadka iyo qoraalka caddaynta loo baahnaa. Inkasta oo dood cilmiyeed ay weli jirto, NASA waxay xustay guushan. Ed Stone, saynisyahan madaxa ah ee Voyager, wuxuu ku tilmaamay meel-dhig iyo bilow socdaal cusub. Voyager 1 waxay sii wadi doontaa in ay daraasayso walxo iyo dhacdooyin ku cusub koonka oo ay xogta usoo diri doonto Dhulka. Labada Voyager ah waxaa weli la socdaa koox gaar ah. Fariin kasta oo ka timaada Voyager 1, oo ku shaqeysa plutonium isla markaana la mid ah baabuur yar, waxay qaadataa qiyaastii 17 saac si ay u gaarto Dhulka sababo la xiriira fogaanta ballaaran. Voyager 1 waxaa la daahfuray 1977-kii, waxayna adeegsatay cufisjiidadka Saturn si ay xawaare ugu hesho oo uga baxdo nidaamka qoraxda. Voyager 2 waxay ahayd dayax-gacmeedkii kaliya ee gaaray Uranus iyo Neptune. Labada dayax-gacmeed waxay wataan disc dahabaysan oo xambaarsan salaan, heeso iyo sawirro ka turjumaya Dhulka, oo loogu talagalay nolol kasta oo aqoon leh oo ay la kulmaan. Qaar saynisyahanno ah sida Lennard Fisk iyo astaroonoomiga Harvard, Jonathan McDowell, wali waa taxaddar badan yihiin, iyaga oo xusay in isbeddelada laga filayay beerta magnetic-ka aysan weli si cad loo arkin. Si kastaba, falaadh qoraxeed ayaa keentay xog muhiim ah, taas oo ku qancisay NASA in Voyager 1 ay gashay bannaanka xiddigaha Agoosto 2012. Voyager 1 iyo Voyager 2 weli way shaqeynayaan, se korontada nukliyeerka ah ee isticmaalaan waxa la filayaa inay socon doonto illaa 2025, markaas ka dibna way aamusi doonaan.

article_content: Protesters blocked roads across Panama on Monday, demanding the government revoke a contract allowing continued copper mining in a biodiverse region. Teaching and construction unions, alongside environmentalists, warned that further development threatens vital forests and groundwater about 75 miles (120 kilometers) west of Panama City, in Colon province. In Panama City, protesters peacefully distributed flyers, but police deployed tear gas in some outlying areas. Anticipating the largest demonstrations since last July’s cost-of-living protests, the Department of Education and University of Panama canceled classes. The government promoted on social media the 'enormous contribution' made by the copper mine, Panama's largest private investment. In March, Panama’s legislature struck a deal with Canadian mining company First Quantum, granting its subsidiary, Minera Panama, rights to operate the massive open-pit copper mine for at least another 20 years. The mine had previously been temporarily closed after talks over government payments fell through. Protesters took to the streets after President Laurentino Cortizo signed the new contract on Friday, following congressional approval. Union leaders criticized the government for quickly approving the deal without public support. Teachers and construction workers—two strong labor groups—continue to lead the demonstrations. Saúl Méndez, a prominent union leader, said, 'People are taking to the streets to defend our sovereignty against a contract that sacrifices our environment and resources.' Mine supporters note it generates 3% of Panama’s GDP and accounts for 80% of the country’s exports. The new contract guarantees Panama at least $375 million a year from Minera Panama, more than ten times the previous agreement, making it one of the largest deals in the region. Neighboring countries like Costa Rica have strict mining regulations, while El Salvador has banned metal mining. Teacher union leader Fernando Abrego stated there would be no compromise, with plans to continue protests.

Ururada macallimiinta iyo dhismaha ayaa la safan deegaan-dhowrayaal, iyagoo ka digaya in mashruucani halis gelinayo kaymaha iyo biyaha dhulka ee qiyaastii 120km galbeed uga beegan Panama City, gobolka Colon. Magaalada Panama City, dibad-baxayaashu si nabad ah ayay waraaqo u qaybinayeen, balse boolisku waxay adeegsanayeen gaas dadka ka ilmaysiiya qaar ka mid ah duleedka. Waxaa la filayay isu-soo-baxii ugu waynaa tan iyo mudaharaadyadii sicir-bararka ee bishii Luulyo, taasoo sababtay in Wasaaradda Waxbarashada iyo Jaamacadda Panama fasallada joojiyaan. Dowladdu waxay baraha bulshada ku muujisay 'dhibaato-la’aanta dhaqaale' ee macdanta naxaasta, taasoo ah maalgashiga ugu weyn ee gaarka loo leeyahay ee dalka. Bishii Maarso, baarlamaanka Panama ayaa heshiis la gaaray shirkadda Canadian-ka ah ee First Quantum, taasoo siisay shirkaddeeda Minera Panama oggolaansho ay ku sii waddo howlgalka goobta weyn ee naxaasta 20 sano oo dheeraad ah. Macdanta ayaa xidhnaa si ku-meelgaar ah ka dib markii wadahadalladii lacag bixinta dowladda iyo shirkaddu burbureen. Dibad-baxyadu waxay billowdeen markii Madaxweynaha Laurentino Cortizo uu saxiixay heshiiska cusub jimcihii, kaddib ansixinta baarlamaanka. Hoggaamiyaasha shaqaalaha waxay dhaliileen dowladda, iyagoo ku eedeeyay inay si degdeg ah u meel mariyeen heshiiska iyada oo aan la tixgalin shacabka. Macallimiinta iyo shaqaalaha dhismaha—oo ka mid ah ururada ugu awoodda badan dalka—ayaa sii hoggaaminaya mudaharaadyada. Saúl Méndez, oo ah hoggaamiye urur shaqaale, ayaa yiri: 'Shacabku waddooyinka ayay kusoo baxeen si ay u difaacaan madax-bannaanideenna, heshiiskuna wuxuu saameynayaa deegaanka iyo kheyraadkeena.' Dadka taageersan macdanta waxay sheegayaan inay keento 3% GDP-ga Panama oo 80% dhoofinta dalka ka yimaado isla hal goob. Heshiiska cusub wuxuu Panama siinayaa ugu yaraan $375 milyan sanadkii Minera Panama, taasoo ka badan toban-laab heshiiskii hore, kana mid ah kuwa ugu waaweyn gobolka. Dalalka jaarka sida Costa Rica waxay leeyihiin xeerar adag oo ku saabsan macdanta, halka El Salvador gebi ahaanba mamnuucay macdanta biraha. Hoggaamiyaha ururka macallimiinta Fernando Abrego ayaa sheegay in aysan ogolaan doonin wax tanaasul ah, qorshahooduna yahay inaanay joojin dibadbaxyada.

article_content: Romelu Lukaku says he has no regrets about turning down a move to Serie A champions Juventus to sign for Everton last summer. The former Chelsea striker joined Everton for a club-record £28 million after attracting interest from several European clubs. Although he has struggled to reach the same heights as his previous loan spell at Everton, where he scored 16 goals in 33 appearances, the 21-year-old insists he made the right decision. Lukaku stated, 'I considered Serie A and Juventus because they are a big club. But for me, Everton was perfect. I'm here and I'm happy. I don't regret any choices I've made. Everton was the best choice I could make as a young player wanting to progress and develop.' Unable to establish himself in Chelsea's first team, Lukaku has struggled to score this season while Everton have only managed one win from seven matches. Despite scoring only two goals in 10 games this campaign, and with Everton sitting in the bottom three of the Premier League after just one win, Lukaku believes the team can qualify for the Champions League. 'Everton play good football, we aim to be at the top of the league and everyone wants to win. We want to prove that last year wasn't a fluke. Our mission is to reach the Champions League because it was within our grasp last season and we let it slip.' Lukaku has supported Everton manager Roberto Martinez to bring Champions League football to Goodison Park. He also declined the opportunity to play alongside stars like Carlos Tevez for Juventus in the Champions League. Lukaku shared insight into his personal life, saying he prefers to stay home and avoids the usual temptations associated with young Premier League footballers. He said, 'I prefer to stay home. Even as a kid in Belgium, I didn't go out much. I've never had a glass of alcohol in my life. It's outside my comfort zone, and I don't know how to act. I'm very shy. When people know me, like my teammates at Everton, they see I'm outgoing and enjoy joking around. But when I don't know someone, I'm very reserved.'

Weeraryahankii hore ee Chelsea ayaa ku biiray Everton isagoo lagu jabiyay rikoodhka kooxda ee £28 milyan kadib markii uu xiiso ka helay kooxo badan oo Yurub ah. Inkastoo uu la ildaran yahay inuu gaaro heerarkii uu ku joogay Everton xilli ciyaareedkii hore ee amaahda, oo uu dhaliyay 16 gool 33 kulan ah, 21 jirkaan ayaa ku adkaystay inuu qaaday go'aan sax ah. Lukaku wuxuu yiri, 'Waxaan ka fikiray Serie A iyo Juventus maxaa yeelay waa koox weyn. Laakiin aniga Everton wuu iga fiicnaa. Halkan ayaan ahay, waanan ku faraxsanahay. Ma qoomameynin wax go'aamo ah oo aan gaaray. Everton waxay ahayd xulashada ugu fiican ee aan sameyn karo anigoo ciyaaryahan da'yar ah oo rabay inuu horumar sameeyo.' Iyadoo aanu ka mid noqon karin safka koowaad ee Chelsea, Lukaku xilli ciyaareedkan wuu ku dhibtoonayay inuu dhaliyo goolal halka Everton kaliya hal ciyaar ay guuleysatay toddobo kulan. Inkasto oo uu kaliya dhaliyay labo gool toban kulan xilli ciyaareedkan, Evertonna ay ku jiraan saddexda ugu hooseysa Premier League kadib hal guul oo keliya, Lukaku wuxuu aamisan yahay in kooxda ay u soo bixi karto Champions League. 'Everton waxay ciyaaraan kubbad wanaagsan, waxaan dooneynaa inaan sare uga jirno horyaalka, qof walbana wuu doonayaa guul. Waxaan rabnaa inaan muujinno in sanadkii hore aysan ku imaan si kedis ah. Hadafkayagu waa inaan gaarno Champions League sababtoo ah waxaa naga lumi yay fursaddaas xilli ciyaareedkii hore.' Lukaku wuxuu taageeray tababaraha Everton Roberto Martinez si uu Champions League ugu keeno garoonka Goodison Park. Lukaku wuxuu wax ka sheegay noloshiisa gaarka ah, isagoo xusay inuu doorbido inuusan bixin, isla markaana uu iska ilaaliyo waxyaabaha badanaa lagu yaqaan ciyaartooyda da'da yar ee Premier League. Wuxuu yiri, 'Waxaan doorbidayaa inaan guriga joogo. Xitaa markii aan caruurnimo ku joogay Belgium, ma bixi jirin. Weligay maan cabbin khamri. Waa meel ka baxsan waxa aan is leeyahay waad ku fiican tahay, mana ogi sidaan u dhaqmo. Aad ayaan u xishoodaa. In dadka ii yaqaan sida asxaabta Everton, waxay ogaadeen inaan ahay qof faraxsan oo jecel kaftanka. Laakiin aniga qof aanan aqoon, marka hore aad ayaan u qabow ahay.'

article_content: The Monty Python stars launched their farewell show yesterday, featuring performances with dancers and appearances by notable guests. With the surviving members now in their seventies, they have hired 20 dancers—ten male and ten female—to add excitement to their ten-show run at London’s O2 Arena, beginning tonight. The dancers, wearing costumes designed by Agent Provocateur, appeared with Michael Palin, 71, in a routine based on Monty Python's 1970 sketch 'Blackmail.' John Cleese, 74, Terry Gilliam, 73, Terry Jones, 72, and Eric Idle, 71, also star in the £4.5 million production, which will feature appearances by Professors Stephen Hawking and Brian Cox. The Pythons also shared a humorous video featuring Sir Mick Jagger, 70, and Rolling Stones bandmate Charlie Watts, 73, joking about the show, calling it a group of older men trying to revisit their youth and make money. Michael Palin appears in a re-creation of the original 1970 'Blackmail' sketch. In the video, Jagger asks Watts who would want to see the show, commenting that it was funny in the 1960s and that the group had already put their material on YouTube. Leading up to the event, it was also announced that scientist Stephen Hawking will join the Pythons for their performances. The troupe—Cleese, Palin, Idle, Gilliam, and Jones—are reuniting for the concerts. In a press conference in London, Idle said Hawking is a fan and agreed to take part. Monty Python’s Flying Circus aired on television from 1969 to 1974, and remains popular with fans who can recite entire lines and sketches. The sixth member, Graham Chapman, died of cancer in 1989 at age 48. Nine years later, the group performed together at the Aspen Comedy Festival in the US. According to Cleese, the current show, with its large cast, set changes, and special effects, costs around £4.5 million to produce. Tickets for the reunion shows quickly sold out. Eric Idle, who oversaw much of the planning, said the idea is 'to leave them wanting less.' The press conference at London’s Palladium Theatre included a promotional clip featuring Mick Jagger and Charlie Watts discussing the concerts. Jagger humorously questioned why people would want to see a group of 'older men' revisiting their past. Idle commented that fans expect to see the classic sketches that made Monty Python famous, adding that it’s better to perform their best material rather than try to write new sketches now. He is confident the older jokes remain relevant and timeless. It was also announced that another 600 tickets would go on sale.

Kahor bandhigga, waxaa la shaaciyay in saynisyahan Stephen Hawking uu la ciyaarayo kooxda Monty Python. Kooxda—Cleese, Palin, Idle, Gilliam, iyo Jones—ayaa dib isugu yimid bandhigga. Shir jaraa'id oo ka dhacay London, Idle waxa uu sheegay in Hawking uu yahay taageere iyo inuu aqbalay martiqaadka. Tigidhada bandhigga iskusoo laabashada si dhaqso ah ayey u dhammaadeen. Jagger waxa uu si caadifad leh u tilmaamay sababta loo daawanayo rag waayeel ah oo isku dayaya inay dib u soo nooleeyaan ciyaartoodii hore. Idle waxa uu sheegay in taageerayaashu ay filayaan in ay mar kale daawadaan sketiyada classic-ga ah ee caaniga ahaa Monty Python, isagoo intaa ku daray in ay ka fiicantahay inay sii wadayaan waxyaabo hore halkii ay ka dhisi lahaayeen cusub. Kloe Richardson, a 15-year-old resident of Arbroath, died unexpectedly after collapsing during dance practice at Knox’s Church on Thursday evening. Despite immediate CPR efforts by classmates and the arrival of emergency services, she could not be revived and was pronounced dead at Ninewells Hospital in Dundee.

Diagnosed earlier this year with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy—a heart condition that can cause sudden cardiac events in young people—Kloe was on prescribed medication and had been active and lively before her death. Just three weeks prior, she won her age group in a Highland dance competition in Pitlochry.

A pupil at Arbroath Academy, Kloe was recognized for her enthusiasm for both dance and music, playing violin and keyboard in the school’s orchestra. Her family, especially her twin brother Dylan and siblings Kyle and Rhys, are heartbroken by her sudden loss. Head teacher Doreen Redfern praised Kloe’s friendly, bright nature and said she would be deeply missed by staff and students. Reverend Dr Nelu Balaj of Knox’s Church also offered condolences and support to all affected. The whole community has been united in mourning, remembering Kloe as both kind and exceptionally talented.

article_content: On the final day of the NFL draft, attention is focused on AJ McCarron and Michael Sam as teams decide which players to pick. If Michael Sam is selected, he will become the first openly gay football player drafted into the NFL, after revealing his sexuality in February. Alabama quarterback McCarron, who expected to be chosen on an earlier draft day, is also awaiting news of his selection. A total of 20 players are still waiting to be picked as the draft takes place at New York’s Radio City Music Hall. Both McCarron, who is engaged to television personality Katherine Webb, and Sam did not expect to be left until the last day. Sam was projected as a middle-round pick, but some teams have concerns about his size (6'2", 255 lbs) and speed for his position. If he is not drafted, Sam will become a free agent able to sign with any team. After coming out as gay earlier this year, 23-year-old Sam said: 'I am an openly, proud gay man... but I know what I want to be... I want to be a football player in the NFL.' He stated he went public to control his own story. NFL executives and coaches have publicly supported Sam, stating he will be evaluated based solely on his athletic ability. A league spokesperson said: 'We admire Michael Sam's honesty and courage. Any player with ability and determination can succeed in the NFL. We look forward to welcoming and supporting Michael Sam in 2014.' However, former Minnesota Vikings player Chris Kluwe has raised concerns that if Sam is not drafted, questions may be asked about possible discrimination based on his sexual orientation. He told the Associated Press: 'Guys who have to change positions are generally drafted in rounds three through five. A bad combine shouldn’t send him out of the draft. If that's the precedent and that precedent is not met, then why not?' McCarron, meanwhile, has also been anxiously awaiting selection, after being told he could be picked as high as 16th to 35th overall. He noted in an interview: 'I don’t have my hopes set on anything.' Other quarterbacks such as Johnny Manziel and Blake Bortles have already been selected. Manziel tweeted his excitement at joining the Cleveland Browns, and Bortles was picked by the Jacksonville Jaguars, with his girlfriend Lindsey Duke sharing her happiness online. Tight end Eric Ebron was picked by the Detroit Lions on the first day, and proposed to his girlfriend Brittany Rountree earlier that day at the Empire State Building. Another notable player waiting for selection is Aaron Murray, a Georgia quarterback regarded as a good backup option. Murray and his girlfriend, Fox anchor Kacie McDonnell, are passing time in Florida while they wait for the draft to conclude. Murray shared their plans to relax and enjoy the day despite the tension.

Haddii Michael Sam la doorto, wuxuu noqonayaa ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay ee si furan u sheegta in uu gay yahay ee laga doorto NFL, kadib markii uu shaaciyay jinsigiisa bishii Febraayo. Manziel ayaa Twitter ku muujiyay farxadda uu ugu biiray Cleveland Browns, halka Bortles uu la wareegay Jacksonville Jaguars, gabadhiisa Lindsey Duke-na waxay baraha bulshada la wadaagtay farxaddeeda. article_content: Rory McIlroy continues his impressive run of form, securing the U.S. PGA Championship title only three weeks after winning the British Open. This achievement makes him the first golfer since 2008 to win consecutive majors. Despite starting poorly on the final day at Valhalla, the 25-year-old finished with a score of three-under-par 68, beating Phil Mickelson by just one stroke. This latest victory marks McIlroy’s second time lifting the Wanamaker Trophy and his third consecutive tournament win, following last week's WGC-Bridgestone Invitational. Despite these successes, his focus has already shifted to the Masters, the only major he hasn’t won. Claiming victory at Augusta next year would complete his career grand slam. After a difficult 2013 season and a highly publicized breakup with tennis player Caroline Wozniacki, McIlroy states he is now more dedicated to achieving his golfing goals. He emphasizes the importance of making the most of his athletic prime, viewing each missed win as a lost opportunity. The Masters holds particular meaning for McIlroy, as he previously lost a significant lead in the 2011 tournament. He says it is important to return to Augusta as a four-time major champion, aiming not just for a fifth title but to complete the rare grand slam. McIlroy also aspires to join legendary golfers Ben Hogan, Jack Nicklaus, and Tiger Woods, the only players who have claimed three straight major titles. Aware of the expectations that come with his recent form, McIlroy expresses confidence in his ability to handle pressure and perform at Augusta.

article_content: Several costume companies have come under criticism for selling Halloween outfits labeled with terms like 'skitzo' and 'psycho ward.' Critics argue these costumes contribute to the stigmatization of people with mental health conditions. Government minister Norman Lamb described the costumes as 'horrendous' and urged retailers to refrain from selling items that could demonize those dealing with mental illness. Jokers' Masquerade and online stores like Fun World and Simply Fancy Dress are offering products such as a £12.45 orange jumpsuit called 'Adult Skitzo Costume'—including faux shackles and a mask—and a £20.99 'Maximum Restraint Halloween Costume' featuring a straightjacket and mask reminiscent of Hannibal Lecter. Mental health groups and advocates have criticized these items and called for their removal from stores. Norman Lamb intends to highlight this issue at the National Child and Adult Services conference, asserting that Halloween should not spread fear or misinformation about mental illness. Campaigners argue that these costumes reinforce harmful stereotypes that make it harder for individuals, especially young people, to seek help for mental health challenges. A petition started by Rebecca Holdcroft of Leeds urges sites like Jokers' Masquerade to stop selling these costumes, describing them as damaging and offensive. John Lawlor, chief executive of Northumberland, Tyne and Wear NHS Foundation Trust, pointed out that people would not consider marketing a 'cancer patient' costume and called for equal sensitivity regarding mental health. This controversy follows previous backlash against Asda and Tesco for selling similar 'mental patient' costumes, which both supermarkets withdrew after complaints. Responding to the concerns, Jokers' Masquerade’s Mike Dawson stated that offending people was not their intention and the company is open to feedback. He noted that they have renamed products and updated descriptions to be more considerate. Separately, Bar Risa in Birmingham faced criticism for holding an Ebola-themed Halloween party. Staff wore hazmat suits and the venue featured mock quarantine zones—despite the real Ebola outbreak then causing thousands of deaths in West Africa. The bar acknowledged its error and faced public condemnation for insensitivity. The pattern of controversial Halloween costumes also includes child-sized, blood-stained cheerleader and football uniforms sold by Asda. A spokesperson said such costumes are meant to be spooky and are popular during Halloween, not meant to depict real violence.

Jokers' Masquerade iyo goobaha Fun World iyo Simply Fancy Dress ayaa iibinaya dhar sidan oo kale ah, sida jumpsuit oranji ah oo lagu magacaabo 'Adult Skitzo Costume' iyo 'Maximum Restraint Halloween Costume' oo ah £20.99 kuna qalabeysan jaakad culeys ah iyo waji-xidh la mid ah kii Hannibal Lecter. article_content: Meta is using public posts from Facebook and Instagram to train its new artificial intelligence assistant, according to a spokesperson. The training includes both text and photos shared publicly, as confirmed by Nick Clegg, Meta’s president of global affairs, in an interview with Reuters on Thursday. However, the AI system does not access private posts, such as those shared only with friends and family, Clegg emphasized. Meta claims that it has implemented measures to exclude private details from the public data leveraged for AI development, though no specific techniques were detailed in the interview. Furthermore, Meta does not use private messages from its platforms or data from sites like LinkedIn in training the AI, citing privacy concerns. 'We've tried to exclude datasets that contain extensive personal information,' Clegg told Reuters. Meta recently launched its virtual assistant, Meta AI, to the public in a beta release. The new assistant is designed to help users create personalized digital stickers from text prompts, edit photos using text instructions, and interact with AI personalities, including Snoop Dogg as a 'Dungeons & Dragons' Dungeon Master. Meta AI was developed using the company’s Llama 2 language model and a text-to-image model called Emu. According to a Meta spokesperson, both models were trained using data from public Instagram and Facebook posts. Clegg noted that there may be upcoming legal challenges over the use of copyrighted material in AI training, stating, 'We think it is [fair use], but I strongly suspect that’s going to play out in litigation.' Authors, artists, and developers have filed lawsuits against AI companies, including Meta, expressing concerns that their creative work is being used without their permission to train technology that could impact their livelihoods. As per Meta’s policies, Facebook and Instagram users retain ownership of their posted content, provided it does not infringe on the intellectual property rights of others. Meta's press team did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside regular business hours.

Tababarka wuxuu ku salaysan yahay qoraalo iyo sawirro la wadaagay dadweynaha, sida uu xaqiijiyay Nick Clegg, madaxweynaha arrimaha caalamiga ah ee Meta, wareysi uu siiyay Reuters Khamiistii. article_content: While most people were celebrating at midnight on New Year's Eve, some families were welcoming new babies into the world. Lethea Rankine from Edgbaston, Birmingham, gave birth to her daughter Gracie, weighing 7lb 7oz, just seconds after midnight by caesarian section. Gracie joins a family known for memorable birthdays: her great-grandmother Adina Seymour and grandmother Georganne Rankine were both born on Christmas Day, and her grandfather Leighton Rankine was born on December 31. Lethea, who moved to the UK from the Cayman Islands two years ago, said she felt a mix of emotions during the birth, describing it as terrifying and painful, but also exciting knowing Gracie arrived right as the new year began. She said, 'She's so beautiful. My waters broke around 9:30 am on New Year's Eve, contractions started about 7:30 pm, and she arrived at 12:00 on the dot—well, ten seconds past midnight.' Gracie's father, Romeo Welcome, 27, was overjoyed, joking that Gracie looks like him. Lethea added, 'We've been on the phone to my family and everyone is so excited. There must be something in the genes about birthdays.' Elsewhere, Martin Ogilvie was born at 12:01 am at St John's Hospital in Livingston, Scotland, to parents Edward and Colleen. In Coventry, Edward Sutheran and Lola-Jai Fenton were also born early on New Year's Day. Altogether, 11 babies were born at Birmingham hospital on New Year's Day, which hospital spokeswoman Nichola Robinson said is a high number in a short period. For some families, the day was poignant; Martin's parents, Edward and Colleen, had previously lost his twin in the same hospital in November.

article_content: New Zealand's cricket team left Pune disappointed after suffering their third consecutive World Cup defeat, this time to South Africa, with a growing injury list threatening their chances of reaching the semi-finals. Pace bowler Matt Henry is unlikely to play in Saturday's (Nov 4) crucial match against Pakistan after injuring his right hamstring during the 190-run loss to the Proteas. Kyle Jamieson has been called up from New Zealand as cover for Henry and is expected to join the squad late on Thursday, according to the team. Jimmy Neesham is dealing with a bruised right wrist after being struck by the ball while bowling in the first innings. Although an X-ray confirmed no broken bones, selectors may have little choice but to play the all-rounder due to injury concerns over Mark Chapman (calf) and Kane Williamson (thumb), both of whom were ruled out of the South Africa game. Paceman Lockie Ferguson is nursing a right Achilles injury but was cleared of significant damage by scans, and selectors hope he will be available for the match against Pakistan. "It's sad to see guys get injured but at the same time it gives others opportunities," all-rounder Daryl Mitchell told reporters. "We're a close group, we support each other, and we've done it for a long time." After winning their first four games in a perfect start, the Black Caps have now lost to India, Australia, and South Africa. They are in fourth place in the standings, two points ahead of Pakistan. The top four teams advance to the semi-finals. The heavy defeat to South Africa hurt their run-rate, and another loss against Pakistan could allow the South Asians to move into the top four. Captain Tom Latham surprised many by choosing to field after winning the toss against South Africa, a team known for strong performances batting first. Despite this, middle-order batsman Glenn Phillips supported the decision: "South Africa are strong batting first, but we have a great bowling attack and could have restricted them to a more manageable total." New Zealand cannot afford more mistakes but are confident their World Cup destiny is in their control. Wins in their last two matches against Pakistan and Sri Lanka should secure a semi-final spot. "If we stick to our brand, we know we're fighters and keep coming back when it matters most," said Phillips.

Matt Henry, oo ah qof kubbad tuura, laga yaabo inuusan ka qeyb-gelin kulanka muhiimka ah ee Sabtida (Nov 4) ee ay la ciyaarayaan Pakistan kadib markii uu jug kasoo gaaray lugta midig intii lagu jiray guuldarradii 190-run ahayd ee ay ka qaadeen Proteas. Kyle Jamieson ayaa laga soo daray kooxda New Zealand si uu u buuxiyo booska Henry waxaana la filayaa inuu la midoobo kooxda Khamiista fiidkii, sida kooxda sheegtay. "Waxa xanuun leh in ciyaartoygu dhaawacmo, balse waxay sidoo kale fursad siinaysaa kuwa kale," ayuu warbaahinta u sheegay Daryl Mitchell oo ah all-rounder. "Kooxdeennu waa mid is jecel, waan is taageernaa, waanan sameyneynay muddo dheer." Kadib markay guuleysteen afar ciyaarood oo isku xiga bilowgii koobka, Black Caps waxay guuldarrooyin ka qaateen India, Australia, iyo South Africa. Kabtan Tom Latham waxa uu dad badan la yaabiyey isagu oo doortay inuu kubbad tuuro marka uu guuleystay laadka garoon doorashada South Africa, oo ah koox caan ku ah inay si fiican u horumarto markay hore u ciyaarto. New Zealand ma awoodi karaan khaladaad kale, balse waxay ku kalsoon yihiin in masiirkooda koobka adduunka uu gacantooda ku jiro. article_content: A disturbing video has surfaced showing a woman verbally abusing two international students in the waiting room of Ipswich Hospital in Suffolk. The incident occurred on Saturday night around 7:30 pm, when Gina Thompson, 23, a film and media student from Port Harcourt, Nigeria, and her 21-year-old Spanish friend from Seville were waiting after the latter injured her ankle playing sports. In the two-minute video, the woman is seen directing racist and offensive remarks at the students, questioning their presence in the UK and making derogatory comments about taxes and the state of the country. The altercation took place in front of about 20 shocked patients and their families. Miss Thompson, who has been studying at University Campus Suffolk for two years, was visibly upset and later told how the incident made her feel humiliated and fearful. Her Spanish friend, who arrived in the UK last September, also felt shaken and unsafe. Hospital staff and security quickly intervened after police were called. According to Suffolk Constabulary, the woman was arrested on-site and later charged with assaulting a police officer, two counts of racially aggravated assault, and two additional counts of assault—a total of five charges. She is scheduled to appear before Ipswich Magistrates’ Court on February 20, 2013.

article_content: Mohamed Hady Taresh, who was forced to abandon his studies and leave Syria amidst civil war in 2013, has graduated with a first-class master's degree in cyber security from the University of Gloucestershire. Fleeing his home country for safety, he arrived in the UK in 2022 with his wife, Jollanar, and their five-year-old daughter, Alice, seeking a better life. Before moving to the UK, Taresh spent 10 years working in IT management roles in Syria, Lebanon, Egypt, and Cyprus. When their city of Raqqa became too dangerous during the conflict, the family escaped, eventually making their way to Cheltenham, England. Their late-night arrival brought anxiety, but the calm of the countryside restored a sense of safety. Restricted from working while his asylum claim was processed, Taresh decided to further his education. He became the first postgraduate to receive the Michael Perham Sanctuary Scholarship at the University of Gloucestershire, receiving vital support through food vouchers and travel assistance. Graduating with top honors, Taresh said his achievement felt like a "dream come true" and expressed heartfelt gratitude for the opportunities that came his way despite facing many obstacles. The article concludes with a mention of BBC West's social media links.

Isagoo raadinaya amni iyo nolol dhaanta, wuxuu 2022 UK ula soo guuray xaaskiisa Jollanar iyo gabadhooda Alice oo shan jir ah. article_content: Sampdoria claimed a 3-1 victory over Fiorentina in Sunday's Serie A match. The game saw Sampdoria's goalkeeper Sergio Romero save a penalty, reinforcing his reputation after previous World Cup heroics. Defender Angelo Palombo put Sampdoria ahead with a penalty in the 27th minute but conceded another penalty just five minutes later after fouling Kouma Babacar. However, Romero denied Fiorentina's Gonzalo Rodriguez from the spot, maintaining Sampdoria's lead. Luca Rizzo doubled Sampdoria's advantage with a solo goal, before Fiorentina's Stefan Savic headed in during first-half stoppage time to narrow the margin. In the second half, Brazilian forward Eder secured the win for Sampdoria by dribbling past three defenders and finishing under goalkeeper Norberto Neto. Fiorentina's Mario Gomez made his first appearance since recovering from a September thigh injury, coming on as a substitute in the second half. With this win, Sampdoria climbed to third in the standings, one point ahead of Genoa and Napoli. Juventus remain at the top with 25 points, followed by Roma with 22 points. Elsewhere, Udinese's veteran striker Antonio Di Natale scored his 199th Serie A goal and the fastest goal of the season after just 23 seconds, but Udinese ultimately lost 4-2 at home against Genoa. Genoa equalized with Giovanni Marchese's volley and took the lead as Iago Falque capitalized on a defensive error. Although Udinese leveled before halftime through Silvan Widmer, further goals from Alessandro Matri and Juraj Kucka gave Genoa the victory. Di Natale nearly reached his 200th goal, narrowly missing with a shot that grazed the post. In other matches, Chievo drew 0-0 with Sassuolo, earning their first point under new coach Rolando Maran, while Torino and Atalanta also played out a goalless draw.

article_content:
Donna Edmunds, a UKIP councillor and candidate for the European Parliament in the South East, has drawn criticism after saying businesses should be allowed to refuse service to anyone, regardless of gender, race, or sexual orientation. These remarks came after she was questioned about fellow UKIP councillor David Silvester’s claim that recent UK floods were caused by government support for same-sex marriage. Edmunds clarified that, while she does not share Silvester’s views, she believes private businesses should have the freedom to choose whom they serve.

Her comments, initially made online, were met with strong criticism. Edmunds later stated she regretted her choice of words and clarified that her position is based on libertarian ideals of minimal government intervention, not an endorsement of discrimination. She said she opposes all prejudice and apologized for any negative impact her remarks may have had on her party.

UKIP leader Nigel Farage has recently praised the quality of the party’s candidates, but party representatives distanced themselves from Edmunds’ statement, describing it as misguided and emphasizing the party does not support such views. James Ledward, editor of GScene Gay Magazine, strongly condemned Edmunds’ comments. UKIP confirmed that Edmunds had apologized and reaffirmed efforts to maintain high candidate standards.

Edmunds waxay cadeysay inaysan aragtidaas la raacsanayn, laakiin ay aaminsan tahay in ganacsiyada gaarka loo leeyahay ay xor u yihiin inay cida ay doonaan u adeegaan.

article_content: The pace of tur (pigeon pea) imports from Mozambique to India has slowed significantly, leading to a slower correction in domestic tur prices. Indian importers claim that over 150,000 tonnes of tur have been sitting at Mozambican ports for over a month, as some exporters are allegedly withholding the cargo. India has been facing shortages of pulses such as tur, urad, and masur. Despite overall retail inflation easing to 5.02% in September, the prices of pulses increased from 13% in August to 16.4% in September. Tur prices in India have stabilized after the government imposed stricter stock limits on traders and processors. However, a pulse importer from Maharashtra noted, 'Prices of African tur, which have declined by 5%, could have decreased by another 10% if imports had been smoother.' The importer added that while tur dal prices have been stable, the price of African whole tur with skin, expected to drop to ₹75-80/kg, has only fallen to ₹90/kg from a high of ₹95-96/kg due to the slower pace of imports from Mozambique. 'Some traders from Mozambique are trying to artificially increase prices and block supplies to India,' the importer alleged. In related news, an industry body representing India's top three telecom companies has accused major global technology firms, such as Microsoft and Amazon, of bypassing legal telecom channels by using platforms like WhatsApp to send business messages. This could be causing an annual revenue loss of around ₹3,000 crore to both the government and telecom providers. The government has requested that Apple cooperate in an investigation into alleged state-sponsored hacking attempts on iPhones belonging to several prominent Indians, including opposition parliament members, according to S Krishnan, secretary of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. Additionally, the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) informed the Delhi High Court that Go First’s leased aircraft and engines can be deregistered and returned to their lessors, impacting the bankrupt airline’s revival hopes.

Soo dejiyeyaasha Hindiya waxay sheegayaan in in ka badan 150,000 tan tur ah ay muddo ka badan bil yaalleen dekedaha Mozambique, iyadoo lagu eedeeyay in qaar ka mid ah dhoofiyeyaasha ay si ula kac ah u hayaan alaabta. Hindiya waxay la tacaaleysaa yaraanta digirta kala duwan sida tur, urad, iyo masur. Inkastoo sicir-bararkii guud uu hoos ugu dhacay 5.02% bishii Sebtember, haddana qiimaha digirta ayaa kordhay 13% bishii Agoosto una kacay 16.4% bishii Sebtember. Qiimaha tur ee Hindiya ayaa degay kadib markii dowladda Hindiya ay adkaysay xayiraadda kaydka ee ganacsatada iyo warshadeeyayaasha. Si kastaba, mid ka mid ah soo dejiyeyaasha digirta ee Maharashtra ayaa sheegay, 'Qiimaha tur-ka Afrikaanka ah, oo hoos u dhacay 5%, wuxuu sii dhici lahaa ilaa 10% dheeraad ah haddii soo dejinta ay fudeyd lahayd.' Soo dejiyuhu wuxuu intaas ku daray in inkastoo qiimaha tur dal uu deggan yahay, hadana qiimaha tur-ka Afrikaanka ah ee aan la shiilin, oo la filayay inuu hoos ugu dhaco ₹75-80/kg, uu kaliya hoos ugu dhacay ₹90/kg halka uu gaarsiisnaa ₹95-96/kg sababo la xiriira hoos u dhaca soo dejinta laga keenayo Mozambique. 'Qaar ka mid ah ganacsatada Mozambique ayaa isku dayaya inay si macmal ah u kordhiyaan qiimaha, iyagoo xanibaya sahayda tur ee Hindiya,' ayuu yiri soo dejiyaha. War la xiriira arrintan, urur warshadeed matalaya saddexda shirkadood ee hormuudka u ah shirkadaha isgaarsiinta Hindiya ayaa ku eedeeyay shirkado waaweyn oo caalami ah sida Microsoft iyo Amazon, in ay hareer marinayaan sharciga isgaarsiinta iyagoo adeegsanaya baraha sida WhatsApp si ay fariimo ganacsi ugu diraan macaamiisha. Tani waxay sababi kartaa khasaare dakhli sanadle ah oo gaaraya qiyaastii ₹3,000 crore dowladda iyo shirkadaha isgaarsiinta. Dowladda Hindiya waxay Apple ka codsatay inay ka qeyb qaadato baaritaan la xiriira eedeymo ah in la isku dayay in si sirdoon dawli ah loo jabsado iPhone-yada dhowr ruux oo caan ah oo ay ka mid yihiin xubnaha mucaaradka ee baarlamaanka, sida uu sheegay S Krishnan, xoghayaha wasaaradda tignoolajiyada macluumaadka. Sidoo kale, Hay’adda Duulista Rayidka ee DGCA ayaa u sheegtay Maxkamadda Sare ee Delhi in diyaaradaha iyo matoorada Go First oo la kireystay la diiwaangelin karo laguna celin karo shirkadaha ay ka kiraysteen, taas oo dhaawacaysa rajada soo kabashada shirkadda diyaaradeed ee bangrutay.

article_content: An Iranian man who was refused asylum by the Home Office has pursued nine legal battles in less than five years, according to judges. The 20-year-old lost his latest attempt to stay in the UK in the Court of Appeal, but he may still take his case to the Supreme Court. The man, whose name was not disclosed, arrived in Britain unaccompanied in January 2009 at the age of 15 and claimed asylum. Since then, he has taken his case to immigration tribunals and the High Court, including appeals and a judicial review. Three judges in London today dismissed his most recent appeal, which challenged an earlier upper tribunal decision denying him permission to contest a previous tribunal’s ruling. Lord Justice Maurice Kay, in the written ruling, explained that this was the ninth judicial consideration of the man’s case. He said the man's claim focused on legislation requiring Home Office officials to act in the best interests of unaccompanied children by attempting to trace family members as quickly as possible. The asylum seeker argued that then-Home Secretary Theresa May had failed to fulfill this tracing duty. Lord Justice Maurice Kay noted that his appeal was the latest in a series of cases alleging Home Office failures regarding the tracing regulations.

Ninkan 20 jirka ah ayaa maanta ku waayay dacwadiisii ugu dambeysay ee uu ku doonayay in uu UK ku joogo maxkamadda Court of Appeal, balse wali wuu heli karaa fursad uu kiiskiisa ugu gudbiyo Supreme Court. article_content: Chef and mixology expert Kathy Casey forecasts that fresh ginger and hibiscus will be standout flavors in cocktails for 2010. Known worldwide for her creative approach to drinks and cuisine, Casey’s company, Kathy Casey Food Studios®-Liquid Kitchen, recently assisted the new nightclub at Fairmont Abu Dhabi with its menu design. When crafting sparkling beverages for Middle Eastern tastes, she swaps out apple cider for sparkling date cider.  From her recent book, 'Sips & Apps,' Casey shares two inventive cocktail recipes:  Green-Eye Daiquiri: This festive twist on the classic includes a dramatic touch—fresh thyme briefly set aflame with green Chartreuse, which brings in complex botanical notes. To prepare one drink: Place two thyme sprigs in a sturdy, heat-proof old-fashioned glass, add green Chartreuse, and carefully ignite it. Once the thyme is singed, use simple syrup to extinguish the flame. Add lime juice and white rum, fill the glass with ice, stir well, and garnish with thyme. *Simple Syrup: Combine equal parts water and sugar, boil, then cool. Store refrigerated.  Chameleon Club: Designed for the Chameleon nightclub in Abu Dhabi launching on New Year's Eve, this cocktail modernizes tradition with fresh ginger and hibiscus. To make one drink: Muddle a small slice of ginger in a shaker (no ice), add gin (or vodka), lemon juice, homemade hibiscus syrup, and egg white. Add ice and shake vigorously to foam the egg white, then strain into a martini glass and garnish with candied ginger.  Hibiscus Syrup: Boil two cups water with two cups sugar and a generous cup of dried hibiscus flowers for a minute. Remove from heat, let steep for half an hour, then strain. Press flowers to extract more flavor. Store the cooled syrup in the fridge.

"Edge of Tomorrow" stars Tom Cruise and Emily Blunt. Cruise plays a reluctant hero trapped in a time loop during an alien invasion, forced to relive the same day repeatedly. He joins forces with Blunt’s formidable soldier, and together they seek a solution to save humanity. The film combines clever writing with intense action, and Cruise and Blunt share impressive chemistry.

"The Matrix" is a landmark 1990s action film that redefined the genre by drawing on Asian cinema influences. It follows a computer coder who realizes his reality is a simulation, and its originality has left a lasting impact on action movies.

"Strange Days," released in 1995, was initially overlooked but is now viewed as a modern classic. Set in a dystopian Los Angeles marked by immersive technology and police brutality, it follows a man unraveling a vast conspiracy involving his friends. The movie’s dark, detailed world-building makes it essential viewing for action fans.

Julian Fellowes, creator of Downton Abbey, has sparked controversy by asserting that only those with an 'expensive education,' like his own, can truly understand the works of William Shakespeare. This claim follows criticism from Shakespeare scholars regarding his recent film adaptation of 'Romeo and Juliet,' starring Hailee Steinfeld, Douglas Booth, and Damian Lewis, which features rewritten dialogue.

Caitlin Griffin, from the Folger Shakespeare Library in Washington DC, the world’s largest Shakespeare collection, questioned Fellowes' approach, pointing out that his adaptation, while poetic and set in the correct period, does not utilize Shakespeare’s original language—a detail not clearly conveyed in its advertising. Professor Michael Dobson, director of the Shakespeare Institute at the University of Birmingham, noted the trend of simplifying Shakespeare’s complex vocabulary for clarity, as Fellowes did, though some changes may seem awkward.

Fellowes defended his choices, stating that understanding Shakespeare in its original form requires specialized education: 'I can do that because I had a very expensive education at Cambridge. Not everyone did.'

This view drew criticism. Janet Suzman of the Royal Shakespeare Company told The Guardian that one does not need a special education to respond to Shakespeare, stressing that skilled actors can make the meaning accessible to any audience. Professor Stanley Wells, President of the Shakespeare Birthplace Trust, echoed this sentiment, noting that some of the best Shakespeare scholars attended comprehensive schools. Wells added that Shakespeare’s works range from high complexity to profound simplicity, and that actors' performances help audiences grasp the meaning without requiring scholarly analysis. He said that while understanding Shakespeare may require some effort, the greatest works are open to all.

Penelope Middleboe, CEO of the Shakespeare Schools Festival, also rejected Fellowes' assertion, highlighting that their programs help children from all backgrounds enjoy and engage with Shakespeare.

This latest issue comes after a previous controversy involving Fellowes over a rape scene in Downton Abbey, which received over 200 complaints. Fellowes defended the depiction, saying it was handled with restraint to explore the resulting emotions, rather than for sensationalism.

article_content: The Organisation for the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) has postponed its meeting to finalize oil output levels for 2024 from its original date to November 30, citing disagreements over production quotas for its African members, according to Bloomberg and Reuters. Sources report that Angola and Nigeria requested extra time because of lower production targets set by more influential OPEC members. "This postponement indicates difficulties within the OPEC+ group to reach an agreement on production cuts," said Jorge Leon, Senior Vice President at Rystad Energy. The meeting involves major oil producers, including Saudi Arabia, Russia, and other OPEC+ members, and is expected to review potential changes to an agreement that already limits oil supply into 2024. Analysts suggest that the delay could mean more oil production may come online in the next few months. Dennis Kissler, Senior Vice President of Trading at BOK Financial, noted that rising inventories also add pressure to oil prices. John Evans, an oil broker at PVM, said that in order to support prices, OPEC and its allies need to not only extend but also deepen production cuts. Earlier this week, an OPEC technical panel invited a major financial market dealer to present an outlook, and according to Reuters, the presentation reflected a bearish view for the oil market.

Isbuucan hore, guddiga farsamada ee OPEC ayaa casuumay khabiir ka socda suuqa maaliyadda si uu u soo bandhigo saadaal, taasoo, sida ay Reuters sheegtay, la soo bandhigay aragti hoos u dhac ah oo la xiriirta suuqyada saliidda.

article_content: By Sara Malm The Earth's core is nearly 1,000 degrees Celsius hotter than previously thought, making it as fiery as the surface of the sun. Recent experiments have determined that the core temperature is around 6,000°C, much higher than the previous estimate of 5,000°C. Researchers used X-rays to study iron crystals under extreme pressure to examine how iron melts and forms. The Earth's inner core is a solid ball of iron about the size of the moon, surrounded by a dynamic outer core composed mostly of a liquid iron-nickel alloy. Experiments in the early 1990s, which measured the melting curves of iron, indicated the core's temperature was about 5,000°C. In this new research, scientists used one of the world's most powerful X-ray sources at the European Synchrotron Radiation Facility to replicate pressures found at the core. A device called a diamond anvil cell, where a tiny sample is pressed between two precision-machined synthetic diamonds, was used to apply the required pressure. Researchers then used X-ray diffraction to observe the behavior of iron crystals. Agnes Dewaele of the French research agency CEA, a co-author of the study, told BBC News, 'Other groups made different measurements and computer calculations, but the results did not agree. That wasn't good for our field.' 'We need to provide accurate data to geophysicists, seismologists, and geodynamicists, as they need this information for their models,' Dr. Dewaele added.

Tijaabooyin cusub ayaa lagu ogaaday in heerkulka xuddunta dhulka uu gaarayo qiyaastii 6,000°C, taasoo ka sarreysa qiyaastii hore ee ahayd 5,000°C. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay adeegsadeen raajooyinka X-ray si ay u sahamiyaan sida birta isu beddesho marka la saaro cadaadis aad u badan. Xuddunta gudaha ee dhulka waa kubad adag oo bir ah, oo cabirkeedu la eg yahay dayaxa, waxaana ku hareereysan xuddun dibadeed firfircoon oo badankeed laga sameeyay bir iyo nikkel dareere ah. Tijaabooyinkii hore ee 1990-meeyadii oo lagu cabiray sida birtu u dhalaasho ayaa muujiyay in heerkulka xuddunta dhulku yahay qiyaastii 5,000°C. Cilmi-baaristan cusub, saynisyahannadu waxay adeegsadeen mid kamid ah ilaha X-ray-ga ugu awoodda badan ee European Synchrotron Radiation Facility si ay u abuurtaan cadaadis la mid ah midka xuddunta. Waxay adeegsanayeen qalab la yiraahdo diamond anvil cell, kaasoo muunad yar lagu dhex xiro laba dheeman oo si gaar ah loo farsameeyay si cadaadis loogu saaro. Kadib, cilmi-baarayaashu waxay adeegsadeen farsamada X-ray diffraction si ay u eegaan dhaqanka crystals-ka birta. Agnes Dewaele oo ka tirsan hay'adda cilmi-baarista Faransiiska ee CEA, oo co-author ka ah daraasadda, ayaa BBC News u sheegtay, 'Kooxo kale waxay sameeyeen cabbirro iyo xisaabaad kombuyuutar, balse natiijooyinkoodu isma waafaqin. Taasina cilmigeena uma fiicnayn.' 'Waa inaan siinaa xog sax ah geophysicists, seismologists, iyo geodynamicists, sababtoo ah waxa ay xogtan ugu baahanyihiin modeladooda,' ayey Dr. Dewaele ku dartay.

article_content: US Navy sailors attempting to approach the lifeboat holding Captain Richard Phillips were fired upon by Somali pirates off the eastern coast of Africa, according to a US official. The guided missile frigate USS Halyburton, equipped with helicopters, joined the USS Bainbridge at the scene. The attacked sailors did not fire back and returned to the Bainbridge. The incident stems from the hijacking of the Maersk Alabama, a US-flagged cargo ship transporting food aid to Kenya, around 350 miles from Somalia. Captain Phillips had offered himself as a hostage during the hijacking to protect his crew. The crew successfully regained the ship, though how remains undisclosed. About 20 crew members arrived safely in Mombasa with added security. FBI agents were dispatched to debrief the crew before their disembarkation. The US Navy spearheaded the response, and the FBI began a criminal investigation since US citizens were involved, with its New York office coordinating the case and sending agents to Africa. Support for Phillips’s family is strong in his Vermont hometown, with relatives and neighbors offering help during the ordeal. Elsewhere, pirates aboard the hijacked German ship Hansa Stavanger attempted to reach Phillips’s captors but turned back due to significant US naval presence, returning to the Somali port of Eyl. The Hansa Stavanger had also been hijacked days prior. Military sources confirmed that Phillips, guarded by four armed pirates in a covered lifeboat, tried to escape by jumping overboard but was soon caught and restrained. Due to escalating piracy in the region, the Navy increased its presence, deploying the USS Halyburton and the amphibious assault ship USS Boxer, which has a medical facility, to support operations. This piracy crisis has led to increased anxiety among sailors and cruise passengers transiting near Somalia, prompting US forces to focus on resolving the standoff and safeguarding those involved.

Markabka USS Halyburton oo wata helikoptaro ayaa ku biiray USS Bainbridge oo horey halkaas ugu sugneyd. Ciidamada la weeraray ma aysan celin rasaasta, waxayna dib ugu laabteen USS Bainbridge. Waxaa markabka saarnaa qiyaastii 20 ruux oo si nabad ah ugu yimid Mombasa iyagoo wata ciidan amni ah. FBI ayaa diyaarisay ehel loogu wareysto shaqaalaha ka hor inta aysan ka degin. Ciidanka badda Mareykanka ayaa hoggaaminaya howlgalka, FBI-da ayaa furtay baadhitaan rexan dambiyeed maadaama muwaadiniin Mareykan ah ay ku jiraan, iyadoo xafiiska New York ee FBI-da loo xilsaaray arrintaasi lana dirayo wakiillo Afrika. Dhanka kale, burcad-baddeed saarnaa markabka Jarmalka ee la afduubay Hansa Stavanger ayaa isku dayay in ay caawiyaan burcadii haystay Phillips balse waxay dib ugu laabteen dekedda Eyl ee Soomaaliya kadib markay la kulmeen ciidan Mareykan ah oo xoogan. Kai la xiriira kororka falalka burcad-baddeedda gobolkaas, ciidanka badda Mareykanka ayaa kordhiyay joogitaankooda, iyagoo keenay USS Halyburton iyo USS Boxer oo leh xanaanada caafimaad si ay uga qaybqaataan howlgalka. article_content: United Airlines is introducing a new boarding process that prioritizes economy class passengers with window seats, starting October 26. This change—reported by ABC News from an internal memo—is designed to reduce boarding time by about two minutes. Known as 'WILMA' boarding, the updated system will have economy flyers with window seats board first, followed by passengers in middle seats and then those in aisle seats. This system has already been tested at select domestic airports. The revised boarding order does not apply to premium class travelers, elite status holders, or pre-boarding groups. For those on the same economy reservation, everyone will board together in the highest group allowed, except for Basic Economy customers who remain in the final boarding group. United says boarding times have increased since 2019 and that this adjustment comes ahead of the busy holiday season to help keep flights on time.

article_content: A video showing secretary Ellie Cole, 34, dancing to music on her headphones at a bus stop has become an online sensation. In the clip, which features Abba’s ‘Dancing Queen’, Ellie is seen moving enthusiastically while waiting for her bus home from work. She waggles her head, waves her arms, and performs lively dance moves that have delighted locals. The video has been viewed over 380,000 times on YouTube and has garnered more than 69,700 'likes' on Facebook. The bus stop is near a cafe in Eastleigh, Hampshire, owned by Jane Rowland, 45, whose partner Nigel Baker filmed and uploaded the dance. Jane said, 'Everyone around here knows her. Drivers beep their appreciation and she’s truly an inspiration. People in America have said watching her dance made them smile after the recent tragic events in Boston.' Ellie explained that she often dances to songs like 'Knock Down' by Alesha Dixon while waiting for the bus. Her energetic performances, complete with air punches and creative gestures, have even attracted international attention, with fans from Australia, Brazil, and the US commenting positively online. Ellie, from Southampton, says, 'I have my headphones in every day on the way back from work and just can’t help myself—I love to dance.' Her mother finds it unusual, but Ellie insists she’s simply a cheerful, everyday person who enjoys moving to music. Nigel, a former DJ, mentioned that the video’s soundtrack was chosen for its upbeat mood, and was surprised by its rapid popularity. 'We shared it online and it was an instant hit, even being discussed on American radio stations. The feedback has been overwhelmingly positive.' Customers at Jane’s cafe and passersby look forward to Ellie’s performances, which have become a local highlight. Sometimes, she ends her routine with a special move to signal the approaching bus, waving to drivers who honk as they go by. Fans worldwide have praised Ellie’s joyful attitude. Comments on YouTube include, 'She’s a fantastic example of how to enjoy life,' and 'She made my day.'

article_content: Hannah Notley, 30, a police constable with Essex Police trained in sexual offenses, admitted to failing to investigate a reported rape case and misleading both her supervisors and the victim. She claimed the case had been reviewed and dismissed by the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS), when in reality it was never submitted for prosecution. These events took place between July 2011 and April 2012, during which Notley also neglected to correct the misunderstanding among her superiors regarding the case's status. Appearing at Inner London Crown Court, Notley pleaded guilty to misconduct in public office, accepting she violated the trust required of her position by giving false information about the investigation’s progression. The court’s decision on sentencing has been postponed until December 6 to obtain further reports on Notley’s personal circumstances. Her lawyer asserted that her actions were not connected to corruption. Judge Alistair McCreath stressed the serious nature of the offense but explained that sentencing would be determined after reviewing all available information. Notley was released on bail until her sentencing date. Due to legal considerations, public comments on the case are currently not being accepted.

article_content: Planning your expenses carefully is wise, but unexpected needs can always arise. In such situations, a personal loan from the right lender can be a valuable relief. Whether you need funds for education, travel, or home improvements, personal loans provide flexible solutions. Most lenders prefer applicants with a credit score of at least 750, but it’s still possible to get approved with a lower score by taking specific steps: 1. Request a smaller loan amount: Lenders are typically cautious about lending large sums to those with lower credit scores due to the increased risk. Applying for a smaller amount can improve your chances of approval. Successfully repaying this loan can also help increase your credit score over time. 2. Apply with a co-applicant or guarantor: If your own credit score is low, consider applying for a loan with a guarantor or co-applicant who has a better credit history. Lenders will consider both scores, which increases your likelihood of approval, especially for larger amounts. 3. Demonstrate stable income: Lenders need assurance that you can make consistent repayments. Even with a low credit score, showing proof of a steady income or additional sources of funds can support your application. A stable cash flow can give lenders confidence to approve your loan. 4. Review and correct errors on your credit report: Mistakes on your credit report can negatively impact your score. Look for errors, like closed accounts listed as open or unfamiliar inquiries, and have them corrected quickly. Fixing these issues can boost your score and improve your loan chances. By following these tips, you can increase your chances of securing a personal loan even if your credit score is below 750. Regularly monitoring your credit report keeps you informed and helps you address any issues early, making the loan approval process smoother. Choosing a reputable lender will also help ensure a hassle-free experience. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs): 1. Can I get a personal loan if my credit score is below 750? Yes, you can. Strategies like requesting a smaller loan amount, applying with a co-applicant or guarantor, and proving a stable income can help you get approved even with a lower credit score. 2. Why is choosing a smaller loan amount helpful if I have a low credit score? Lenders are more cautious about lending large amounts to individuals with low credit scores. Asking for a smaller loan increases the likelihood of approval. Timely repayments can also help you build your credit score. 3. Can applying with a co-applicant or guarantor help if I have a low credit score? Yes. Applying with someone who has a good credit history improves your chances because the lender assesses both credit scores and views your application as less risky. 4. How important is it to demonstrate a stable income when applying for a loan with a low credit score? It’s very important. Lenders want to know that you’ll be able to repay the loan. Even with a less-than-ideal credit score, a consistent and reliable income can help your application get approved. 5. Is reviewing my credit report necessary before applying? Absolutely. Checking your credit report for errors, such as incorrectly listed accounts or unexplained inquiries, is important. Fixing these errors improves your creditworthiness and your chance of loan approval. Using free services regularly can help you keep track of your credit health.

article_content: Six Lionel Messi jerseys, worn during Argentina’s run to World Cup victory in Qatar 2022, will be auctioned at Sotheby’s and could surpass $10 million—possibly breaking records for sports memorabilia sales. From November 30 to December 14, Sotheby’s in New York will showcase and sell six of the shirts Messi wore in the first half of tournament matches, including the one from the intense final against France, where Argentina claimed the trophy in a penalty shootout following a 3-3 stalemate at Lusail Stadium. Soccer stars, including Messi, are known to swap jerseys after games, making his shirts particularly sought after among collectors. Sotheby’s will open a public display of these rare jerseys at its New York headquarters during the auction period. The auction is conducted with AC Momento, a tech firm that manages athletes’ match-worn memorabilia. If bids reach expected levels, Messi’s shirts could become the most valuable sports memorabilia ever auctioned, topping the $10.1 million record set by Michael Jordan’s 1998 NBA Finals jersey. In football, the highest previous record is for Diego Maradona’s 1986 World Cup shirt—famed for the 'Hand of God' goal—which sold for $9.3 million. A portion of proceeds will support the UNICAS Project for children with rare diseases, run by Sant Joan de Déu Barcelona Children’s Hospital and supported by the Leo Messi Foundation. Messi, now 36 and playing with Inter Miami in Major League Soccer, had an outstanding 17 years with Barcelona, winning multiple La Liga and Champions League titles plus an unmatched eight Ballon d’Or awards. His World Cup win in Qatar is a landmark that cements his legacy alongside icons like Pele and Maradona, making his shirts exceptionally valuable.

Laga bilaabo 30-ka November ilaa 14-ka December, Sotheby’s magaalada New York waxay soo bandhigi doontaa lana xaraashi doonaa lix ka mid ah funaanadaha uu Messi xirtay qeybta hore ee ciyaartii koobka, oo ay ku jirto tii uu ku xirtay finalkii kulul ee la ciyaaray France, oo Argentina ku guuleysatay rigoore kaddib markii lagu kala baxay 3-3 garoonka Lusail. Ciyaartooyda kubadda cagta, gaar ahaan Messi, waxay caadi u tahay inay funaanadaha isku beddelaan marka ay ciyaartu dhammaato, taasoo funaanadihiisa ka dhigaysa kuwo aad loo jecel yahay. article_content: Trading on the Nigerian Exchange Limited (NGX) opened negatively on Monday, ending several days of gains and resulting in a N57 billion loss for investors. The All-Share Index dropped by 0.15% to close at 71,008.70, while market capitalization fell to N39.050 trillion. The day’s losses were driven by price declines in key stocks such as Zenith Bank (-0.75%), Stanbic IBTC Holdings (-7.08%), Nigerian Breweries (-2.50%), AccessCorp (-0.58%), and Fidelity Bank (-0.57%), along with 10 other declining stocks that kept the ASI in negative territory. Market activity also declined, with the value and volume of traded shares falling by 27.77% and 18.83% respectively, to N4.36 trillion and 358.45 million units. Despite the negative overall trend, market breadth, which reflects investor sentiment, was positive with 36 gainers and 15 losers. Leading the gainers were MeCure Industries (up 9.95% to N6.30), Multiverse (up 9.92% to N3.99), ABC Transport (up 9.88% to N0.89), C&I Leasing (up 9.84% to N5.47), and Northern Nigerian Flour Mills (up 9.83% to N26.25). On the losing side, RT Briscoe topped the chart with a 9.84% drop to N0.55, followed by Prestige (down 9.09% to N0.50), Stanbic IBTC (down 7.08% to N65.00), Computer Warehouse Group (down 3.14% to N7.70), and Caverton (down 2.78% to N1.40). The main volume and value drivers for the day were stocks of AccessCorp, AIICO, Zenith Bank, Geregu Power, VFD Group, and Airtel Africa.

article_content: Joseph Soares, a former advisor to the Prime Minister of Canada and a managing partner at HR firm IBPROM Corp., explains the increasing relevance of neurodiversity in today's business world. Neurodiversity recognizes and values the unique strengths of people with diverse neurological profiles. Embracing neurodiversity in the workplace isn’t just a moral responsibility—it’s also a strategy that can transform organizations. Consider the example of John, a software engineer on the autism spectrum, who is highly skilled in pattern recognition and problem-solving. His abilities remained unseen until a progressive tech company fostered an inclusive environment, enabling him to excel. John's innovative work propelled the company forward and demonstrated the impact of neurodiversity. Neurodiversity is more than a feel-good measure; it offers real business advantages. Diverse teams with neurodivergent individuals contribute unique perspectives and creative solutions, leading to greater innovation and productivity. SAP's Autism at Work program, for example, hires and supports autistic employees. This has led to a high retention rate, more patent applications, product breakthroughs, and better team collaboration. Autistic employees at SAP have been vital in improving software quality, managing data, and enhancing customer service. Their inclusion has brought concrete benefits. To maximize the benefits of neurodiversity, leaders should: • Use inclusive hiring, like blind recruitment suggested in Harvard Business Review (2022), focusing on skills rather than labels. • Offer reasonable accommodations, noted in Forbes (2021), such as flexible schedules or tailored communication tools. • Provide training to raise awareness and foster inclusive cultures, as Group & Organization Management (2022) recommends. • Set up mentorship and support programs, as emphasized by McKinsey & Company (2023), giving neurodivergent employees resources to thrive. Neurodiversity is both a modern necessity and a business advantage. Case studies like SAP’s and research from respected publications show that supporting neurodiversity helps companies access hidden talents, boost innovation, and get ahead competitively. Leaders who champion neurodiversity drive their organizations to greater success and support a fairer, more inclusive society. The time to act is now, and the benefits are clear.

Neurodiversity waxa ay aqoonsataa oo qiimaysaa kartida dadka maskax ahaan kala duwan. Qaadashada neurodiversity-ka goobaha shaqada ma aha oo kaliya waajib akhlaaqeed—waa istaraatiijiyad ugu dambayn horumarin karta urur kasta. Tusaalaha la xusay waa John, injineer software ah oo autism ah, oo aad ugu fiican ogaanshaha qaababka iyo xalinta dhibaatooyinka. Shaqadiisa la maqli waayey ilaa shirkad hormuud ah ay abuurto deegaan loo dhan yahay, taasoo siisay fursad uu ku dhiso kartidiisa. Waxqabadkiisa hal-abuurka leh wuxuu shirkadda u horseeday horumar muuqda, taasoo muujineysa sida neurodiversity loo adeegsado. Neurodiversity horumar buu u keenaa ururada. Kooxaha kala duwan ee ay ka mid yihiin dadka neurodivergent-ka ah waxay keenaan aragtiyo cusub iyo xalal hal-abuur leh, taasoo hagaajisa wax-soo-saarka iyo hal-abuurka. Barnaamijka SAP ee Autism at Work, tusaale ahaan, waxa uu shaqaaleysiinayaa oo taageerayaa dadka autistic ah taasoo keentay heer sare oo shaqo haynta, patent-yada cusub iyo kororka wax-soo-saarka kooxda. Shaqaalaha autistic ah ee SAP waxay gacan ka geysteen horumarinta tayada software-ka, maaraynta xogta, iyo waayo-aragnimada macaamiisha, taasoo keentay faa’iidooyin muuqda. Si loo gaaro faa’iidooyinka, hogaamiyeyaashu waa inay: • Adeegsadaan habab shaqo qoran sida blind recruitment oo Harvard Business Review (2022) soo jeedisay, si xirfadda loola hormaro. • Bixiyaan taageerooyin sida jadwal dabacsan iyo agab isgaarsineed oo la habeeyay, sida lagu xusay Forbes (2021). • Fidiyaan tababaro la xiriira kor u qaadista wacyiga iyo is-dhexgalka, sida lagu sheegay Group & Organization Management (2022). • Abuuraan barnaamijyo hagid iyo taageero, sida McKinsey & Company (2023) ay ku taliyeen, si shaqaalaha neurodivergent-ka ah loo siiyo agab ay ku kobcaan. Neurodiversity waxay lamid tahay baahi casri ah iyo fursad ganacsi. Tusaalayaal dhab ah sida SAP iyo tixraaca daraasadaha ugu waaweyn waxay caddeeyaan in neurodiversity ay ururada ka caawin karto in ay helaan karti qarsoon oo ay sare ugu qaadaan hal-abuurka iyo tartanka. Hogaamiyeyaasha horbooda neurodiversity waxay gaarsiinkaraan ururkooda guul iyo bulsho cadaalad badan. Hadda waa waqtigii la dhaqaaqi lahaa, faa’iidaduna way cadahay.

article_content: Indonesia will continue its domestic market obligation (DMO) for palm oil into 2024 to help maintain stable cooking oil prices, Trade Ministry official Isy Karim said on Thursday. Indonesia, the world's largest producer of palm oil, introduced the DMO last year to control rapidly rising cooking oil prices. Under the DMO, producers are allowed to export palm oil only after supplying a portion to the domestic market. The current export-to-domestic sales ratio, where companies can export four times the amount they sell domestically via the DMO, will remain unchanged, Isy said at an industry conference on Bali Island. He noted that there are still occasional shortages of affordable cooking oil at home, and that prices in eastern Indonesia sometimes exceed the government price cap of 14,000 rupiah ($0.88) per litre. Isy also mentioned that some companies have not met their DMO obligations. The government aims for the DMO scheme to provide 300,000 metric tons of crude palm oil per month as affordable cooking oil. "We are requesting increased DMO compliance, as average fulfilment stands at 87% of the target, with some companies far below this level," Isy told reporters during the conference. As of last week, Indonesia had at least 6.7 million tons of unused export quota. Indonesia previously disrupted the global vegetable oil market last year by banning all palm oil exports for three weeks in an effort to stabilize local prices, which caused prices to surge worldwide. (At the time of reporting: $1 = 15,846 rupiah)

U.S. environmental officials have begun reviewing the use of 6PPD, a common chemical in car tires, following a petition from West Coast Native American tribes for its ban. The Yurok, Port Gamble S’Klallam, and Puyallup tribes argue that 6PPD runs off roads into rivers during rain, killing salmon—especially coho—returning to spawn.

Several states, including Washington, Oregon, Vermont, Rhode Island, and Connecticut, support the petition, citing risks to water sources and fisheries. The EPA's decision to grant the petition starts a lengthy review that could potentially lead to a ban.

Tire manufacturers are investigating substitutes for 6PPD that meet federal safety standards, but as of now, no suitable alternative has been found. The U.S. Tire Manufacturers Association warns that banning 6PPD prematurely could endanger road safety and affect the economy.

6PPD, used in tires and products like footwear and playground equipment for around 60 years, breaks down into 6PPD-quinone—a byproduct dangerous to aquatic wildlife. Coho salmon are particularly sensitive; exposure can be lethal within hours. Salmon are culturally and nutritionally vital to Native American communities, who have long worked to safeguard dwindling populations from threats like pollution and climate change.

The EPA intends to gather more information and require reports on unpublished health and safety studies from manufacturers by the end of next year, though there is no set decision timeline. While the impact on humans remains unclear, reducing 6PPD in waterways could help restore fish populations.

Researchers and environmental advocates emphasize that tire runoff contains many chemicals, not just 6PPD, so careful consideration is needed when searching for safe alternatives.

Williams credits her rehabilitation to learning how to pace herself, noting that some days, she was so exhausted after training that she would fall asleep in her car. Currently, Venus Williams is competing in London at Wimbledon, where she faces Maria Teresa Torro-Flor.
