article_content: Stephen Graham, renowned for his roles in Boardwalk Empire and Boiling Point, is set to receive the Richard Harris Award at this year’s British Independent Film Awards (BIFAs). This award recognizes actors who have made significant contributions to British film. Previous recipients include Riz Ahmed, Judi Dench, Vanessa Redgrave, Daniel Day-Lewis, Helena Bonham Carter, John Hurt, and Emma Thompson. Graham has built an impressive career in both film and television, with notable works such as This Is England, Snatch, Boardwalk Empire, Rocketman, Venom: Let There Be Carnage, The Virtues, and Roald Dahl’s Matilda the Musical. In 2020, Graham and his wife, actress Hannah Walters, co-founded Matriarch Productions. Their debut project, Phillip Barantini’s Boiling Point, won a BIFA award in 2021 and later inspired a TV series. Matriarch Productions is currently producing A Thousand Blows for Disney+. Recently, Graham starred in Netflix’s Bodies and will soon appear with Daisy Ridley in Disney’s Young Woman and the Sea, as well as with Saoirse Ronan in Steve McQueen’s London-based WWII drama Blitz. Keshet International is distributing a series of seven in-depth current affairs reports titled Israel: This is War, focusing on the Israel–Hamas conflict post-October 7 attacks. These documentaries are produced by Uvda, the long-running investigative program on Keshet 12. According to Kelly Wright, Managing Director of Distribution at Keshet International, the films provide a perspective centered on the bravery, resilience, and trauma of individuals affected by the conflict, differing from standard foreign news coverage. A six-week pause in fighting is currently taking place in Gaza, with some Israeli hostages gradually being released. Leonine Studios’ dramas Troppo and Bonn have both landed international broadcast deals. Troppo, the Australian show based on Candice Fox’s Crimson Lake novels, will air on Canal+’s Polar+ in French-speaking regions, as well as on AMC Networks International in several European countries. RTP2 in Portugal has acquired Free TV rights. The series debuted in the U.S. on Amazon Freevee and has already filmed its second season. The German political thriller Bonn is set to broadcast in Slovenia (RTV), Hungary (MTVA), Portugal (RTP2), and Australia (SBS).

article_content: Michael Bloomberg, during his 12-year tenure as mayor of New York City, used more than $650 million of his own wealth to support a diverse array of projects and initiatives. His spending encompassed the funding of city agencies, backing the arts, launching charitable programs, advocating for political causes, and providing benefits for his staff. As the city’s second-richest resident, with a net worth of roughly $27 billion, Bloomberg’s investments were unprecedented in scale. Research by The New York Times indicates that Bloomberg gave $263 million to city charities, $30 million to the Metropolitan Museum of Art for expanded wifi and audio tours, another $30 million to programs aiding disadvantaged Black and Latino men, and $100,000 each year to Queens Theatre in the Park. He also reportedly spent $268 million across his three mayoral campaigns and contributed $23 million in political donations supporting like-minded candidates. Bloomberg was a prominent backer of advocacy campaigns: he invested $7 million in gun control efforts, $5.7 million in immigration reform, and $6.2 million to promote volunteerism. Sometimes, his personal and official expenditures merged—such as covering daily staff meals (about $890,000 over his terms), funding $5 million in renovations for Gracie Mansion (though he didn’t live there), and installing two large tropical fish tanks at City Hall, with cleaning costs amounting to $62,400 each year. The mayor traveled extensively in his private Dassault Falcon 900LX, a jet he purchased for $24 million; he spent an additional $6 million on travel while in office. Bloomberg also declined the standard mayoral salary, opting instead for just $1 per year—turning down a potential $2.7 million over 12 years. Some critics—including figures from his own administration—contend that Bloomberg’s vast financial outlays allowed him to wield outsized influence over city politics, outspending opponents and fostering goodwill, or silence, from key civic groups through generosity. The Times believes his total expenditures are underreported, since certain personal events and costs were not fully tracked. Bill De Blasio, who will succeed Bloomberg, is set to take office with a far more modest lifestyle, continuing to reside with his family in an un-renovated Park Slope brownstone. While Bloomberg largely avoids public discussion of his wealth and philanthropy, his financial footprint has left a significant mark on the city.

article_content: NASA's Cassini spacecraft explored Saturn from 2004 to 2017, collecting valuable data that continues to provide new insights. A recent study published in the Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society analyzes data Cassini gathered when passing through Saturn’s shadow, mimicking solar eclipses. The research reveals details about how much sunlight Saturn's iconic rings absorb and how transparent they are. The rings, composed primarily of ice, stretch up to 87,000 miles (140,000 kilometers) from Saturn, yet are less than a mile thick. When Cassini found itself in spots where Saturn or its rings blocked sunlight, its instruments measured the diminished sunlight. Focusing on data from Cassini's Langmuir probe—which measures charged particles and is sensitive to sunlight through the photoelectric effect—scientists calculated the transparency of various ring segments. George Xystouris of Lancaster University noted that comparing the probe’s outputs with sun brightness in Saturn’s area allowed the team to measure the rings’ optical depth, confirming the results matched existing high-resolution images. Research indicates Saturn's rings are less than 400 million years old and will likely disappear in about 100 million years as the planet's gravity draws them in. Presently, the rings are becoming less visible from Earth and will be edge-on by 2025, making them nearly impossible to observe. Afterward, they will tilt toward us again, gradually becoming brighter and easier to spot by 2032. Remember to look up and enjoy the sky’s wonders.

Cilmi-baaristani waxay muujisay xog cusub oo ku saabsan sida giraamaha caanka ah ee Saturn uga nuugaan iftiinka qorraxda iyo heerka ay wax u dhaafaan. Markii Cassini ay ku sugnayd meel Saturn ama giraamuhu qarinayeen qorraxda, qalabkeedu waxa uu cabiray isbeddel iftiin oo hooseeya. Iyadoo la adeegsanayo macluumaadka qalabka Langmuir probe ee Cassini—oo cabira jilayaasha korantada, isla markaana uga falceliya qorraxda saameynta loo yaqaanno 'photoelectric effect'—cilmi-baarayaashu waxay xisaabiyeen sida iftiinka looga gudbo qaybaha kala duwan ee giraamaha. Cilmi-baaristu waxay muujinaysaa giraamaha Saturn inay ka yar yihiin 400 milyan oo sano, waxaana la filayaa inay baaba’aan qiyaastii 100 milyan oo sano gudahood, markay cufisjiidadka Saturn gudaha u jiido. article_content: A federal lawsuit alleging job discrimination has prompted changes at the Washington, D.C. headquarters of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). Suzanne Barr, the chief of staff for ICE Director John Morton, has stepped down and is on paid leave as an internal review investigates claims against her. These claims originate from James Hayes, the ICE chief in New York, who also names the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and Secretary Janet Napolitano in his civil suit. Hayes alleges he was unfairly passed over for promotions in favor of women he says were less qualified, including some with connections to Napolitano. According to the lawsuit, Barr fostered a workplace environment hostile to male employees and engaged in inappropriate, sexually explicit conduct. Court records claim Barr harassed a male colleague with crude language and relocated the belongings of several men into a restroom as a form of intimidation. Following the lawsuit, additional federal employees have provided affidavits to Hayes’ attorney describing further alleged incidents. ICE referred the matter to its own and DHS’s oversight offices for investigation, and Barr will remain on leave during the inquiry. DHS denies accusations of discrimination or retaliation and is seeking dismissal of the case, arguing the claims are unfounded and meant to malign leadership. Hayes also questions the qualifications of Dora Schriro, a former DHS official now Commissioner of New York City’s Department of Correction. Although Schriro held prior positions leading corrections departments in Missouri and Arizona, Hayes contends she was not fit for her appointment at DHS. Hayes claims he was financially harmed by his transfer to New York, losing bonuses and paying moving costs, and is seeking reimbursement. He also alleges that he experienced retaliation for threatening to file an Equal Opportunity Complaint, and references several internal complaints, some predating Napolitano’s leadership. ICE and DHS officials contend Hayes’s steady career advancement contradicts his discrimination claims, noting he currently heads ICE’s second-largest field office. Both agencies support Barr and Schriro and reject claims of misconduct. New York City officials have publicly praised Schriro’s qualifications and service. Some members of Congress have shown interest in the lawsuit, but no formal investigation has been launched. Hayes has not commented, but his attorney has requested a bipartisan congressional review. The situation remains under scrutiny as more federal employees indicate willingness to contribute information.

article_content: Latvia has announced that it will close the Vientuli border crossing with Russia next week after accusing Russian authorities of intentionally routing Ukrainian passport holders through this small checkpoint. Russia recently ordered that Ukrainians may only enter its territory via Moscow's Sheremetyevo airport or the Vientuli crossing in Latvia, starting next week. Officials in Latvia argue that Vientuli, which manages around 60 crossings daily, is ill-equipped to manage the expected increase in traffic. They fear this could threaten public order and national security at the European Union border, alleging that Russia's move is designed to create instability. Latvian Foreign Minister Krisjanis Karins denounced Russia's tactics, stating they aim to create difficulties among EU countries bordering Russia. He affirmed Latvia’s commitment to collaborating with EU and NATO partners to respond. On Thursday, the Latvian government said the Vientuli checkpoint would close starting Monday, along with the smaller Padedze crossing, while two larger crossings with Russia will remain in operation. Last month, Latvia also closed a border point with Belarus due to concerns over illegal migration, following similar challenges faced by Latvia, Poland, and Lithuania in 2021.

article_content: With spring comes the return of baseball, and also the latest major league video games: 'MLB12: The Show' (Sony) and 'Major League Baseball 2K12' (2K Games). Both franchises are well-established—'2K12' marks eight years, and 'The Show' six—but one is beginning to show signs of age. Pitching mechanics are a key difference. '2K12' uses a gesture-based joystick system with timed movements and features refined AI so batters remember and adapt to pitches, enhancing realism. 'The Show' introduces pulse pitching, where pressing a button at the right time determines accuracy, offering a simpler approach that minimizes thumb fatigue. Defensive play in both games is straightforward, with accurate fielding and throwing. Both use a scale for throw precision—'The Show' utilizes a circle, '2K12' a bar. Holding the throw button longer increases strength, but can decrease accuracy. 'The Show' unveils zone batting, with the right stick managing swing and stride while the left adjusts the sweet spot. '2K12' also employs a similar batting system and provides cues about incoming pitches, reflecting real batter skills. 'The Show' includes a basic button-swing option as well. Visually, 'The Show' excels: player models are distinct and animations are fluid, creating a lifelike broadcast feel. In comparison, '2K12' appears less detailed, features less unique player appearances, and some stilted movements, resulting in a more dated visual experience. Announcing in '2K12'—with Gary Thorne, Steve Phillips, and John Kruk—is dynamic and relevant, keeping the gameplay lively. The team for 'The Show'—Matt Vasgersian, Dave Campbell, and Eric Karros—sounds repetitive and sometimes reused from previous years, leading to a less engaging experience. Both games feature franchise modes and let you create a player and progress through the ranks. '2K12' includes 'MLB Today,' matching games with the real MLB schedule but limiting play to one game daily. 'The Show' introduces 'Diamond Dynasty,' a fantasy-focused mode with cards, budgeting, and team customization, ideal for fans who love statistics and management. The 'Perfect Game Challenge' returns in '2K12,' now sending the first eight perfect game achievers to New York City for a live tournament to compete for the grand prize, instead of awarding the first perfect game outright. 'The Show' supports Sony’s motion-control Move system and offers cloud saves between PlayStation 3 and PS Vita, letting you pick up where you left off across devices, so long as you have a Vita. 'The Show' is exclusively for PlayStation, while '2K12' is available on multiple platforms. If you own a PS3 or Vita, 'The Show' is the more realistic and visually impressive baseball experience. Both games are rated E for Everyone. This review is based on playthroughs of both titles on the PS3 and 'The Show' on the Vita.

Labada ciyaarba waxay leeyihiin waayo-aragnimo dheer—'2K12' waa sanadkii siddeedaad, 'The Show' waa kii lixaad—balse midkood ayaa bilowday inuu muujiyo duqoownimo. article_content: Devyani International, operator of KFC, Pizza Hut, and Costa Coffee in India, reported a 43.2% decline in quarterly profit, citing increased raw material costs that outweighed gains from promotional campaigns. For the second quarter ended September 30, consolidated net profit fell to 333.5 million rupees ($4.01 million), down from 587.6 million rupees a year earlier. Chairman Ravi Kant Jaipuria stated that high inflation across sectors has temporarily impacted consumer sentiment and reduced spending in recent quarters. Despite falling profits, Devyani's operational revenue increased by 9.6% to 8.19 billion rupees, largely fueled by promotions such as 'Wednesday offers' at KFC and buy-one-get-one deals at Pizza Hut. Key ingredient prices, including cheese and vegetables, rose during the quarter, causing some restaurants to remove tomatoes from their menus. Total expenses at Devyani International increased by nearly 16.3% year-on-year. Other Indian food chains also face declining footfall as high inflation curbs discretionary spending, with retail inflation in Q2 ranging from 5.02% to 7.44% due largely to costly vegetables. Rival Sapphire Foods India, which also runs Pizza Hut, saw a 20% decrease in quarterly same-store sales and is cautious about new store openings. Westlife Foodworld, the operator for McDonald's outlets in India, also reported lower profits, attributing it to a slowdown in consumer demand. Despite operational challenges, shares of Devyani rose 2.3% to 194 rupees at 12:45 p.m. IST.

Rubuca labaad ee dhammaaday 30-ka Sebtembar, faa'iidada saafiga ah waxay hoos ugu dhacday 333.5 milyan rupees ($4.01 milyan), halkii ay ka ahayd 587.6 milyan rupees sannadkii hore isku mid ah. Inkastoo faa'iidada hoos u dhacday, dakhliga howlgalka Devyani wuxuu kordhay 9.6% oo gaaray 8.19 bilyan rupees, taasoo sabab u ahayd xayeysiisyo sida 'Wednesday offers' ee KFC iyo iibso-mid-hel-mid ee Pizza Hut. Kharashaadka guud ee Devyani International ayaa kordhay ku dhowaad 16.3% marka la barbardhigo sannadkii hore. Sidoo kale, shirkadaha kale ee cuntada Hindiya waxay la kulmayaan hoos u dhac ku yimid tirada macaamiisha sababtoo ah sicir-bararka sare oo xaddidaya kharash-garashada, iyadoo sicir-bararka tafaariiqda ee rubuca labaad uu u dhexeeyay 5.02% ilaa 7.44%, taasoo ugu wacan khudaarta oo qaali noqotay. Iyadoo ay jiraan caqabado, haddana saamiyada Devyani ayaa sare u kacay 2.3% oo gaadhay 194 rupees 12:45 duhurnimo waqtiga IST.

article_content: Indonesia's Defence Minister, Prabowo Subianto, has officially registered as a candidate for the 2024 presidential election, with Gibran Rakabuming Raka—the eldest son of incumbent President Joko Widodo—as his running mate. Their entry sets the stage for a three-way race scheduled for February 14, when the world's third-largest democracy holds concurrent presidential and parliamentary elections. Prabowo, 72, and Gibran, 36, journeyed to the General Elections Commission in Jakarta on Wednesday, accompanied by a marching band and greeted by thousands of enthusiastic supporters. This marks Prabowo's third bid for the presidency, following defeats to Widodo in 2014 and 2019. "We ask for the blessing of all Indonesians. We are now facing a very important moment in Indonesia's history," Prabowo stated upon arrival. Presenting their credentials and manifesto to election officials, Prabowo declared, "We are ready to advance our programs and vision to continue national development for a more prosperous Indonesia." A former special forces commander, Prabowo narrowly leads in opinion polls over his competitors, former Central Java Governor Ganjar Pranowo and former Jakarta Governor Anies Baswedan. Indonesia has nearly 205 million eligible voters, about a third of whom are under 30. Prabowo and Gibran registered on the final day of the registration period, after the Constitutional Court—led at the time by Widodo’s brother-in-law—issued a controversial ruling allowing candidates under 40 to run for office if they have held regional positions. Gibran, a relative newcomer to national politics, is currently mayor of Surakarta (Solo), Central Java. Under Indonesian law, a president may serve a maximum of two terms. Prabowo’s selection of Gibran is seen as a move that may attract support from Jokowi’s considerable base, but has also triggered concerns among activists and analysts about Jokowi’s ongoing influence after leaving office. Prabowo continues to face longstanding allegations of involvement in human rights abuses during the 1998 Jakarta protests, conflict in Papua, and East Timor’s transition to independence, though he has never been charged. In recent years, he has worked to present himself as a charismatic statesman appealing to younger Indonesians. The Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P), led by Jokowi, has nominated Ganjar Pranowo as its presidential candidate, with Chief Security Minister Mahfud MD as his running mate. Anies Baswedan, favored among religious conservatives in the Muslim-majority country, has selected National Awakening Party (PKB) chairman Muhaimin Iskandar as his vice-presidential candidate. Indonesia’s Constitution limits presidents to two terms. The upcoming election is anticipated to be highly competitive, with current polls showing Prabowo holding a narrow lead.

Diiwaangelintoodu waxay sameynaysaa tartan saddex geesood ah oo dhici doona 14ka Febraayo, iyadoo Indonesia oo ah dimoqraadiyadda saddexaad ee ugu weyn dunida ay qaban doonto doorashooyin madaxweyne iyo baarlamaan isku mar. Prabowo, 72 jir, iyo Gibran, 36, ayaa Arbacadii ku tagay Gudiga Doorashooyinka Guud ee Jakarta iyadoo ay lasocdeen koox muusig ah, waxaana halkaasi kusoo dhaweeyay taageerayaal badan oo faraxsan. Waqti aad u muhiim ah ayay tahay taariikhda Indonesia," ayuu yiri Prabowo. Markii ay gudbinayeen waraaqahooda iyo barnaamijkooda saraakiisha doorashooyinka, Prabowo wuxuu yiri, "Waxaan diyaar u nahay inaan hirgelino barnaamijyadayada iyo aragtideena si aan waddanka u gaarsiinno horumar iyo barwaaqo." Prabowo, oo horey taliyaha ciidamada gaarka ah u ahaan jiray, wuxuu hadda hoggaamin yar ku leeyahay ra'yi ururinta marka loo eego Ganjar Pranowo ee Central Java iyo Anies Baswedan oo Jakarta horey u soo maamulay. Indonesia wuxuu leeyahay ku dhawaad 205 milyan oo qof oo xaq u leh inay codka dhiibtaan, qalbina saddex meelood meel waa da'doodu ka hooseysaa 30. Prabowo iyo Gibran waxay is diiwaangelinayeen maalintii ugu dambeysay, kaddib go’aan muran dhalisay uu gaaray Maxkamadda Dastuuriga ah—oo markaa hoggaaminayay soddogga Widodo—oo ogolaatay in musharixiin ka yar 40 jir tirsadaan haddii ay qabteen xil goboleed. Gibran, oo aan waayo aragnimo badan u lahayn siyaasadda qaranka, hadda waa duqa magaalada Surakarta (Solo), Central Java. Sharciga dalka Indonesia wuxuu dhigaya in madaxweynuhu laba jeer oo kaliya xafiiska hayn karo. Iskaashiga Prabowo ee Gibran waxaa loo arkay inuu keeni karo taageero badan oo weli Jokowi leeyahay, balse waxaa sidoo kale jira walaacyo laga muujiyay saamaynta Jokowi ee mustaqbalka kaddib xafiiska. Prabowo weli waxaa hadheeya eedeymo waqti dheer socday oo la xiriira xadgudubyo xuquuqul insaanka ah intii lagu jiray mudaaharaadyadii Jakarta 1998, qalalaasaha Papua iyo xorayntii East Timor, inkasta oo uusan waligiis la maxkamadeyn. Sanadihii ugu danbeeyay, wuxuu isku dayey inuu noqdo hoggaamiye dadka dhalinyarada ah soo jiita. Xisbiga Dimoqraadiga Indonesia ee Halgame (PDI-P) oo uu hoggaamiyo Jokowi, ayaa Ganjar Pranowo u magacaabay musharraxa madaxweynaha, Mahfud MD ayaana u ah ku xigeen. Anies Baswedan, oo la jecel yahay dadka diinta u janjeera ee dalka badankiisa Muslimka ah, ayaa u doortay Muhaimin Iskandar, guddoomiyaha PKB, sida ku xigeenkiisa. Dastuurka Indonesia wuxuu xaddidayaa madaxweynaha labo waqti oo kaliya. Doorashadan waxaa la filayaa inay noqoto mid si weyn loogu tartamo, iyadoo sahanno badan laga dareemayo Prabowo oo hoggaan yar leh.

article_content: Early Thursday, four members of the Lakewood Police tactical team and a suspect were wounded during a firearms and drug raid in central New Jersey, officials confirmed. When officers entered the residence, they were fired upon and returned fire, striking 39-year-old Jamie Gonzalez, who is now in critical but stable condition after sustaining multiple gunshot wounds. One officer suffered a gunshot to the face and is in serious but stable condition at a hospital. Another was shot in the foot and is stable. Two others were shot in their bulletproof vests and avoided serious injury. Authorities have not released the officers’ identities. The raid was carried out with participation from federal, state, and local law enforcement at 2:25 a.m. Lakewood is approximately 70 miles south of New York City. This follows a deadly July confrontation in Jersey City where a police officer, Marc DiNardo, was fatally shot during a raid and both suspects were killed. (Reporting by CNN’s Vanessa Juarez.)

article_content: A luxury hotel in Atlanta is searching for a homeless man, John Crabber, who recently returned a guest's stolen wallet he found in a trash can. The Omni Hotel at CNN Center wants to thank Crabber by offering a $500 reward, a Thanksgiving meal, and an overnight stay. However, the hotel only knows his name and has a blurry surveillance photo, making it difficult to contact him. Crabber found the wallet, which contained credit cards and French identification, while searching for food on November 7. He took the wallet to two hotels—the Glenn Hotel and then the Omni Hotel, where the owner was staying. The wallet belonged to Anne Drouart, a French woman visiting Atlanta for a nephrology convention. A police report stated that Drouart, 45, was robbed of her bag as she walked to her car, but she got her wallet and cards back due to Crabber's honest act. Managing director Scott Stuckey released the surveillance image and is asking the public to help find Crabber. Thanksgiving lunch at the hotel is $28 and rooms start at about $119 per night. Anyone who sees John Crabber is asked to contact the Omni Hotel.

Omni Hotel ee CNN Center waxay rabtaa inay u mahadceliso Crabber, waxayna siineysaa abaalmarin $500 ah, cunto Thanksgiving ah iyo habeen jiif bilaash ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, hotelku waxa uu hayaa oo kaliya magaciisa iyo sawir muraayaddu si fiican u muujinayn, taasoo adkaynaysa in lasoo helo. article_content:
Losing weight before their wedding day is common among brides, with 96 percent of women admitting to dieting ahead of the big event. For Rachel Chew, 38, from the West Midlands, her efforts to slim down turned into a nightmare when a surgeon accidentally cut her bowel during a gastric bypass procedure. Three years and eight operations later, the wound on her stomach still hasn't healed, and Rachel remains unmarried.

Rachel had hoped to become healthier so she and her fiancé, Michael, could enjoy their lives together. Supported by Michael, she chose to undergo a private gastric bypass three months before their planned wedding, paying £7,000 for the operation. Within just 24 hours, complications emerged. Doctors discovered that her bowel had been accidentally cut during the first surgery. Although emergency surgery was performed, less than two weeks later, Rachel's stitches split, leading to a severe infection and a painful open wound.

Since then, Rachel has had eight operations in total, with seven to repair the damage caused by the initial mistake. She now lives with a tube attached to her stomach to drain fluids from the ongoing infection—a device she must carry with her at all times.

The infection and persistent wound have also put a strain on Rachel's relationship. Even simple physical contact is painful, making it difficult for Michael to offer her comfort. Despite these hardships, the couple have set a new wedding date. Rachel remains focused on her future and hopes her health will improve enough for her to wear her wedding dress. She shares her story on Channel 5's 'Botched Up Bodies: Brides.'

Laakiin Rachel Chew, oo 38 jir ah kana timid West Midlands, dadaalkeedii is dhimista waxa uu isu bedelay dhibaato markii qalliin gastric bypass ah uu dhakhtarku si khalad ah ugu jaray xiidmadaheeda. Saddex sano iyo siddeed qalliin kadib, dhaawaca caloosheeda wali ma bogsan, Rachelna weli ma guursan.

Rachel waxay rajeyneysay iney caafimaad hesho si ay iyada iyo fiancée-gaygeeda Michael ay nolol farxad leh u wadaagaan. Michael oo iyada garab taagan ayaa Rachel ku dhiirrigeliyay iney gasho qalliin gaar ah saddex bilood ka hor arooskooda, iyadoo bixisay £7,000. 24 saacadood gudahood kadib, dhibaatooyin ayaa bilowday. Dhakhaatiirta waxay ogaadeen in xiidmada laga jaray si khalad ah intii qalliinku socday. Inkastoo si deg deg ah loo qalliin celiyay, wax ka yar laba toddobaad kadib, tolmada caloosheeda ayaa furantay taasoo dhalisay infekshan daran iyo dhaawac xanuun badan.

Rachel tan iyo waqtigaas waxa ay gashay siddeed qalliin, toddoba ka mid ahna waxay ahaayeen in lagu saxo dhaawacii hore. Hadda waxay la nooshahay tubo caloosheeda laga saaray oo si joogto ah u tuurta dareeraha infekshanka—qalab ay mar walba la socoto.

Waxay sheekadeeda kaga warrameysaa Channel 5 'Botched Up Bodies: Brides.'

article_content: A Chinese icebreaker called Xue Long (Snow Dragon) made an attempt to rescue a Russian ship trapped in Antarctic ice but had to retreat just six nautical miles from the stranded vessel because of the challenging ice conditions, according to the Australian Maritime Safety Authority (AMSA). The Snow Dragon remains close by to assist the Akademik Shokalskiy and has a helicopter ready for possible evacuations, AMSA spokesperson Andrea Hayward-Maher noted. AMSA called off the mission of a French icebreaker that had been en route to help, citing the conditions on Saturday. Rescue teams continue to face extremely harsh weather while 74 researchers, crew, and tourists on board the Shokalskiy have been stranded since Monday. Officials report that everyone remains safe and positive. Another ship, Aurora Australis from Australia, is currently making its way to the site and is expected to arrive late Sunday. Hayward-Maher explained the Aurora Australis is equipped to break thicker ice than the other ships, being rated for 1.35 meters of ice, though some sources say the ice is at least two meters thick, which could still prevent access to the stuck ship. In that scenario, an evacuation by air might become necessary. Chris Turney, a University of New South Wales professor leading the expedition, told CNN that morale among those on board the Akademik Shokalskiy is still high and that all are safe. The ship was surrounded by ice up to three meters deep about 100 nautical miles from the French base Dumont D'Urville and 1,500 nautical miles from Hobart, Tasmania. They sent a distress signal via satellite on Christmas morning but have been keeping occupied, even enjoying Christmas celebrations. The research mission set out on November 27 to revisit data first gathered during Douglas Mawson's 1911 Antarctic expedition. The current phase started on December 8, with hopes of returning to New Zealand by January 4, as originally planned.

Markab kale, Aurora Australis oo Australia laga leeyahay, ayaa socdaal ugu jira goobta waxaana la filayaa inuu ku soo xirmo fiidkii Axadda. Hayward-Maher waxay sheegtay in Aurora Australis uu leeyahay awood uu ku gooyo baraf ka dhumuc weyn kan labada markab kale, oo ah ilaa 1.35 mitir, inkastoo wararka qaarkood ay sheegayaan in barafku gaarayo laba mitir ama ka badan, taasoo adkayn karta in markabka la sii gaarsiiyo. Haddii aysan suuroobin, daadgureyn diyaaradeed ayaa la tixgelin karaa. Chris Turney, borofisar jaamacadda New South Wales, Australia iyo hogaamiyaha safarka, ayaa u sheegay CNN in dadka markabka saaran ay weli niyad fiican leeyihiin, oo dhan sidii la doonayay ay badqab yihiin. Markabku wuxuu ku xayirmay baraf saddex mitir ah, isagoo u jiro qiyaastii 100 mayl badeed saldhiga Dumont D’Urville (Faransiiska) iyo 1,500 mayl badeed koonfurta Hobart, Tasmania. Waxay direen signal gargaar ah maalintii Christmas isagoo ay xaalada adagtahay, kooxda wax badan ayey ka faa’iidaystay waqtiyadoodana waxay sii wataan shaqooyinka, xataa waxay u dabaaldegeen Christmas. Safarkan cilmi-baarista ahi wuxuu bilowday 27 Noofambar, waxa ayna horumarinayaan xogtii la soo uruuriyay inta lagu guda jiray expeditions-kii Douglas Mawson ee 1911. Wajiga labaad ee safarku wuxuu bilaabmay 8-dii Disembar rajana waxaa laga qabaa in kooxda lagu soo celiyo New Zealand 4-ta Janaayo sidii loo qorsheeyey.

article_content: Liverpool and England midfielder Steven Gerrard pleaded not guilty to charges of actual bodily harm and affray in relation to a nightclub incident last month, the Southport magistrates' court heard. The accusations involve company director Marcus McGee, 34, at the Lounge Inn, Southport, after Gerrard scored twice for Liverpool in a 5-1 win against Newcastle. Gerrard, 28, appeared in court with co-defendants John Doran, 29, and Ian Smith, 19. All defendants are accused of affray and causing actual bodily harm. Gerrard confirmed his identity and intention to plead not guilty, as did his co-defendants. Outside the court, a large media presence was noted. Prosecutor Nick Evans initially proposed reconvening on April 3 after a preparation period, but following arguments from defense attorneys, including Richard Green for Gerrard, the case was rescheduled to March 20. Gerrard, a father of two daughters, made no further statements in court.

Eedeymaha waxay ku saabsan yihiin Marcus McGee, agaasime shirkadeed 34 jir ah, waxaana la sheegay inay wax ku dhaceen Lounge Inn, Southport, kadib markii Gerrard uu labo gool ka dhaliyay Liverpool kulan ay 5-1 ku garaaceen Newcastle. Gerrard, oo 28 jir ah, waxa uu maxkamad la soo galay John Doran (29 jir) iyo Ian Smith (19 jir), dhammaan oo lagu eedeeyay rabshad iyo dhaawac gaarsiinta qof kale. Gerrard wuxuu maxkamadda ka xaqiijiyay magaciisa iyo inuu rabayo inaysan dembi galin, mid la mid ah saaxiibbadiis kale. Warbaahin fara badan ayaa dibadda maxkamadda sugaysay. Gerrard, oo ah aabbe labo gabdhood leh, waxay ahayd intaas oo kaliya ee uu maxkamadda ka hadlay.

article_content:
Marcus Bebb-Jones, a British poker champion, is set to be sentenced in Colorado after admitting responsibility for the second-degree murder of his wife, Sabrina, who disappeared in 1997. Sabrina's skull was uncovered by a rancher in a remote national park in Colorado in 2004. At the time she vanished, Marcus and Sabrina managed the Melrose Hotel in Grand Junction together. 

Initially, Marcus denied being involved in her death but accepted a plea agreement earlier this year. Shortly after Sabrina's disappearance, Marcus used her credit cards to spend money and later survived a suicide attempt. He subsequently returned to the UK with their toddler son, Daniel, and gained prominence on the British poker scene, winning £90,000 in a 2007 tournament. 

In 2009, British police arrested Marcus in Kidderminster following extradition requests from the US. Investigators highlighted inconsistencies in his accounts about Sabrina's disappearance, but he repeatedly insisted she had left after a dispute during a day trip. Furthermore, police discovered traces of Sabrina’s blood in Marcus’s minivan and plant material similar to what was found near her remains. 

After losing his fight against extradition, Marcus was sent to Colorado, where he pleaded guilty to murder in the 'heat of passion.' According to the plea deal, he faces a maximum sentence of 20 years, though it's up to the judge to accept the agreement. Sabrina’s relatives are urging the court to impose the strictest penalty, expressing grief over Marcus’s actions and apparent lack of remorse. This sentencing marks the end of a case that has stretched over sixteen years.

article_content: Raytheon, a military technology company, has unveiled its JLENS surveillance blimps capable of detecting objects up to 340 miles away. The project provides 360-degree, 24/7 surveillance for up to 30 consecutive days. The US Army has purchased two of these blimps: one is currently being tested over Maryland, while the other remains in strategic reserve. JLENS (Joint Land Attack Cruise Missile Defense Elevated Netted Sensor System) consists of two tethered blimps equipped with advanced radar systems. These blimps operate at an altitude of about 10,000 feet and are designed to detect cruise missiles, low-flying aircraft, and moving surface vehicles. The Maryland system reportedly covers an area from Boston to North Carolina and as far inland as Lake Erie. Raytheon promotes JLENS as a cost-effective, persistent surveillance system, capable of tracking various threats without relying on nearby aircraft or ships. Aerostats, as these blimps are also called, have previously been used to protect U.S. bases in Afghanistan and Iraq, equipped with cameras to monitor troop and insurgent movements. Footage from such systems played a role in the investigation of Army Staff Sergeant Robert Bates in Kandahar in 2012. In the United States, the blimps are also used along the U.S.-Mexico border for monitoring illegal crossings, according to CBS News. The Pentagon has stated that the primary purpose of JLENS is missile detection, but privacy advocates, including the ACLU, are concerned about possible surveillance of civilians if future camera upgrades are implemented. ACLU representatives Christopher Calabrese and Jay Stanley have expressed concerns about a lack of regulations regarding persistent public surveillance. The Army states the main objective of JLENS is to track airborne objects, with secondary capabilities for tracking vehicles and boats, but it does not currently have the ability or plans to track individual civilians. While the government has not ruled out future use of high-resolution cameras, the JLENS program is expected to cost approximately $2.7 billion. The blimps are visible from locations as far away as Baltimore.

article_content: OceanX, a global nonprofit dedicated to ocean exploration, involves students and faculty from Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) in its Young Explorers Program. This initiative brings participants on board the advanced OceanXplorer research and filmmaking vessel, offering hands-on learning and career opportunities, particularly for those underrepresented in STEAM (science, technology, engineering, arts, and math) and marine science. In 2023, the program brought together 15 undergraduate students and 6 faculty members from across the United States for a 10-day expedition from Bergen, Norway, to Brest, France. Participants located and mapped the shipwrecks of the USS Bonhomme Richard and HMCS Athabaskan. Guided by expert scientists and faculty, students explored oceanic life with cutting-edge technology, gaining experience in maritime archaeology, data science, artificial intelligence, storytelling, science communication, mapping, and acoustics—enhancing their learning in both arts and sciences. This year's Young Explorers cohort includes undergraduates from OceanX partners such as Spelman College, Howard University, Yale University, Stanford University, the University of Southern California, Maine Maritime Academy, Sacred Heart University, Western Washington University, Dartmouth College, and Worcester Polytechnic Institute. Faculty and staff from Spelman College, Black in Marine Science, Ocean Discovery League, Stanford University, along with the OceanX team and OceanXplorer crew, served as mentors, sharing their expertise in environmental journalism, communications, marine sciences, and higher education. Mark Dalio, co-founder and co-CEO of OceanX, highlighted the mission of inspiring passion for the ocean, fostering curiosity, and encouraging future ocean advocates. He stated, 'The Young Explorers Program provides students with hands-on ocean science research, opportunities to learn from leading scientists, explore the ocean genome, experiment with media and science communication, and build leadership skills aboard the OceanXplorer. It's an unparalleled opportunity for the next generation of ocean advocates and scientists.' Dalio also stressed the importance of increasing diversity in STEAM education and marine sciences, citing Pew Research Center data that black and brown researchers comprise only six percent of the U.S. life sciences workforce. OceanX addresses this equity gap by partnering with HBCUs and bringing their students and faculty aboard the OceanXplorer. One of this year’s participants, Kendi King, a senior at Spelman College majoring in filmmaking, valued connecting with renowned scientists and fellow HBCU students. She said the experience was unique and meaningful, highlighting that science should be accessible: 'Science is for everyone, and its tools for discovery should be available to all. I learned about frugal and civil science on board, which reshaped my outlook on science as an open, inquisitive lens.' Araj Shah, a freshman at Howard University from Kathmandu, Nepal, shared excitement about conducting deep-sea research in the Norwegian Sea, reaching depths of approximately 2,000 meters. He appreciated witnessing two historic shipwreck explorations and noted the strong collaborative spirit among the team, which led to new scientific discoveries and enduring friendships. For Shah, swimming in the North Sea and bonding with peers were standout moments. Dalio reaffirmed the need for ocean exploration, adding, 'We’ve explored more of space than of our own oceans, which cover about 70% of the planet. Understanding the ocean is essential for protecting biodiversity, regulating climate, and more. We can’t protect what we don’t know.'
translated_content: OceanX, waa hay’ad caalami ah oo aan faa’iido doon ahayn oo ku hawlan sahaminta badaha, waxay barnaamijkeeda 'Young Explorers' ku casuuntay ardayda iyo macalimiinta jaamacadaha taariikhiga ah ee madowga Mareykanka (HBCUs). Barnaamijkaan waxa uu ka dhigayaa ardayda iyo macalimiinta in ay la socdaan markabka casriga ah ee OceanXplorer, oo lagu tababaro khibrad shaqo oo toos ah iyo fursado xirfadeed, gaar ahaan kuwa aan si weyn looga wakiil ahayn kuliyadaha STEAM (cilmiga, tignoolajiyada, injineerinka, farshaxanka, iyo xisaabta) iyo cilmiga badda. Sanadkii 2023, barnaamijku wuxuu isu keenay 15 arday jaamacadeed iyo 6 macallin oo ka kala yimid daafaha Mareykanka, kuwaas oo qaatay safar 10 maalmood ah oo ka bilaabmay Bergen, Norway, ilaa Brest, France. Safarka dhexdiisa, ardayda waxa ay heleen oo ay dejiyeen khariidadaha doonyaha dagaalka ee USS Bonhomme Richard iyo HMCS Athabaskan. Iyagoo wata khubaro ciyaaraya doorka macalimiin, ardayda waxa ay sahmiyeen noocyada nolosha badda iyagoo kaashanaya qalab horumarsan iyo tignoolajiyad, waxayna barteen dhinacyo badan sida taariikhda maraakiibta, xog-ururin, sirdoonka macmalka ah, sheeko abuurka, isku xirka sayniska, khariidaynta iyo akustiigga—taasoo sare u qaadday fahamkooda fanka iyo sayniska. Sanadkan, ardayda cusub ee Young Explorers waxay ka kala yimaadeen jaamacadaha OceanX sida Spelman College, Howard University, Yale University, Stanford University, University of Southern California, Maine Maritime Academy, Sacred Heart University, Western Washington University, Dartmouth College, iyo Worcester Polytechnic Institute. Macallimiin iyo shaqaale ka socda Spelman, Black in Marine Science, Ocean Discovery League, Stanford University, kooxda OceanX iyo shaqaalaha OceanXplorer ayaa gacan ka geystay hagida ardayda, waxayna la wadaageen khibrad ay ku leeyihiin saxaafadda deegaanka, isgaarsiinta, cilmiga badaha, iyo baridda heerka jaamacadda. Mark Dalio, oo ah aasaasaha iyo maamulaha guud ee OceanX, wuxuu xusay in barnaamijkani uu dhiirrigelinayo xiisaha badda, abuurista maskaxta wax baara, iyo horumarinta jiilal cusub oo ilaaliya badaha. Wuxuu yiri, 'Barnaamijka Young Explorers wuxuu ardayda siinayaa fursado wax ku ool ah oo ay ku sameeyaan cilmi-baaris badeed, la kulmaan khubaro sare, sahaminta hiddo-badeedka, tijaabiyaan warbaahinta iyo isgaarsiinta cilmiga, horumarinta xirfado hoggaamineed—dhammaan waxay ku dhacaan markabka OceanXplorer. Waa waayo-aragnimo aad u gaar ah jiilasha mustaqbalka ee ka shaqeyn doona ilaalinta badaha iyo cilmiga.' Dalio waxa uu sidoo kale xoojiyay muhiimada lagu dari karo kala-duwanaanta waxbarashada STEAM iyo cilmiga badda, isagoo xusay tirakoobka Pew Research Center oo muujinaya in cilmi-baarayaal madow iyo kuwa midabka leh ay ka yihiin 6% oo keliya shaqaalaha cilmi-nafsiga Mareykanka. OceanX waxa ay arrintaan wax uga qabataa iyadoo iskaashi la leh HBCUs, soona qaatay arday iyo macalimiin markabkeeda OceanXplorer. Mid ka mid ah ka qayb-galayaashii sanadkan, Kendi King oo ah ardayad dhigata Spelman College qaybta filmmaking-ga, waxay aad u qiimeysay la kulanka khubarada sayniska iyo ardayda kale ee HBCU. Waxay sheegtay in waayo-aragnimadu ahayd mid gaar ah oo wax badan laga bartay, iyo in saynisku yahay mid loo siman yahay: 'Saynis waa qof walba, qalabkiisuna waa in loo heli karo si caddaalad ah. Waxaan badda ka bartay frugal science iyo civil science, taasina waxay bedeshay sida aan sayniska u eegay—fahan furan iyo su’aal la’aan.' Araj Shah oo ah arday dhigta Howard University kana yimid Kathmandu, Nepal, waxa uu aad ugu farxay cilmi-baaristii qoto-dheer ee badda Norwegian taasoo gaadhay 2,000 mitir. Waxa uu kaloo xiiseeyay sahamintii laba markab oo taariikhi ah iyo iskaashiga xooggan ee kooxdu la abuurtay—taasoo horseeday saaxiibtinimo iyo helitaanka cilmiyaysan cusub. Shah wuxuu si gaar ah u xusay dabaasha uu ku sameeyay North Sea iyo saaxiibtinimada uu helay. Dalio wuxuu mar kale xusay in sahaminta badda ay lama huraan u tahay mustaqbalka, asagoo yiri, 'Waxaan si fiican u baranay meelaha sare ee cirka marka loo eego badaha oo ilaa 70% ka dhulka badhtankiisa. Fahamka badda waa muhiim si loo ilaaliyo biodiversiteetka, isbedelka cimilada iyo waxyaabo badan. Ma ilaalin karno waxa aynaan garaneyn.'

article_content: The superhero film "The Marvels" opened with just $47 million (£38 million) at the box office in the US, marking the lowest debut in Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) history. This compares to "Avengers: Endgame,'' which earned a record-breaking $1.2 billion (£980 million) worldwide in 2019. Analyst David A. Gross noted that "The Marvels" saw a 67% drop from the first "Captain Marvel" film, calling it an 'unprecedented box office collapse' for Marvel, especially since sequels usually outperform originals. With a production budget of $220 million (£179 million), the film faces challenges in recovering its costs. Possible reasons for this downturn include the rise of streaming services impacting cinema revenues, the recent actors' strike which limited promotional activities for the film, and, as Gross points out, a trend of 'unimaginative and bad movies' in the superhero genre. Industry observers have pointed to potential superhero fatigue. In March, Dani Di Placido from Forbes noted that superhero films may no longer seem as essential, attributing Marvel Studios' struggles to releasing too much content too quickly and making audiences feel fatigued and confused. Polls show a shifting public sentiment away from superheroes as the main pop culture trend. "The Marvels," starring Brie Larson, Iman Vellani, and Teyonah Parris, received mixed reviews from critics. Some described it as an uninspiring installment in the franchise, while others commented that audience responses on Rotten Tomatoes were more positive than anticipated, despite negative early critical reviews. Variety described the film as a "skittery sequel loaded down with MCU baggage." Other news: The Indian Income Tax Department is investigating the Indian branches of Apple, Google, and Amazon for potential tax issues, focusing on their transfer pricing practices. Indians have become the largest investors in Dubai's real estate market. Razorpay is considering relocating its parent entity to India, which could involve a US tax payment estimated between $250-300 million.

Tan waxay aad uga hooseysaa filimkii "Avengers: Endgame" kaasoo 2019-kii ka helay rikoodh $1.2 bilyan (£980 milyan) guud ahaan caalamka. Falanqeeye David A. Miisaaniyadda filimka ayaa ah $220 milyan (£179 milyan), taasoo keentay caqabado lagu laabto kharashaadkii la geliyay. article_content: Japanese audio specialist Final has announced its new VR2000 earbuds, designed specifically for gaming, virtual reality (VR), and spatial audio experiences. For almost fifty years, Final has built its reputation in high-end audio equipment, originally making products like turntable cartridges, amplifiers, and CD transports. Recently, the company has focused on portable audio, including award-winning headphones and earbuds. The new VR2000 earbuds feature custom-designed ‘f-Core DU’ dynamic drivers, tuned to extract detailed sound from any audio source, making them suitable for immersive gaming, VR sessions, ASMR, and music. The VR2000 earbuds are wired and include a three-button inline remote and a high-quality microphone for gaming, streaming, or phone calls. Final claims the VR2000 provides a spatial listening experience with a wide, natural soundstage and clear sound separation. While optimized for gaming and VR, these earbuds are also suitable for live recordings, electronic music, and Dolby Atmos content. The earbuds feature housings made from durable ABS plastic with a brass front for enhanced sound properties, and they use 6mm 'f-Core DU' drivers engineered for minimal adhesive and lightweight moving parts. The voice coil is crafted from 30μ copper-clad aluminum wire for improved diaphragm response. Cables are made from oxygen-free copper with a tough, flexible coating. Each package includes Type E silicone ear tips, ear hooks, and a carrying pouch. Final's VR2000 earbuds will be available worldwide from October 15, priced at $69.99, £59.99, or €67.99 through Amazon and selected retailers.

In ka badan konton sano, Final waxay caan ku ahayd qalabka maqalka tayada sare leh, iyadoo markii hore samayn jirtay cartridges-ka turntable-ka, amplifiers, iyo CD-yo. article_content: Jamie McDonald, a 27-year-old from Tredworth, Gloucestershire, accomplished an incredible solo run spanning Canada to support charities helping sick children. Dubbed the ‘British Forrest Gump’, Jamie covered 5,000 miles from St John’s, Labrador, to Vancouver over 275 days, all while dressed as the comic book superhero 'The Flash'. During his epic journey, he was assaulted, mugged, frequently slept outside, and pushed through persistent injuries—including chronic tendonitis and a permanently damaged foot. Jamie’s inspiration stemmed from personal experiences as a child when he received care for a serious immune disorder and spinal illness. Wanting to give back, he set out to raise funds for organizations like Great Ormond Street Hospital and Gloucestershire’s Pied Piper Appeal. He launched his coast-to-coast quest in March, using his own savings intended for a house deposit to finance the trip. Despite major challenges, such as being attacked and robbed during New Year’s Eve celebrations in Banff, losing important items and video footage (later recovered with help from social media), Jamie pressed on. He often relied on strangers for meals and places to sleep. When he finished, Jamie had raised nearly £150,000 for children’s health causes, and became the first person to run coast-to-coast across Canada on his own without a support team. This accomplishment followed his previous achievement of biking 14,000 miles from Bangkok to Gloucester. With his father and friends by his side at the Vancouver finish, Jamie’s hometown is preparing a homecoming fit for a hero, featuring an event at Gloucester Cathedral to celebrate his success.

article_content: At 53, Tosca Reno is breaking the mold for what it means to age, showing that it's never too late to embrace health and fitness. Reno, a well-known author and fitness expert, has written 13 books about clean eating—a way of life she says is key to lasting wellness and happiness. Her 'Eat-Clean Diet' is built around simple principles: eat six small meals a day, focus on lean proteins and complex carbohydrates, drink lots of water, and avoid processed and fast foods in favor of fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Reno describes clean eating not just as a diet, but as a lifelong change that can help people eat more food and still lose weight by making healthier choices. Reno's personal journey began at 40, during a difficult time in her life marked by poor health and an unhappy marriage. Deciding to make a change, she started working out and returned to school, where she met fitness pioneer Robert Kennedy. The two married, and Kennedy—with his extensive background in publishing and fitness—helped guide Reno on her health journey. Under Kennedy’s mentorship, Reno discovered the power of nutrition, noting that a healthy lifestyle was mostly about what you eat, complemented by exercise and genetics. Her first book, 'The Eat-Clean Diet,' shared these insights and quickly gained a following. Reno has faced significant hardships, especially after losing Kennedy to lung cancer. She credits her clean eating habits with giving her the energy and resilience to handle grief and continue moving forward. Now, she runs Robert Kennedy Publishing and is preparing to compete in a figure competition as a tribute to Kennedy. Reno emphasizes having a clear goal as the first step for anyone starting the Eat-Clean Diet. She encourages people to prepare their environment by removing junk food and stocking up on healthy options, and to plan meals ahead—including doubling recipes for easy access to healthy leftovers. Setting and writing down weekly and monthly goals, Reno says, makes success more likely. She reminds those taking on the Eat-Clean lifestyle that success takes commitment; managing time, planning meals and workouts, and building routines ultimately make healthy living much easier.

Reno, oo ah qoraa iyo khabiir jimicsi oo magac leh, waxay qortay 13 buug oo ka hadlaya cunto nadiif ah — taasoo ay sheegtay in ay muhiim u tahay caafimaad iyo farxad waarta. Markii ay Kennedy la shaqeysay, Reno waxay fahantay muhiimadda nafaqada — iyada oo sheegtay in nolol caafimaad qabta ay inta badan ka timaaddo cunto wanaag, ay weheliso jimicsi iyo hiddo. Buuggeedii ugu horreeyay, 'The Eat-Clean Diet', ayay fikradahan ku faafisay, wuxuuna si degdeg ah taageere u yeeshay. Waxay sheegtay in cunto nadiif ahi siisay tamar iyo adkeysi ay kaga gudubto murugada oo ay nolosha u socoto. Maanta waxay maamushaa Robert Kennedy Publishing waxayna isu diyaarinaysaa tartan jir-dhis muuqaal ah (figure competition) si ay ugu sharfato Kennedy. Reno waxay adkaysaa in yool cad layska yeesho qof kasta oo bilaabaya Eat-Clean Diet. Waxay dadku ku dhiirrigelisaa inay deegaankooda nadiifiyaan — cuntooyinka faaiidada la'aanta ah madlika saaraan, kana dukaameystaan cuntooyin caafimaad leh — iyo in la qorsheeyo cuntooyinka iyadoo xitaa laba laab lagu kariyo si cunto hadhay loo helo maalinta xigta. Reno waxay si joogto ah isugu dardaarantaa deji yoolal toddobaadle ama bille oo qoro, sababtoo ah waxay kordhisaa guusha. Waxaana ay xasuusisaa qof kasta oo bilaabaya noloshan cusub in ay dadaal iyo go’aan qaadasho xiisa leh u baahan tahay; waqtiga habeyntiisa, xisaabinta cuntada iyo jadwalkiisu waxay ka dhigayaan caafimaadku mid sahlan.

article_content: Credit card surcharges that increase the cost of flights, taxis, household bills, tickets, and more could be reduced or eliminated under recommendations set to be proposed by Treasurer Joe Hockey this weekend. Choice, a consumer advocacy group, says it is only a matter of time before surcharges—which may cost Australian consumers up to $800 million each year—are abolished. Choice spokesperson Tom Godfrey commented that the removal of surcharges is imminent, with the government showing determination for stricter enforcement against companies. Treasurer Joe Hockey has requested the Reserve Bank of Australia to accept recommendations from his Financial System Inquiry report, which calls for a stop to large surcharges. The proposals would allow retailers to charge only the actual administrative cost of a credit card transaction—capped at 12 cents or 0.5% of the transaction value. Currently, companies like Telstra charge 2% plus GST for card payments, while airlines such as Jetstar and Tigerair add $8.50 per flight. Tom Godfrey of Choice called the report a significant step in fighting excessive industry surcharges. He noted airlines, taxis, and ticket sellers are among those imposing significant fees, which cost consumers an estimated $800 million yearly. Godfrey stated that airlines are the worst offenders, having benefited from credit card surcharges for years. Until reforms are implemented, consumers can try to avoid these fees by seeking fee-free payment options, though credit cards remain appealing for convenience. The Financial System Inquiry is led by former Commonwealth Bank executive David Murray, with support from Joe Hockey. Hockey stressed the importance of consumer protection in the inquiry, aiming to ensure Australians can make well-informed financial choices. Airlines like Jetstar and Tigerair add $8.50 in surcharges per flight, while Cabcharge adds percentage-based fees for credit card payments. Previous attempts to curb surcharges include a 2013 move by Visa banning extra fees for its cards, which led to some changes by airlines and the taxi industry. Tyro Payments, an independent EFTPOS provider, reports that 36% of Australian businesses (about 100,000 firms) apply some kind of surcharge, meaning 64% do not. In June 2012, the Reserve Bank of Australia observed that some surcharges exceeded the true cost of card acceptance and intended to address these cases. Daily Mail Australia has contacted the Reserve Bank of Australia for comment about the new recommendations. The Financial System Inquiry seeks to shape the future of Australia's financial system. Since its interim report, it has received more than 6,500 submissions—over 5,000 discussing credit card surcharges. The findings will be released on Sunday, marking sixteen years since the previous inquiry.
translated_content: Lacagaha dheeraadka ee lagu daro markaad isticmaasho kaarka deynta si aad ugu bixiso tigidhada diyaaradaha, taksiyada, biilasha guriga, iyo waxyaabo kale ayaa laga yaabaa in la yareeyo ama la baabi’iyo, sida lagu taliyay qorshayaal uu wado Wasiirka Maaliyadda Joe Hockey usbuucan. Kooxda u doodda macaamiisha ee Choice waxay sheegtay in waqti dhow laga yaabo in la joojiyo lacagahaas dheeraadka ah ee surcharges-ka, kuwaas oo ay ku kacaan macaamiisha Australian-ka ilaa $800 milyan sanadkii. Afhayeenka Choice Tom Godfrey wuxuu sheegay in la wareegayo waqtigii la baabi’in lahaa lacagahaas, isagoo sheegay in dowladda ay muujisay go’aan adag oo ku aaddan in si adag loola xiriiro shirkadaha. Wasiirka Maaliyadda Joe Hockey ayaa ka codsaday Bangiga Dhexe ee Australia (Reserve Bank of Australia) inuu aqbalo talooyinka kasoo baxay Warbixinta Baaritaanka Nidaamka Maaliyadeed, kuwaas oo loogu baaqayo in la joojiyo lacagaha badan ee surcharges-ka. Qorshayaasha cusub waxay ogolaanayaan ganacsatada inay kaliya ku dalacaan kharashka maamulka ee runta ah marka la isticmaalayo kaarka deynta—aan ka badnayn 12 senti ama 0.5% qiimaha wax iibsiga. Hadda, shirkado sida Telstra waxay dalacaan 2% iyo canshuur ah GST marka kaarka lagu bixiyo, halka diyaaradaha sida Jetstar iyo Tigerair ay ku daraan $8.50 safar kasta. Tom Godfrey wuxuu warbixinta ku tilmaamay talaabo weyn oo ka dhan ah lacagaha dheeraadka ah ee warshadaha. Wuxuu xusay in diyaaradaha, taksiyada, iyo iibiyayaasha tigidhadu ay ka mid yihiin kuwa ugu badan ee lacagahan dalaca, taasoo ku kacda macaamiisha qiyaastii $800 milyan sanadkii. Godfrey wuxuu sheegay in diyaaradaha ay yihiin kuwa ugu daran ee ka faaiideystay surcharges-ka muddo sannado ah. Inta isbadalka la hirgelinayo, macaamiishu waxay iska ilaalin karaan lacagahan iyagoo dooranaya habab lacag-bixin oo aan wax kharash ah lahayn, in kastoo kaararka deynta ay weli yihiin kuwo fudud oo la jecel yahay. Baaritaanka Nidaamka Maaliyadeed waxaa hogaaminaya David Murray oo horey ugu soo shaqeeyay Bangiga Commonwealth, iyadoo Wasiir Hockey uu garab taagan yahay. Hockey waxa uu adkeeyay muhiimadda ilaalinta macaamiisha oo ah ujeedka baaritaankan, lana hubiyo in Australian-ku ay heli karaan xulashooyin xog-ogaal ah darafkooda maaliyadeed. Diyaaradaha Jetstar iyo Tigerair waxay ku daraan $8.50 safar kasta lacagaha surcharges ah, halka Cabcharge ay iyaduna ku darto boqolkiiba lacagta marka la bixiyo kaarka deynta. Tijaabooyin hore oo lagu dadbidayay yaraynta surcharges-ka waxaa ka mid ahaa mid uu Visa qaaday 2013 oo xayiraad saaray shirkadaha inuu lacag dheeri ah ka qaadaan isticmaalka kaarka Visa, taasoo keentay isbedel loogu sameeyay qaar ka mid ah diyaaradaha iyo warshadaha taksiyada. Tyro Payments, oo ah bixiye EFTPOS madax banaan, waxay sheegtay in 36% ganacsiyada Australia (ku dhawaad 100,000 shirkadood) ay dalacaan surcharge, taasoo la micno ah in 64% aysan dalacin. Bishii Juun 2012, Bangiga Dhexe ee Australia wuxuu sheegay inuu arkay surcharges ka badan kharashaadka dhabta ah ee aqbalidda kaarka, lana qorsheeyay in arrimahaas wax laga qabto. Daily Mail Australia waxay la xiriirtay Bangiga Dhexe ee Australia si uu uga faaloodo talooyinkan cusub. Baaritaanka Nidaamka Maaliyadeed wuxuu doonayaa in mustaqbal loo sameeyo nidaamka maaliyadda Australia. Ilaa warbixintii ku meel gaarka ahayd, wuxuu helay in ka badan 6,500 warqadood oo laga soo dhiibtay, kuwaasoo 5,000 ka mid ahi ay ka hadlayaan lacagaha surcharges-ka. Natiijooyinka ayaa la shaacin doonaa Axadda, taasoo ah 16 sano kadib baaritaankii hore.

article_content:
My journey toward creating a truly “smart” home has been frustratingly slow. I’m fed up with unreliable voice commands, inconsistent smart switches, and poorly designed apps. Where is the seamless experience we were promised? As my wife often reminds me, if smart devices aren’t easier to use than flicking a regular switch or drawing the curtains by hand, they aren’t an improvement. While smart home automation promises convenience, it rarely delivers. Any smart home schedule is only as reliable as its weakest link. Reliable devices with broad compatibility, customizability, and backup options are essential.

The Eve Motion Sensor is a standout device in this regard. It reliably tracks room occupancy and light levels, works with nearly all major smart home platforms—thanks to its support of the Matter standard—and triggers automations quickly. It has played a key role in convincing my wife that a smarter home can actually be worthwhile.

I’ve previously shared my frustrations with smart home controls. The core issue is that every device has its own app, requires specific voice commands, and sometimes responds slowly. For example, smart lights require the physical switch to stay on, but muscle memory can make this difficult. Teaching family members or housemates about a complex smart home setup is also a challenge. When it takes several attempts to get a device to work, convenience is lost. Reminding my patient wife to ask Google instead of Siri to turn the light off is never well received.

Automating smart home functions can reduce dependence on apps, voice commands, and switches. However, many sensors are unreliable; they may take several seconds to react or fail entirely. Some stop working if the internet goes down or after a firmware update. The Eve Motion Sensor has delivered a completely different experience. article_content: A venomous spider native to South America, the Brazilian banana spider (Phoneutria nigriventer), can trigger unusual symptoms when it bites people—including intense and long-lasting erections. This effect has led researchers to create a synthetic version of the spider’s venom in the form of a topical gel for treating erectile dysfunction (ED). The gel, which users apply directly to their genitals, has just completed its first round of human trials, showing it is safe and effective for treating ED. Although further testing is needed before it can be widely used, these early findings are promising. Carolina Nunes, a biologist with nearly two decades of experience studying banana spider venom, told EuroNews that the treatment could become globally recognized. Unlike oral ED medications like Viagra and Cialis that work throughout the body and may be unsuitable for people with certain conditions, the gel acts locally, offering a safer option for up to 30% of individuals who can’t take pills. Initial trials also included women, revealing that the gel is both safe and beneficial for them. Its ability to boost blood flow locally may help address some sexual health issues in women. Next, researchers will compare how the gel stacks up against current erectile dysfunction treatments.

article_content: For researchers and environmentalists, understanding how frogs and other amphibians move through their environment is crucial for designing effective conservation strategies. Movement is a central aspect of how species interact with their surroundings, and environmental disruption can significantly impact amphibian populations. To address a lack of data on the movement patterns of the nocturnal tree frog Phyllomedusa burmeisteri (Burmeister's leaf frog), a team from Brazil’s Universidade Estadual de Santa Cruz and Germany’s Zoologisches Forschungsmuseum Alexander Koenig studied 19 frogs in Reserva Ecologica Michelin, which includes rainforest and open areas in Bahia, Brazil. Their results were published in Scientific Reports in a study titled, 'Following the footsteps of Burmeister’s leaf frog (Phyllomedusa burmeisteri) in the Atlantic forest of Brazil.' Burmeister’s leaf frogs begin their lives as tadpoles in ponds, then move onto land as juveniles. Instead of jumping, they slowly walk using their legs and often cling to tree branches. Key drivers of their movement include the availability and reliability of resources along with the landscape’s structure. Understanding these behaviors helps scientists learn about the frogs’ home ranges, population densities, migration routes, and breeding locations. The research process involved: (A) capturing the frogs and collecting data, (B) weighing each individual, (C) attaching a spool-and-line device, (D) releasing and observing the frogs, and (E) taking daily measurements of distances, heights, and movement angles. Flagged lines were used to measure these variables. (Credit: Gabriela Luiza de Deus / Scientific Reports, 2023) Researchers estimated movement distances over one and four-day periods, studied movement patterns, analyzed correlations between weight and movement, and compared frogs from forest ponds (eight males, two females) to open area ponds (eight males, one female). Each frog was fitted with a backpack-like spool-and-line tracker holding about 250 meters of thread, all weighing under 10% of the frog’s body weight. Over a four-day span, each frog was tracked daily by following its thread; researchers checked for injuries and changed bobbins as needed. They recorded distances traveled, maximum heights reached, and observed the frogs’ behavior. Findings showed that the tracking apparatus did not hinder frogs’ normal activities—walking, climbing, and swimming proceeded normally. The average total distance traveled was similar between forest and open area frogs. However, forest frogs reached higher elevations, and open area frogs took more steps on average. All frogs showed fluctuating horizontal and vertical movement patterns, as well as variable daily activity. Open area frogs tended to move less to the east but more toward the north, west, and south, matching pond positions. Forest frogs, with ponds mainly south, moved less to the north but more to the west, south, and east. Researchers identified a positive link between frog weight and distance moved. The heaviest frog (40.77g) traveled the farthest (4,824 cm), while a frog about half as heavy (20.5g) moved almost as far (4,700 cm). A map of the sites included Mata Boa (MB), Vila 5 (V5), pond 1 (P1), and pond 2 (P2), with coordinates from EPSG:32724 WGS 84/UTM zone 24S and 2022 satellite imagery. (Credit: Scientific Reports, 2023) This research adds to previous studies of Brazilian frog movement, supplying new details beyond linear distances. Findings show that P. burmeisteri moves more slowly and carefully than some tree frogs, but covers similar daily distances. Although the species typically occupies tree branches, researchers observed the frogs also using habitats such as low vegetation, logs, and aquatic areas. Frogs in open areas tended to prefer lower vegetation and were frequently observed at lower heights, possibly because observations occurred outside the breeding season. Further studies should address possible food resource differences in various habitats, and analyze vertical movement in relation to local vegetation. Even though P. burmeisteri is listed as 'Least Concern' by the IUCN, such research could be pivotal for conservation planning. The research team intends to continue monitoring this species and others in the region for longer periods and in multiple seasons.

Inkasta oo noocan loo helo laamaha geedaha badankood, cilmi-baarayaashu waxay arkeen inuu kale isticmaalo dhir hoose, laamo, iyo deegaan biyo leh. article_content: Official data reveal that one in five recent graduates are either unemployed or working in unpaid or low-wage positions six months after leaving university. Approximately 10% of graduates are still seeking work, and a similar proportion are engaged in internships, volunteer roles, or travel. Among those who have found jobs, many report working in unskilled roles, such as window cleaning, packing, or shelf stacking. The Higher Education Statistics Agency (HESA) highlights a challenging employment landscape for university leavers, many of whom have accrued substantial debt after spending at least three years studying. The job market remains fiercely competitive, and it may take years for some graduates to find fulfilling employment. Last year's increase in tuition fees, now capped at £9,000 annually, has left students facing debts exceeding £40,000 when living costs are included. Many have little hope of repaying these debts in the near future. These concerns coincide with a report from the Confederation of British Industry (CBI), warning that too many students are steered automatically toward university instead of considering vocational courses and on-the-job training. Key sectors such as manufacturing, construction, IT, and engineering are facing a shortage of new recruits as a result. Of the 190,000 full-time first degree graduates surveyed by HESA in 2011-2012, more than 17% continued further study, two-thirds secured jobs, but just over half had permanent contracts. Six percent reported working in basic, unskilled jobs, while others took on internships (2%), voluntary work (1.3%), or identified as 'other/unknown' (2.7%), which includes portfolio development. Another 5% pursued travel or alternative paths. Additionally, graduate opportunities have declined by 4% since last year, according to a recent Association of Graduate Recruiters survey. The banking and finance sector has seen 45% fewer jobs, and openings in accountancy and professional services have dropped by 17%. At the same time, the financial advantage of holding a degree has narrowed; graduates now earn just 27% more than non-graduates, down from 52% two decades ago. Toni Pearce, president of the National Union of Students, noted that many young people struggle to find roles that match their skills, and urged employers to stop exploiting new entrants with unpaid internships. The CBI has called for an application system similar to university admissions to guide more young people toward apprenticeships and vocational training, predicting that most new jobs through 2020 will require high-level skills. Katja Hall, CBI policy director, emphasized the need to challenge the belief that A-levels and a three-year degree are the only routes to successful careers. Facing large debts, students are increasingly considering other pathways to gain a competitive edge in a tough job market.

article_content: President Barack Obama, in an editorial carried by 31 newspapers worldwide, called for swift and united international action to address the global economic crisis. The op-ed comes ahead of the upcoming Group of 20 (G-20) summit in London, where leaders from the world's top economies will convene to tackle the economic downturn. Obama made it clear: 'The United States is prepared to lead, but we urge our global partners to act with urgency and purpose. Important progress has been made, yet much more remains to be done.' He stressed that piecemeal or isolated efforts won't suffice, urging for bold, coordinated steps that not only spark recovery but also build a foundation to avoid future crises. Highlighting the deep links between the American economy and the world, Obama pointed out that the US’s financial health is inseparable from that of other nations, regardless of physical distance. He stated, 'America’s economic well-being is deeply connected to global prosperity. There is no longer a distinction between domestic and international economic actions.' Next week’s G-20 gathering will be Obama's first time meeting many international leaders as president. The following month, he is expected to engage with Western Hemisphere leaders in Trinidad and Tobago at the Fifth Summit of the Americas. Obama will also address the nation in a prime-time press conference on Tuesday night, where he'll elaborate on his administration’s economic plans.

article_content: A huge lump of solidified fat, approximately the size of a double-decker bus, has been removed from a sewer underneath Kingston in south London. The so-called 'fatberg,' weighing about 15 tonnes, consisted of decaying food, wet wipes, and other waste, which had accumulated to completely block the pipes. The obstruction, which formed because people poured cooking oils and flushed sanitary products down drains, reduced normal sewage flow to just five percent. Thames Water engineers called it possibly the largest fatberg ever recorded in Britain. If it hadn't been discovered and cleared, the blockage could have caused raw sewage to overflow into the streets. Its existence came to light after residents in nearby apartments found their toilets wouldn't flush. Authorities estimated repairs could last up to six weeks. Workers used high-pressure water jets over ten nights to break down and remove the fatberg. Gordon Hailwood from Thames Water urged everyone to dispose of fats and wipes by putting them in the bin to help keep sewers clear in the future.

Most recently, he featured for Roma in their Champions League fixture against Manchester City.

article_content: Imagine a frequent customer, Bob, visits a liquor store to purchase drinks for a party. He accidentally leaves without his credit card. When clerk Stephen discovers it, he tries to catch up, but Bob is already out of reach. Another regular, Chad, offers to take the card to Bob, saying he knows where Bob lives and can return it before Bob realizes it's missing. If you owned the store, how should Stephen handle this situation? Should he trust Chad to deliver the card, or contact Bob directly? What's at stake in terms of customer trust, store policies, and the store’s reputation for security? In this scenario, Stephen decided to hand Bob's credit card to Chad. Soon after, Bob’s wife Lisa called the store to confirm the card had been delivered safely. She thanked Stephen for trusting Chad, saying their loyalty to the store was strengthened by this gesture. This story illustrates how taking risks for customers can build trust and loyalty. Risk-taking in service communicates confidence in your brand and relationships, even if it means going beyond established policies. Examples of building trust include: letting regulars pay next time if they forget their wallet, or auto dealerships allowing loyal customers to drive off in a new car before finalizing trade-in details. Such acts signal strong faith in customers. Five strategies for fostering extreme trust: 1. Start Small: Trust-centered companies begin with modest gestures. At Vincenzo's Italian Restaurant in Omaha, guests can pour their own wine and simply report how much they drank at the end of their meal. 2. Embed Risk-taking in Processes: SHED RAIN, a leading umbrella manufacturer since 1947, offers a guarantee to replace any defective umbrella without a receipt or fine print, demonstrating explicit trust in customers. 3. Train Staff to Take Smart Risks: Ritz-Carlton empowers employees to spend up to $2,000 to satisfy guests, coupled with training to ensure responsible decisions and creative problem-solving. 4. Make Risk-taking Part of Customer Advocacy: The Tattered Cover Bookstore in Denver refused to release customer information during a criminal investigation, defending customer privacy at financial risk, which led to widespread admiration. 5. Trust Employees: Building trust with customers starts with trusting employees. Review and revise procedures that presume guilt or require excessive proof, encourage input on restrictive policies, and coach rather than chastise after mistakes. Personal Story: The author recalls receiving a classic 1962 Mercedes-Benz 220 as a gift, which frequently required repairs at Brothers Auto Service in Charlotte, NC. Owners Nicky and Joe trusted customers by offering their own cars as loaners—something uncommon at the time. In turn, customers gave them freedom to proceed with repairs without pre-approval. Every customer interaction involves a 'trust gap'—the emotional space between hope and evidence. Businesses can bridge this gap by taking faith-based actions, sometimes before a long history of trust is established.

Markii uu xafiiltamaha Stephen ka helo, wuu isku deyaa inuu soo gaaro Bob, laakiin Bob mar hore ayuu ka baxay. Macaamiil kale oo joogto ah, Chad, ayaa sheegay, 'Waan garanayaa Bob. Ka dhig khatar qaadashada difaac macaamiil: The Tattered Cover Bookstore ee Denver waxay diiday inay bixiso xogta macaamiisheeda baadhitaan booliis sababay darteed, iyadoo la ilaalinayo sirta macaamiisha xattaa iyadoo lacag badan laga waayo—waxaa lagu amaanay caalami ahaan. 5. Shaqaalaha ku kalsoonow: Kalsooni macaamiisheeda bilowdaa adigoo shaqaalahaada kalsoonida siiya. Dib u eeg siyaasadaha ad adag, dhiirrigeli fikradaha shirkadda, khaladaadka lagu xaliyo tababar, laakin aan la canaanin. Xiriir kasta oo macaamiil iyo adeeg bixiye ah waxaa ku jira 'farqiga kalsoonida'—wakhtiga rajada iyo xaqiiqda. Shirkaduhu waxay buuxin karaan farqigan iyagoo qaadaya tillaabooyin ay ku muujinayaan rumaysad, marar badan ka hor taariikh kalsooni sii jirta.

article_content: Following match-fixing sanctions, Turkish football clubs Fenerbahce and Besiktas have been excluded from European competitions, allowing other teams to take their places. The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) upheld Fenerbahce's two-year ban from European tournaments. Consequently, APOEL Nicosia from Cyprus, despite being eliminated by Belgium's Zulte Waregem in the playoffs, was chosen by UEFA in Monaco to participate as a 'lucky loser' in the Europa League. APOEL will join Group F with Bordeaux (France), Eintracht Frankfurt (Germany), and Maccabi Tel Aviv (Israel). The Cypriot club previously reached the Champions League quarterfinals in 2012, where they were defeated by Real Madrid. Besiktas also lost their appeal to CAS regarding their one-year suspension for match-fixing, so Norwegian team Tromso, who lost to Besiktas in the playoffs, was given their slot in Group K. Tromso will play against Tottenham Hotspur (England), Anzhi Makhachkala (Russia), and Sheriff Tiraspol (Moldova). In other Europa League news, Valencia (Spain), who have reached the Champions League final twice and won the Europa League in 2004, are paired in Group A with Swansea City (England), Kuban (Russia), and St Gallen (Switzerland). Meanwhile, Sevilla (Spain), a two-time Europa League champion, is grouped in Group H with Freiburg (Germany), Estoril (Portugal), and Liberec (Czech Republic). Current Europa League titleholders Chelsea will meet Bayern Munich in the European Super Cup final in Prague.

Maxkamadda Ciyaaraha ee CAS ayaa xukuntay in Fenerbahce laga saaro tartamada Yurub muddo laba sano ah. APOEL waxay la ciyaari doontaa kooxaha Bordeaux (Faransiiska), Eintracht Frankfurt (Jarmalka), iyo Maccabi Tel Aviv (Israa’iil) tartanka Group F.
