article_content: Islamabad, Pakistan (CNN) — U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton held a candid meeting with Pakistani President Asif Ali Zardari on Friday, aiming to mend strained ties between the two countries after a U.S. mission killed Osama bin Laden. Clinton was joined by Admiral Mike Mullen, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, for what one senior State Department official described beforehand as a 'sober' discussion on Pakistan's role in combating terrorism within its borders. The closed-door talks were described by Clinton as 'very extensive, open, frank and constructive.' She emphasized that the United States and Pakistan, as partners with mutual interests, need to intensify efforts against terrorist groups that have found refuge in Pakistan. Clinton addressed ongoing speculation, stating, 'There is absolutely no evidence that anyone at the highest levels of the Pakistani government knew that bin Laden was living just miles from where we are today.' The discovery of bin Laden living openly in an area surrounded by Pakistani military installations, as well as Pakistan’s embarrassment over not being informed beforehand of the U.S. raid, has triggered heightened tensions between the two nations. Admiral Mullen urged increased action and cooperation, saying, 'Now is not the time for retreat or for recrimination. Now is the time for action and closer coordination; for more cooperation, not less; for the friendship to get stronger, not weaker.' Clinton asserted that Pakistan must prevent insurgents from operating in Afghanistan from its territory and reaffirmed U.S. support for the Pakistani people in the long term. Both Clinton and Mullen acknowledged that Pakistan has suffered from terror attacks. Clinton asked Mullen to attend so they could jointly deliver a unified message and observe Pakistani leaders' reactions together. After the meetings, Zardari’s office announced both sides agreed to 'work together in any future actions against high value targets in Pakistan' and to promote peace in Afghanistan. A senior U.S. administration official said the meetings helped improve relations, suggesting that joint U.S.-Pakistani operations might occur soon. An opinion poll found around 80% of Americans held an unfavorable view of Pakistan, with about a quarter seeing Pakistan as an enemy. The poll, conducted by telephone with 1,007 Americans from May 24 to May 26, had a margin of error of ±4.5 percentage points. Clinton's planned visit earlier in the month was delayed following the bin Laden raid by U.S. Navy SEALs. She stressed that international efforts have killed more terrorists in Pakistan than anywhere else, which would not have been possible without Pakistani cooperation. Clinton expressed strong support for a long-term partnership with Pakistan. Marc Grossman, the U.S. special envoy to Afghanistan and Pakistan, recently delivered demands for more concrete actions against extremism during tough but productive talks in Islamabad, following a similar firm message from Senator John Kerry. Pakistani leaders voiced concern about ongoing U.S. drone strikes but indicated willingness to conduct joint operations and support efforts against al Qaeda. Officials cited progress since Grossman’s visit, including Pakistan’s return of the helicopter tail from the bin Laden operation, as a sign that ties are improving. Nonetheless, significant work remains before full cooperation resumes on key issues. Recently, Pakistan requested the U.S. to reduce its number of military trainers in the country. The Pentagon has started withdrawing some of the more than 200 American personnel stationed there.

article_content:
A fraudulent advertisement spread across social media platforms this week, falsely promoting Apple's new iOS 7 software as making iPhones and iPads waterproof. Some people, accepting the misleading claim, ended up damaging their devices by immersing them in water. The hoax advert, thought to have started on online forum 4Chan, was widely shared on Facebook and Twitter. It portrayed iPads and iPhone 5S units covered in water droplets and insisted that a so-called 'smart-switch' in iOS 7 would protect internal circuits from water damage by cutting power. The advert went further, incorrectly stating water damage would be covered under Apple's warranty. 

After the advert circulated, various social media users expressed their frustration when their devices stopped working, while others mocked the gullibility of those who fell for the trick. On Twitter, users were divided between criticizing the prank and those deceived by it. 

iOS 7 launched as a free update last Wednesday, and both the iPhone 5S and 5C include it as standard. Apple’s devices, however, do not feature water resistance, unlike models like the Sony Xperia Z1, Samsung Galaxy S4 Active, or Motorola Defy. In general, smartphone warranties—including Apple’s—do not cover water-related damage, regardless of cause. 

Separately, the Chaos Computer Club, a German hacker group, bypassed Apple's TouchID fingerprint sensor soon after the iPhone 5S release. By creating a fake fingerprint using a high-resolution image, laser print, and a wood glue mold, they managed to unlock the phone.

Qaar ka mid ah dadka, oo rumeysan sheegashadan, ayaa qalabkoodii galiyay biyo taasoo sababtay in ay xumaadaan. article_content: Bajaj Finance has been ordered by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to stop disbursing loans under its 'eCOM' and 'Insta EMI Card' lending products due to non-adherence to digital lending guidelines. Shares of Bajaj Finance, India's largest non-banking financial company (NBFC), dropped by up to 4% to Rs 6,937 on the BSE in the morning session but recovered to trade 0.4% higher after analysts said the RBI action had limited impact. Bajaj Finserv, the holding company, also saw its share price fall 3% to Rs 1,540 before recovering. Bajaj Finance expects the RBI-imposed restriction to be lifted within 6-8 weeks and does not anticipate any significant financial effect from the move. Jefferies analysts noted that while the restriction is a negative development, the financial impact is likely to be minor. Insta EMI Card customers make up 5% of total customers, 0.2% of disbursals, less than 1% of fees, and less than 0.5% of profit. Jefferies has a target price of Rs 9,470 for the stock. As of September 2023, Bajaj Finance had 77 million customers, including 42 million with EMI cards and 4 million with Insta EMI Cards—representing about 5% of total customers and 10% of EMI cardholders. Analysts believe that the issues identified by RBI are operational and do not call into question Bajaj Finance’s business processes. Motilal Oswal stated there may be an impact on assets under management (AUM) growth and fee income in the second half of FY24, but the company’s long-term outlook remains strong. The brokerage recommends using any significant share price drop as a buying opportunity. Morgan Stanley maintained its overweight rating, saying the issue could be resolved soon, with a target price of Rs 10,300. CLSA said profits could be impacted by 6% but also retained a buy call with a target price of Rs 9,500. In a broader context, the RBI has also tightened capital norms for unsecured retail loans, requiring banks to allocate more capital and strengthen oversight to control risks. Other financial market news and investment advice were also included for additional context.

article_content: As some approach middle age, the allure of a sleek sports car can feel irresistible—a sentiment especially associated with men. But any automotive enthusiast would be hard-pressed to compete with the dedication of Fritz and Hans Schlumpf. The Schlumpf brothers, successful textile industrialists, devoted their fortunes to an extraordinary passion: collecting classic cars—most famously, Bugattis. Between 1957 and 1976, they quietly assembled 122 Bugattis and hundreds of other rare vehicles inside their factory warehouses in Mulhouse, France. Today, their collection forms the heart of the Cite de l'Automobile, or the French National Automobile Museum—Schlumpf Collection, broadly regarded as the world’s most impressive Bugatti collection. Among its treasures is founder Ettore Bugatti’s own 1929 Type 41 Royale Coupe Napoleon—a striking black and blue six-and-a-half-meter car powered by a 14.7-liter engine, valued at over $15 million. Only six Royales were ever built, making them exceptionally rare. Italian-born Ettore Bugatti envisioned the Royale as a luxury car fit for royalty, rivaling Britain's Rolls-Royce and Germany's Mercedes-Benz. However, the Great Depression ended those ambitions, and the cars became coveted collectors’ items instead. The Mulhouse museum doesn’t only feature Bugattis. Visitors can admire over 430 vintage vehicles, from early French horseless carriages to prewar sports cars and postwar icons like Ferrari, Maserati, and the Mercedes-Benz 300 SL. Unique designs, such as the futuristic 1942 'Egg' by Paul Arzens, stand alongside a lineup of Formula 1 racers and modern supercars. The story of the Schlumpf brothers is one of extreme devotion, secrecy, and, ultimately, hardship. As the European textile industry declined, their risky investments in car collecting caught up with them, leaving them deeply in debt. The brothers eventually left France for Switzerland, and after their deaths, their collection—once shrouded in secrecy—was preserved by French authorities for public enjoyment. Opened officially in 1982, the museum welcomes visitors from around the world. Located in Mulhouse, about a three-hour train ride from Paris, it offers an extensive look at automotive history. The museum is open daily, with tickets starting at €14.50 for adults. Accommodations in Mulhouse include international chains and well-regarded independent hotels. Geoff Hiscock, a freelance journalist and classic car enthusiast, authored this article. Hiscock has covered topics from business to global resources.

Hase yeeshee, qof kastoo xiiseeya baabuurta waa adag tahay in uu la tartamo hankii Fritz iyo Hans Schlumpf. Labadan walaalaha ah ee ku guuleystay warshadaha dharka, waxay maalkooda u hureen uruurinta baabuurta qadiimiga ah—gaar ahaan Bugatti. Intii u dhexeysay 1957 ilaa 1976, si qarsoodi ah ayay ugu keenayaan 122 Bugatti iyo boqolaal baabuur oo kale oo naadir ah warshadoodii Mulhouse, Faransiiska. Maanta, uruurintooda ayaa saldhig u ah Cite de l'Automobile, ama Matxafka Qaranka Baabuurta ee Faransiiska—Uruurinta Schlumpf, waxaana loo arkaa midka ugu weyn Bugatti dunida. Waxaa ka mid ah hantiyaheeda, gaarigii Ettore Bugatti ee 1929 Type 41 Royale Coupe Napoleon—madow iyo buluug, dhererkiisuna yahay lix mitir iyo bar, matoorkuna waa 14.7-litir, qiimihiisuna kor ayuu ka yahay $15 milyan. Lix Royales oo kaliya ayaa la sameeyey, taasoo ka dhigaysa kuwo aad u naadir ah. Ettore Bugatti oo Talyaani ah asalkiisa wuxuu Royale u arkay inuu noqdo baabuur boqortooyo, si uu loola tartamo Rolls-Royce iyo Mercedes-Benz. Laakiin riyadiisii waxa ay curyaamisay dhibaatadii dhaqaale ee weynayd, waxayna baabuurtaas noqdeen kuwo la lunsado oo lagu faano. Matxafka Mulhouse kuma eka Bugatti oo keliya. Booqdayaasha waxa ay halkaas ku arki doonaan in ka badan 430 baabuur qadiimi ah, laga bilaabo baabuurtii hore ee Faransiiska ilaa kuwa cayaaraha dagaalka ka hor iyo kuwa casriga ah sida Ferrari, Maserati iyo Mercedes-Benz 300 SL. Waxaa intaas dheer naqshad cajiib ah sida 'Ukuntii' uu sameeyay Paul Arzens sanadkii 1942, iyo saf baabuur oo Formula 1 ah iyo kuwa waaweyn ee casriga ah. Sheekada walaalaha Schlumpf waa mid ku saabsan jacayl xad dhaaf ah, qarsoodi iyo ugu dambeyn dhibaato xagga dhaqaalaha ah. Ganacsigii dharka ee Yurub markii uu hoos u dhacay, maalgashigii weynaa ee uruurinta baabuurta ayaa sababay inay deymo galaan. Ugu dambeyn waxa ay u qaxeen Switzerland, kadibna waxa la dammaanad qaaday in uruurintoodii—oo awal qarsoodi ahayd—dadweynaha loo furo iyadoo ay ilaalinayso dawladda Faransiiska. Matxafka waxa si rasmi ah loo furay 1982, wuxuuna soo dhaweeyaa booqdayaal ka kala socda dunida oo dhan. Waxa uu yaalaa Mulhouse, oo saddex saacadood tareen ah u jirta Paris, wuxuuna bixiyaa aragti taariikheed oo gaadiidka ah. Matxafka waxa uu furan yahay maalin walba, tigidhaduna waxa ay ka bilaabmaan €14.50 dadka waaweyn. Mulhouse waxa laga helaa hoteelo caalami ah iyo kuwo madax banaan oo la aqoonsan yahay. Geoff Hiscock, qoraa madax bannaan iyo xiiseeye baabuurta qadiimiga ah, ayaa maqaalkan qoray. Hiscock waxa uu hore uga warramay arrimo ganacsi iyo kheyraad caalami ah.

article_content: The latest projections from the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) indicate that global temperatures could rise by 2.5 to 2.9 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels by the end of this century, based on current policies. Extreme heat is already being experienced, such as a recent heat index of 59.7 degrees Celsius (139.5 degrees Fahrenheit) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Humidity made conditions especially dangerous, leading to a thousand people fainting and one death at a Taylor Swift concert. Wildfires are affecting Brazil’s wetlands during this intense spring heatwave. These impacts are occurring with just a little over 1 degree Celsius of warming so far. If warming approaches 3 degrees Celsius, as projected, the consequences could worsen significantly. Notably, a decade ago, projections were even more dire, forecasting nearly 4 degrees of warming before the 2015 Paris Agreement was established. The Paris Agreement aimed to keep warming well below 2 degrees Celsius, preferably 1.5 degrees, but these targets are slipping out of reach. Some research suggests that the 1.5-degree mark could be surpassed as soon as 2029. Preliminary data recently showed that global average temperatures briefly rose above 2 degrees Celsius for the first time in recorded history, a milestone scientists hope will not be sustained. The UNEP report highlights that global greenhouse gas emissions continue to rise, shrinking the window to meet climate targets. Another round of crucial climate negotiations is set for November 30 at the UN conference in Dubai, focusing on phasing out fossil fuels. Yet, there are concerns about the effectiveness of these talks, with an oil executive leading the conference and some leaders, such as US President Joe Biden, reportedly not attending. Still, UN Secretary-General António Guterres remains optimistic. He emphasized today that reaching the 1.5-degree goal is still possible, but requires ending reliance on fossil fuels and ensuring a fair transition to renewable energy.
translated_content: Warbixintii ugu dambeysay ee Barnaamijka Deegaanka Qaramada Midoobay (UNEP) ayaa muujineysa in heerkulka caalamka laga yaabo inuu kor ugu kaco 2.5 ilaa 2.9 darajo Celsius marka loo eego heerarkii kahoreeyay kacaankii warshadaha dhammaadka qarnigan, iyadoo la raacayo siyaasadaha hadda jira. Kulayl daran ayaa horayba loo dareemayaa, sida heerkul kulul oo gaadhay 59.7 darajo Celsius (139.5 Fahrenheit) oo laga diiwaan geliyey Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Qoyaanku wuu kasii daray xaaladda, taasoo keentay in kun qof suuxeen hal qofna dhimasho ka dhacdo xafladii fannaanta Taylor Swift. Dabka ka kacay dhulka dooxada ee Brazil waxa keenay kulayl aad u daran intaan lagu jiro xagaagan. Dhacdooyinkan waxay ka dhacayaan iyadoo kaliya heerkulka dunidu sare u kacay wax ka yar 1 darajo Celsius. Haddii kulaylku gaaro ku dhowaad 3 darajo Celsius, sida la saadaaliyey, cawaaqib xumadu way kasii dari kartaa. Muddo toban sano laga joogo, saadaasha waxay ahayd mid aad uga sii xun, taasoo tilmaamaysay in koror gaadha ilaa 4 darajo uu dhici lahaa ka hor Heshiiskii Cimilada Paris ee 2015. Heshiiskii Paris wuxuu ujeedkiisu ahaa in la xaddido kulaylka heer hooseeya 2 darajo Celsius, ugu dambaynna 1.5 darajo, balse bartilmaameedyadaasi hada way adkaanayaan in la gaaro. Cilmi-baaris ayaa muujisay in la dhaafi karo xadkaas 1.5 darajo sida ugu dhaqsaha badan 2029. Xog hordhac ah ayaa muujisay in celceliska heerkulka caalamka si kooban uga kor maray 2 darajo Celsius markii ugu horreysay taariikhda la diiwaangeliyey. Tani waa dhacdo khubaro badani ay shacabka uga digayaan in la joogteeyo. Shir muhiim ah ayaa la qaban doonaa 30-ka November magaalada Dubai, diiradduna waxa ay saaran tahay wax ka qabashada shidaalka fossil-ka. article_content: British actress Talulah Riley will receive $4.2 million as part of her divorce from Elon Musk, the well-known tech entrepreneur who co-founded PayPal and founded companies like Tesla Motors and SpaceX. Riley, 26, was married to Musk, 41, for two years and the couple was together for four years before separating in July 2011. The settlement will be paid over nine years, and Riley will also keep certain personal items including Cartier and Gucci watches, various pieces of diamond jewelry, and a Tesla Roadster valued at $110,000. Court documents show she will receive $1.4 million of the total up front. Elon Musk, with an estimated net worth of $2 billion, built his fortune through ventures including Zip2 (sold for nearly $340 million), PayPal (acquired by Ebay for $1.2 billion), and later, SpaceX. In 2009, SpaceX launched the first privately owned liquid-fueled rocket to enter space, and it now holds a contract with NASA to deliver supplies to the International Space Station worth up to $3.1 billion. Musk founded Tesla Motors as well, taking it public in 2010 with a $226 million IPO. Despite his substantial wealth and reportedly high personal spending, Riley's lawyers have not contested the divorce terms. Before his marriage to Riley, Musk finalized a divorce from his first wife, Justine Musk, in 2010. She is a Canadian fantasy author and mother to two of Musk's children.

Riley, oo 26 jir ah, waxay la qabay Musk, oo 41 jir ah, labo sano waxayna wada joogeen afar sano ka hor intaysan kala tagin bishii Luulyo 2011. Heshiiska furriinka waxaa lagu bixin doonaa sagaal sano, iyadoo Riley ay sii haysan doonto alaabo gaar ah sida saacadaha Cartier iyo Gucci, dahabyo luul ah, iyo gaadhigeeda Tesla Roadster oo qiimahiisu yahay $110,000. Sanadkii 2009, SpaceX waxay sameysay dayax-gacmeedkii ugu horreeyey ee gaar loo leeyahay ee shidaal dareere ah isticmaala, hadda waxay haystaan heshiis ay NASA la leedahay oo xambaarsan in alaabo la geeyo Saldhigga Caalamiga ah ee Dayaxa, qiimihiisu uu gaarayo $3.1 bilyan. article_content: The residential real estate market in India has shown a robust recovery, prompting property developers to actively acquire land parcels across the country, including in tier II and III cities. Between January 2022 and October 2023, developers acquired approximately 3,294 acres, according to data from JLL India. Remarkably, 44.4% of these transactions—or 1,461 acres across 17 land deals—occurred in tier II and III towns. Key cities such as Nagpur, Palghar, Khalapur, Panipat, Ludhiana, and Panchkula contributed about 75% of these acquisitions. Samantak Das, Chief Economist and Head of Research and REIS, India, JLL, noted that 'Strategic land acquisitions in tier II and III cities are increasing as developers aim to enter new markets and leverage rising demand for quality projects. The launch of plotted developments and low-rise apartments is especially popular in these cities.' Established real estate developers are expanding into tier II and III markets driven by increasing demand and improved purchasing power. Data indicates branded developers have closed multiple land deals in these cities. Interestingly, 91.6%—or 1,339 acres—of the acquired land is designated for proposed residential developments, mostly for plotted residential projects. Developers focus on low-rise and plotted development formats, which align with local preferences. Approximately 1,015 acres have been earmarked for plotted developments, valued at over Rs 3,163 crore. Some developers are also exploring holiday home projects as demand for second homes grows in vacation destinations like Shimla, Rishikesh, and Goa.

Intii u dhaxaysay Janaayo 2022 ilaa Oktoobar 2023, horumariyeyaashu waxay iibsadeen ku dhawaad 3,294 acres, sida laga soo xigtay xogta JLL India. Comedian and best-selling author Steve Harvey, known for 'Act Like a Lady, Think Like a Man,' offers his perspective on relationships to single women. Harvey explores what women are seeking in a partner, questioning if their standards may sometimes be unrealistically high. He meets with two friends, Yinka and Lynell, who have detailed lists of desired qualities. Harvey humorously suggests that such perfection might be unattainable, but emphasizes the importance of having standards and understanding what one can offer in return.

According to Harvey, the foundation of a man's role in a relationship centers on 'the three Ps'—professing, providing, and protecting. He notes that men want to know their place in these roles and encourages independent, successful women to allow space for men to contribute, without diminishing their own achievements.

Harvey urges patience, assuring women that their ideal partner exists and that waiting is worthwhile. He addresses why some men do not provide closure when ending relationships, explaining that men often do not recognize the need for it. Harvey also delves into reasons men may cheat, such as opportunity, lack of consequences, dissatisfaction, or not having found the right partner, though he states these reasons do not justify the behavior.

Tackling the issue of being married to a 'mama's boy,' Harvey advises spouses to set clear expectations and to assert their place in the relationship. He encourages women to communicate their needs and to expect mutual respect and commitment. Harvey's advice stresses the need for honest self-reflection, patience, and the balance of standards with understanding in the search for a meaningful relationship.

Harvey wuxuu baadhayaa waxa dumarku ka doonayaan lammaanaha, isagoo isweydiinaya haddii mararka qaar shuruudahaasi aad u adag yihiin. Wuxuu la hadlay laba saaxiibo ah, Yinka iyo Lynell, kuwaas oo haysta liis dheer oo shuruudo ah. Harvey si kaftan leh ayuu u sheegay in laga yaabo inaan la helin qofka dhammaan sifooyinkaas leh, balse wuxuu muujiyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in haweenku shuruudo yeeshaan isla markaana fahmaan waxa ay iyaguna bixinayaan.

Sida Harvey sheegay, saldhigga doorka ninka ee xidhiidhka waxa uu ku salaysan yahay 'saddexda P'—ku dhawaaqid, bixinta, iyo ilaalinta. Wuxuu xusay in raggu rabaan inay ogaadaan doorkooda, wuxuuna dhiirrigeliyay haweenka madax-bannaan ee guulaysta inaysan raga ka hor istaagin inay qayb ka noqdaan, iyagoo aan luminin madax-bannaanidooda.

Harvey wuxuu haweenka ku dhiirrigeliyay deyneysa dulqaad, isagoo xasuusiyay in lammaanaheeda saxda ahi jiro oo mudan tahay in la sugo. Wuxuu sharxay sababaha ragga qaarkood aysan jawaab u bixin marka xiriirku dhammaado, isagoo sheegay in raggu inta badan ogayn sida ay muhiimka u tahay dumarka. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay sababaha qaar ee keenay in nin qofkiisa khiyaaneeyo—fursad, is-aaminsanaan xumo, xal la'aan guriga, ama inuusan weli helin qofkii saxda ahaa—balse wuu caddeeyay inaysanasi cudur daar rasmi ah noqon karin.

Marka laga hadlayo haweeneyda qabo nin aad u hooyadii ugu dhagan ('mama's boy'), Harvey wuxuu kula taliyay xaasaska inay dejistaan xuduud cadcad oo ay deganaan ku leeyahay xidhiidhka. Wuxuu ku adkeeyay in haweenku si toos ah u sheegaan baahidooda ayna sugnaadaan ixtiraam iyo daacadnimo. Talooyinka Harvey waxay xooga saarayaan is-eegid dhab ah, dulqaad, iyo isla jaanqaad si loo helo xidhiidh macno leh.

At first glance, the scene resembles a dazzling aerial display with glowing trails looping across a night sky—suggesting the work of the Red Arrows. However, this isn't the feat of a skilled RAF team; rather, it is a mesmerizing photograph of seagulls soaring over Rome. Using a long-exposure technique, photographer Gabriel Bouys captured the birds' nocturnal flight, transforming their paths into delicate golden wisps of light.

In the photograph, the outline of an Italian rooftop appears as a dark silhouette at the bottom, set against a luminous sky. The seagulls dart and circle through the air, their movements traced in brilliant gold by the absorbed light during the camera's extended exposure. This method intentionally blurs and illuminates moving objects, causing the birds' paths to stand out against the blurred surroundings.

Long-exposure photography, especially effective at night or with bright subjects, leaves the camera's shutter open longer to absorb more light, producing vividly bright and dramatic images. This approach has become increasingly popular for its ability to artistically capture light and motion, turning everyday moments into romantic scenes. For this particular image, Bouys chose to forgo iconic sites like St Peter's Basilica and the River Tiber, instead gazing skyward to capture a unique and breathtaking view of Rome.

Sawirqaade Gabriel Bouys ayaa isticmaalay farsamada xariiqda dheer (long-exposure) si uu u helo duullimaad habeen ee shimbiraha, taasoo dariiqyadooda cirka ka dhigtay kuwo nuur dahabi ah oo jilicsan.

Sawirka, saqaf Talyaani ah ayaa ka muuqda hadh madow dhanka hoose ee sawirka, iyadoo uu ka horeeyo cirka iftiinka leh. Shimbirahu waxay ku wareegayaan hawada, dhaqdhaqaaqooda waxaa si layaableh u iftiimiyay nuurka uu camera-gu qaaday waqti dheer. Farsamadani waxay si casri ah u xaleefaysaa una iftiimisaa xayawaanka dhaqaaqa, tani oo keenta in dariiqyada shimbiraha si cad uga dhex muuqdaan sawirka.

Sawirka noocan ah ee xariiqda dheer ayaa si gaar ah ugu habboon habeenkii ama marka shayga la sawirayo uu ka iftiimayo deegaanka, taasoo keenta in kamaraddu furnaato waqti dheer, lagana helo sawiro iftiin badan leh. Habkan ayaa aad looga helay sababtoo ah wuxuu si farshaxan leh u qabtaa iftiinka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa, isagoo beddelaya muuqaallada caadiga ah kuna reebaya dareen jacayl. Sawirkan, Bouys wuxuu iska daryeelay meelaha caan ah ee Rome sida Basilica St Peter’s iyo webiga Tiber, wuxuuna doortay inuu sanka cirka ku eego si uu u abuuro muuqaal cajiib ah oo Rome ah.

article_content: New research from Japan, published in Ecology, indicates that intensifying weather caused by climate change could be pushing seabirds to their limits. In August 2019, Kozue Shiomi, a seabird biologist at Tohoku University, equipped 14 adult streaked shearwaters (Calonectris leucomelas) from a nesting colony on Mikurajima—a small island near Tokyo—with GPS bio-loggers to study their homing behavior. The following month, Typhoon Faxai, an exceptionally powerful storm with wind speeds reaching nearly 200 km/hr, struck southeastern Japan, causing significant physical damage. The typhoon also offered researchers a rare opportunity to observe how seabirds fare under extreme storm conditions—events scientists expect to become increasingly common as the climate changes. Analysis of tracking data after Typhoon Faxai showed that most tagged shearwaters were either unaffected or able to avoid the storm. However, one male bird was caught in the typhoon. Over an 11-hour period, he circled five full loops, each 50–80 km in diameter, and traveled a total of 1,146 km. Under normal circumstances, streaked shearwaters fly at speeds of 10–60 km/hr, at altitudes below 100 meters, and typically remain at sea. In contrast, data showed that the storm-affected bird reached speeds of 90–170 km/hr, soared to 4,700 meters, and was carried over mainland Japan before the typhoon returned to the Pacific Ocean. Although it cannot be confirmed, researchers speculate that the bird might have had the chance to escape but instead stayed with the storm until it moved back over the ocean. Like many seabirds, streaked shearwaters usually fly low over the sea—a strategy that conserves energy but can put them at greater risk of collisions with buildings or vehicles when blown over land. They are also awkward on solid ground and, if forced to land, struggle to take off, making them vulnerable to predators. Pelagic birds employ various tactics to avoid storms. For example, red-footed boobies and great frigatebirds often ascend to high altitudes to let storms pass beneath, while Eastern brown pelicans stay grounded until conditions are safer. Some birds even wait in the eye of the storm, where winds are calmer. With storms intensifying worldwide due to rising air and sea surface temperatures, it remains uncertain how well oceangoing birds can adapt to what may become more frequent and severe storms. Shiomi emphasizes that improving our understanding of how these birds cope with extreme weather will be crucial to predicting their resilience to adverse environmental changes expected in the future.
translated_content: Cilmi-baaris cusub oo ka timid Japan, oo lagu daabacay Ecology, ayaa muujinaysa in cimilada sii xoogeysaneysa ee ay keentay isbeddelka cimiladu ay cadaadis saarayso shimbiraha badda. Bishii Agoosto 2019, Kozue Shiomi, oo ah takhasuse ku xeel dheer shimbiraha badda kana tirsan Jaamacadda Tohoku, ayaa 14 shinbir oo ah streaked shearwaters (Calonectris leucomelas) uga xirtay qalabka GPS jasiiradda Mikurajima—oo ku dhow Tokyo—si ay ugu eegto dhaqdhaqaaqyada ku noqoshada degaanka. Bishii xigtay, duufaantii Faxai, oo ahayd mid si gaar ah u xoogan, xawaareheedu gaarayo 200 km/saacaddii, ayaa ku dhufatay koonfur-bari Japan taasoo waxyeelo wayn u geysatay dhulka. Duufaantan waxay cilmi-baarayaashu siisay fursad gaar ah oo ay ku arkaan sida shimbiraha badda ugu sabraan xaalado cimilada daran—kuwaasoo la filayo inay sii bataan mustaqbalka. Falanqaynta xogta raadraaca shinbiraha kadib duufaantii Faxai ayaa muujisay in badankood aysan saameyn weyn dareemin ama ay awoodeen inay ka fogaadaan duufaanta. Si kastaba, nin shinbir ah ayaa si toos ah ugu dhex dhacay duufaanta. Intii lagu jiray 11-saacadood oo la socday, wuxuu sameeyey shan wareeg oo buuxa midkiiba dhexroor 50–80 km ah, wadar ahaanna wuxuu jaray 1,146 km. Shimbirahan waxay caadi ahaan ku duulaan xawaare ah 10–60 km/saac, dhererka aan ka badneyn 100 mitir, waxaana badanaa ku sugan yihiin badda. Balse xogtu waxay muujisay in shinbirkan uu gaaray xawaare ah 90–170 km/saac, dherer ah 4,700 mitir, isla markaana uu dul maray dhulka Japan ka hor inta aan duufaantu dib ugu laaban badweynta. Inkastoo aan la hubi karin, cilmi-baarayaashu waxay maleynayaan in shinbirka uu haystay fursad uu kaga baxsan karo duufaanta, laakiin uu doortay inuu la socdo ilaa duufaantu dib ugu laabato badda. Sida shimbiraha badda badankood, streaked shearwaters waxay uga duulaan meel hoose badda—xeelad tamar-badbaadineed ah balse khatar ay tahay inay ku dhacaaan dhismayaasha ama gaadiidka marka dhulka la dhigo. Sidoo kale, way ku adag tahay inay ku ordaan dhulka oo, hadii ay ku qasbanaadaan inay degaan, way ku adag tahay inay dib u duulaan taasoo ka dhigaysa mid si fudud ugaarsan karo xayawaanka kale. Shimbiraha badda ayaa adeegsanaya xeelado kala duwan si ay uga fogaadaan duufaannada. Tusaale ahaan, red-footed boobies iyo great frigatebirds badanaa cirka sare ayay u kacaan si duufaanta hoos uga gudubto, halka Eastern brown pelicans ay dhulka ku sugayaan ilaa ay roonaato. Qaar kale waxay joogaan bartamaha duufaanta, halkaasoo dabayluhu yaryihiin. Maaddaama duufaannadu sare u sii kacayaan dunida oo dhan sababo la xiriira heer kulka hawada iyo badda, weli lama ogaan karo sida shimbiraha badda u la qabsan doonaan duufaanno badan oo sii xoogeysanaya. Shiomi waxay tilmaantay in fahanka sida shimbirahan badda u maareeyaan cimilada daran ay muhiim u tahay saadaasha xasilloonidooda isbeddellada deegaanka ee la filayo mustaqbalka.

article_content: With Christmas still 47 days away, Amazon is already gearing up for the festive season by hiring thousands of seasonal workers in its vast UK warehouses. These temporary staff members are being brought in ahead of Cyber Monday, when millions of British shoppers are expected to buy hundreds of products every minute online. At Amazon's enormous Peterborough facility in Cambridgeshire, an impressive volume of holiday gifts will be processed in the coming month. Meanwhile, the Swansea warehouse in South Wales is busy packaging and shipping everything from dog treats to the latest PlayStation 4 consoles—sometimes hundreds of items every second. Inside the Peterborough warehouse, thousands of boxes are arriving in preparation for Christmas. Toys and gadgets are organized into 'sortable' areas, separated by cardboard partitions. Employees work at computers as they manage carts filled with gifts. Items move continuously on conveyor belts through the massive space to loading docks, where delivery trucks depart every 130 seconds. Last year, Amazon received over 3.5 million orders on Cyber Monday—about 44 items every second. This year in Swansea, 1,500 additional employees have been hired for the season. The general manager there expressed confidence: 'We're ready for Cyber Monday... bring it on!' She also noted that this year's number of part-time hires is the highest ever. 'We'll see if Cyber Monday is the busiest yet, but here in Swansea, we're certainly prepared,' she added. Staff must scan every individual item passing through the storage area, enabling real-time tracking throughout the delivery process. A combination of letter and number codes helps employees quickly locate items among thousands of rows. Yellow containers are stacked in front of seemingly endless shelves, ready to transport goods to shipping. The 700,000 square-foot South Wales centre, opened in 2008, now employs more than 2,000 people—numbers that grow each year. Amazon's UK fulfilment center workers, including 'pickers' and 'sorters,' work four 10-hour shifts weekly, providing three days off. Company spokesperson Fran Waite said, 'Fewer workdays can save employees time and money, and reduce commuting’s environmental impact.' At the massive Jersey Marine warehouse, workers in 'wrapland' carefully wrap gifts in gold and red paper when customers request gift wrapping. About 50% more staff have been brought in for the busy holiday season. Elsewhere, stacks of nappies, cardboard dividers, and yellow containers help organize the bustling operation. Seasonal workers move around the warehouse with trolleys and assemble boxes for packing. A computerized system tracks every item from arrival to shelving and dispatch. Workers use handheld scanners to process orders like DVDs and gaming consoles. Miss Waite explained, 'A lot is done by computer, but some things are still better handled by hand.' The fast-paced routine starts with staff receiving supplier shipments at the dock, scanning stock, and storing items. When an item is ordered, employees use guided routes to find it, wrap it, and send it out for delivery. All this activity ramps up as Amazon prepares for the expected surge on December 2nd, declared the year's busiest shopping day.

article_content: A new report from the Office for National Statistics (ONS) has identified a number of English seaside towns as some of the most deprived communities in the country. These towns—including Blackpool, Clacton, Ramsgate, and Margate—are struggling with high unemployment, poor health outcomes, and elevated crime rates. Once thriving vacation spots, these coastal towns have experienced economic decline, partly blamed on the popularity of inexpensive international travel. A separate report from the Centre for Social Justice described some of these resorts as 'dumping grounds' after their local economies suffered. The ONS examined the 57 largest seaside towns in England, all with populations over 15,000. Notable smaller resorts like Polzeath were excluded due to their population size. The worst-hit larger towns—such as Blackpool, Clacton, and Hartlepool—showed greater deprivation than the national average. Blackpool, in particular, ranked highest in indicators like unemployment, low income, poor health, and crime. Smaller seaside resorts have also struggled. Skegness and Ingoldmells, where Billy Butlins opened his first holiday camp in 1936, are listed as the most deprived among these communities. Yet, some nearby coastal towns have managed to avoid serious decline. Lytham St Annes, known for the Royal Lytham and St Annes Golf Club, is among the least deprived English seaside towns, with Christchurch in Dorset also ranking highly. To help local children affected by poverty, Blackpool has introduced free school breakfasts for all primary pupils. The Centre for Social Justice noted that parts of Blackpool also face high rates of fatherless households and falling property values. Government officials recognize these hardships, attributing some of the decline to previous economic neglect. Since 2011, the Coastal Communities Fund has aimed to spur regeneration, grow local businesses, and generate new jobs. The ONS findings draw attention to the often sharp differences along England's coast, with struggling communities existing alongside more prosperous, sought-after destinations.

Magaalooyinkan — sida Blackpool, Clacton, Ramsgate, iyo Margate — waxaa la daalaa dhacaya shaqo la’aan sare, caafimaad xumo, iyo heer dambiyeed sare. article_content: Anthony Savino is the CEO of Benjamin Marc Corp., a web design and digital marketing agency based in Long Island. Creating a logo for your business requires careful planning, research, and execution. Whether you hire a professional creative agency or design one yourself, this article aims to highlight several important aspects of the logo creation process. A key to a great logo is making it timeless. Your logo should continue to look current 15 years from now. Avoid using overly common graphics seen within your industry, and ensure that your target audience understands your brand message clearly. Choosing the right colors, fonts, graphics, slogan, and design team are essential factors in creating a logo that will endure. Here are some tips to consider when designing a logo: 1. Color Scheme: Selecting the perfect color may seem simple, but it requires research. Colors play a major role in setting the tone for your business’s visual identity. Be sure your chosen colors complement your website, printed materials, and even your business's physical space. Use online tools like 'CMYK color picker' or 'RGB color picker' to explore options. Once satisfied, share the exact color codes with your designer. 2. Font Selection: Picking the right font is another vital step and can take time. Be diligent about font licensing; some fonts are expensive while others are affordable or free. Review the license details for commercial use before making your selection. Font sellers usually provide clear instructions on licensing. 3. Graphics: You may choose to include a graphic or an acronym in your logo, ideally fitting your industry. If you work with a design agency, provide detailed information about your preferred graphics to achieve the best results. 4. Selecting a Logo Designer: Decide whether you want a hands-on approach with a local designer or prefer using online logo creation tools. If hiring a designer or agency, review their portfolio and social media to evaluate their style and skill. 5. Files: Once the logo is finalized, ensure you receive all original artwork files and necessary licenses. This will allow future edits or adjustments, whether by you or another designer. Common file types include PDF, PSD, AI, JPG, and PNG. Hopefully, these tips will assist you in your logo design process.

Faylasha: Marka la dhammeeyo astaanta, hubi inaad hesho dhammaan faylasha asalka ah iyo rukhsadaha lagama maarmaanka ah. Tani waxay kuu fududaynaysaa in aad wax ka bedesho mustaqbalka. article_content:
Anne-Marie Griger is in the business of envisioning and developing massive clean energy projects—think solar panel fields and towering wind turbines capable of powering entire cities. But making these projects a reality is complicated. As a development director at RES Group, she has to select ideal sites with suitable weather, geography, and transmission access, while also persuading landowners to participate. One of the biggest challenges isn’t technical—it’s people saying “not in my backyard.”

Much of the open land in the western U.S. is federally owned, which leads to lengthy permitting processes and extensive paperwork. Private land, meanwhile, comes with its own web of state and local restrictions, drawn-out environmental reviews, and contentious public hearings. Increasingly, local communities resist these projects, motivated by concerns ranging from property values to misinformation about health risks. Even generous financial incentives often fail to win over opponents.

This local resistance is just one symptom of a broader slowdown in American infrastructure building. Decades ago, the country led the world in constructing highways, railroads, and city-spanning bridges. Now, projects take years, infrastructure decays, and costs rise sharply. Trillions of dollars are being authorized for repairs and renewable energy under federal legislation, but bureaucratic bottlenecks and local opposition often stall progress.

Research shows that most renewable projects are not stopped by federal regulations, contrary to popular belief—instead, local objections are the main stumbling block. Landowners and residents frequently exploit environmental laws to block infrastructure, housing, and energy improvements, even when those projects align with climate and societal needs. Lawsuits, zoning rules, and emotional appeals can delay or derail development for years.

While original environmental policies were vital for safeguarding nature, they’re often now used to thwart projects that could actually help the environment—such as wind farms and affordable housing. Experts suggest it’s time to thoroughly update these regulations. A new legal framework could maintain strong protections against pollution and habitat loss but streamline approval for projects that mitigate climate change or provide social benefits, as long as impacts are offset elsewhere. Courts’ power to delay essential projects could be limited, and federal authorities would have greater ability to keep progress moving forward.

Some states, like New York and Florida, are already simplifying approval for renewable and transit infrastructure. Market forces also favor this shift, with renewable energy now cheaper than most fossil fuel options. The proposal is gaining backing from both major parties and leading environmentalists, though it requires rethinking who holds the power over America’s built environment.

The core message: If we want thriving communities and a healthy planet, we must modernize our approach, ensuring that resistance from a few doesn’t prevent solutions for the many. Reforming environmental rules is about protecting nature and society for the future—not rejecting progress.

Anne-Marie Griger waxay qorshaysaa oo horumarisaa mashaariic waaweyn oo tamarta nadiifka ah—beero qoraxda ah iyo matoorro waaweyn oo dabayl—kuwaas oo awood u leh inay iftiimiyaan magaalooyin dhan. Laakiin hirgelinta mashaariicdaas way adag tahay. Agaasime horumarineed oo ka tirsan RES Group ahaan, Griger waa inay heshaa meel ku habboon, cimilada saxda ah leh, dhul fidsan, iyo marin koronto oo fudud—iyadoo intaas dheer la heshiinaysa milkiilayaasha dhulka. Caqabadda ugu weyn waxay noqotay dad deegaanka ah oo diidan in wax laga dhiso dhulkooda ama agagaarkiisa.

Dhulka waqooyiga-galbeed ee Maraykanka inta badan dawladda dhexe ayaa leh, taas oo la micno ah in ogolaanshaha iyo waraaqaha ay waqti badan qaataan. Dhulka gaarka loo leeyahayna waxa la socda xeerar iyo sharuuc maxalli ah, baaritaano deegaanka ah oo waqti badan qaata, iyo kulamo dadweyne oo hadhowna muran ka dhasha. Xataa marka la bixiyo magdhow lacageed oo badan, diidmadu way jirtaa. Dadka magaalooyinka qaar waxay marar badan sabab uga dhigaan khatar caafimaad ama qiimaha guryaha si ay uga hortagaan horumarka cusub, balse waxaa jira macluumaad qaldan iyo sababo kale.

Hakadkan maxalliga ah waa calaamad muujinaysa sida dhismaha kaabayaasha muhiimka ah Mareykanku hoos ugu dhacay. Dalka waxa uu mar hormuud u ahaa dhismaha waddooyin iyo buundooyin waaweyn, halka maanta mashaariic badan la beegsanayo sannado badanna lagu hakiyo. Balaayiin doolar ayay dawladdu u qoondaysay wax ka qabashada arrimahan, balse xeerar adag iyo diidmo dadweyne ayaa hortaagan hormarka.

Cilmi-baaris ayaa caddeysay in inta badan mashaariicda tamarta la cusboonaysiin karo aan lagu xannibin xeerarka federaalka, balse ay sabab u tahay gadoodka dadka deegaanka. Mararka qaar, milkiilayaasha dhulka ayaa xeerarka deegaanka uga faa’iidaysta inay ku xannibaan mashaariic waxtar leh oo dadka badan dani ugu jirto. Dacwooyin, xeerar dhisme, iyo cabashooyin aan sal lahayn ayaaba la adeegsadaa.

Sharciyadii hore ugu talagalnaa badbaadinta deegaanka hadda inta badani waxay noqdeen caqabad hor taagan mashaariicda waxtarka leh sida matoorada dabaysha iyo guryaha la awoodi karo. Khubaro badan waxay isku raacsan yihiin baahida loo qabo xeerar cusub oo dheeli-tira ilaalinta deegaanka iyo degdegga ay u baahan tahay la tacaalida isbeddelka cimilada. Sharcigaas cusub wuxuu sii adkeyn lahaa ka hortagga wasakheynta iyo dumin deegaanka, laakiin wuxuu sahli lahaa in si dhakhso ah loo ogolaado mashaariicda waxtarka leh—iyadoo cudur-daar la’aan maxkamaduhu dib u dhigaan, iyo dowlad dhexe ay leedahay awood dheeraad ah.

Dowladaha sida New York iyo Florida ayaa durbaba fududeeyey oggolaanshaha mashaariicda sida dabaysha iyo tareenada. Suuqa laftiisa ayaa taageeraya beddelaadkan maadaama tamarta nadiifka ah ay ka jaban tahay shidaalka. Fikraddan ayaa taageero ka helaysa labada xisbi iyo deegaamyada, inkastoo la isku hayo cidda go’aanka ugu dambaysa leedahay.

Gunaanadku waa: haddii aan doonayno nolol tayo leh iyo deegaanka oo la ilaaliyo, waxaa lama huraan ah in la waafajiyo sharciyada xilligan casriga ah si horumarka waxtarka leh uusan ugu xayirmin cabashada tiro yar. article_content: A father in New Hampshire was arrested during a school board meeting after objecting to his 14-year-old daughter being assigned a book with explicit content in her high school English class. William Baer became upset at a Gilford High School board meeting, arguing that 'Nineteen Minutes' by Jodi Picoult—assigned to his daughter—addresses sensitive topics such as school shootings, bullying, and sexual violence. Baer, an attorney, claimed the school showed a lack of respect to parents by assigning a novel with mature themes without notifying them or giving an opt-out option. Several parents attended the meeting to express their concern about the absence of prior notice regarding the book’s content. During the meeting, Baer attempted to read aloud a passage he found objectionable, but was stopped by the school board. After exceeding his two-minute speaking time, a police officer asked Baer to leave; when he questioned the grounds for his removal, he was escorted out in handcuffs and charged with disorderly conduct. Baer later said he and his wife were surprised by the graphic nature of the book. Another parent, Doug Lambert, criticized the choice of book, suggesting students deserve higher quality literature. The novel’s author, Jodi Picoult, responded by stating the sexual scene in question was less explicit than common TV content, and expressed that the main focus on bullying was being overlooked. Despite the controversy, the school board emphasized that 'Nineteen Minutes' has been part of the curriculum since 2007 and apologized for not giving parents prior notification. Supporters of the book, including students and fans, have highlighted its importance in fostering discussions about real-life issues. Gilford High School’s superintendent, Kent Hemingway, reaffirmed the book’s significance in addressing complex social themes.

article_content: Share prices typically follow a company’s earnings over time. A recent analysis of BSE-listed firms found 14 stocks that have delivered at least 20% year-on-year (YoY) growth in both sales and profits for the past four quarters. These have become notable ‘multibaggers’ in the last year. Most of these high-performing stocks are from capital expenditure-driven sectors. The top spots are occupied by two railway companies, Titagarh Rail Systems and Jupiter Wagons, which have reported profits over 100% higher than the previous year. In the September quarter, Titagarh reported a 107% jump in profit after tax (PAT) and a 54% rise in sales, while Jupiter Wagons achieved a 233% profit increase alongside 111% sales growth. Over the past year, Titagarh shares soared 476%, and Jupiter Wagons’ stock rose 320%. Titagarh also announced a strategic partnership with ABB to provide propulsion systems for Gujarat’s metro projects. Lloyds Engineering posted a 149% YoY profit increase in Q2, seeing its shares climb by 282.5% over the year. Apar Industries, Anand Rathi Wealth, and Kaynes Technology each experienced share price growth of over 200%. Domestic brokerage Prabhudas Lilladher reports that the demand for premium conductors remains strong, particularly in TBCB and re-conductoring segments. Improved execution in Q2FY24 led to higher productivity, and the cable business is expected to continue its growth, fueled by strong demand for elastomeric cables. Other stocks demonstrating outstanding performance include Tilaknagar Industries, Action Construction Equipment, Anant Raj, PG Electroplast, The Jammu & Kashmir Bank, RateGain Travel, Elecon Engineering, and KPIT Technologies. While robust earnings are a key driver of stock prices, factors like market sentiment, sector trends, and anticipated growth also play important roles. CLSA, a global brokerage, suggests investors focus on sectors that have underperformed or are traditional defensives, and recommends holding largecap liquid stocks to provide capital protection and growth opportunities. Comparative data for Q2 earnings show that small and midcap firms—particularly in auto, durables, FMCG, and BFSI—have outperformed their largecap peers in profit growth, thanks in part to lower input and credit costs. The IT, metals, and pharma sectors also show small and mid-sized companies outpacing largecaps. CLSA analyst Vikash Kumar Jain highlights that smaller banks now have a significant valuation premium over large banks, while institutional exposure to the banking sector remains low. Nevertheless, banks are still the largest overweight in CLSA’s India-focused portfolio, with top recommendations like Axis Bank, Bharti Airtel, Hindustan Unilever, ICICI Bank, Mahindra & Mahindra, NTPC, Sun Pharma, UltraTech, TCS, and SBI. In other news, Byju’s main shareholders insist the company meet certain conditions before they consider providing further funding, amid a serious cash crunch. Meanwhile, virtual influencers such as Kyra and Naina are becoming increasingly popular for brand campaigns, attracting partnerships from companies like Titan, Realme, MG Motors, and Boat. At Religare Enterprises, independent director Ahmed Hamid has publicly questioned the timing of the Burman family’s open offer, marking the first such comment from the board regarding the bid. article_content: Digital marketing is a fast-paced, ever-evolving field. As customer expectations become more sophisticated and competition increases, maintaining a consistent and compelling multichannel presence is now essential. To meet these needs, composable digital experience platforms (DXPs) offer marketing teams the ability to create, manage, and deliver personalized content across various channels, touchpoints, and devices.  In this article, we explore how marketing teams can thrive with a composable DXP and what factors to consider when selecting DXP partners.  What Is a Composable DXP? A digital experience platform (DXP) is software that organizations use to create, manage, and optimize digital experiences. It typically includes tools for managing content, email marketing, personalization, and more. A composable DXP enhances this model by providing modular, flexible building blocks. Teams can assemble core features—such as analytics, customer journey mapping, data management, search, and multi-experience support—to suit their needs, expand functionality as their business evolves, and better execute digital campaigns.  Types of Composable DXPs: 1. Best-Of-Breed DXP: Custom-built from multiple specialized products, tailored for specific needs. Requires skilled integration and development; can increase complexity and costs with a less unified user experience. 2. Integrated DXP: Components are preselected and merged by the vendor. Typically comes as a product suite from a major provider, easing executive buy-in, but may face inconsistent user experiences and higher costs. 3. Single-Vendor DXP: All capabilities are developed by one vendor for cohesive integration and a consistent interface. Essential tools are included, and marketers can add or replace features as needed.  How Marketing Teams Can Succeed with a Composable DXP CMOs and marketing leaders encounter several challenges when moving to a composable DXP—budgeting, choosing components, setting KPIs, ensuring ROI, and managing implementation without extensive technical backgrounds. Key ways to address these include: 1. Align DXP goals with organizational strategy, set clear objectives, and balance customization with time-to-market. 2. Budget for licensing, integration, maintenance, and scalability, keeping ROI and potential hidden costs in mind. 3. Facilitate collaboration with IT to meet technical or security requirements. 4. Train marketing teams on platform capabilities and data analysis to maximize personalization and optimization. 5. Use low-code/no-code tools for rapidly creating, modifying, and publishing content without IT support.  Be cautious not to over-customize, as this can complicate maintenance.  Selecting the Right DXP Implementation Partner Selecting a composable DXP vendor greatly impacts your ability to customize and integrate solutions. While large organizations may manage this internally, most businesses benefit from partnering with software implementation specialists, agencies, or consultancies. A trusted partner provides guidance, solves integration issues, and helps maintain your digital experience stack.  Consider these factors when choosing a partner: - Strength of their relationship with the DXP vendor - Technical knowledge and understanding of the product's architecture - Track record of successful projects, especially in your industry - Ability to offer strategic advice beyond development - Quality and reputation of customer support - Flexibility to create custom solutions  A reliable, communicative, and experienced partner fosters long-term success amid changing business needs and digital maturity. Customer intimacy and ongoing collaboration are key to leveraging your composable DXP effectively.  In summary: To maximize the value of your composable DXP, choose partners who have the expertise to develop, integrate, and support your ecosystem. Selecting the right agency is essential to ensure seamless implementation and ongoing success. Arintan darteed, barnaamijyada la isku keeni karo ee Digital Experience Platforms (DXPs) waxay ka caawiyaan kooxaha suuq-geynta inay abuuraan, maamulaan, una gudbiyaan khibrad dhijitaaleysan oo la waafajiyey, iyagoo adeegsanaya kanaallo kala duwan, taabashooyin kala duwan, iyo aaladaha kala duwan.  Maqaalkani wuxuu sharaxayaa sida kooxaha suuq-geynta ugu guuleysan karaan DXP la isku keeni karo iyo waxa ay tixgelinayaan marka ay dooranayaan lammaane DXP.  Waa Maxay DXP la isku keeni karo? Digital Experience Platform (DXP) waa software ay shirkadu ku abuurto, ku maamusho, kuna hagaajiso khibradaha dhijitaalka ah. Waxay caadiyan ka kooban tahay qalabyo sida maamulka macluumaadka, email suuq-geynta, shaqsiyeenta, iyo kuwo kale. DXP la isku keeni karo waxay xoojisaa arintan iyadoo u oggolaanaysa in kooxaha si modular ah ugu dhistaan qaybaha—sida falanqeynta xogta, jaantuska socdaalka macaamiisha, maamulka xogta macaamiisha, raadinta, iyo taageerada khibrad kala duwan—si loo waafajiyo baahiyahooda, la ballaariyo marka ay shirkaddu korto, loogana shaqeeyo ololeyaal dhijitaal si mustaqbal leh.  Noocyada DXP-yada la isku keeni karo: 1. Best-Of-Breed DXP: Waa nidaam laga sameeyey barnaamijyo gaar ah, si gaar ahna loogu habeeyey baahiyahaaga. Single-Vendor DXP: Dhamaan awoodaha waxaa sameeya hal shirkad, waana la mid ah interface isku mid ah. Qalab badan ayaa horay ugu jira, waana la beddeli karaa marka loo baahdo.  Sida Kooxaha Suuq-geyntu Ugu Guuleysan Karaan DXP la isku keeni karo Hogaamiyeyaasha suuq-geynta waxay la kulmaan caqabado badan marka ay u wareegayaan DXP la isku keeni karo—sida miisaaniyadda, xulashada qaybaha, dejinta KPIs, xaqiijinta ROI, iyo hirgalinta iyadoo aysan jirin aqoon farsamo oo qoto dheer. Hababka lagu wajahayo waxaa kamid ah: 1. Ula jeedo u dejiso ujeedooyinka DXP-ga iyo istiraatiijiyadda shirkadda, oo si cad u qeex yoolalka iyo baahiyaha. 2. Miisaaniyad samee adigoo qora kharashaadka rukhsadaha, isku xirka, dayactirka iyo ballaarinta, isla markaana maskaxda ku hayso ROI-ga la rajaynayo iyo kharashaadka qarsoon. 3. La shaqee waaxda IT si loo hubiyo amaanka iyo shuruudaha farsamada. 4. Tababaro kooxda si ay usii bartaan awoodaha barnaamijka iyo falanqeynta xogta, taasoo suurto galinaysa shaqsiyeenta iyo horumarka. 5. Adeegso low-code/no-code tools si degdeg loogu abuuro macluumaad loona daabaco adigoon IT baahnayn.  Ka taxaddar inaad xad-dhaaf u habeyso nidaamka, sababtoo ah waxay keeni kartaa dhibaatooyin dayactir.  Doorashada lammaane DXP sax ah Doorashada DXP la isku keeni karo waxay si weyn u saameynaysaa sida aad ugu habboonaan karto badeecadaada. Shirkadaha waaweyn way maareyn karaan gudaha, laakin inta badan ganacsiyadu waxay u baahan yihiin lammaane ammaan ah sida la-taliye ama xafiis suuq-geyn. Lammaane la isku halleyn karo wuxuu bixiyaa xal iyo talooyin, waxaana uu ka caawiyaa maareynta dhammaan baahiyahaaga waayo-aragnimo dhijitaal.  Markaad dooranayso lammaane isku day inaad eegto: - Heerka xiriirka ay la leeyihiin bixiyaha DXP-ga - Aqoontooda farsamo iyo fahamka dhismaha barnaamijka - Rikoodhka mashruucyo guuleysta gaar ahaan warshaddaada - Kartida la taliyaha inay bixiyaan talo istiraatiiji ah markaa laga baxo horumarinta kaliya - Tayada iyo magacooda adeegga macaamiisha - Debecsanaanta in la abuuro xal gaar ah  Lammaane la isku halayn karo, khibrad leh, oo la xiriir wanaagsan leh wuxuu kuu ogolaanaya guul waqti dheer ah—gaar ahaan marka ganacsigaagu koro oo baahiyahaagu is bedelaan. Xiriirka dhow iyo wada shaqeynta joogtada ah waa furaha in si buuxda looga faa'iideysto DXP-gaaga.  Gunaanad: Si aad u hesho faa'iido taas ugu badan ee DXP la isku keeni karo, iskaashi la lammaane yaqaana horumarka, isku xirka, iyo taageerada nidaamkaaga. Doorashada hay'ad sax ah waa muhiim si aad u guuleysato muddada fog. article_content: Nestled between snow-capped mountains, Lebanon’s Bekaa Valley is home to numerous makeshift camps sheltering Syrian refugees who have limited protection against the severe winter cold. For Hala Habib Qiblawi, a designer and mother of three, haunting images of barefoot children braving the harsh winter remained fixed in her mind for the past year. Determined to help, Qiblawi organized a campaign to provide winter boots for refugee children. As she was planning the initiative, Lebanon experienced one of its coldest and most severe storms in recent memory. Qiblawi realized many others shared her urge to act. 'Everyone was angry—at the government, at the silence,' she recalls. Fueled by this shared frustration and concern for the refugees, she launched a Facebook campaign called ‘Rain Boots for Syrian refugee children,’ with an initial target of 2,000 pairs of boots. The response exceeded her expectations: the goal was met within 24 hours and thousands more boots poured in, confirming for Qiblawi that compassion persists even in difficult places. Distribution efforts are coordinated with Sawa for Syria, a grassroots non-governmental organization founded by Lebanese Syrian Rouba Mhaissen. Sawa for Syria, which now counts about 2,000 volunteer members, helps manage and distribute aid across camps in the region. Mhaissen, a Ph.D. candidate based in London, had planned only a short visit to Lebanon but stayed to help as the refugee crisis escalated. On distribution day, children eagerly await their new footwear. Nine-year-old Amina proudly writes her name in English, while others speak longingly of returning to Syria. Suzanne, a quiet five-year-old, tightly grasps a volunteer’s hand. Her family’s story is one of hardship: her father was killed by a sniper in Homs, a brother is missing and presumed detained, and another is recovering from injuries inflicted by an artillery strike. Inside their tent, Suzanne and her sisters show where they stuffed cardboard into the makeshift ceiling to soak up leaking rainwater. Thirteen-year-old Outour, unable to enroll in school, spent the summer working in the fields with a brother to help support the family after their father’s death. Their mother bears additional burdens after also losing her son-in-law. Despite everything, the children still dream—Outour hopes to be a journalist; her younger sisters aspire to be a dentist and a doctor. Though they face constant reality checks, the simple joy of receiving new boots brings rare smiles and laughter. Mhaissen observes that, while aid efforts meet only a small fraction of the vast need, moments of happiness—like seeing a child smile or a mother relieved—matter deeply. Qiblawi echoes this: providing boots is like giving the children a Cinderella moment, restoring a sense of pride and dignity.

Qiblawi waxay fahantay in dad badan dareen la mid ah qabaan. ‘Qof kastaa wuu xanaaqay—dowladda, aamusnaanta,’ ayay xasuusataa. Dhiirrigelintaasi iyo walwalka ay ka qabto qaxootiga ayay Facebook-ga ka bilowday olole la yiraahdo ‘Kabo Roobaad Carruurta Qaxootiga Suuriya,’ bartilmaameedkuna wuxuu ahaa in la helayo 2,000 kabo ah. Jawaabta aadbay uga weyneyd filashada: bartilmaameedkii waxaa la gaaray 24 saacadood gudahood, kumanaan kabood oo dheeraad ah ayaa la helay, taasoo Qiblawi tusisay in bini’aadannimada weli jirto xitaa meelaha adag. Qaybinta kabaha waxaa fududeeya ururka Sawa for Syria, oo ay aasaastay Rouba Mhaissen, asalkedana waa Lubnaan-Suuyaan. Sawa for Syria waxay hadda leedahay ilaa 2,000 oo iskaa wax u qabso ah, iyadoo caawisa qeybinta iyo maaraynta gurmadka xeryaha gobolka. Mhaissen, oo Ph.D. ku barata London, waxay booqasho yar ku tagtay Lubnaan balse waxa ay go’aansatay in ay sii joogto markii musiibada qaxootigu korodhay. Maalinta qaybinta, caruurtu si xiiso leh ayay ug sugayeen kabahooda cusub. Amina oo sagaal jir ah waxay farxad ku tustay sida ay magacaheeda Ingiriisi ugu qorto, kuwa kalena waxay ka hadlayeen rabitaankooda inay Suuriya ku laabtaan. Suzanne, oo shan sano jir ah, waa aamusnaan kuna dhaggan gacan mutadawac ah. Qoyskeeda waxay la daalaa dhacaan dhibaato: aabahood waxaa dilay snayper Homs gudaheeda, mid walaalkood ah waa la la'yahay, mid kalena wali wuu ka soo kabanayaa dhaawicii duqeynta. Gudaha teendhada, Suzanne iyo walaalaheed waxay tusayaan meeshii ay kartoonka ku dhejiyeen si uu u nuugo biyaha da'aya ee dushiisa. Outour oo 13 jir ah mana suurtagalin in ay isdiiwaangeliso dugsiga, xagaagana waxay la shaqaysay walaalkeed si ay qoyska u taageeraan kadib geeridii aabahood. Hooyadood waxaa dusha ka saaran culaysyo kale kadib markii ninkeeda gabadheeda hore dhintay. Iyadoo dhibaatooyinkaas oo dhan ay jiraan, caruurtu weli waxay leeyihiin riyooyin—Outour waxa ay rabtaa in ay suxufi noqoto, walaalaheed yaryar waxay rajeenayaan in ay noqdaan dhakhtar ilkood iyo doctor. Inkastoo ay la kulmayaan xaqiiqooyin adag, farxadda ay dareemayaan marka ay helayaan kabo cusub waxay keentaa dhoolla caddeyn iyo qosol. Sida Mhaissen sheegey, inkastoo caawinta la hayo ay tahay boqolkiiba yar baahida jirta, farxadda ilmaha ama raynraynta hooyada aad buu muhiim u yahay. Qiblawi-na waxay tiri: kabaha la siiyo caruurta waa sidii sheekada Cinderella—waxa uu soo celiyay xasiloonidooda iyo sharaf.

article_content: After almost thirty years, advances in forensic science have resolved the murder of nine-year-old Christopher Laverack. His uncle, Melvyn Read, was identified as his killer. Christopher went missing in March 1984 while staying at a relative’s house. Two days later, his body was discovered in a stream, showing signs of severe assault and sexual abuse. Recent investigation found that unusual pollen and plant particles on Christopher’s clothing matched species in Read’s garden. An ornamental brick at the scene was traced to Read’s garden water feature, just ten minutes from where Christopher disappeared. Read, who had a history of sexual offenses against children, died in prison in 2008 before he could be charged with the murder. DNA testing had not provided answers, but Dr. Patricia Wiltshire’s analysis of the plant evidence gave police the breakthrough they needed. Legal experts and police agree the evidence would have likely ensured Read’s conviction had he been alive. Although some relief comes with solving the case, Christopher’s family continues to grapple with the pain of his loss, and police regret not being able to bring Read to trial.

Christopher waxa uu luntay bishii Maarso 1984 isagoo booqanaya qaraabo, waxaana meydkiisii lagu helay durdur laba maalmood kadib, isagoo la kulmay jirdil xun iyo xadgudub galmo. Baaritaan cusub ayaa muujiyey in burushka iyo walxaha dhirta ee dharkiisa laga helay ay ku xidhnaayeen beerta Read. Birik qurxin ah oo laga helay meydka ayaa lagu ogaaday inay ka timid muuqaal biyo ah oo beertiisa ku yaallay, meel ay ku dhowdahay meesha uu Christopher ka luntay. Read wuxuu hore ugu xirnaa dambiyo galmo oo uu u geystay carruur, waxa uuna ku dhintay xabsi 2008 isagoo aan maxkamad loo soo taagin kiiskan. Inkastoo imtixaankii DNA-ga uusan wax natiijo ah keenin, haddana xog ururin ay sameysay Dr. Patricia Wiltshire oo ku saabsan caddaymaha dhirta iyo burushka ayaa si cad ugu xidhtay Read kiiskan. Khubarada sharciga iyo booliiska ayaa aaminsanaa in caddaymahan ay sababi lahaayeen xukun dambiyada dilka haddii Read uu noolaan lahaa. In kasta oo qoyskiisa ay helaan wax yari deganaansho ah, haddana weli way tabayaan Christopher, booliskuna waxay xuseen inay ka xun yihiin in maxkamad la horkeeni waayey Read.

article_content: Italy has decided not to build a new bobsled track required for the 2026 Winter Olympics in the country’s north. Previously, escalating project costs had deterred all construction companies from bidding, with the track estimated to cost between €93 and €120 million. Rebuilding an old track had also been ruled out as too expensive. The new track was meant to be completed by December 2024 for a test event ahead of the games. After months of debate and setbacks, Italian Olympic officials announced the track will not be constructed. As a result, key Olympic sliding events—bobsled, luge, and skeleton—will need to be held outside Italy. The decision was reached by both the Italian government and the International Olympic Committee (IOC). It remains undecided which country will host the events in place of Italy. Innsbruck, Austria’s mayor Georg Willi has offered use of local facilities for approximately €12.5 million in upgrades, though Italy has so far not responded. St. Moritz in Switzerland is also considered a possible venue. USA Luge CEO Jim Leahy expressed disappointment that the competition will not take place in Cortina, citing its historic significance. Nevertheless, he affirmed U.S. athletes are prepared to compete wherever the events occur.

Horay, kharashka mashruuca oo sii kacayay ayaa dhiirrigeliyay in shirkadihi dhismaha diidaan inay soo tartamaan, iyadoo la qiyaasay in waddada cusub ay ku kacayso inta u dhaxaysa €93 ilaa €120 milyan. Sidoo kale, dib-u-dhisidda waddadii hore ayaa laga tanaasulay maadaama ay aad qaali u ahayd. Waddadan cusub waxaa la rabay in la dhameeyo December 2024 si loo qabto tijaabo ka hor ciyaaraha. Kadib bilo doodo iyo caqabado ah, masuuliyiinta Olympic-ga ee Talyaaniga ayaa sheegaya inaan waddadu la dhisi doonin. Taas macnaheedu waxa weeye in ciyaaraha muhiimka ah ee bobsled, luge iyo skeleton dibadda lagu qaban doono. Go’aanka waxay isla gaadheen dowladda Talyaaniga iyo Gudiga Caalamiga ah ee Olympic-ga (IOC). Wali lama cayimin dal marti gelin doona ciyaarahan. Duqa magaalada Innsbruck ee Austria, Georg Willi, ayaa dalbaday in la isticmaalo goobaha magaaladaas oo lagu sameeyo casriyeyn ku kacaysa €12.5 milyan; Talyaanigu ilaa hadda wuu ka aamusan yahay. St. Moritz ee Switzerland-na waa mid kale oo la tixgelinayo. Madaxa USA Luge, Jim Leahy, ayaa sheegay inuu ka xunyahay in tartanka la wareejiyay kana baxayo Cortina oo taariikh weyn leh. Si kastaba, wuxuu xusay in ciyaartoyda Mareykanku diyaar u yihiin inay tartamaan meel kasta oo lagu qabto.

article_content: The Red Sea's Galaxy Leader cargo ship was recently escorted by Houthi boats after its seizure by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels. Amid persistent geopolitical risks, global trade and economic stability remain under strain. Following the disruptions from the COVID-19 pandemic and the Ukraine war, the ongoing Israel-Hamas conflict is adding new concerns. While the conflict between Israel and Hamas has not spread to other countries, it threatens to disrupt global trade. After threatening Israeli vessels over the Gaza situation, Houthi rebels seized a ship linked to an Israeli businessman and redirected it toward Yemen. This incident endangers not only Israeli shipping but overall maritime traffic in the Red Sea, a vital global shipping lane. The Galaxy Leader, flagged in the Bahamas and registered in the Isle of Man, is connected to Israel. It was operated by Japan's Nippon Yusen (NYK Line), departed Korfez in Turkey for Pipavav, India, and had an international crew. Targeting vessels in this region puts global interests at risk, including the potential for misdirected attacks or ships avoiding the route due to escalating threats. The Red Sea and Suez Canal are crucial shipping corridors between Europe, Asia, and the Arab world—offering the shortest and most economical route. A NYK Line spokesperson noted that disruption here could affect goods transported between Europe and Japan, and possibly impact Japan’s economy. About 10% of world maritime trade passes through the Suez Canal. Significant energy shipments—such as LNG and petroleum products—move via the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a major chokepoint. In 2018, around 6.2 million barrels per day passed along this route. Following the seizure, shipping insurance and war risk premiums have risen in the region, according to S&P Global and shipping experts. Oil prices may also be affected by risk premiums, depending on the extent of escalation and restraint among regional actors. Previous incidents, like the 2019 Houthi attack on Saudi Aramco facilities, led to temporary supply shocks, but recent responses by Middle Eastern countries have shown restraint. Analysts advise that, while the Houthis' seizure poses real risks, most countries are avoiding broader involvement in the Israel-Hamas conflict. The global oil market impact has been limited so far, and there is some optimism for a diplomatic solution. In separate developments, Indian tax authorities have found approximately ₹10,000 crore in tax evasion by online sellers using social media platforms, with notices sent to various brands. Additionally, Gautam Singhania’s estranged wife Nawaz Modi has accused him of assault. Keywords: Red Sea, Houthi rebels, Israel, world trade, global economy, Suez Canal, Gaza, Palestine.

Iyadoo ay weli jiraan khataro baahsan oo siyaasadeed, ganacsiga adduunka iyo xasilloonida dhaqaale waxay weli wajahayaan cadaadis. article_content:
Ambitious scientific ventures, known as 'moonshots', inspire and drive progress yet often require significant investment and entail risk. Even when projects like the Apollo 11 moon landing do not go as planned, their legacy includes technological breakthroughs applicable well beyond their original scope. For example, NASA’s Apollo program spurred the adoption of integrated circuits, crucial to microchip technology, by purchasing them in large quantities. Companies such as Fairchild Semiconductor—whose founders later established Intel—benefited from NASA’s early support, fueling widespread use of microchips. Federal investment played a foundational role in igniting the computer revolution.

Similarly, GPS technology was pioneered by the U.S. military but remained restricted until the 1983 downing of a Korean Air Lines flight by the Soviet Union. Following this, the Reagan administration permitted civilian use to enhance flight safety, and the technology was fully opened to commercial use after the Cold War, sparking a wave of innovation.

The Human Genome Project illustrates government leadership in science. From 1990 to 2003, the federal government invested $3.8 billion in this initiative. The project’s breakthroughs enabled personal DNA sequencing for less than $1,000 and, according to Battelle Memorial Institute, generated economic benefits approaching $800 billion between 1988 and 2010, including over 310,000 jobs in 2010 alone.

However, National Science Foundation data indicate that U.S. federal funding for research and development has only just kept up with inflation recently. As mandatory programs such as Social Security remain protected, science—classified as discretionary spending—often faces cuts. Meanwhile, global competitors like China are dramatically increasing their investment in research and development and are projected to surpass the U.S. in research spending as a portion of GDP in the near future.

Support for fundamental research was once a unifying cause in U.S. politics. President Ronald Reagan remarked in 1988 that, despite lacking immediate practical goals, basic research yields highly practical outcomes and represents one of the most important governmental investments. He encouraged Congress to increase scientific funding, calling it essential for America's future.

Moonshot initiatives both inspire and secure America's advancement. Continued commitment to funding science, research, and development is critical for sustaining national leadership and fostering the next era of innovation.

Mashruucyada waaweyn ee sayniska, kuwaas oo loo yaqaan 'moonshots', waa kuwo dhiirrigelin leh oo keena horumar, balse waxay u baahan yihiin maalgelin weyn iyo halis qaadasho. Xitaa haddii mashaariicda ay la midka yihiin Apollo 11 aysan u hirgelin sidii la rabay, haddana waxa ay reebaan dhaxal taariikhi ah oo keena horumarro tiknoolaji ah oo aad uga ballaaran intii hore lagula xisaabtamayey. Tusaale ahaan, barnaamijka Apollo ee NASA wuxuu sare u qaaday isticmaalka cirbadaha isku dhafan (integrated circuits) isagoo si ballaaran u iibsaday, taas oo muhiim u noqotay horumarka 'microchip'-ka. Shirkado sida Fairchild Semiconductor—oo aasaasayaasheedu markii dambe dhiseen shirkadda Intel—ayaa ka faa'iidaystay taageeradii hore ee NASA, taas oo sahashay in 'microchip'-yadu ku faafo adduunka. Maalgelinta dowladda ayaa gundhig u ahayd kacaanka kumbuyuutarka.

Sidoo kale, tiknoolajiyada GPS waxay asal ahaan ka timid milatariga Mareykanka balse waxay xannibnayd ilaa dhacdadii 1983 ee diyaarada Korean Air Lines ay soo rideen Ruushku. Kadib, xukuumaddii Reagan ayaa ogolaatay in la isticmaalo GPS-ka duulimaadyada rayidka si loo kordhiyo badbaadada, waxaana tiknoolajiyadaas la siidaayay si buuxda kadib Dagaalkii Qaboobaa taasoo dhalisay horumar tiknoolajiyeed oo weyn.

Mashruuca Khariidaynta Hidda-sidaha Aadanaha ayaa tusaale u ah doorka dowladda ee hormarinta sayniska. Intii u dhaxaysay 1990 ilaa 2003, dawladda Mareykanka waxa ay gelisay $3.8 bilyan mashruucaas. Guulihii la gaarayna waxay suurto gelisay in qofku iska baaro hiddo-sidaha kaliya $1,000 gudahood. Battelle Memorial Institute ayaa sheegtay in mashruucaas uu keenay faa'iido dhaqaale oo ku dhow $800 bilyan intii u dhaxaysay 1988 ilaa 2010, taas oo keenay abuurista in ka badan 310,000 shaqo sanadkii 2010 keligiis.

Si kastaba, xogta National Science Foundation waxay muujinaysaa in maalgelinta cilmi-baarista ee dowladda Mareykanka ay si dirqi ah ula socotay sicir-bararka tobannaan sano ee la soo dhaafay. Maadaama barnaamijyada waaweyn sida Social Security aysan la kulmin goyn, ayaa cilmibaarista—oo ka mid ah kharashaadka la xakameeyo—wajahaysa cadaadis miisaaniyadeed. Dhinaca kale, waddamada tartamaya sida Shiinaha ayaa si xawli ah u kordhinaya maalgelinta cilmibaarista, waxaana la filayaa inay dhaafaan Mareykanka marka la eego maalgelinta cilmibaarista ee GDP-da dhowr sano gudahood.

Taageerada cilmibaarista aasaasiga ah waxa ay mar ahaan jirtay qodob mideeya siyaasiyiinta Mareykanka. Madaxweyne Ronald Reagan ayaa 1988 sheegay in cilmi-baaristu, in kastoo ay bilowgiisu uusan lahayn ujeedo deg deg ah, ay ugu dambeyntii noqoto mid aad loo isticmaalo oo faa'iido weyn leh. Wuxuu ugu baaqay Congress-ka in la kordhiyo maalgelinta sayniska, isagoo ku tilmaamay inay tahay maalgelin lama huraan u ah mustaqbalka Mareykanka.

Mashruucyada moonshot-ka ah waxay dhiirrigeliyaan dadka oo sidoo kalana keena horumar muhiim ah. Sii wadista maalgelinta sayniska, cilmibaarista, iyo horumarka waa furaha sii haynta hogaaminta qaranka iyo hal-abuurka mustaqbalka.

YouTube faces the threat of a $1 billion lawsuit after being told to remove 20,000 videos by artists including Pharrell Williams and The Eagles. The complaint, led by Irving Azoff and his company Global Music Rights (GMR), represents about 40 high-profile musicians. Azoff claims YouTube does not have the proper performance rights for thousands of songs on its platform. GMR, representing artists such as Pharrell Williams and John Lennon, is demanding the removal of these songs.

According to the Hollywood Reporter, many of these songs—performed by John Lennon, Smokey Robinson, and Chris Cornell, among others—were previously managed by ASCAP and BMI. Azoff says that while YouTube may have deals with record labels, it has not secured rights from the artists or their agencies. He told the Hollywood Reporter that his clients are going after YouTube, rather than other video sites, because YouTube has been 'the least cooperative' and is 'the worst offender' regarding rights issues.

YouTube claims it has the necessary public performance rights through existing agreements but has not issued a public statement on the matter. This dispute reignites debate over musicians' digital rights as Google prepares to launch its own subscription music service. The Eagles are also among the artists represented by Azoff and GMR.

Cabashada waxaa hoggaaminaya Irving Azoff iyo shirkaddiisa Global Music Rights (GMR), oo mataleysa ku dhowaad 40 fannaan oo caan ah. Azoff wuxuu sheegay in YouTube aysan heysan xuquuqda bandhigga ee heeso badan oo ku jira mareegtooda. GMR, oo matasha fanaaniinta sida Pharrell Williams iyo John Lennon, ayaa dalbanaya in la tirtiro heesahan.

Sida uu qoray Hollywood Reporter, heesahan badan—oo ay qaadeen John Lennon, Smokey Robinson, Chris Cornell, iyo fanaaniin kale—waxay markii hore la socdeen ASCAP iyo BMI. Azoff wuxuu sheegay, in kasta oo YouTube ay heshiis la gashay shirkadaha duubista, aysan la gelin heshiis fanaaniinta ama xafiisyadooda.
