article_content: Senator John McCain has paid an emotional tribute to Colonel George 'Bud' Day, a legendary Vietnam War veteran and his former fellow prisoner of war, who passed away on Saturday at the age of 88 in Shalimar, Florida. McCain recalled how Colonel Day, who survived more than five and a half years as a POW—part of it alongside McCain in North Vietnam’s notorious 'Hanoi Hilton'—played a crucial role in his survival and recovery. 'He ordered me back to life,' McCain said in a heartfelt Senate address, envisioning a reunion with Day in the afterlife, hunting in the Iowa cornfields. Both men, after being shot down and captured in 1967, endured severe hardships during their imprisonment. Colonel Day, described as a fierce resister, showed McCain how to maintain his self-respect and honor through adversity. Together with fellow cellmate Major Norris Overly, Day cared for the seriously injured McCain, aiding in his recovery. Over a distinguished 35-year military career, Colonel Day served in World War II, Korea, and Vietnam, accumulating 70 medals—making him one of the most decorated servicemen in U.S. history. His greatest test came during the Vietnam War, where after being shot down and badly injured, Day was captured, managed to escape, and was then recaptured while nearly reaching safety. Despite relentless interrogation, Day never provided valuable information, instead offering only false details. He described his POW years as a defining, proud period of his life. For his actions and extraordinary resilience, Day was awarded the Medal of Honor by President Gerald Ford in 1976. Born February 24, 1925, in Sioux City, Iowa, Day left high school to join the Marines during World War II. After the war, he completed his education and received a law degree before being recalled to service in Korea and later volunteering for duty in Vietnam. After retiring in 1977, Day practiced law in Florida and actively supported McCain’s presidential campaigns. Colonel Day is survived by his wife, four children, and fourteen grandchildren. McCain described him as 'my friend, my leader, my inspiration.'

article_content: ATLANTA — Georgia residents will continue paying no state taxes on gasoline and diesel until at least November 29, after Governor Brian Kemp extended the fuel tax suspension. The rollback reduces gasoline by 31.2 cents per gallon and diesel by 35 cents per gallon. Georgia law allows the governor to suspend fuel taxes during emergencies if lawmakers approve at their next session. Originally, the legislative session was set for January 8, but a special session will now begin November 29 to address redistricting after a federal court ruled some districts diluted the voting power of Black residents. It is still unclear whether Kemp will ask legislators to extend the tax break during the session. Alternatively, he could declare another emergency to continue the waiver until January. Spokesperson Garrison Douglas said there is no information yet about Kemp’s plans. This current tax suspension is similar to Kemp’s 2022 reelection strategy, which saw bipartisan support. Since then, seven extensions have been enacted. From March 2022 to January 2023, the state gave up about $1.7 billion in revenue. In September, Kemp reinstated the suspension due to high fuel prices. In 2022, the suspensions responded to COVID-19 emergencies. Kemp claims that this helps Georgians cope with inflation, which he attributes to President Biden’s administration, although many economists believe such relief can also increase inflation. Kemp stated, “Thanks to our responsible approach to budgeting, we’re able to deliver relief to families coping with the effects of Bidenomics. I’m proud this action has kept millions of dollars in Georgians’ pockets, especially as Thanksgiving approaches.” Fuel tax relief represents about $180 million per month, while Georgia’s tax collections are declining—a potential sign of a slowing economy. In October, tax revenues fell by about 3%, even with some fuel taxes still being collected. Fuel taxes primarily fund road construction. Despite revenue declines, Georgia is likely to end the year with a surplus unless there is a sharper economic downturn or more tax giveaways. Kemp set the spending ceiling more than $5 billion below last year’s $37.7 billion total. Georgia’s rainy day fund is full, and the state has $11 billion in surplus cash. On Tuesday, Georgia drivers paid an average of $2.89 for a gallon of unleaded—the nation’s second-lowest price behind Texas, down 68 cents since Kemp's suspension. The national average is $3.41, down 43 cents per gallon over the same period. Prices also include a federal gas tax of 18.4 cents per gallon and 24.4 cents per gallon for diesel.

Carol J. Geffner, president of CB Vision and author of Building a New Leadership Ladder, is a respected coach and consultant. She notes that while leaders who spend time on the ground with their teams can build relationships and improve communication, too much involvement in everyday details—the so-called 'weeds'—can distract from essential strategic priorities.

Being 'in the weeds' refers to getting caught up in urgent, minor details and operational issues, often at the expense of larger leadership responsibilities. Such entanglement tends to arise when team members are hesitant to make decisions, avoid accountability, or lack clear direction. For example, when an air conditioner breaks down in the office and an executive manager personally arranges the repairs, this can undermine both time management and employees’ autonomy.

To avoid this, leaders should reflect on why they gravitate toward these tasks. Is it due to a lack of trust in the team, anxiety about issues slipping through the cracks, or structural gaps in accountability? Sometimes, it could even be a primary means of relationship-building. Whatever the reason, ongoing involvement in day-to-day matters can hinder a leader’s effectiveness.

It's important for leaders to establish clear boundaries, such as designating specific team interaction times and setting aside focused blocks for strategic work and self-care. Regular delegation is also essential. Without it, leaders risk staying bogged down in routine matters and missing opportunities to promote accountability and distributed leadership among their teams.

Jesse Sostrin, director at PwC’s Leadership Coaching Center of Excellence, emphasizes in a Harvard Business Review article that effective leadership involves being 'more essential and less involved.' Being busy does not necessarily mean being productive.

Finally, leaders should set and track clear goals that align with their organization’s strategic direction. Defining success and measuring progress helps focus efforts on high-impact outcomes and contributes to a workplace where all team members can thrive.

Forbes Coaches Council is an invitation-only community for leading business and career coaches.

'In the weeds' waxay ka dhigan tahay in hoggaamiyuhu uu ku maqnaado arrimo degdeg ah ama faahfaahin yar-yar halkii uu ka eegi lahaa masuuliyadaha waaweyn ee hoggaaminta. article_content: Super Mario Bros. Wonder is designed with players of all ages in mind, delivering exciting levels that everyone can enjoy. For those seeking a greater challenge, the game offers the Special World—a set of more difficult stages accessible only by finding hidden entrances throughout the game. Accessing these Special World levels requires exploration and completing certain objectives. Here is how to unlock the entrances in each area: - Pipe-Rock Plateau: To reach the Special World here, locate the secret exit in the 'Bulrush Express' level. Use an Elephant Fruit at the end of the stage to open a new path. Once you've exited, continue up the mountain by completing the next levels until you arrive at the entrance atop the peak. - Fluff-Puff Peaks: Progress through the levels on the far right side of the clouds. After clearing them, you'll unlock the Special World entrance at the end. - Shining Falls: Complete the world to earn the Royal Seed. Then, revisit the Royal Seed Mansion where a new event opens a path to the Special World. - Sunbaked Desert: Move to the right side of the desert's main structure and repair a bridge using Flower Coins. This opens a sequence of levels, starting with 'Secrets of Shova Mansion,' ultimately leading to the Special World entrance. - Fungi Mine: Finish the world and obtain the Royal Seed, then return to Operation Poplin Rescue. A new cutscene will reveal the next entrypoint for the Special World. - Deep Mountain Bog: Head to the far bottom-left of the map and clear several levels to the left, beginning with 'Wavy Ride through the Magma Tunnel,' to reach the Special World entrance. - Petal Isle: Complete the 'Spelunking! Wiggler Race' level near the Deep Mountain Bog entrance. Afterwards, a cutscene shows the location of a new Special World entrance. By completing these tasks and finding the secret paths, players can unlock and experience the toughest stages Super Mario Bros. Wonder has to offer.

article_content: A federal judge in New York has ordered that the civil defamation trial between former President Donald Trump and writer E. Jean Carroll will proceed with an anonymous jury. Judge Lewis A. Kaplan issued this decision as a precaution after Trump made repeated public statements about the case and the court. To protect jurors, their identities will remain confidential. During the trial, they will stay together during breaks, receive lunch as a group with a U.S. Marshal Service officer, and be transported to and from the courthouse as a group to undisclosed locations before going home. The trial is set for January and focuses on defamation. Carroll, a former Elle magazine columnist, brought her case in November 2019 after Trump publicly denied her allegation of rape, claimed she was motivated by improper reasons such as promoting her book, and said she was not his type. Trump denies the accusations. The judge has already ruled that Trump’s statements were defamatory. The upcoming trial will determine the amount of financial damages Carroll may receive; she seeks $10 million. Previously, in May, Carroll won a separate lawsuit alleging battery and defamation, resulting in a $5 million award—currently under appeal by Trump. Judge Kaplan’s order for anonymous jurors arrived the same day as new developments in Trump’s other New York legal cases, including changes to gag orders.

article_content: TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew will travel to Brussels next week to meet with key European Union officials, the company said on Friday. Chew is set to meet EU industry chief Thierry Breton on November 6, followed by meetings with EU digital chief Vera Jourova and EU antitrust chief Didier Reynders on November 7. This marks Chew’s second visit to Brussels and comes as TikTok faces heightened regulatory scrutiny over its handling of disinformation, particularly after the recent Hamas attack on Israel and the ensuing conflict in Gaza. In other technology news: India's leading telecom companies have accused global tech firms, including Microsoft and Amazon, of circumventing legal telecom protocols by using platforms like WhatsApp to send enterprise messages to customers, allegedly resulting in considerable revenue losses for both the government and telecom operators. The Indian government has requested that Apple join an investigation into alleged state-sponsored hacking attempts targeting iPhones owned by prominent Indian individuals, including several opposition lawmakers. Furthermore, India's Directorate General of Civil Aviation has informed the Delhi High Court that Go First’s leased aircraft and engines can be deregistered and returned to lessors, severely affecting the struggling airline's chances for recovery.

article_content:
Where are the best places to travel in the world? For many, the excitement of exploring new destinations keeps their travel bucket list ever-growing. Recently, British travel company Kuoni conducted a study to determine the world’s top bucket list destinations, analyzing Google search data for 119 iconic places across 219 countries. This revealed travel dreams stretching from the serene Maldives to the powerful Niagara Falls, encompassing famous landmarks and natural wonders.

According to Sheena Paton, Kuoni’s senior program manager, “This is the first time we’ve ranked every country’s favorite must-see destination. Our earlier reports analyzed demand for specific places, but this is unique in revealing what travelers in each country dream about most.”

At the top of the global bucket list is the Maldives—a group of islands renowned for white sands, turquoise waters, and incredible sunsets. It was the number one dream trip for travelers from 121 countries. “It’s wonderful to see so many people consider the Maldives a dream destination,” says Paton. “Its appeal spans from honeymooners to retirees—truly a tropical paradise.”

Second is Niagara Falls, the dramatic natural wonder on the USA–Canada border. Millions wish to witness its thundering waters up-close. “Experiencing Niagara Falls is an unforgettable moment,” Paton adds.

Third is viewing the Mona Lisa at the Louvre in Paris, an iconic artwork by Leonardo da Vinci that attracts visitors from around the globe. “People worldwide are drawn to the Mona Lisa’s enigmatic smile,” Paton notes.

The United States features most often in the top 20, including Niagara Falls, climbing the Statue of Liberty, seeing Times Square, visiting Alcatraz, touring the White House, and exploring Yosemite National Park. Paton comments, “America offers a huge variety of travel experiences, from natural wonders to city landmarks.”

Whether you’re an explorer adding to your list or planning a once-in-a-lifetime adventure, know that these top 20 destinations are just the start—travel dreams only grow with every journey.

Travel Bucket List: Top 20 Destinations
1. Maldives – Overwater bungalows, clear waters, and vibrant marine life.
2. Niagara Falls – Majestic waterfalls on the border of the US and Canada.
3. Mona Lisa at the Louvre – Leonardo da Vinci’s world-famous painting in Paris.
4. Bora Bora – Tropical paradise with stunning lagoon and coral reefs.
5. Northern Lights – Best viewed in Iceland, Norway, Sweden, Greenland, or Finland.
6. Stonehenge (UK) – Ancient stone circle shrouded in mystery.
7. Taj Mahal (India) – Symbol of love and architectural brilliance.
8. Times Square (New York) – Iconic hub full of lights and energy.
9. Burj Khalifa (Dubai) – The world’s tallest skyscraper with scenic views.
10. Pompeii (Italy) – Preserved Roman city near Mount Vesuvius.
11. Sagrada Familia (Barcelona) – Gaudí’s spectacular basilica.
12. Cinque Terre (Italy) – Picturesque villages linked by trails and a scenic railway.
13. Big Ben (London) – Famous British clock tower.
14. Chichén Itzá (Mexico) – Ancient Mayan city and pyramid.
15. Annapurna Range (Nepal) – Himalayan trekking adventure.
16. Alcatraz (San Francisco) – Infamous island prison and popular tour.
17. White House (Washington, D.C.) – Seat of US government, open for public tours.
18. Dead Sea (Israel/Jordan) – Floating in mineral-rich waters with health benefits.
19. Yosemite National Park (California, USA) – Waterfalls, sequoias, and grand cliffs.

These destinations reflect a spirit of adventure—embracing natural wonders and remarkable human achievements. For travelers, each new journey is a chance to broaden horizons and keep dreaming.

Goobaha ugu wanaagsan ee lagu safri karo waa kuwama? Dad badan oo safar jecel, xiisaha aagga cusub sahminta ayaa ka dhigaysa liiska safarkooda mid mar walba sii fidaaya. article_content: President Obama's public endorsement of same-sex marriage on May 9, 2012, marked a significant historical moment and spurred a wave of political debate. Following his announcement during an ABC News interview, Obama's reelection campaign saw a sharp increase in donations, with BuzzFeed reporting $1 million raised within 90 minutes. While LGBTQ+ advocates welcomed Obama's statement, Republican leaders quickly criticized the move as a political tactic. Republican National Committee Chairman Reince Priebus accused the President of 'playing politics,' reiterating that their party supports marriage only between a man and a woman. Mitt Romney, the likely Republican nominee, affirmed his own position opposing same-sex marriage during a campaign event in Oklahoma. Major Republican and conservative groups, including the Log Cabin Republicans, criticized both the timing and sincerity of Obama's announcement. Obama reflected that his stance had evolved, influenced by discussions with his daughters Malia and Sasha and their friends' families. He emphasized that for young people, equal treatment of same-sex couples was simply logical. Obama maintained he believed the definition of marriage should ultimately be left to the states. At the time of the announcement, six states allowed same-sex marriage while 30 states had enacted constitutional bans. The day prior, North Carolina voters had passed Amendment 1, a measure banning same-sex marriage and prohibiting civil or domestic partnership benefits for gay couples. Obama had faced increasing pressure to clarify his views after Vice President Joe Biden publicly expressed support for same-sex marriage. Obama described his personal journey, noting previous hesitations based on his religious background, but now expressing support for marriage equality. Recent polls showed the nation was divided, with about 50% in support of same-sex marriage and 45% opposed, many with strong convictions. Obama acknowledged the generational divide and expressed hope this issue would mobilize young voters. Republican House Speaker John Boehner said Congress should focus on the economy, while pointing out his personal belief that marriage is between a man and woman. The topic continued to generate national discussion about civil rights, politics, and changing public opinion.

article_content: Scientists are expressing concern about the current flu season, according to the Director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). This follows the CDC's recent advisory indicating that this year's flu vaccine is less effective because the main flu strain has mutated. Dr. Tom Frieden, CDC Director, warned that this mutated strain could lead to a more severe flu season, with increased hospitalizations and deaths. The CDC's advisory noted that 52% of the 85 influenza virus samples collected between October 1 and November 22 differed from the strains included in this year's vaccine, indicating a significant mutation, or 'drift'. The dominant strain this season is influenza A (H3N2), which has previously been associated with higher rates of hospitalization and death, particularly among high-risk groups such as the very young, the elderly, and people with chronic health conditions like asthma or heart disease. Each year, a panel of experts selects three strains to include in the vaccine based on global data, but some years the match is better than others. This year, it is too late to create a new vaccine, as the process typically takes about four months. Even though this season's vaccine is less protective against the mutated strain, it can still reduce the severity of illness and protect against other circulating strains. Therefore, the CDC continues to recommend vaccination. Dr. Lisa Thebner, a pediatrician from New York City, emphasized that while the flu vaccine isn't perfect, it's the best preventive measure available. She added that people should always be concerned about the flu. Dr. Frieden also stressed the importance of starting antiviral medications promptly at the first sign of flu symptoms — such as fever, sore throat, cough, or body aches. Medications like Tamiflu and Relenza are most effective when taken early but are underused: fewer than 1 in 6 severely ill patients receive them. Antiviral medications can lessen symptoms, shorten illness duration, and may help keep people out of the hospital. To date, five children in the United States have died from the flu this year, though their vaccination status was not disclosed. Historically, 98% of children who died from flu were unvaccinated. During the 2012-2013 flu season, 12,337 people were hospitalized and 149 children died from flu-related illness, with 90% of pediatric deaths involving unvaccinated children. Currently, flu activity across the country remains low, according to the latest CDC data.
translated_content: Saynisyahannadu waxay muujinayaan walaac ku saabsan xilligan hargabka, sida uu sheegay Agaasimaha Xarunta Xakamaynta Iyo Ka Hortagga Cudurrada (CDC). Tani waxay timid ka dib digniin ay soo saartay CDC taas oo sheegtay in tallaalka hargabka ee sanadkan uusan si fiican u shaqaynayn sababtoo ah cudurku wuu isbeddelay. Dr. Tom Frieden, Agaasimaha CDC, wuxuu sheegay in isbeddelkan cusub ee fayraska uu sababi karo xilli hargab oo ka daran intii hore, iyadoo ay kordhayaan dadka la dhigo isbitaalka iyo dhimashada. Warbixinta CDC waxay xustay in 52% 85-tii muunad ee fayraska hargabka ah ee la ururiyey intii u dhaxaysay Oktoobar 1 iyo Nofeembar 22 ay ka duwan yihiin fayrasyada lagu daray tallaalka sanadkan, taasoo muujinaysa in fayrasku isbeddelay (ama drift). Nooca ugu badan ee fayraska sanadkan waa influenza A (H3N2), kaasoo horey loola xiriiriyey in uu sababo qof badan oo la dhigo isbitaalka iyo dhimasho, gaar ahaan kooxaha halista ugu jira sida carruurta aadka u yar, dadka waayeelka ah, iyo dadka qaba cudurrada raaga sida neefta ama xanuunka wadnaha. Sanad walba, guddiga khubarada ayaa doorta saddex nooc oo fayraska ah in lagu daro tallaalka iyadoo la eegayo xogaha caalamiga ah, balse mararka qaar iswaafajinta wey fiicantahay mararka qaarna ma fiicna. Sanadkan, waa goor dambe in la sameeyo tallaal cusub maxaa yeelay waxay qaadanaysaa abuuristiisu afar bilood. In kastoo tallaalka sanadkan aan si fiican uga difaacin isbeddelka cusub, hadana wuxuu yareyn karaa darnaanta xanuunka wuxuuna difaac ka yahay fayrasyada kale ee wareegaya. Sidaas darteed, CDC weli waxay kula talinaysaa in la is tallaalo. Dr. Lisa Thebner, dhakhtar carruur ah oo jooga New York City, waxay xustay in inkastoo tallaalku aanu qumaneen, hadana waa difaaca ugu fiican ee hargabka laga helo. Waxay ku dartay in dadka mar walba ay tahay inay ka digtoonaadaan hargabka. Dr. Frieden wuxuu sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ah in la bilaabo isticmaalka daawooyinka antiviral marka astaamaha hargabka ugu horeeya la arko — sida qandho, cun xanuun, qufac, iyo xanuunada jirka. Daawooyinka sida Tamiflu iyo Relenza waxay si fiican u shaqeeyaan marka la qaato goor hore, balse si yar ayaa loo isticmaalaa: wax ka yar 1 qof 6-dii qof ee xanuunka daran qaba ayaa hela. Daawooyinka antiviral-ka waxay yareyn karaan astaamaha, waxayna soo gaabin karaan muddada xanuunka, sidoo kalena waxay ka ilaalin karaan dadka in isbitaal loo dhigo. Ilaa hadda, shan carruur ah ayaa sanadkan hargabka ugu dhimatay Mareykanka, lamana caddayn in la tallaalay iyo in kale. Taariikh ahaan, 98% carruurta hargabka u dhimatay ma aysan qaadan tallaalka. Xilligii hargabka ee 2012-2013, 12,337 qof ayaa la dhigay isbitaal la xiriirta hargabka, waxaana u geeriyooday 149 carruur ah. 90% dhimashadaas carruurta ah waxay ahaayeen kuwo aan la tallaalin. Hadda, heerka hargabka guud ahaan dalka waa hooseeyaa, sida ay muujinayso xogta ugu dambeysa ee CDC.

article_content: McDonald's has partnered with Crocs to release a special collection of footwear. The line includes clogs and sandals inspired by McDonald's characters like Grimace, Hamburglar, and Birdie, plus the brand's well-known red and yellow colors. Fans can customize their Crocs with themed charms featuring McDonald's staples such as french fries, the Big Mac, and the Golden Arches. The new footwear collection will be available starting November 14, 2023, with prices set between $70 and $75, and matching socks for $20. McDonald's and Crocs have both invited fans to follow their social media channels for updates; the collection launches at noon Central Time. This marks another fashion collaboration for McDonald's, following an earlier limited edition release with British brand PALACE. Crocs has also previously collaborated with Shrek and Pixar's Lightning McQueen. Molly McKenna, a senior director at McDonald's, noted that both companies have passionate followers and a strong presence in pop culture, making this collaboration significant. As of 2021, McDonald's is the largest fast-food chain globally, operating over 40,000 outlets and serving around 69 million people daily.

Taageerayaasha waxay kabohooda Crocs ku qurxin karaan bilado gaar ah oo temayaal ka sameysan, sida french fries, Big Mac, iyo astaanta Golden Arches. article_content: BREMEN, Germany – Carlos Alberto, who scored in FC Porto’s Champions League final victory against Monaco in 2004, has joined Bundesliga club Werder Bremen for a club-record fee of 7.8 million euros ($10.7 million). Carlos Alberto found success at FC Porto under coach Jose Mourinho. “I’m here to win titles with Werder,” the 22-year-old said after his first training session with his new club. “I like Bremen and only wanted to come here.” Carlos Alberto began his career with Fluminense, helping them win the Campeonato Carioca in 2002. In January 2004, he moved to FC Porto, then managed by José Mourinho, where he won both the Portuguese title and the Champions League. Early in 2005, he transferred to Corinthians, impressing as they won the Brasileirão, but in 2006 the club had a poor season and Carlos Alberto had disagreements with manager Emerson Leão. Their strained relationship culminated during a Copa Sul-Americana match against Club Atlético Lanús, after which Carlos Alberto announced he would no longer play for Corinthians as long as Leão was manager. Since January this year, he has been on loan at his former club Fluminense. Bundesliga champions VfB Stuttgart said Sunday they would sign a loan agreement with Real Zaragoza on Monday for Ewerthon, making him the third Brazilian player to join the German league in three days. A VfB spokesperson said Ewerthon, who previously played in the Bundesliga for Borussia Dortmund from 2001 to 2005, is expected to join the club for pre-season training in Austria on Monday. On Friday, Ailton returned to Germany, where he was the league’s top scorer in 2004, signing a one-year deal with Duisburg after a transfer from Red Star Belgrade.

article_content: UK financial regulators have come under intense scrutiny for approving the appointment of Rev Paul Flowers—a man without banking experience and known to struggle with drug addiction—as chairman of the Co-operative Bank. Parliament members have criticized this approval process, calling it a shallow, check-box exercise lacking genuine oversight. Flowers is being investigated by police after reportedly being caught on camera buying illegal drugs such as crack cocaine and crystal meth. The Labour Party, including its leader Ed Miliband, is facing tough questions about their connection to Flowers, who had served as a business adviser. In response to the unfolding controversy, the Co-operative Bank has launched a comprehensive internal review. Flowers, also a Methodist minister, has been suspended both from his church and the Labour Party—particularly following revelations of large donations made to the Shadow Chancellor Ed Balls. Andrew Tyrie, chair of the Treasury Select Committee, labeled Flowers’ appointment as obviously unsuitable, calling for stricter, ongoing scrutiny of senior bankers. It came to light that Flowers was only vetted when joining the board, but not when being promoted to chairman in 2010. He resigned his post earlier this year when the bank’s financial troubles threatened the pensions of thousands. Amid the scandal, the Bank of England was forced to clarify that Deputy Governor Andrew Bailey did not approve Flowers’ appointment and had not joined the Financial Services Authority until after Flowers took on the chairman role. Other MPs stressed that Flowers’ lack of qualification was apparent and suggested that political considerations influenced his appointment within the Co-op. Flowers, 63, has apologized publicly for his actions and the damage caused.

Xildhibaanadu waxay dhaliileen habka ogolaanshaha, iyagoo ku tilmaamay mid aan lahayn kormeer dhab ah, oo wax badan lagu soo koobay kaliya calaamadaynta foomamka. Flowers waxaa baaraya booliska kadib markii la sheegay in lagu qabtay muuqaal isagoo iibsanaya daroogooyin sida crack cocaine iyo crystal meth. Xisbiga Labour, oo uu hoggaaminayo Ed Miliband, ayaa la waydiinayaa su'aalo adag oo ku saabsan xirirkooda Flowers, kaasoo horey uga tirsanaa la-taliye ganacsi. Bangiga Co-operative ayaa bilaabay baaris buuxda si loo milicsado wixii dhacay. Flowers—oo sidoo kale ah wadaad Methodist ah—wuxuu lagu ganaaxay joojinta xubinnimada Labada Kaniisadda iyo Xisbiga Labour, gaar ahaan kadib markii la ogaaday deeqo lacageed oo waaweyn oo lagu sameeyay Ed Balls. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Xisaabaadka ee Golaha Baarlamaanka, Andrew Tyrie, wuxuu ku tilmaamay magacaabista Flowers mid si cad aan habooneyn, isagoo ugu baaqay kormeer joogto ah oo adag oo lagu sameeyo madaxda sare ee bangiyada. Waxaa soo baxday in Flowers la kormeeray kaliya markii uu ku biiray guddiga, balse aan dib loo eegin marki loo dallacsiiyay guddoomiye 2010. Wuxuu is casilay sannadkan markii mushkilado dhaqaale oo uu Bankigu galay ay halis u keeneen lacagta howlgabnimada kumannaan qof. Markay fadeexaddu soo baxday, Bangiga England ayaa sheegay in Andrew Bailey—Ku-xigeenka Guddoomiyaha—uusan qayb ka ahayn ansixinta Flowers, isagoo caddeeyay in Bailey uu FSA ku biiray kadib markii Flowers loo magacaabay guddoomiye. Flowers, 63 jir, wuxuu si fagaare ah raaligelin uga bixiyay falalkiisii iyo khasaarihii dhacay.

article_content: Australian authorities are urging motorists to avoid using Apple Maps when traveling to Mildura due to a dangerous error. The mapping app misplaces Mildura, a city of 30,000 people, over 40 miles (70 kilometers) away, deep in Murray-Sunset National Park. Police have labeled this a potentially life-threatening issue, as motorists have become stranded in the park’s harsh environment—where temperatures can reach 46°C (114°F) and no water supply is available. Some drivers have been rescued after going up to 24 hours without food or water, forced to trek long distances for phone reception. Authorities have contacted Apple and advise travelers to use other navigation options until the problem is fixed. Apple declined to comment directly on the police report but said they are working to improve Maps. By contrast, services like Google Maps correctly locate Mildura. Since Apple Maps replaced Google Maps with the release of iOS 6 in September, the app has faced widespread criticism. Apple CEO Tim Cook apologized for the problems, assuring customers that improvements are underway. Reports indicate former Apple executive Scott Forstall left the company after an internal dispute over apologizing for the Maps issues. Apple told CNN it does not comment on speculation.

article_content: The Edo State Government Secretariat was closed on Tuesday following a strike by the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC). The closure was supervised by Odion Olaye, Chairman of the NLC Edo State Council, to ensure members complied with the directive to begin the strike. Olaye said he had assigned members to monitor schools, airports, petrol stations, and the Nigeria Petroleum Development Corporation (NPDC) to enforce the shutdown. He stated, “We are fully complying with the strike. I have sent people to various institutions to ensure compliance. I will provide further details as I receive feedback.” When The PUNCH visited Benin Airport, airport officials confirmed flights had landed and departed on Tuesday, with travelers proceeding to different destinations. Banks along Akpapava Road, Mission Road, Forestry Road, and other areas were also closed. Customers were seen queuing at the few ATMs still dispensing cash. Public schools in the Government Reserved Area (GRA) were also shut, and students were seen loitering outside the premises. A security officer at NPDC said only essential staff were allowed access during the strike. The strike action led to widespread shutdowns across various sectors, with ongoing monitoring by the NLC to ensure compliance.

article_content: Elizabeth Arden has reported a significant 28% drop in revenue, largely attributed to declining sales of celebrity fragrances, particularly those by Justin Bieber and Taylor Swift. The slump in fragrance sales led to a 25% drop in the company's share price and resulted in a quarterly pre-tax loss of £48 million, marking the worst financial period in the company's 104-year history. Once a booming market, celebrity fragrances now face oversaturation and decreasing demand. Justin Bieber, who by age 20 had launched three perfumes—Someday (2011), Girlfriend (2012), and The Key (2013)—saw his latest fragrance underperform, possibly influenced by his recent legal issues and shifting public perception. Similarly, Taylor Swift's scents, Wonderstruck and Wonderstruck Enchanted, have also underperformed despite being affordably priced in the UK. Elizabeth Arden owns additional celebrity fragrance lines, including those from Britney Spears, Jennifer Aniston, Mariah Carey, and Nicki Minaj. To address the financial downturn, the company is cutting 175 jobs and acknowledged that about half of its losses stemmed from underperforming celebrity fragrances. The company stated, 'The decline in sales of celebrity fragrances, particularly the Justin Bieber and Taylor Swift fragrances, was steeper than anticipated.' The market sees more than 500 new celebrity perfumes launched annually, dating back to the successful debut of Elizabeth Taylor's White Diamonds in 1991. Notably, in 2011, Justin Bieber's Someday became America's top-selling perfume, with a bottle sold every minute during its first week. However, the market's current saturation and changing consumer preferences have contributed to the downturn. Other celebrities with fragrance lines include the Beckhams, Madonna, Kylie Minogue, One Direction, and several reality television personalities. Perfume sales account for 75% of Elizabeth Arden's revenue, a stark contrast to competitors like Estée Lauder, which focuses more on cosmetics.

Hoos u dhacaas ayaa kaloo sababay in qiimaha saamiyada shirkadda uu hoos u dhaco 25%, iyadoo sidoo kale lasoo sheegay khasaare dhan £48 milyan oo ah kii ugu xumaa ee shirkaddu la kulanto 104 sano ee ay jirtay. article_content: While most people use a bridge to cross from one side to another, a group of skilled gymnasts took a different approach. In a remarkable video filmed in the French countryside, these athletes perform challenging routines while hanging from a large bridge. They showcase their agility, strength, and flexibility as they execute impressive tricks on rings suspended over the water. Throughout the two-minute and nine-second video, the gymnasts perform a variety of Olympic-style moves and demonstrations. The participants secure ropes and rings to the bridge and prepare to display their impressive abilities, all set to the backdrop of the Dropkick Murphys song 'I'm Shipping Up To Boston.' In the video, one gymnast powders his hands before he and his teammates swing from the rings and ropes, performing daring stunts over the water. Another gymnast gestures playfully, spinning his finger near his head, before a colleague somersaults backwards off the bridge. The performance is filled with dynamic swinging, circling, transitions, and release moves. Highlights include a gymnast swinging from rings, another hanging upside down from the bridge, two gymnasts spinning together, and others demonstrating remarkable control as they descend toward the water.

Muuqaal cajiib ah oo laga duubay baadiyaha Faransiiska, ciyaartoydani waxay ku sameeyaan jimicsiyo adag iyagoo ka laadlaadsan buundo weyn. article_content: A mother who refused to pay a fine for taking her son out of school during term time for her Caribbean wedding was ordered by a court to pay £280. Frances Harden, 31, was found in violation of truancy laws after her teenage son, Harrison Thorpe, missed 11 days of school to walk his mother down the aisle. She had organized her wedding to Nick Harden, 34, in an £8,000 ceremony at a four-star hotel in St Lucia, expecting the event to occur during that year's Easter holidays. However, the 2012 Easter holidays fell two weeks earlier than she anticipated. When Mrs. Harden realized the dates did not match, Dr. Rose Hegan, headmistress of Marple Hall School in Stockport, Greater Manchester, refused permission for Harrison to be absent. Despite the refusal, Mrs. Harden took Harrison out of school and later pleaded guilty under Section 444 of the 1996 Education Act after declining to pay a £50 fixed penalty. She was fined £100, with an additional £165 in prosecution costs and a £15 victim surcharge. Magistrate Alf Storey noted that while Harrison's overall attendance was good, the absence occurred during term time and began after an existing holiday period. Storey commented that the couple had ample time to plan their wedding and holiday within designated school breaks. Mrs. Harden expressed frustration at perceived inconsistencies in granting term-time leave, stating her younger son Alex, six, was allowed out of his primary school for the same purpose. She also submitted a Freedom of Information request to Stockport Council, asking how many pupils had been given term-time leave since 2010. Following the hearing, Mrs. Harden said she would continue challenging the current policy. Mrs. Harden, a care assistant, said the decision regarding holidays should be made by an independent party, as opposed to the headteacher, given the subjectivity involved. She noted that at the time, another student was out of school in Turkey, yet Harrison's case was denied. Mrs. Harden brought school reports and attendance records to court, highlighting Harrison's academic progress. She argued that consistent attendance policies are needed and that Harrison's education had not suffered; his grades even improved after the absence. Mr. Hamza Soren, prosecuting for Stockport Council, stated the case was due to an unauthorized term-time absence and that prosecution is a last resort to prevent harm to a child's education. He added there are thirteen weeks of school holidays in a year for attending special occasions and exceptions are generally made for serious health or family reasons.

Waxay sheegtay in waqtiga la hadlayo, arday kale uu ku maqan yahay Turkey, balse kiiskooda la diiday. article_content: Authorities are seeking video footage to clarify events leading up to a fatal altercation at an Israel-Hamas war protest in California this weekend, amid conflicting witness reports, according to the sheriff. Paul Kessler, a 69-year-old Jewish man, died from blunt-force head trauma following a confrontation with a counterprotester on Sunday during simultaneous pro-Israel and pro-Palestinian demonstrations in Thousand Oaks, the Ventura County Sheriff's Office reported. The Ventura County Medical Examiner's Office stated that Kessler suffered skull fractures, swelling, and bruising of his brain, and ruled his death a homicide. Ventura County Sheriff Jim Fryhoff said Tuesday that authorities have not ruled out the possibility of a hate crime. Deputies determined Kessler fell backwards and hit his head, but conflicting witness reports about the altercation and 'who the aggressor was' have been received from those at both rallies. Sheriff Fryhoff explained that 'what exactly transpired prior to Mr. Kessler falling backwards isn't clear right now,' and said the investigation remains ongoing. Multiple callers reported an incident of battery at the intersection of Westlake Boulevard and Thousand Oaks Boulevard on Sunday afternoon, where the demonstrations were taking place, with 75 to 100 people present. Among the callers was the suspect—a 50-year-old Moorpark resident participating in the pro-Palestinian demonstration—according to Fryhoff. Responding deputies found Kessler bleeding from the head and mouth; he was taken to a hospital for advanced treatment but died early Monday. The suspect remained at the scene, cooperated with authorities, and stated he was involved in the altercation, Fryhoff said. A search warrant was executed at the suspect's home on Monday, but no further details have been released. No arrests have been made and the suspect has not been publicly identified. Chief Medical Examiner Christopher Young clarified that ruling the death a homicide indicates another individual was involved but does not necessarily mean a crime was committed. Fryhoff said available video footage does not clearly capture the interaction between Kessler and the suspect, and the level of interaction remains unclear. The Jewish Federation of Los Angeles issued a statement expressing grief over the 'tragic death of an elderly Jewish man' and calling for safety and an end to violence. Hussam Ayloush, Executive Director of CAIR-LA, also released a statement expressing deep sadness, urging the public not to jump to conclusions, and discouraging sensationalism or rumor-spreading that could heighten tensions. Ayloush encouraged waiting for the investigation's completion before drawing conclusions and affirmed the organization's support for rejecting violence, antisemitism, Islamophobia, or incitement of hatred. ABC News' Marilyn Heck contributed to this report.

Paul Kessler, oo 69 jir Yuhuudi ah, ayaa u dhintay dhaawac madax ah oo xooggan kadib markii uu galay muran uu la yeeshay qof kasoo horjeeday, xilli isla markaana ay socdeen mudaharaadyo pro-Israel iyo pro-Falastiiniyiin ah magaalada Thousand Oaks, sida uu xaqiijiyay xafiiska sheriff-ka Ventura County. Xafiiska baaraha caafimaadka ee Ventura County waxay sheegeen in Kessler uu qabay jab madaxa ah, barar iyo nabarro maskaxda ah, iyadoo lagu tilmaamay geeridiisa dembi-dil (homicide). Taliyaha sheriff-ka Ventura County, Jim Fryhoff, ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in wali aan laga saarin suuragalnimada dambiga naceybka ee dhacdadan. Booliisku waxay go’aamiyeen in Kessler uu gadaal u dhacay kadibna madaxa dhulka ku dhuftay, laakiin warbixinno is khilaafsan ayaa kasoo baxay markhaatiyaasha labada dhinac ee mudaharaadka ku sugnaa ee ku saabsanaa sida dhacdadu u dhacday iyo cidda ahayd 'qofka weerarka bilaabay'. Taliyaha Fryhoff wuxuu sheegay 'in si rasmi ah aysan weli u caddayn waxa dhabta ah ee dhacay ka hor inta Mr. Kessler gadaal ugu dhacay', isagoo xusay in baaristu wali socoto. Dad badan ayaa wacay xarunta isgaarsiinta ee sheriff-ka Ventura County si ay u soo sheegaan dhacdo la xiriirta garaacid ka dhacday isgoyska Westlake Boulevard iyo Thousand Oaks Boulevard galabnimadii Axadda, halkaas oo mudaharaadyadu ka socdeen, iyadoo ay joogeen 75 ilaa 100 qof. Mid ka mid ah dadka wacay 911 wuxuu ahaa tuhmanaha — nin 50 jir ah oo deggan Moorpark kana qaybgalayay mudaharaadka pro-Falastiin, sida uu sheegay Fryhoff. Booliiska yimid goobta waxay heleen Kessler oo madax iyo afka ka dhiigaya; waxaa loola cararay isbitaal si loo siiyo daaweyn degdeg ah balse wuxuu u geeriyooday dhaawacyadii waaberigii Isniinta. Tuhmanaha ayaa goobta joogay, wuxuu la shaqeeyay booliska, wuxuuna qirtay inuu qayb ka ahaa is-muran kaasi, sida uu sheegay Fryhoff. Warrant baadhe ah ayaa laga fuliyay guriga tuhmanaha Isniintii, mana jirto faahfaahin dheeri ah oo la sii daayay xiligan. Ma jiro cid la xiray, tuhmanahana looma shaacin magaciisa dadweynaha. Baare sare ee caafimaadka Christopher Young ayaa caddeeyay in sababta geeridu u noqotay dembi-dil ay tahay qof kale oo lug lahaa, balse tani micnaheedu maahan in dembi la galay. Fryhoff wuxuu sheegay in muuqaalka la heli karo aanu si cad u muujinayn isdhexgalka Kessler iyo tuhmanaha, heerka isdhexgalka ayaa wali lama cadda. Gudiga Yuhuudda ee Los Angeles ayaa soo saaray warbixin ay ku muujinayaan murugo ku saabsan 'geerida naxdinta leh ee nin Yuhuudi ah oo da’ weyn', waxayna baaq u direen ammaanka iyo in la joojiyo rabshadaha. Hussam Ayloush, Agaasimaha Fulinta ee CAIR-LA, ayaa isna soo saaray warsaxaafadeed uu ku muujiyay murugo weyn, isagoo dadka ugu baaqay inaysan ku degdegin go'aan ka gaarista dhacdada, islamarkaana laga fogaado warar xasaasi ah oo xiisadda kicin kara. Ayloush wuxuu ugu baaqay bulshada inay sugto natiijada baaritaanka ka hor inta aysan gaadhin go’aan, wuxuuna xaqiijiyay in hay’addoodu ay si adag u diidan tahay rabshad kasta, nacaybka dadka Yuhuudda, Islaam-nacaybka, ama dhiirrigelinta naxariis la’aanta. Marilyn Heck oo ka socota ABC News ayaa warbixintan wax ku darsatay.

article_content: Fans of the Bored Ape Yacht Club NFTs (non-fungible tokens) are having a difficult year. The prices of the NFT collection have reached their lowest point this year, following a general downturn in the cryptocurrency market. Recently, attendees at ApeFest—a festival organized by Yuga Labs, the company behind Bored Ape—reported experiencing 'eye burn,' severe pain, and vision problems due to intense UV lighting at the event. NFTs like those from the Bored Ape Club collection surged in value during the crypto boom of 2021. Although most of that value has since diminished, there continues to be a sizable crypto enthusiast community. According to The Verge, over 2,500 people attended ApeFest. After the event, many took to social media to report a burning sensation in their eyes and, for some, vision troubles. On Monday, the official Bored Ape Yacht Club account tweeted: 'Apes, we are aware of the eye-related issues that affected some of the attendees of ApeFest and have been proactively reaching out to individuals since yesterday to try and find the potential root causes. Based on our estimates, we believe that much less than 1% of those attending and working the event had these symptoms.' Chloe Ge, an attendee, told the Financial Times she began to feel as if her eyes were 'being burnt with spicy chilli' a while after a party at the event began. She noted a rapper was performing, and the stage lights were 'quite strong.' According to Ge, the symptoms were not immediately apparent but emerged later. Adrian Zduńczyk, another attendee and a crypto analyst, shared on X that he was diagnosed with 'accident-related photokeratitis,' or snow blindness, which is commonly caused by exposure to UV rays. He added that after examination, no serious corneal damage was found.

Dhacdo dhawaan ka dhacday—ApeFest—oo ay soo qabanqaabisay Yuga Labs (shirkadda ka dambeysa Bored Ape), ayaa dadkii kasoo qeyb galay ay sheegeen inay indhahooda la kulmeen 'gubasho,' xanuun daran, iyo dhibaatooyin aragga la xiriira, taas oo sabab u ahayd iftiin UV aad u daran. Bolton manager Neil Lennon is optimistic that his team could surprise Liverpool in their upcoming FA Cup match. Lennon has acknowledged that he adopted some training techniques from Brendan Rodgers, having observed Rodgers’ sessions at Reading in 2009. He still employs some of these methods in his own coaching.

Ahead of the fixture, Lennon commented, "Brendan’s training sessions were excellent and I’ve incorporated a few ideas myself – although he may not realize it."

This match will be the first time Lennon and Rodgers face each other competitively, after only meeting previously in a preseason friendly in Dublin. With £500,000 potentially on the line, the match is crucial for Bolton, who face financial pressures as a Championship club.

Reflecting on his previous underdog experiences at Celtic, Lennon stated that Bolton will take a determined and competitive approach, aiming for more than just the experience of playing at Anfield.

article_content: Tesla, the American electric vehicle leader, is poised to make its debut in India in 2024, with the Prime Minister’s Office directing officials to fast-track Tesla’s investment plans by January. Industry experts consider this move a significant milestone, highlighting India's status as the world's third-largest automotive market after China and the U.S. Besides its U.S. operations, Tesla already manufactures in Germany and China. With slower economic growth in the West and intense competition in China, India is viewed as a promising market for Tesla’s expansion. The company plans to begin by importing fully assembled electric cars. This strategy has sparked debate about the potential lowering of India’s high import duties and the impact on the existing car industry. CEO Elon Musk has advocated for reduced import taxes, and after a meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi this year, he expressed willingness to set up manufacturing in India if initial sales of imported vehicles succeed. Currently, Indian customs duties are high and apply uniformly to all vehicles, whether electric or gasoline-powered, as a way to encourage local production. Tesla’s earlier efforts to enter India stalled when officials insisted on a firm commitment to local manufacturing before reducing duties. Recent reports indicate that the Indian government is developing a policy where foreign automakers could receive import duty reductions if they pledge local production. This would apply industry-wide to any company investing in Indian EV manufacturing. Those receiving duty benefits would be expected to use domestically sourced components and provide bank guarantees to ensure commitments. Tesla’s request for lower import duties has polarized the auto sector. While local companies such as Tata Motors and Ola Electric worry these changes might undercut their investments, multinational firms like Hyundai, BMW, and Audi argue that lower duties could help expand the EV market. Tesla is also rumored to be preparing a new, more affordable model for the Indian market, priced about 25% less than its current base model. Should import taxes be lowered, luxury EVs—including Tesla's—could become more accessible, potentially challenging domestic manufacturers even as the government looks for ways to safeguard their interests with incentive programs for local production. The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade is reportedly drafting plans linking EV subsidies to investments in domestic manufacturing. Tesla’s presence is likely to push local manufacturers to accelerate their own EV advancements. Foreign EV makers like Vinfast from Vietnam also plan to enter India, which could further intensify market competition and drive down prices. Lower import duties may not just benefit Tesla but could also open doors for other luxury car brands to introduce their advanced EVs at lower prices. India’s EV sector is rapidly expanding—from fewer than 1,000 units sold in 2019–20 to nearly 45,000 units by late 2023—and the government aims for EVs to make up 30% of all vehicle sales by 2030. Nevertheless, the Indian auto market is branching into multiple segments including strong hybrid and CNG vehicles, with several brands emerging as leaders in each. Strong hybrids are attracting buyers seeking a mid-point between conventional and fully electric cars, while companies like Maruti Suzuki plan for a significant EV presence in their future lineup. As battery and charging infrastructure improve, the shift toward electrification is set to accelerate further.

Khubaro warshadeed waxay sheegeen in dhaqaaqani uu muujinayo, una xoojinayo India kaalinteeda ee suuqyada baabuurta caalamka ee ugu weyn (ka dib Shiinaha iyo Mareykanka). article_content: Nvidia has informed customers in China that the launch of its new artificial intelligence chip, the H20, will be delayed until the first quarter of next year, according to two sources familiar with the matter. The H20 is the most advanced of three chips Nvidia developed to comply with new US export restrictions. This delay could make it harder for Nvidia to maintain its market share in China against rivals such as Huawei. Nvidia, based in California, was initially expected to introduce the new chips as early as November 16, according to industry newsletter SemiAnalysis. Now, the H20 launch is scheduled for the first quarter of next year, possibly in February or March, the sources said. Both sources requested anonymity because the information is confidential. Nvidia declined to comment. The sources explained that the H20 is delayed due to challenges server manufacturers face in integrating the chip. Nvidia is also working on two other chips for China, the L20 and L2, designed to meet the export rules. The L20 is reported to be on schedule, while there is no information available about the L2's status. Nvidia hopes these new chips will help it maintain its presence in China after US authorities barred it from exporting its advanced A800 and H800 AI chips. The A800 and H800 were introduced for Chinese customers in November 2022, after the US imposed its first export bans on advanced chips and equipment to China. All three new chips—the H20, L20, and L2—incorporate most of Nvidia's advanced features for AI, but their computing power has been reduced to comply with US regulations, according to SemiAnalysis. The US export restrictions have given rivals like Huawei new opportunities to win business in the AI market, which Nvidia’s graphics processing units (GPUs) have traditionally dominated. Earlier this year, Chinese tech giant Baidu placed a large order for Huawei’s AI chips, Reuters reported, citing sources. One source said Baidu made the purchase before the latest US restrictions in anticipation that it might not be able to buy from Nvidia in the future.

article_content: In early December, 17-year-old Shannon Zwanziger, a senior at Owatonna High School, passed away after contracting the flu. She was among three children in Minnesota who have died from what health officials say is a particularly virulent strain of seasonal influenza this year. Seven additional children are currently receiving intensive care at the Children's Hospital in St. Paul. Alarmingly, the flu has caused fatalities in children who had no underlying health conditions. The Minnesota Department of Health reports that in certain parts of the state, up to half of students were absent from school in December due to the illness. Dr. Pritish Tosh, an infectious disease specialist at the Mayo Clinic, explained to ABC News that even healthy children can experience severe complications. He noted that the body's immune response can become overly aggressive, sending large numbers of white blood cells to the lungs, which can lead to fatal outcomes. If the virus enters the bloodstream and reaches the brain, it can produce severe respiratory symptoms, including shortness of breath and high fever. Shannon became ill with a fever and sore throat, quickly deteriorated at home, and tragically passed away at the Mayo Clinic despite emergency efforts. According to her parents, she had no preexisting health conditions. Karen Martin, a state health epidemiologist, told the Star Tribune that this year's dominant flu strain appears to be H3N2. In previous flu seasons, H3N2 has been associated with increased hospitalizations and deaths. Earlier in the month, the CDC issued an advisory indicating that one component of this year's flu vaccine provides only partial protection against the predominant H3N2 variant, which has mutated since the vaccine's development. CDC Director Dr. Thomas Frieden noted that manufacturing a new vaccine takes about four months, which is too long to impact the current season. Dr. Frieden expressed concern that seasons dominated by H3N2 tend to be more severe, and the limited vaccine match could lead to more people being hospitalized or dying from the flu. Nonetheless, he encouraged those who have not yet received a flu shot to get vaccinated, as it can still offer partial protection against H3N2 and effective protection against other strains, such as H1N1 and Influenza B. Testing shows the vaccine works well against about half of the circulating H3N2 viruses and other types.

Shannon waxay ka mid ahayd saddex caruur ah oo ku dhimatay gobolka Minnesota cudurka qaboowga oo sanadkan noqday mid si gaar ah u halis ah, sida ay sheegayaan masuuliyiinta caafimaadka. Shannon waxay bilowday xanuunkeeda iyadoo qabta xummad iyo cunaha oo xanuunaya, xaaladdeeda ayaa si degdeg ah uga sii dartay guriga, waxayna ugu dambeyn ugu geeriyootay Mayo Clinic inkastoo la sameeyay dadaal degdeg ah. Horaantii bishan, CDC ayaa qoraal digniin ah soo saaray oo sheegaya in qayb ka mid ah tallaalka qaboowga sanadkan uu si kooban uga difaacayo nooca H3N2 ee hada jira, kaasoo isbeddelay tan iyo markii la sameeyay tallaalka. Agaasimaha CDC Dr. Thomas Frieden ayaa xusay in soo saarista tallaal cusub ay gaarayso ilaa afar bilood, taasoo aan la gaari karin inta uu xanuunku socdo. Dr. Frieden wuxuu sheegay in xilliyada uu H3N2 hogaaminayo ay caadiyan noqon karaan kuwo adag, isla markaana, la'aanta tallaalka si fiican ugu habboon ay keeni karto in dad badan isbitaalka la dhigo ama dhintaan. Weli wuxuu kugula taliyay dadka aan tallaal qaadan in ay qaataan, maadaama ay si xaddidan uga difaacaysa H3N2 iyo si dhamaystiran uga badbaadin karo noocyada kale, sida H1N1 iyo Influenza B. Baaritaanka CDC-da waxay muujinayaan in tallaalku si fiican uga difaaco qiyaastii kala badh fayraska H3N2 ee wareegaya iyo noocyada kale ee jira.

article_content: Nigeria is aiming to become a BRICS member within the next two years, as reported by Bloomberg. Foreign Affairs Minister Yusuf Tuggar highlights Nigeria's willingness to join organizations with positive intentions and clear goals. Tuggar remarked that Nigeria has matured enough to choose its international partners and stands to gain from being part of several global alliances. He questioned why Nigeria isn’t included in groups like BRICS and the G-20, considering its population and economic size. BRICS currently includes Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa. In August, the alliance invited Saudi Arabia, Iran, Egypt, Argentina, Ethiopia, and the UAE to join, aiming to widen its influence. Analysts note that despite being Africa’s largest economy, Nigeria’s absence from BRICS might limit its opportunities for greater economic and political influence. Vice President Kashim Shettima explained that Nigeria has not formally applied for BRICS membership yet, attributing this to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s consensus-driven and democratic approach. The Nigerian government remains open to joining international groups if it aligns with the nation’s strategic interests.

article_content: Carbon steel pans are highly valued in both professional and home kitchens for being lightweight, durable, and versatile. While similar to cast iron in many ways, they’re easier to handle and equally long-lasting. Through thorough testing of 11 carbon steel pans, the Matfer Bourgeat Black Carbon Steel Frying Pan stood out as the best overall—it’s sturdy, fairly priced, and excels at tasks from frying eggs to searing meat. Though it comes unseasoned, following Matfer Bourgeat’s detailed seasoning steps creates an excellent nonstick surface. Winco’s French Style Fry Pan is recommended for its budget-friendly price, lightweight design, and ease of seasoning—qualities appreciated by both professionals and home cooks. OXO and Made In are worthy alternatives: OXO offers a preseasoned pan perfect for immediate use, featuring a nonstick finish and a comfortable heat-resistant handle cover, while Made In is ideal for sautéing and stir-frying with high sides and a comfortable, ergonomic handle. All carbon steel pans heat quickly and evenly. They come in a range of weights and handle styles—some are very light and easy to maneuver; others are heavier for added stability. Most require seasoning, although some brands provide preseasoned options. When selecting a pan, consider how you cook, what size or weight you prefer, your budget, and your interest in seasoning and maintenance. Preseasoned pans are simpler for beginners, while traditional unseasoned pans let you build a custom patina. Testing included experiments for heat conduction, retention, seasoning ease, and real-world cooking of chicken, eggs, omelets, and crêpes to assess nonstick performance. Other tested brands such as Lodge and Merten & Storck performed reasonably well but did not surpass the top picks. High-cost models, like Smithey, had unique features but were not outstanding in overall value. Insights from experts (Ali Slagle, Andrea Nguyen, Hailee Catalano) highlighted practical usage, comfort, and the importance of good seasoning. Ultimately, the ideal carbon steel pan depends on your priorities—whether it’s weight, affordability, maintenance, or professional-grade results, there’s a suitable option for every cook.

Doorashada digsiga saxda ah waxay ku xirantahay sida aad u karisid, noocyada aad jeceshahay, baaxadda iyo miisaanka aad rabto, miisaaniyadaada, iyo inaad diyaar u tahay in aad shidato oo aad daryeesho. Noocyada qaali ah sida Smithey waxay lahaayeen astaamo gaar ah balse qiimo dheeraad ah may lahayn. Khabiirada sida Ali Slagle, Andrea Nguyen, iyo Hailee Catalano waxay muujinayaan waxtarka, raaxada, iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay shidashada saxda ah. Ugu dambayn, digsiga birta kaarboonka ugu fiican adiga waa kan buuxinaya waxa aad rabto—ha ahaato culays la’aan, qiimo jaban, daryeel fudud ama natiijooyinka heerka xirfad, waxaad heli doontaa doorasho fiican.

article_content: Bendel Insurance earned their second victory of the 2023/2024 Nigeria Premier Football League season by defeating Plateau United 1-0 at Samuel Ogbemudia Stadium in Benin City. The only goal came from a 14th-minute penalty converted by Benjamin Tanimu, ensuring all three points for the Federation Cup holders and moving them to the top of the league table with six points for now. Plateau United made determined attempts to equalize but were unsuccessful. At Akure Township Stadium, Heartland FC secured a 1-1 draw against Sunshine Stars thanks to a late goal. Sunshine Stars' Michael Olalusi opened the scoring with a penalty in the 42nd minute, before Heartland's Patrick Nwogbaga equalized in the 75th minute. Sunshine Stars missed a late penalty that could have won them the match, and the game ended level. With this result, Heartland climbs to fourth in the standings with four points from three matches, though this could change based on upcoming results from Doma United, Rivers United, and others. Elsewhere, Katsina United and Lobi Stars could not find the net, resulting in a goalless draw.

Goolka kaliya waxa uu ahaa rigooro uu dhaliyay Benjamin Tanimu daqiiqaddii 14aad, taas oo u sahashay kooxda haysta Federation Cup inay saddexda dhibcood guriga joogsato ayna si ku-meel-gaar ah ugu sareyso shaxda horyaalka iyadoo leh lix dhibcood. article_content: The Indian Navy, in collaboration with the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), successfully conducted guided flight trials of the country's first indigenously developed naval anti-ship missile from a Seaking 42B helicopter in Kochi on Tuesday, officials confirmed. In an official post on X, the Navy stated, 'This firing is a significant step towards achieving self-reliance in advanced missile technology, including seeker and guidance systems.' The missile was initially tested in May 2022. According to an official statement released after the maiden flight test, the missile incorporates several new technologies, such as an indigenously developed launcher for the helicopter and a state-of-the-art navigation and avionics system. (Originally published on November 21, 2023)

Qoraal rasmi ah oo lagu faafiyay X, Ciidanka Badda ayaa yiri, 'Ridayntani waa tallaabo weyn oo loo qaaday is-ku-filnaanta tiknoolojiyadda gantaalada sare, gaar ahaan kuwa leh qalabka raadinta iyo hagista casriga ah.' Gantaalkani markii ugu horreysay waxaa la tijaabiyay bishii May 2022. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed rasmi ah kadib tijaabadii ugu horreysay ee duulimaadka, gantaalku wuxuu isticmaalaa teknoolojiyado cusub, oo ay ku jiraan qalab gudaha dalka lagu sameeyay oo lagu rido helikobtar-ka iyo nidaamka hagis iyo avionics casri ah. (Markii ugu horreysay ayaa la daabacay 21-ka Noofembar, 2023)

article_content: Matcha, the finely ground Japanese green tea powder, is now featured on coffee shop menus globally, including major chains offering several varieties. Its popularity is understandable: matcha is flavorful and provides numerous health benefits. High-quality matcha delivers a distinctive yet smooth taste, is rich in antioxidants, and offers a more gradual caffeine effect compared to coffee. There are two main grades of matcha: culinary and ceremonial. Culinary grade is used for drinks like lattes, smoothies, and recipes such as cakes and cookies. Ceremonial grade, made with top-quality leaves, is intended for traditional enjoyment—whisked with water and consumed by itself. Recommended for daily drinking is Kettl Hanaka Matcha from Yame, Japan, available in a convenient 20-gram tin and sourced from respected Japanese tea producers. For those on a budget, Ito En’s Matcha Green Tea Powder, a culinary-grade option from Japan, stands out for its bright color and multiple uses. Rocky’s Matcha presents a premium ceremonial matcha from Uji, Japan. These tea leaves, grown by renowned producer Kiyoharu Tsuji, offer a notably sweet and delicate flavor. Ippodo Tea in Kyoto is recommended for lattes and those new to matcha due to its rich yet balanced taste. For baking, culinary-grade matcha such as Aiya from Nishio, Japan, is excellent for its strong flavor that remains prominent in recipes. Encha’s organic, stone-ground matcha is highlighted for its versatility—it’s suitable for sipping and mixing into milk-based drinks. DōMatcha, with tea blended by 16th-generation tea master Kazunori Handa-san, is praised for its vibrant green color and rich umami, offering a ceremonial-grade matcha experience. Golde, from Uji, Japan, provides a gift set with ceremonial grade matcha and a bamboo whisk, making it ideal for gifting. For flavored varieties, Chamberlain Coffee’s ceremonial grade matcha includes notes like mango, chocolate, or vanilla, offering unique options that complement, rather than overshadow, the green tea. In summary, ceremonial grade matcha from young tea leaves is considered best for traditional preparation. Culinary grade is suitable for cooking and blended drinks. The highest quality matcha is vibrant green, finely ground, has a grassy aroma, and comes from reputable sources.
translated_content: Matcha, oo ah budada shaaha cagaaran ee Jabaan, ayaa si weyn looga helaa maqaayadaha kafeega caalamka, xataa silsiladaha waaweyn oo bixiya dhawr nooc. Caanimadiisa waa la fahmi karaa: matcha waa mid dhadhan fiican leh oo leh faa'iidooyin badan oo caafimaad. Matcha tayo sare leh waxa uu leeyahay dhadhan gaar ah balse siman, waxa uu hodan ku yahay antioxidants wuxuuna bixiyaa kafeen si tartiib tartiib ah usoo baxa marka loo eego kafeega. Waxaa jira laba heer oo waaweyn oo matcha ah: heer cunto-karin iyo heer xaflado (ceremonial) ah. Matchada cunto-karinta waxa loo adeegsadaa cabitaannada sida lattes, smoothies iyo karinta keega ama buskudka. Heerka ugu sareeya – ceremonial – waxa laga sameeyaa caleemo tayo sarreeya, waxaana caadi ahaan lagu caba sida dhaqanka ah, iyadoo la karsanayo biyaha oo keligiis la cabo. Kettl Hanaka Matcha oo laga keeno Yame, Japan, waxaa lagu taliya in si joogto ah loo cabo, waana mid sahlan oo 20-gram ah kana yimaada warshadaha shaaha ee sumcadda leh. Haddii aad rabto doorasho jaban, budada shaaha cagaaran ee Ito En, oo ah heerka cunto-karinta kana timaada Japan, ayaa aad loogu taliyay sababtoo ah midabkeeda cagaaran iyo isticmaalkeeda kala duwan. Rocky’s Matcha wuxuu bixiyaa matcha heer sare ah oo ceremonial ah oo ka yimaada Uji, Japan, oo uu soo saaro beeraleyga caan ka ah Kiyoharu Tsuji, dhadhankeeduna waa macaan oo jilicsan. Ippodo Tea oo Kyoto ah ayaa lagu taliyey in laga sameeyo lattes ama loogu talagalay kuwa bilaabaya matcha, sababtoo ah waa hodan iskuna dheeli tiran. Marka la karayo, matcha heer cunto-karin sida Aiya ee Nishio, Japan, ayaa ugu fiican dhadhankeeda xooggan oo cuntooyinka ku sii jirta. Encha waa matcha organic ah oo la shiido lagana sameeyo caleemo cusub, waxayna ku fiican tahay nooc kasta oo la doono in la isticmaalo—ha ahaato cabitaan gooni ah ama cabitaan caano leh. DōMatcha, oo uu isku daray macalinka shaaha ee 16aad Kazunori Handa-san, waxay leedahay midab cagaaran oo dhalaalaya iyo dhadhan umami ah oo xoog leh, sidoo kalena waa heer ceremonial ah. Golde oo ka timaada Uji, Japan, waxay keentaa xirmo hadiyad ah oo isugu jirta matcha heer sare iyo ul bamboo ah, taasoo hadiyad heer sare ah u ah qofka xiiseeya matcha. Noocyada dhadhanaysan, Chamberlain Coffee waxay keentaa matcha ceremonial ah oo ay ku dareen dhadhanada mango, shukulaato ama vanilla—taas oo aan xad dhaaf ku ahayn balse shidanaya dhadhanka shaaha cagaaran. Ugu dambayn, matcha heer ceremonial ah loo sameeyay caleemo yar-yar ayaa la tixgeliyaa midka ugu fiican ee dhaqanka. Matcha heer cunto-karin ayaa ku habboon karinta iyo cabitaannada la isku darsaday. Matcha tayo sare leh wuxuu leeyahay midab cagaar dhalaalaya, waa si wanaagsan loo shiiday, udgoon daaqsi ah, wuxuuna ka yimid ilo sumcad leh.

A palatial villa in St Tropez, known as Castle St Therese, is on the market for approximately £70 million, making it accessible only to the ultra-wealthy. This 30-bedroom estate, perched on the French Riviera, is not only a symbol of luxury but also holds a special place in history as the location where Princess Diana and Dodi Al Fayed began their romance and spent their last holiday together. Photographs of the pair, taken just days before their tragic deaths in Paris in 1997, include images of them on a yacht departing from the villa.

The estate spans four acres in the exclusive Les Parc De St Tropez community and features an impressive main villa with nine bedrooms—five ensuite—spacious reception rooms, two kitchens, and a children’s playroom. Additional amenities include both indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a waterfront beach house with nine bedrooms, a nightclub complete with a cinema and bar, a gym and sauna, a large boathouse with a helipad, and a jetty. The property also contains a four-bedroom guesthouse (where Princess Diana stayed with her sons), staff accommodations, a security lodge, and a tennis court.

Originally built in the 1860s and owned by Ferdinand de Lesseps, developer of the Suez Canal, Castle St Therese has attracted high-profile neighbors, including Bernard Arnault, owner of Louis Vuitton. While the estate agents Knight Frank have not officially confirmed the asking price, insiders suggest it is around £70 million.

Mohamed Al Fayed decided to sell the villa because it has seen little use since his children grew up. According to his spokesman, Michael Cole, the decision comes with mixed emotions, as the family cherishes joyful memories of their time in St Tropez—particularly the summer of 1997, which remains bittersweet given its tragic ending.

Moritz Baier-Lentz, a partner at Lightspeed Gaming, recently completed the World Marathon Challenge: running seven marathons on seven continents over seven days. Despite a demanding job managing $29 billion at a venture capital firm, Baier-Lentz has spent over a decade balancing work with endurance sports like Ironman triathlons and ultramarathons, viewing this challenge as his biggest yet.

His preparation was intense, with multiple strength training sessions, weekend runs, and a full marathon each month for a year. Managing an 80-hour workweek, he set up strict daily routines, focusing on clearing his email inbox—even during the race itself—and informing colleagues he’d be unavailable without meetings scheduled during the event.

To combine his goals with family time, Baier-Lentz planned marathon weekends as vacations with his wife. He advocates for starting with manageable goals before aiming higher, citing experiences like the gruelling Marathon des Sables in Morocco as crucial for his confidence.

Accountability and social support fueled his motivation: he signed up for official races, created a GoFundMe campaign that raised $250,000 for depression, and connected with other driven participants, including friend Patrick Renner. Their camaraderie persists through a WhatsApp group of fellow runners.

The Antarctic marathon, with its -13°F temperatures and multiple clothing layers, stood out as a highlight. Baier-Lentz stresses mental strategies—like mindfulness and focusing on gratitude—to overcome hardship. He believes that personal growth comes from leaving your comfort zone, and that social networks, careful routines, and gradual steps are essential for achieving tough personal goals.

article_content: Indian stock markets bounced back strongly on Thursday after a weak start, led by IT companies, Reliance Industries, and major banks. The Sensex surged over 600 points to rise above 66,100, while the Nifty added 177 points, crossing the 19,850 mark. The technology sector continued to perform well, benefiting from optimism about US interest rates, since many Indian IT firms generate significant revenue from the US market. Oil and gas shares also traded higher as a drop in global oil prices — now near $80 a barrel — gave a boost to India and its energy firms. Bharat Petroleum was among the top gainers in the Nifty 50. In contrast, PSU banks and metal stocks declined. Market observers highlighted that strong purchases by domestic institutions and retail investors have helped offset recent heavy selling by foreign investors. According to V K Vijayakumar of Geojit Financial Services, this stability has led some foreign investors to reconsider their selling strategies. Technically, Deepak Jasani of HDFC Securities identified 19,849 as a resistance level for the Nifty and 19,547 as support. Globally, US markets closed with small gains after encouraging inflation data raised hopes that the Federal Reserve would hold interest rates steady. However, Asian markets, including key Chinese and Hong Kong indices, fell slightly on Thursday. In trading activity, foreign institutional investors broke a long selling streak to buy Indian stocks worth Rs 550 crore, while domestic investors kept up their buying momentum by adding Rs 610 crore. The Indian rupee inched down by 9 paise to 83.18 against the US dollar as the dollar index edged up. India's central bank, the RBI, tightened lending rules for unsecured retail loans, requiring banks to increase capital reserves and implement stronger controls against risk. In the sports business arena, cricketer Mohammed Shami's endorsement fees have doubled to about ₹1 crore per deal as his performance during the Cricket World Cup boosts his popularity. Separately, the government has told Hindustan Zinc that any business restructuring needs official approval.

article_content: An international team of scientists has discovered a significant spike in radiocarbon levels from 14,300 years ago by analyzing ancient tree rings in the French Alps. This spike is believed to have been caused by an enormous solar storm—the largest ever identified to date. Researchers warn that if a similar event happened today, it could have catastrophic effects on modern society, potentially disabling telecommunications, satellite systems, and power grids, resulting in massive disruptions and financial losses. The study, conducted by scientists from Collège de France, CEREGE, IMBE, Aix-Marseille University, and the University of Leeds, was published in the journal 'Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society A: Mathematical, Physical and Engineering Sciences.' The team examined radiocarbon concentrations in ancient trees preserved along the Drouzet River near Gap in the Southern French Alps. These partially fossilized tree trunks, known as subfossils, were examined ring by ring. This detailed analysis uncovered an unprecedented radiocarbon spike from 14,300 years ago. By comparing this radiocarbon anomaly with beryllium levels from Greenland ice cores, researchers concluded that a massive solar storm likely caused the event, bombarding Earth's atmosphere with energetic particles. According to Professor Edouard Bard, lead author and expert in climate and ocean evolution, radiocarbon is continuously produced in the upper atmosphere through cosmic ray reactions. He explained that intense solar events, such as solar flares and coronal mass ejections, can produce short-term bursts of energetic particles, resulting in sharp radiocarbon spikes in a single year. The team cautions that a solar storm of this magnitude today could devastate technological infrastructure, damaging transformers, disabling satellites, and exposing astronauts to high radiation. These disruptions could result in widespread blackouts lasting months and immense economic damage. As Tim Heaton, Professor of Applied Statistics at the University of Leeds, notes, understanding these past events is crucial for preparing and safeguarding our communication and energy systems. Researchers have identified at least nine extreme solar storms, called Miyake Events, over the last 15,000 years. The most recent occurred in 993 AD and 774 AD, but the newly discovered 14,300-year-old event is the largest yet—about twice the size of previous known events. The exact causes and frequency of Miyake Events remain unclear since none have been directly measured with modern instruments. Professor Bard emphasizes the importance of using radiocarbon from tree rings and beryllium from polar ice cores to extend our understanding of the sun's behavior beyond the era of modern observation, which began with sunspot counts in the 17th century. The Carrington Event of 1859 is the strongest solar storm to have been directly observed, but the Miyake Events—including this newly discovered one—were far larger. Cécile Miramont, Associate Professor at IMBE, Aix-en-Provence University, highlighted the exceptional find of preserved trees. Using dendrochronology, the team built a timeline by piecing together various tree rings, allowing them to document environmental changes and solar activity over uncharted periods. Ultimately, researchers stress that learning from past solar events is essential to better predict, prepare for, and minimize the risks posed by potential future solar storms.

Kororkan waxaa la rumeysan yahay in uu sababay duufaan qoraxeed aad u xoog badan—ta ugu weyn ee la hayay ilaa hadda. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay ka digayaan in haddii weerar la mid ah uu maanta dhaco, ay sababi karto burbur weyn oo ku yimaada tiknoolajiyada casriga ah sida isgaarsiinta, dayax-gacmeedyada, iyo grid-yada korontada kaasoo keeni kara jahwareer iyo khasaare lacageed aad u weyn. Waxa ay fursad u tahay in ay keento go’itaan koronto oo bilo badan qaata iyo khasaare dhaqaale. Professor Tim Heaton oo ka tirsan Jaamacadda Leeds ayaa adkeeyay in fahamka dhacdooyinkii hore ay muhiim u tahay diyaar-garowga iyo ilaalinta nidaamyada isgaarsiinta iyo tamarta. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay ogaadeen ugu yaraan sagaal duufaan qorraxeed oo aad u daran (loogu yeero Miyake Events) 15,000 sano ee la soo dhaafay. Kuwa u dambeeyay waxay dhaceen 993 AD iyo 774 AD, laakiin tan hadda la helay ee 14,300 sano jirta ayaa tii ugu weynayd—ku dhowaad labo laab kuwa hore. Lama caddeyn sababta rasmiga ah iyo inta jeer oo ay dhacaan Miyake Events maadaama aan si toos ah loo cabbirin waqtigan casriga ah.
