article_content: As people remove their jack-o'-lanterns to prepare for Thanksgiving, thousands of decorative pumpkins are expected to end up in landfills. In these oxygen-deprived conditions, discarded pumpkins create methane—a greenhouse gas over 25 times more potent than carbon dioxide. The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency states that around one-quarter of landfill contents in the U.S. is food waste. Landfills contribute 15% of all methane emissions in the country. In Illinois, residents are taking action by attending pumpkin-smash events at sites across the state each weekend after Halloween. People break apart pumpkins with tools like bats and sledgehammers, and the remains are sent for composting in oxygen-rich environments. Jennifer Olson, director of guest and community engagement at the Peggy Notebaert Nature Museum, explained, "You don't produce harmful greenhouse gases when composting pumpkins, as the process differs from landfill decomposition." The resulting compost is a nutrient-rich soil amendment that supports soil health. Kay McKeen, founder and executive director of SCARCE (School and Community Assistance for Recycling and Composting Education), said, "There are many problems we can't solve, but this is one thing we can handle—and have fun doing it." Since 2014, SCARCE has composted over 1,000 tons of pumpkins, reducing emissions by about 752 tons of carbon dioxide, and kept over 217,000 gallons of water out of landfills. Recently, over 90 SCARCE-registered pumpkin-smash sites operated in Chicago, its suburbs, and other states including New York, Michigan, and Indiana. Pumpkins hold significance in Illinois. In 2022, Illinois harvested 17,600 acres of pumpkins—26% of the national total, more than double leading states like California and Indiana. Morton, Illinois, is known as the 'Pumpkin Capital of the World.' Libby's (owned by Nestlé) processes 85% of the world’s canned pumpkin there, mainly for pumpkin pie, which became Illinois’ State Pie in 2015. While most Illinois pumpkins go to food processing, many households also use ornamental pumpkins for decoration. Illinois excels in both production and pumpkin waste diversion. McKeen and a former intern started lobbying in 2006 for laws allowing curbside food scrap collection. A decade later, Illinois allowed one-day compostable waste collections. SCARCE hosted early pumpkin events in Glen Ellyn, Wheaton, and Elmhurst, making composting both enjoyable and educational. "Returning materials to the soil mimics nature," McKeen said. "Composting scraps adds value—making soil healthier, capturing water, and reducing flooding." At SCARCE’s Addison headquarters, McKeen’s daughter, Bev Jaszczurowski, the nonprofit’s chief operating officer, directed participants during collection. Edgewater Environmental Coalition’s annual pumpkin smashes have kept over 12 tons of pumpkins from Chicago landfills. Chicago began promoting pumpkin-smash events in 2022 and now hosts 10 such events alongside a new citywide composting program with 15 food scrap drop-off sites. Chris Sauve, deputy commissioner for recycling in Chicago, encouraged participation in organics recycling but asked people not to bring jack-o'-lanterns (except to smash events) to food scrap sites due to limited bin capacity. For composting, pumpkins must be free of nonbiodegradable items like candle wax and stickers. The collected pumpkins go to transfer stations and then composting facilities. During the fall, yard compost is mostly dry leaves, but pumpkins provide needed nitrogen and up to 90% water, improving the composting process. If residents missed local events, they can still compost at home: smash and cover pumpkins with leaves outside—no backyard pile required. Outdoor composting can attract rodents, but Olson, who uses they/them pronouns, says it’s similar to leaving pumpkins on the porch. Alternatively, organizations such as the Hooved Animal Humane Society in Woodstock and various farms accept pumpkin donations for animal feed. Locations are listed at pumpkinsforpigs.org/illinois. SCARCE also helps communities establish permanent drop-off points for used cooking oil, which Green Grease Environmental recycles into biodiesel. Temporary collection points for cooking oil open after Thanksgiving each year. Copyright 2023 Chicago Tribune. Distributed by Tribune Content Agency, LLC.

Jennifer Olson, agaasimaha soo dhaweynta ee Peggy Notebaert Nature Museum, waxay tiri, "Ma soo saaro gaaska waxyeelada leh markaasoo aad bocorka compost-gareyso, sababtoo ah habkaasi wuu ka duwan yahay midka qashinka." Compost-ga la sameeyo wuxuu hodan ku yahay nafaqo si loo hormariyo caafimaadka ciidda. Kay McKeen, aasaasaha iyo agaasimaha SCARCE (School and Community Assistance for Recycling and Composting Education), waxay tiri, "Wax badan lama xallin karo, laakiin tan waa wax la qaban karo—waxaana xitaa lagu raaxaysan karaa." 2014 ilaa hadda, SCARCE waxay compost-gareysay in kabadan 1,000 tan bocor, waxayna hoos u dhigtay qiiq u dhiganta 752 tan carbon dioxide, iyadoo ka fogeysay qashinka in badan oo biyo ah. Sabtidii lasoo dhaafay, in ka badan 90 goobood oo SCARCE diiwaan gelisay ayaa lagu qabtay pumpkin smash-yo Chicago, agagaarkeed iyo gobollo kale oo Maraykan ah. Bocorku muhiim buu u yahay Illinois. Sannadkii 2022, gobolka wuxuu beeray 17,600 acre bocor ah—ku dhowaad 26% wadarta guud ee Maraykanka. Morton, Illinois, waxaa lagu naanaysaa ‘Caasimadda Bocorka Adduunka.’ Libby's (Nestlé leedahay) ayaa ka baakadaysa 85% bocor la canned-dareeyay, gaar ahaan pumpkin pie-ga lagu cuno, kaasoo loo magacaabay pie-ga rasmiga ah ee gobolka sannadkii 2015. Inta badan bocorka Illinois waxaa loo isticmaalaa warshadaha cunto, hase yeeshee dad badan ayaa si gaar ah u iibsada bocor qurxin. Gobolka wuxuu hormuud u yahay wax-soosaarka iyo dib-u-shaqaynta bocorka. McKeen iyo shaqaale hore waxay 2006 bilaabeen la tacaalidda sharci ogolaanaya ururinta qashinka cuntada. Toban sano kadib waxaa lasoo saaray sharci ogolaanaya ururinta qashinka la compost-gareeyo maalin gaar ah. SCARCE waxay qabatay xaflado hore Glen Ellyn, Wheaton & Elmhurst—iyagoo dadaal ku jiray inay bulshada ka dhigaan ka qaybqaadashada mid xiiso iyo waxbarasho leh. "Wixii aan dib ugu celin karno ciidda, waa sida dabiicaddu samayso," ayay tiri McKeen. "Dadku mararka qaar fahmi waayaan qiimaha qashinka, balse compost-ga wuxuu caafimaad u yahay ciidda, biyaha wuu ilaaliyaa, daadadkana wuu yareeyaa." Xarunta SCARCE ee Addison, Bev Jaszczurowski—sarkaalka fulinta ee hay’adda—ayaa dadka hagaysay goobta qashinka. Edgewater Environmental Coalition waxay sannad kasta qabataa pumpkin smash, iyagoo ka leexiyay in ka badan 12 tan bocor ah qashinka Chicago. Chicago waxay bilaawday xafladahaas 2022, waxayna kordhisay in sanadkan lagu qabtay 10 xafladood oo ku darsaday barnaamij cusub oo compost oo dadku qashinka cuntada geeyaan 15 goobood. Chris Sauve, ku xigeenka agaasimaha dib-u-warshadaynta Chicago, wuxuu dadka ka codsaday inaysan jack-o'-lantern-ka u keenin goobaha qashinka cuntada (marka laga reebo xafladaha smashing-ka), maadaama baaldiyada aysan qaadi karin bocor fara badan. Si bocor loo compost-gareeyo waa in aanay saarnayn wax aan dabiici ahayn sida shabbaga ama wax kale. Bocorka la soo ururiyey waxaa la geeyaa goob lagu kala wareejiyo, kaddibna la geeyaa xarunta compost-ga. Waqtiga dayrta, compost-ka beerta inta badan uu ka kooban yahay caleemo qalalan, bocorkana wuxuu bixiyaa nitrogen & biyo—bocorku wuxuu ka kooban yahay illaa 90% biyo. Dadkii seegay xafladahaasi weli way compost-gareyn karaan guryahooda: bocorka la burburiyo, caleemo lagu daboolo dhulka. Compost-gareynta bannaanka waxay soo jiidan kartaa jiirka iyo danyeerka, balse Olson, oo adeegsada they/them pronouns, ayaa sheegtay inay la mid tahay markaad bocorka ka dhigato balbalo. Waxa kale oo la bixin karaa bocorka si xayawaanku u cunaan, sida Hooved Animal Humane Society ee Woodstock iyo beero kale ku yaala gobolka. Macluumaad dheeraad ah: pumpkinsforpigs.org/illinois. SCARCE waxay ka caawisaa bulshooyinka inay sameeyaan goob joogto ah oo saliidda la keeno, kaasoo Green Grease Environmental u rogo biodiesel. Meelo kale oo lagu keeno saliidda karinta ayaa furan sabtida Thanksgiving kadib. Xuquuqda daabacaadda 2023 Chicago Tribune. Waxaa qaybiyay Tribune Content Agency, LLC.

article_content: The word 'champagne' instantly brings to mind sparkling wine, popping corks, and lively celebrations. But referring to Champagne as the region in northeastern France reveals a history filled with wars, politics, and controversy. Today, Champagne is known for its vineyards, but in the 17th century, the area was famous for high-quality wool. That changed when Dom Perignon, a Benedictine monk, became business manager of the Abbey at Hautvillers at age 29. He worked to revive the vineyards and renovate the cellar, bringing the vineyard to life. Many people credit Dom Perignon with inventing champagne by adding bubbles to wine, but that's a myth. Bubbles were seen as a flaw in his day, and he worked to eliminate them. However, he improved the wine by introducing corks to trap carbonation, gently pressing grapes for a clearer wine, and blending grapes to produce lighter white wine. Legend claims he once said, 'Come quickly, I am tasting the stars!' Dom Perignon's work elevated sparkling wine, making it popular among royals, most notably France's Sun King, Louis XIV, who drank champagne almost exclusively. This made Champagne prosperous and sparked rivalry with Burgundy, whose supporters criticized champagne in a feud that lasted more than a century. Along the way, the region embraced the bubbles, and some even believed champagne could cure malaria. Napoleon Bonaparte also grew fond of champagne while studying in Champagne as a boy and continued to enjoy it throughout his military campaigns, often obtaining supplies from Jean-Rémy Moët. He famously declared, 'In victory you deserve it, in defeat you need it.' Champagne's ties to royalty brought hardship too. In 1870, during the Franco-Prussian War, Champagne became a battleground, and the devastation was severe. The region rebounded with the introduction of brut, or dry champagne, by Louise Pommery. Brut required riper grapes and was harder to make, but it became widely popular and contributed to France's economic recovery. Legal protection for 'champagne' came with the 1891 Treaty of Madrid, stating only sparkling wine from Champagne could use the name. However, the region's borders were undefined, causing disputes with neighboring areas and eventually leading to protests and destruction of champagne bottles. World War I brought worse devastation. The treaty after World War I reinforced Champagne's exclusive rights to the name, benefiting producers like Moët & Chandon, Veuve Clicquot, Taittinger, and Krug. Other countries produce sparkling wine under different names, but American winemakers can still call theirs 'champagne' due to a legal technicality. Champagne's wine industry remains strong, although limited by the region's size. Despite growth challenges, the local winemakers continue to thrive and maintain their traditions.

Maanta, Champagne waxa lagu yaqaannaa beero canab ah oo weyn, laakiin qarnigii 17aad waxa uu caan ku ahaa dhogorta tayada sare leh. Markii Dom Perignon, oo ahaa monk Benedictine ah, uu 29 jir noqday maareeyaha Abbey ee Hautvillers, waxa uu dib u soo nooleeyay beerta canabka iyo qolka kaydka khamriga. Dad badani waxay rumaysan yihiin in Dom Perignon uu helay champagne isagoo xumbada ku daray khamriga, laakin taas waa riyo. Xumbada waxa loo arkayay cillad markaas, wuxuuna isku dayay inuu tirtiro. Si kastaba, waxa uu horumariyay khamriga isagoo isticmaala korko si uu xumbada ugu hayo, canabka si tartiib ah u cadaadiyay si uu khamri nadiif ah u helay, waxaana uu isku daray canab si uu u yareeyo midabka madow. Sheekooyinka ayaa sheegaya inuu lahaa, 'Soo degdeg, xiddigaha ayaan dhadhaminayaa!' Shaqadii Dom Perignon waxa ay kor u qaadday sumcadda khamriga dhalaalaya, taasoo ka dhigtay cabbidda lagu jecel yahay boqortooyada gaar ahaan Louis XIV, Boqorkii Qorraxda Faransiiska. Tani waxay Champagne ka dhigtay meel taajir ah, waxayna dhalisay loollan la yeeshay Burgundy, taageerayaashooda ayaa dhaleeceeyay champagne muddo dheer. Intii loollanku socday, dadkii gobolka Champagne wuu la qabsaday xumbada, xitaa waxaa la filayaa in champagne daaweyso malaria. Napoleon Bonaparte wuxuu isagoo yar wax ku baranayey Champagne, halkaasna uu dareen gaar ah u qaaday khamriga gobolka. Markasta oo uu ciidan hoggaaminayo, wuxuu mari jiray Champagne si uu doonaado khamri cusub asxaabtiisa, gaar ahaan Jean-Rémy Moët. Wuxuu caan ku yahay hadalkiisii, 'Guusha waad u qalantaa, guuldarradana waad u baahan tahay.' Xidhiidhka Champagne la lahaa boqortooyada waxa uu sabab u noqday dhibaatooyin. Sannadkii 1870, intii lagu jiray Dagaalkii Franco-Prussian, Champagne waxa ay noqotay goob dagaal, burburlana aad u weyn. Gobolka waxa uu dib u soo kabsaday markii Louise Pommery ay soo bandhigtay champagne qallalan, ama 'brut', taasoo u baahneyd canab bisil oo badan waxayna ahayd samaynteedu mid adag, balse waxay caan ku noqotay dunida iyo dhaqaalahii Faransiiska oo soo kabtay. Ilaalinta magaca 'champagne' waxa ay timid heshiiskii Madrid ee 1891, kaasoo qeexay in khamriga dhalaalaya ee ka yimaada Champagne oo kaliya loo yeeri karo magacaas. Laakiin xuduudaha gobolka lama caddeyn, taasoo dhalisay khilaafyo iyo gubista malaayiin dhalo oo champagne ah. Dagaalkii koowaad ee aduunka waxa uu keenay burbur xun. Heshiiska dagaalkaas kadib waxa uu adkeeyay xuquuqda Champagne ee magaca khamriga, taasoo faa'iido u ahayd shirkadaha sida Moët & Chandon, Veuve Clicquot, Taittinger, iyo Krug. Dalal kale waxay soo saaraan khamri dhalaalaya oo magacyo kale wata, balse Mareykanka wali wuxuu isticmaalaa magaca 'champagne' sabab la xiriirta heshiis sharci ah. Warshadda khamriga ee Champagne maanta aad ayey u xoogan tahay, in kasta oo ay dhul ahaan xaddidan tahay. Inkasta oo ay jiraan caqabado, winemakers-ku way sii barwaaqoobeen oo dhaqankooda way ilaashanayaan.

article_content: The Biden administration is taking action to eliminate hidden fees that often appear when booking flights, buying concert tickets, or even ordering food. The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) has proposed a rule requiring businesses to display the full, true price of products upfront. If the rule is adopted, businesses would be prohibited from imposing hidden or misleading fees, and they must inform customers whether any fees are refundable. Companies found to be deceiving customers with hidden charges could be required to issue refunds and may face financial penalties. FTC Chair Lina Khan stated to reporters that being a consumer in the U.S. increasingly means facing unavoidable and unnecessary fees. She explained that 'junk fees' affect Americans across a range of transactions—whether paying a hotel bill, renting an apartment, buying event tickets, or ordering meals online. Khan highlighted that Americans pay tens of billions of dollars each year in such fees, which she described as money taken from families for worthless costs imposed by corporations. If enacted, the rule would represent a significant change to a practice that has become widespread throughout the economy. Experts previously told Insider that online shopping once enabled consumers to compare prices accurately. However, businesses adjusted by separating various components of products and services—such as charging more for priority boarding or checked luggage—using a strategy known as obfuscation, which makes consumers think they are spending less than they are. Professor Vicki Morwitz of Columbia Business School notes that 'partition pricing,' where the true cost is split into several parts, causes consumers to focus on the base price and underestimate the final amount. The FTC estimates its proposed rule could save Americans over 50 million hours per year otherwise spent determining the real costs of tickets and hotel bookings. Alongside the FTC's proposal, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) has announced measures to further protect consumers from deceptive fees. These include clarifying a law passed in 2010 that bars large banks from imposing excessive fees, and ensuring customers do not have to pay for basic account information. CFPB Director Rohit Chopra criticized large banks for customer service shortcomings and charging unnecessary fees for basic queries, despite federal law requiring complete and timely responses. The agency also revealed plans to return $140 million to consumers, with $120 million related to surprise overdraft charges. Recent examinations found that some banks charged monthly fees for paper statements, unnecessary products for auto loans, and concealed fees for international transfers. Earlier in February, the CFPB proposed a rule to reduce credit card late fees, potentially saving Americans $9 billion annually. National Economic Council Director Lael Brainard emphasized that while small fees may not impact the wealthiest Americans, they are significant for working families trying to manage their bills.
translated_content: Maamulka Biden ayaa qaaday tallaabooyin lagu ciribtirayo khidmadaha qarsoon ee inta badan ka muuqda marka la dalbanayo diyaarad, tigidhada bandhigyada, ama xataa amarka cuntada. Guddiga Ganacsiga Federaalka (FTC) ayaa soo jeediyay xeer lagu amraayo ganacsiyada inay si cad oo dhameystiran u muujiyaan qiimaha dhammaan alaabada hore. Haddii xeerkan la meel mariyo, ganacsiyada waa laga mamnuuci doonaa inay isticmaalaan khidmadaha qarsoon ama madmadowga leh, isla markaana waa inay macaamiisha u sheegaan haddii khidmadahaasi dib loo soo celin karo. Shirkadahii lagu helo in ay si dadban ku qariyaan kharashaadka waxay ku khasbanaan karaan inay bixiyaan lacag celin iyo ciqaab lacageed. Guddoomiyaha FTC Lina Khan ayaa sheegtay in maanta, muwaadin ahaan Mareykan, aad si joogto ah ula kulmayso khidmooyin lama fahan karo oo aan loo baahnayn. Waxay sheegtay in 'khidmadaha junk-ga' ay saameeyaan dadka Mareykanka ah xilliyada kala duwan—ha ahaato marka la bixinayo biilka hoteelka, kireysiga guri, tigidhada dhacdo ama dalabka cuntada. Khan waxay xustay in Mareykanku si wadajir ah u bixiyaan tobanaan bilyan oo dollar sanad kasta khidmooyin ah oo aan waxba tarayn, lacagtaas oo laga qaado qoysaska shaqeeya. Haddii xeerkan la dhaqan geliyo, wuxuu noqon doonaa isbedel weyn oo laga dareemi doono dhaqaalaha oo dhan. Khubaro horey u la hadlay Insider ayaa sheegay in online-ka uu dadka u ogolaa inay isbarbardhigaan qiimaha alaabada si fudud, balse shirkaduhu markaas way garteen oo waxay bilowday inay kala qaybiyaan adeegyada—tusaale ahaan, sii kordhinta lacagta la bixiyo si loogu horeeyo rakaabka ama xitaa boorsooyinka la hubiyo—iyada oo la adeegsanayo xeelad la yiraahdo ‘obfuscation’, taasoo dadka ka dhigta inay moodaan iney sii yareynayaan kharashaadka. Professor Vicki Morwitz oo ka tirsan Jaamacadda Columbia ayaa sheegtay in 'qiime qayb-qaybsan' oo loo adeegsanayo, halkii kharashka rasmiga ah la tusayo, qaybaha kala duwan la muujiyo taasoo keenta in macaamiishu diiradda saaraan qiimaha asaasiga ah, ayagoo illowsan kharashaadka dheeraadka ah. FTC waxay ku qiyaastay in xeerkan la haayo uu badbaadin doono dadka Mareykanka ah in ka badan 50 milyan saacadood sanadkii oo lagu khasaaro garashada kharashka dhabta ah ee tigidhada iyo hoteelada. Waxaa barbar socda dadaallada FTC, hay’adda CFPB (Bureau-ga Daryeelka Maaliyadeed ee Macaamiisha) ayaa sidoo kale shaacisay tallaabooyin ay ku ilaalinayaan macaamiisha khidmadaha khiyaamada ah, oo ay ka mid tahay caddeynta sharcigii la meel mariyay 2010 inuu mamnuucayo bangiyada waaweyn inay soo rogaan khidmadaha xad dhaafka ah, iyo hubinta in macaamiishu aysan bixin khidmad si ay u helaan xogta xisaabaadkooda. Agaasimaha CFPB Rohit Chopra ayaa dhaleeceeyay bangiyada waaweyn ee adeegga macaamiisha liita iyo soo rogidda khidmadaha aan loo baahnayn marka ay macaamiishu su’aalo aasaasi ah waydiistaan, inkastoo sharciga federaalka uu farayo in su’aalahaas si dhameystiran loo bixiyo. Hay’addan waxay sidoo kale shaacisay in $140 milyan dib loogu celin doono macaamiisha, $120 milyan oo ka mid ahna ay la xiriirto lacagaha wareerka leh ee overdraft-ka. Baaritaano la sameeyay intii u dhaxaysay Febraayo iyo Agoosto 2023, ayaa lagu ogaaday in qaar ka mid ah bangiyada ay macaamiisha ka qaadeen khidmad bille ah warqadaha xisaabta, adeegyo aan waxba tarayn oo la xiriira amaahda baabuurta, iyo khidmadaha qarsoon ee wareejinta lacagaha caalamiga ah. Horraantii Febraayo, CFPB waxa ay soo jeedisay xeer lagu yareynayo khidmadaha daahista kaarka deynta, taasoo la filayo inay dadka Mareykanka ah badbaadiso $9 bilyan sanadkii. Agaasimaha Golaha Dhaqaalaha Qaranka, Lael Brainard, ayaa xustay inkastoo khidmadaha yar yar aysan saameyn weyn ku yeelan dadka ugu dhaqaalaha roon, haddana ay culays ku tahay qoysaska shaqeeya ee isku dayaya inay la socdaan biilashooda.

article_content: Former President Donald Trump has made mocking President Joe Biden and questioning his mental fitness for office a core part of his campaign speeches, even as Trump himself has experienced a recent series of gaffes and verbal slips on the campaign trail. At a campaign stop in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, last month, Trump impersonated Biden walking around the stage looking confused, saying, 'He's always looking around, where do I go?' Weeks later in Sioux City, Iowa, Trump mistakenly thanked supporters for coming out to Sioux Falls, South Dakota, before an Iowa state senator discreetly corrected him—a moment caught on a hot mic. During a summit in Washington, DC, Trump claimed that Biden could 'plunge the world into World War II,' though the war ended nearly 80 years ago, and appeared to confuse Biden with former President Barack Obama, stating he was leading Obama in election polls. These recent missteps have created an unwelcome issue for Trump, his campaign team, and the larger Republican political apparatus. Republicans have questioned Biden's ability to serve as commander-in-chief, citing his age and mental fitness; however, their leading candidate appears to be facing similar challenges, weakening their argument. Trump also incorrectly identified Viktor Orbán, the prime minister of Hungary, as the prime minister of Turkey, though he quickly corrected himself. He has repeatedly mispronounced Hamas, the Palestinian militant group, as ‘hummus’, and during a rally in South Carolina in September, confused former Florida Gov. Jeb Bush with his brother, former President George W. Bush. Trump’s rivals have tried to capitalize on his recent mistakes. Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis, whose presidential campaign has slowed due to Trump's attacks, said in New Hampshire in October: 'This is a different Donald Trump than 2015 and '16 — lost the zip on his fastball. He is wedded to the teleprompter. He can't get off that teleprompter. Anytime he does, he says things like 'don't vote,'' criticizing Trump’s campaign style. DeSantis’ campaign also launched a 'Trump accident tracker' to highlight the former president's missteps. Former South Carolina Gov. Nikki Haley, whose polling has slightly improved, appeared to mock Trump’s foreign policy comments at the Republican Jewish Coalition, saying, 'With all due respect, I don't get confused.' The Democratic National Committee has also highlighted Trump's errors, reposting a screenshot from MSNBC that said, 'MSNBC: Trump’s gaffes appear to be getting more incoherent,' and sharing clips of Trump struggling to complete sentences or mispronouncing Hamas. Biden’s reelection campaign is promoting clips of Trump's mistakes on social media. Some Republican strategists, publicly and privately, are skeptical of the effectiveness of this strategy. They note Trump previously claimed he could commit a high-profile act and still retain supporter loyalty. Supporters are aware of Trump’s age; their critique of Biden is that Trump, at 77, is unusually energetic while Biden, at 80, appears weary. Trump spokesperson Steven Cheung stated: 'President Trump continues to dominate in primary polls and is winning against Joe Biden in the general election. None of these false narratives from Team Biden have changed the race at all, because people know President Trump is the strongest candidate. The contrast is Biden falling on stage, mumbling through speeches, appearing confused, and tripping on steps.' Though the age gap between Biden and Trump is only about three and a half years, voters see them differently. A recent NBC News poll showed 59% of voters have major concerns about Biden’s mental and physical health, compared with 34% for Trump. Trump has said the real issue for Biden is not age, but competence, telling Megyn Kelly in an interview: 'No, he’s not too old at all, he’s grossly incompetent.' Trump added, 'I have many friends in their 80s… Age is interesting because some people are very sharp and some people do lose it.'

Taageerayaashu way garanayaan da’da Trump; dooddooda ka dhanka ah Biden waa in Trump, 77 jir ah, uu weli firfircoon yahay, halka Biden, 80 jir, uu daal badan muujiyo. Afhayeenka Trump Steven Cheung ayaa yiri: 'Madaxweyne Trump weli wuxuu ku hogaaminayaa sahanada ololaha xisbiga isagoo ka guuleysanaya Joe Biden doorashada guud. Wararka been abuurka ah ee ay Biden iyo xisbigiisu faafinayaan waxba isma bedelin sidaas darteed dadku waxay ogyihiin Trump waa musharaxa ugu adag. Ra’yi uruurin ay NBC News samaysay ayaa muujisay in 59% cod-bixiyeyaasha ay ka walwalsan yihiin inay Biden ka maqan tahay caafimaadkiisa maskax iyo jirkaba, halka 34% ay walwalkaas ka qabaan Trump. Trump wuxuu yidhi, 'Wax badan oo asxaab ah ayaan leeyahay oo 80 jirro ah… Da’da waa arrin xiiso leh maxaa yeelay dad qaar waa dheg dheg badan yihiin, qaar kalena maskaxdu way liidataa.'

article_content: A two-year-old girl, Sophie Allen, died after becoming entangled in a window blind cord while playing hide and seek with her older brother, Jayden, at their home in Sunderland on Easter Monday. Sophie was found unresponsive in her bedroom by her mother, Danielle Hudson, after Jayden alerted her that Sophie was 'stuck.' Sophie's father, Peter, performed CPR while Danielle called for an ambulance. Paramedics took Sophie to Sunderland Royal Hospital, where she was placed in an induced coma. She was later transferred to Newcastle's Royal Victoria Infirmary. Despite medical efforts, Sophie passed away early Saturday morning, five days after the accident, due to severe brain damage caused by lack of oxygen. Danielle Hudson has since warned other parents about the dangers of window blind cords, urging them to keep them out of children's reach, tie them up, cut them, or remove them altogether to prevent similar accidents. Sophie is remembered by her mother as a happy and loving little girl. The family has expressed deep gratitude to the paramedics and hospital staff who tried to save Sophie and who allowed them the chance to say goodbye.

Sophie waxaa laga helay iyada oo miyir la’aan ah qolkeedii hooyadeed Danielle Hudson, kadib markii Jayden u sheegay in Sophie ay “xayiran tahay.” Aabbaha Sophie, Peter, ayaa CPR sameeyay intii Danielle waceysay ambalaas. article_content: Joey Glynn, a 19-year-old basketball player from Bentley University, died after collapsing during a recreational men’s league game on Monday night in Watertown, Massachusetts. He was transported to Mount Auburn Hospital and was pronounced dead soon after. Glynn was playing with former teammates from the Middlesex Magic AAU club at about 7:30 p.m. when he fell. According to a teammate, there was no physical contact involved before Glynn collapsed. Authorities are investigating the cause of death, but there is no suspicion of foul play at this time. Mike Crotty, coach of the Middlesex Magic and present during the game, expressed his admiration for Glynn, describing him as a genuine and admirable young man. As a freshman forward at Bentley University, Glynn averaged 3.3 points and 3.2 rebounds per game. Earlier, at Cardinal Spellman High School in Brockton, Glynn was a two-time All-Scholastic and captained both the basketball and football teams. He also played baseball, and helped his football team reach the Super Bowl twice, playing at prestigious venues like Gillette Stadium and TD Garden. Bentley University President Gloria Cordes Larson extended heartfelt sympathies to Glynn’s family, friends, teammates, and professors, acknowledging the deep loss experienced by the community. Glynn is survived by his parents, Joseph and Susan Glynn, and his four sisters: Kelly, Sarah, Stephanie, and Ashley. His father graduated from Bentley’s Graduate School of Business. The university is offering counseling and support to students, with information about a campus memorial to be shared when available.

article_content: Danny Alexander, the Liberal Democrat Chief Secretary to the Treasury, has been accused of directing millions of pounds toward projects in his Highlands constituency. Critics, mainly from the Labour Party, allege that Alexander is protecting votes in his Inverness, Nairn, Badenoch & Strathspey seat through increased local spending, while implementing spending cuts elsewhere. Labour’s Chris Leslie described the number of costly initiatives and tax breaks in Alexander’s constituency as suspicious. Since May 2010, several specific projects in Alexander’s area have received extra government funding. As Chief Secretary, Alexander serves as George Osborne's deputy and approves all government spending. According to the Financial Times, support for Alexander’s constituency has included a tax break for ski-lifts, bail-out funding for the Caledonian Sleeper train, and greater funding to offset housing benefit changes compared to other areas. Last week, the government announced additional support for councils to help with changes to housing benefits, which aim to aid those affected by the 'bedroom tax.' Highland Council, where all MPs are Liberal Democrats, received £735,000—80% more than Aberdeenshire’s £412,000. In total, Highland received 15% of the funding allocated to 21 local authorities. Deputy council leader David Alston credited meetings with Alexander for helping secure the money. Further advantages for the region included a VAT cut to 5% for ski-lifts in the Cairngorm Mountains and exempting the two-kilometer Cairngorm mountain railway from the climate change levy. Alexander also announced plans to extend a fuel rebate from the islands to remote rural areas, including the Highlands. Chris Leslie stated, 'It appears to be more than a coincidence that government funding is being directed to projects benefiting Danny Alexander’s constituency, especially during a period of austerity.' The spending has invited comparisons to 'pork barrel politics.' However, Alexander argued that being the first Highlander in Cabinet for several generations gives him insight into the challenges facing remote areas. 'It's good for government to understand fragile areas of the country,' Alexander told House magazine. In January, the government announced £50 million to refurbish the Caledonian Sleeper, which terminates in Inverness. Alexander said he worked hard to secure this support and that it would enhance the service. Additionally, the 2012 Budget included a significant VAT reduction for ski lifts at Cairngorm, which Alexander said would support the local economy. A 2011 tax break exempted the Cairngorm tourist train from the climate change levy, a benefit mainly applicable to this route. A spokesperson for Alexander said, 'Liberal Democrats are working to ensure the government supports rural areas. The government recognizes the challenges in rural communities and is providing targeted support. This is in addition to broad tax cuts, freezes in fuel duty, and council tax freezes to help everyone in Britain.'

Mucaaradka, gaar ahaan xisbiga Labour, ayaa ku doodaya in Alexander uu ilaashanayo codadka deegaan doorashadiisa Inverness, Nairn, Badenoch & Strathspey isagoo kordhiyay qarashaadka halka meelaha kale la jarayo miisaaniyad. Tan iyo May 2010, dhowr mashruuc oo gaar ah oo ku yaal deegaanka Alexander ayaa helay nidaam taageero dhaqaale dawladeed. Toddobaadkii la soo dhaafay, dowladda ayaa shaacisay taageero dheeri ah oo la siiyay golayaasha deegaanka si ay uga caawisso dadka ay saameeyeen isbedelada sharciyada guryaha, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu caawiyo dadka uu saameeyay 'canshuurta qolka la banneeyo'. Highland Council, oo dhammaan Xildhibaanadu yihiin Liberal Dem, ayaa heshay £735,000 — taasoo 80% ka badan £412,000 ee Aberdeenshire. Guud ahaan, Highland waxay heshay 15% deeqda la siiyay 21 yo golaha deegaanka. Ku xigeenka hogaamiyaha golaha deegaanka, David Alston, ayaa sheegay in kulamada uu la yeeshay Alexander ay kaalin fiican ka yeesheen helitaanka lacagtan. Alexander waxa uu sidoo kale shaaciyay qorshe lagu ballaarinayo gunno shidaal oo laga helo jasiiradaha looguna tala galay in lagu daro tuulooyinka fog-fog, oo ay ku jiraan Highlands. Chris Leslie ayaa yiri: 'Waxay u muuqataa inaysan ahayn isku ekaansho kaliya in maalgalin xoog leh loo saaray mashruucyo si toos ah ugu faa'iidaynaya deegaanka Danny Alexander, xilli xadgudubyo dhaqaale ay ka socdaan dalka intiisa kale.' Bixinta lacagaha la siiyay ayaa keentay in lala barbardhigo habka 'pork barrel politics'. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Alexander wuxuu ku dooday inuu yahay Highlander-kii ugu horreeyay ee xil sare ka qabta Xukuumadda muddo tobanaan sano ah taasina ay siisay faham dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan caqabadaha ka jira deegaannada fog. 'Waa wax wanaagsan in dowladda ay fahanto aagagga jilicsan ee dalka,' ayuu u sheegay House magazine. Bishii Janaayo, dowladda ayaa shaacisay £50 milyan si dib loogu dayactiro tareenka Caledonian Sleeper, kaas oo dhammaadkiisu yahay magaalada Inverness. Alexander wuxuu sheegay inuu si adag ugu dadaalay helitaanka taageeradan oo ay sare u qaadi doonto adeegga tareenka. Sidoo kale, miisaaniyadda 2012 waxa ay ku jirtay cashuur-dhimis weyn oo loo sameeyay ski-lifts-ka Cairngorm, taasoo Alexander sheegay inay taageeri doonto dhaqaalaha deegaanka. Sannadkii 2011, cashuur-dhimis ayaa laga saaray tareenka dalxiiska Cairngorm ee la cuno canshuurta isbadalka cimilada, taas oo badanaa khusaysay khadkaas oo kaliya. Afhayeen u hadlay Alexander ayaa yiri: 'Liberal Democrats waxay ka shaqaynayaan in dowladda ay taageerto aagagga miyiga. Dowladda waxay aqoonsan tahay caqabadaha horyaalla bulshooyinka miyiga waxayna bixisaa taageero gaar ah. Tan waxa dheer gooyn cashuureed iyo joojinta kordhinta canshuuraha shidaalka iyo council tax-ka oo la qabtay si looga caawiyo dhammaan dadka dalka Britain.'

article_content: A researcher at the University of Tennessee Herbert College of Agriculture has developed a genetically engineered potato plant capable of detecting gamma radiation. Ph.D. student Rob Sears created this phytosensor so it signals dangerous radiation levels by altering the fluorescence of its leaves—a green glow that is visible from afar. Because potatoes are cultivated worldwide and thrive in a variety of climates, they were chosen for this research and for large-scale implementation. Potatoes reproduce through tubers, generating genetically identical offspring and consistent results across different environments. Sears explains that potatoes are highly resilient and adapt effectively to different settings, making them excellent candidates for reporting environmental stress like gamma radiation. His goal was to make these biological responses clearly visible, offering a natural warning system without the need for electronic sensors. With the continued use of nuclear energy, the demand for simple, effective radiation detection is rising. Phytosensors are affordable, easy to interpret, and require no mechanical upkeep, presenting an opportunity to improve safety for those near radiation sources. Sears describes seeing his foundational studies in radiation biology become a working biological device as rewarding. Beyond agriculture, he notes that phytosensors showcase synthetic biology's potential to shape plants into tools for public and environmental safety. He credits his education and support from Neal Stewart (Department of Plant Sciences) and Scott Lenaghan (Department of Food Science) for making the research possible. Sears is set to graduate in December 2023 and hopes to continue advancing bioengineered plant technologies. Provided by University of Tennessee at Knoxville. Source: 'PhD student bioengineers potato plant to detect gamma radiation' (2023, November 17). Retrieved 20 November 2023 from https://phys.org/news/2023-11-phd-student-bioengineers-potato-gamma.html

article_content: China criticized the United States’ human rights record on Friday, a day after the U.S. State Department reported worsening conditions in China, including crackdowns on dissidents. In its annual report, China argued that the U.S. has no moral, political, or legal authority to serve as a global human rights advocate, citing incidents such as the arrest of Occupy Wall Street protesters and accused police brutality. China's report also referenced strict internet restrictions in the U.S., pointing to provisions in the Patriot Act and Homeland Security Act that grant authorities power to monitor and block content deemed harmful to national security. The report stated that the examples provided represent only a fraction of the U.S.'s 'dismal' human rights situation. Earlier, the U.S. State Department criticized multiple countries, including China, in its annual global human rights report. It highlighted a deterioration in fundamental freedoms in China, including expression, assembly, and association, and reported allegations of arbitrary detentions and abuses, particularly during high-profile events. The U.S. report followed the arrival of Chinese activist Chen Guangcheng in the United States after he escaped house arrest and sought refuge at the U.S. Embassy in Beijing. This incident heightened diplomatic tensions, coinciding with Secretary of State Hillary Clinton's visit to China. Although the U.S. report covered 2011—before Chen's high-profile escape—it raised concerns over his treatment, including beatings, denial of medical care, and reports that activists visiting him faced assaults and detentions. The U.S. also criticized the human rights records of several other countries, including Myanmar, Syria, Bahrain, North Korea, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Iran, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan. China regularly condemns what it sees as U.S. interference in domestic political matters.

Dhanka kale, Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka waxay sannadkan dhaleeceysay dalal badan oo ay ka mid tahay Shiinaha, waxayna sheegtay in xorriyaadka aasaasiga ah ee Shiinaha ay hoos u dhaceen, gaar ahaan hadalka, isu imaatinka, iyo ururashada, iyadoo lagu eedeeyey in la xiray dadka iyo xadgudubyo loo geystay, gaar ahaan xilliyada lagu jiro dhacdooyinka waaweyn. Warbixinta Mareykanka waxay soo baxday kadib imaanshaha Chen Guangcheng – oo ah halgamaa Shiine ah – oo u soo baxsaday Mareykanka kaddib markii uu ka baxsaday xabsi guri una galay safaaradda Mareykanka ee Beijing. Dhacdadan ayaa keentay xiisado diblomaasiyadeed oo la socday booqashadii Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka Hillary Clinton ee Shiinaha. Inkastoo warbixinta Mareykanku ay ka warramayso sanadkii 2011 — ka hor baxsashadii Chen — haddana waxay walaac ka muujisay sida loola dhaqmay, sida jirdil, diiditaan daryeel caafimaad, iyo wararka sheegaya in dadkii isku dayay inay booqdaan la kulmeen garaacis iyo xarig. Mareykanku wuxuu sidoo kale dhaleeceeyey diiwaanka xuquuqda aadanaha dalal ay ka mid yihiin Myanmar, Suuriya, Baxreyn, Waqooyiga Kuuriya, Fiyatnaam, Sri Lanka, Iiraan, Turkmenistan, iyo Uzbekistan. Shiinaha waxay si joogto ah u cambaareysaa waxa ay ugu yeerto faragelinta Mareykanka ee arrimaha siyaasadeed ee gudaha.

article_content: The National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) has apprehended 67-year-old Clement Chukwuemeka at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport, Abuja, for attempting to smuggle 100 wraps of cocaine. Chukwuemeka reportedly ingested the drugs and later excreted them after a body scan revealed multiple pellets in his stomach. The suspect stated he became involved in trafficking to earn enough money to marry a new wife and start fresh after spending 30 years living in Brazil, Ethiopia, and Thailand. NDLEA spokesperson Femi Babafemi confirmed that Chukwuemeka was arrested on Tuesday, October 3, 2023, upon arrival from Addis Ababa, Ethiopia via Ethiopian Airlines flight 951. The cocaine weighed 2.195 kilograms. Chukwuemeka said he had previously been married but, after losing his wife and being childless, chose to smuggle drugs as a means to fund a new beginning. In a separate incident, NDLEA officials arrested 45-year-old Bilkisu Bello at Malam Aminu Kano International Airport on October 2, 2023, as she was preparing to board a Saudia Airlines flight to Saudi Arabia. During questioning, Bello confessed that she was supposed to swallow pellets of cocaine being kept in a house in Kano's Farawa area. She led authorities to the location, where they recovered 52 wraps of cocaine, totaling 767 grams. Additionally, NDLEA operatives, supported by personnel from the Nigerian Army, Civil Defence Corps, and Amotekun, conducted a raid in James town, Ogunmakin, Obafemi Owode Local Government Area of Ogun State on October 3. They destroyed 10.38 tonnes of cannabis sativa spread across more than four hectares. On their return from the operation, NDLEA agents intercepted a truck (number plate FS548XN) carrying a 40-foot container loaded with timber. Upon searching the container, they discovered two bags containing 20 kilograms of cannabis sativa. Six individuals in the truck—Ahmed Yusuf, Olaniyi Babatunde, Adedeji Babatunde, Richard John, Osolale Olamilekan, and Abdulazeez Saied—were taken into custody.
translated_content: Hay’adda Dagaalka Daroogada Qaranka (NDLEA) ayaa xirtay nin 67 jir ah oo lagu magacaabo Clement Chukwuemeka garoonka diyaaradaha ee Nnamdi Azikiwe, Abuja kadib markii la qabtay isagoo isku dayaya inuu si qarsoodi ah u geliyo 100 xabbo oo kokaayn ah. Chukwuemeka ayaa la sheegay inuu liqay kokaaynta kadib markuu baaritaan caloosha lagu sameeyay lagu arkay xirmooyin badan. Wuxuu sheegay inuu dhaqaalahan doonayay si uu u guursado naag cusub oo nolol cusub uu uga bilaabo, kadib 30 sano oo uu ku noolaa Brazil, Itoobiya iyo Thailand. Afhayeenka NDLEA, Femi Babafemi, ayaa xaqiijiyay in la qabtay Chukwuemeka Talaadadii, Oktoobar 3, 2023, markuu kasoo dagay Addis Ababa, Itoobiya, isagoo la socday duulimaadka Ethiopian Airlines ee 951. Kokaaynta la helay ayaa culeyskeedu ahaa 2.195 kiilo. Chukwuemeka wuxuu sheegay inuu horey u qabay xaas balse uu waayay, isagoo ilmo la’aan ah, sidaasna uu ugu biiray tahriibinta daroogada si uu nolol cusub u hormariyo. Dhacdo kale oo gaaray, saraakiisha NDLEA waxay xirtay Bilkisu Bello oo 45 jir ah garoonka diyaaradaha ee Malam Aminu Kano 2-dii Oktoobar 2023, xilli ay dooneysay in ay raacdo duulimaad Saudia Airlines oo ku socday Sacuudi Carabiya. Intii la wareysanayay, Bello waxay qiratay in xabooyin kokaayn ah oo loo diyaariyay inay liqdo laga hayay guri ku yaalla Farawa, Kano. Waxay booliiska u tilmaantay gurigaas, halkaasna laga helay 52 xabbo oo kokaayn ah oo culeyskoodu yahay 767 garaam. Sidoo kale, howlwadeennada NDLEA, oo ay garab siinayeen ciidamada milateriga, Ilaalada Rayidka iyo Amotekun, ayaa 3-dii Oktoobar weerar ku qaaday James town oo ka tirsan Ogunmakin, degmada Obafemi Owode ee gobolka Ogun. Halkaas ayay ku burburiyeen 10.38 tan oo xashiish ah oo ku fidsanaa in ka badan afar hektar. Markii ay ka soo laabteen hawlgalkaas, saraakiisha NDLEA waxay qabteen gaari xamuul ah (nambarka FS548XN) oo siday konteenar 40-foot ah oo ay ku jiraan alwaaxyo. Baaritaan kadib, waxa laga helay labo bac oo xashiish ah miisaankeedu yahay 20 kiilo. Lixda qof ee gaariga saarnaa—Ahmed Yusuf, Olaniyi Babatunde, Adedeji Babatunde, Richard John, Osolale Olamilekan, iyo Abdulazeez Saied—ayaa la qabtay.

article_content: Leaders in British agriculture are calling out the government for not aligning its supportive statements about local food with real action. Speaking at the Oxford Farming Conference, National Farmers’ Union president Peter Kendall said ministers should ensure that government-funded bodies like hospitals and schools prioritize buying British produce, rather than defaulting to cheaper imports. Kendall pointed to a previous event in Parliament, where serving only British food was not possible, exposing shortcomings in the food system. While he welcomed Environment Secretary Owen Paterson’s push to reduce food imports, Kendall insisted that the government needs to set the standard. Secretary Paterson responded that the government is working towards stronger support for British farmers, appointing Sir Peter Bonfield to lead improvements in how public organizations source food. He highlighted that the public sector spent £2.1 billion on food and drink in the previous year, showing there is potential to channel more of this spending to UK producers. The Countess of Chester hospital’s high rate of UK-sourced food was cited as a positive example. Kendall and Paterson both emphasized the role of consumers in boosting the British farming sector by buying seasonal local produce, which also benefits the environment and economy. Echoing these points, the Countryside Alliance’s Sarah Lee argued for government action, not just words, to support British food. Supermarkets have reported investments in new technology to make British produce available for longer, but Paterson acknowledged that complicated labels can mislead shoppers, as ‘British’ sometimes only refers to where the food was processed, not necessarily grown.

article_content: Valencia have rejected a £26.7 million bid for Nicolas Otamendi, making it clear that only his £38.2 million buyout clause will trigger a sale. Otamendi, playing outstandingly this season, is attracting attention from Manchester United and Arsenal. However, owner Peter Lim is committed to retaining key players. The Argentina defender, with a contract until 2019 and partial ownership by Doyen Sports Group, aims to return Valencia to Champions League competition. Elsewhere, West Bromwich Albion have set their sights on Fiorentina left-back Marcos Alonso, who played a key role during Sunderland’s successful fight against relegation. Fiorentina may sanction another loan spell for Alonso. Albion manager Tony Pulis is pursuing Callum McManaman from Wigan and may allow Silvestre Varela to terminate his loan early to join Parma. The Italian side are also adding Cristian Rodriguez from Atletico Madrid. Meanwhile, Olympiacos are interested in West Brom's Joleon Lescott, while Burnley monitor West Brom midfielder Graham Dorrans with no official bid yet. Wigan's Shaun Maloney may move to Chicago Fire if a £1 million fee is agreed, though his contract lasts until summer. Reading boss Steve Clarke wants to sign Glenn Murray from Crystal Palace for about £2 million and is seeking to loan Robert Huth from Stoke. Reading’s Royston Drenthe is discussing terms with Erciyesspor in Turkey. Crystal Palace are seeking new attacking players and are watching Bolton winger Chung-Yong Lee (out injured for three weeks), Rudy Gestede, and Watford’s Troy Deeney and Ikechi Anya. The club aims to secure a winger and striker. Leicester City are interested in taking Lloyd Dyer on loan from Watford, competing with Birmingham and Bolton. Watford are close to signing Serbian defender Vujadin Savic short-term. Birmingham City’s Guy Moussi will not have his contract renewed. Spanish side Sevilla is considering Manchester United keeper Anders Lindegaard, who may depart following Victor Valdes’ arrival. Out of contract this summer, Lindegaard is exploring his options. Chelsea are reviewing an offer from Roma to loan Mohamed Salah, although manager Jose Mourinho is cautious about his departure unless a replacement comes in. Interest comes from multiple European clubs, but Salah reportedly favors a move to Rome. The Egyptian international also urged fans not to rely on ex-agent Oliver Kronenberg for updates due to ongoing legal matters. Aston Villa and Liverpool are tracking youthful Leeds midfielder Lewis Cook, who stands out with 25 appearances this season. Ipswich Town will soon sign veteran goalkeeper Paddy Kenny. Wolves have offered £500,000 for Zulte Waregem’s Idrissa Sylla, currently at AFCON with Guinea. Blackpool’s £30,000 bid for Partick Thistle’s Stephen O’Donnell was turned down. Swansea City’s £5.5 million bid for Stuttgart’s Alexandru Maxim was declined, so they are now pursuing Norwich’s Martin Olsson. Forward Bafetimbi Gomis says he could leave Swansea, potentially for Borussia Dortmund, but will talk with his management and the club before deciding.

article_content: Indiana Pacers All-Star Paul George underwent successful surgery on his broken right leg and is expected to stay in the hospital for about three days. The six-foot, ten-inch George had the operation at Sunrise Hospital in Las Vegas to repair an open tibia-fibula fracture, according to a USA Basketball statement early Saturday. Doctors David Silverberg, Joseph Yu, and team physician Riley Williams attended the procedure. George suffered the serious right leg injury during the U.S. national team’s intrasquad scrimmage on Friday night. While contesting a fast-break layup by James Harden with 9:33 left in the fourth quarter, George’s leg struck the base of the backboard stanchion and broke. Medical staff responded immediately, and after about ten minutes, George was taken from the arena on a stretcher. Players appeared visibly upset, and coach Mike Krzyzewski told the crowd the scrimmage would not continue, out of respect for George and his family. On Saturday, Pacers president Larry Bird issued a statement saying it is too early to discuss George’s return. 'We are hopeful that next week Paul will return to Indianapolis to continue recovery,' Bird said. 'We know how this impacts our team, but our goal is to match Paul’s determination. Our franchise has faced setbacks before and recovered. Paul will set an example off the court; the rest of us must follow on the court. For now, our focus is on helping Paul in any way we can.' USA Basketball chairman Jerry Colangelo described the event as unprecedented and very emotional for the team. He agreed the game could not continue under the circumstances. Doctors estimate George’s complete recovery may take 12 to 18 months. Dr. Patrick Kersey, who treated Kevin Ware for a similar injury in 2013, suggested George might need 6 to 12 weeks post-surgery, and 6 to 10 weeks for normal walking. Kersey is not directly involved in George’s treatment but noted elite athletes can sometimes recover faster. Coach Krzyzewski and Colangelo said all roster decisions are postponed, with priority given to George’s recovery. The U.S. team, already affected by several players withdrawing, will wait before making further decisions. George was anticipated to be a key starter for Team USA in the upcoming World Cup in Spain. Following the surgery, George tweeted appreciation for support and optimism for his return. NBA executives have long expressed concerns about injuries during international play, referencing incidents with Pau Gasol and Manu Ginobili. Krzyzewski referenced past events, pointing out that while these occurrences are rare, they highlight the inherent risks in sports.

In kastoo uu Kersey si toos ah daaweyn ugu hayn George, wuxuu sheegay in ciyaartooyda heerka sare ah ay soo kabsadaan si dhakhso leh mararka qaar. Tababare Krzyzewski iyo Colangelo waxay sheegayeen in dhammaan go’aannada xulashadooda la hakiyay si mudnaanta loo siiyo soo kabashada George. Kooxda USA, oo horeyba xiddigo uga maqnaayeen, waxay go’aansadeen inay sugaan qorshayaasha xiga. George waxaa laga filayay inuu noqdo ciyaaryahan muhiim u ah Team USA ee koobka adduunka ee Spain. article_content: The makers of Khichdi 2 released the trailer for their comedy film on Wednesday. The film stars Supriya Pathak, Jamnadas Majethia, Rajeev Mehta, Anang Desai, and Vandana Pathak. Khichdi 2 is a direct sequel to the 2010 film, Khichdi: The Movie. In addition to the main cast, the sequel features cameo appearances by Kirti Kulhari, Farah Khan Kunder, Pratik Gandhi, Anant Vidhaat, Paresh Ganatra, Kiku Sharda, Flora Saini, and Reyaansh Veer Chaddha. The trailer, which is over two minutes long, sets the tone with its absurd, comedic world: following the creation of Pakistan and India on August 14 and 15 respectively, a new kingdom called 'Paanthukisatn' is introduced. The film follows a series of adventures, misadventures, and outlandish scenarios involving the main characters and various gangs. For instance, in one scene, Rajeev Mehta’s character Praful asks Pratik Gandhi's pilot character, 'Who are you?' Pratik sarcastically responds, 'Aapko kya lagta hai?' Praful quirkily answers, 'Mujhe joota lagta hai, log mujhe marte hai tab.' Supriya Pathak's Hansa then proudly recalls that last year, Praful was allegedly hit by the Qutub Minar. Pratik's character, puzzled, questions how that's possible, and is told, 'Ha, par jijaji ko toh phek sakte hai na Qutub Minar pe?' Khichdi originally aired as a weekly sitcom in 2002 on Star Plus and quickly became one of the most popular shows on Indian television, noted for its humor, memorable characters, and performances. After two successful TV seasons, the franchise released its first film in 2010. Khichdi 2 is set to release on November 17, a week after Salman Khan’s Tiger 3. The film is written and directed by Aatish Kapadia and produced by Jamnadas Majethia.

article_content: WASHINGTON – On Monday, a federal appeals court indicated it could restore some limits on Donald Trump’s statements related to his election interference case. The judges discussed how to issue an order that upholds Trump’s free speech rights while protecting the fairness of the judicial process. A panel of three judges questioned attorneys on both sides to determine whether a lower court’s order preventing Trump from making provocative remarks about prosecutors, witnesses, and court staff should be reinstated. The judges considered multiple outcomes to balance the integrity of the trial with First Amendment protections. Judge Patricia Millett acknowledged the challenge of finding this balance without affecting the political environment. Cecil VanDevender, representing special counsel Jack Smith, supported the need for the original order, while the court appeared willing to consider narrowing the restrictions rather than fully reinstating them. As the trial date approaches, the judges’ inquiries signaled that they might allow certain limits on Trump, the frontrunner for the 2024 Republican presidential nomination, but would likely ensure he can respond to criticism on the campaign trail. Trump’s legal team is ready to take the issue to the Supreme Court if necessary. The matter is significant because Trump frequently speaks publicly, especially on social media and during campaign events, and there is little legal precedent for limiting the speech of criminal defendants who are also running for major public office. Special counsel Jack Smith’s presence at the hearing underscored the significance of the issue. During more than two hours of argument, Trump’s lawyer, D. John Sauer, argued that the gag order is vague and threatens future political speech, saying it acts as a 'heckler’s veto' since it assumes Trump’s words could cause others to harass or threaten those involved. The judges pressed Sauer on whether steps should be taken before potential threats escalate. Prosecutors pointed out a recent case of a Texas woman charged with threatening Judge Tanya Chutkan soon after Trump made a pointed post on social media, asserting that his comments already have an impact. Judge Cornelia Pillard questioned if Trump should face any speech limits in the interest of a fair trial, and Judge Millett noted that calling all of Trump’s remarks political ignores the possibility of undermining the legal process. Still, they discussed how to permit Trump to defend himself in debates. Judge Chutkan’s gag order has gone through several changes: it was imposed, lifted, then reinstated after Trump’s comments, and is now paused while under review. The three judges reviewing the case were appointed by Presidents Obama and Biden. Trump is currently facing four criminal cases: the Washington election case set for trial on March 4, classified documents allegations in Florida, a hush money prosecution in New York involving Stormy Daniels, and an election interference case in Georgia. He continues to deny any wrongdoing.

Garsoorayaashu waxay ka doodayeen sida loo bixin karo amar ilaalinaya xuquuqdiisa hadalka xorta ah, iyadoo sidoo kale la ilaalinayo caddaaladda hanaanka maxkamadda. article_content: Marzena Castillo, a Chicago resident, has filed a lawsuit against her former employer, alleging she was terminated unfairly due to her pregnancy. Castillo held a managerial position at Northside Bar and Grill in Bucktown. She reports that after notifying her supervisor about her pregnancy last year, her work environment changed for the worse, with her manager expressing disappointment and fostering a negative atmosphere. Following the birth of her son, Eros, Castillo says she encountered inappropriate remarks about breastfeeding in the workplace. Soon afterward, she was dismissed without a clear explanation, leading her to believe the action was tied to her pregnancy and role as a new mother. She is now pursuing a discrimination case. In response, Northside Bar and Grill’s co-owner, Cyril Landise, stated that Castillo's dismissal was not related to her pregnancy and that the company continues to support working mothers, though no additional details were given regarding the reasons for her departure. Castillo's attorney argues that terminating an employee due to pregnancy is prohibited by law and claims this was the basis for her dismissal. Castillo, who began working at the restaurant in 2004, managed a staff of over 50 and oversaw restaurant operations. Labor statistics suggest that roughly 75% of women entering the U.S. workforce are expected to become pregnant during their careers.

article_content: Romantic comedies, or rom-coms, are beloved for their feel-good stories and the joy they bring as romantic relationships unfold onscreen. These films are often set in picturesque locations, providing audiences with delightful escapism. Netflix currently offers several standout rom-coms. For October, here are three recommended romantic comedies: a story about love and mathematics, a romance set among the clouds, and a film featuring Julia Roberts, one of the genre’s most iconic stars. ‘Love at First Sight’ is a Netflix original based on the novel ‘The Statistical Probability of Love at First Sight’ by Jennifer E. Smith. It follows Hadley Sullivan (Haley Lu Richardson) who, after missing her flight from New York to London, meets Oliver Jones (Ben Hardy), a university student passionate about math. The two share a meal at the airport and become seatmates on their flight to London. As they fall for each other, a series of events threatens to separate them, but fate seems determined to bring them back together. ‘Love at First Sight’ is available to stream on Netflix. The Australian rom-com ‘Love Is in the Air’ stars Delta Goodrem as Dana Randall, a seaplane pilot for her family's struggling company, Fullerton Airways. In London, investment executive William Mitchell (Joshua Sasse) is sent to Queensland to shut down the airline as part of his company’s cost-saving plan. While in Queensland, William gets to know Dana and must choose between his corporate objective and the chance for love. ‘Love Is in the Air’ is now streaming on Netflix. Julia Roberts shines in the classic rom-com ‘My Best Friend’s Wedding.’ She plays Jules Potter, who reunites with her childhood friend Michael O’Neal (Dermot Mulroney) days before he is set to marry Kimmy Wallace (Cameron Diaz). Realizing she’s in love with Michael, Jules tries to sabotage the wedding with the help of her friend George Downes (Rupert Everett), who pretends to be her fiancé. The film explores whether Jules will go too far to win Michael’s heart. Watch ‘My Best Friend’s Wedding’ on Netflix.

article_content: For years, scientists believed that the extinct mammal group known as anthracobunidae were closely related to the ancestors of today's elephants and sea cows. However, new fossils found in India and Pakistan, dating back around 48 million years, have prompted researchers to rethink this theory. The recently analyzed bones—including two jaw fragments—have led experts to reclassify anthracobunidae as more closely related to modern horses, rhinos, and tapirs, rather than elephants. This finding makes sense, considering that elephants and their relatives originated in Africa, while anthracobunidae's presence in Asia was always a puzzle. The study, published in the journal PLOS ONE and led by Dr. Lisa Noelle Cooper of Northeast Ohio Medical University, analyzed the isotopes and shape of the ancient bones. Results suggest that anthracobunidae were bulky land mammals that spent significant time near water, much like today's tapirs and rhinos. The animals had dense bones, which Dr. Cooper notes might have helped balance their bodies in the water—similar to what is seen in hippos, otters, and certain birds such as penguins. Co-author Erik Seiffert from Stony Brook University explained that accumulating fossil and genetic evidence points to elephants and sea cows having their evolutionary roots in Africa. As a result, the new findings about anthracobunidae’s Asian lineage help clarify previous scientific confusion.

Laakiin, lafaha cusub ee laga helay Hindiya iyo Pakistan, kuwaas oo jiray qiyaastii 48 milyan oo sano ka hor, ayaa dardargeliyay cilmi-baarayaal in ay dib u eegaan aragtidan. Lafaha dhawaan la baaray—oo ay ku jiraan laba daan—ayaa sababay in khubaro badan ay anthracobunidae u arkaan kuwo aad ugu dhow faraska, wiyisha, iyo tapirs-ka maanta jira, halkii ay maroodiyada la xiriiri lahaayeen. Tani waa mid la fahmi karo, sababtoo ah maroodiyada iyo xayawaanka la midka ah waxay kasoo jeedeen Afrika, halka anthracobunidae laga helay Aasiya taas oo markasta la yaab lahayd. Cilmi-baaristan, oo lagu daabacay joornaalka PLOS ONE kana hogaaminaysay Dr. Lisa Noelle Cooper oo ka socota Jaamacadda Caafimaadka ee Northeast Ohio, ayaa falanqaysay isotopes-ka iyo qaab-dhismeedka lafahaas hore. Natiijooyinka waxay muujinayaan in anthracobunidae ahaayeen xayawaan waaweyn oo cufan oo waqtiga badan la qaata meelaha biyaha agtooda ah, sida tapirs-ka iyo wiyilaha maanta. Xayawaankani waxay lahaayeen lafo dhumuc weyn leh, sida uu sheegay Dr. Cooper, taas oo u suuragelin karta in ay jirka dheeli tiraan marka ay biyaha galayso—sida lagu arko hippopotamus-ka, otter-ka, iyo shimbiro sida penguins-ka. Qoraa kale oo la yiraahdo Erik Seiffert kana socda Jaamacadda Stony Brook, ayaa sheegay in caddeymaha laga helay lafaha iyo hidde-sidaha ay muujinayaan in maroodiyada iyo manatee-yadu ay asal ahaan kasoo jeedeen Afrika. Sidaas darteed, xogta cusub ee la xiriirta anthracobunidae ee Aasiya waxay bidhaamisay fahamkii hore ee khaldan ee cilmiga.

article_content: Rhonda Meath, a 51-year-old waitress from Bethel, Minnesota, recently won an $11.7 million lottery jackpot. Rather than changing her life dramatically, she's chosen to stick to her regular routine—including her shifts at the Lake Elmo Inn. Rhonda and her retired husband, Joe, say the big win won’t alter their lifestyle. 'Life goes on as usual—I still have to mow the lawn, get the mail, and put my grandkids on the bus,' Rhonda said after her win. article_content: Tour de France cyclists have raised concerns about the growing trend of spectators taking selfies near the race, citing potential safety dangers for both fans and riders. The issue escalated on Sunday, when Team Garmin-Sharp’s Lithuanian rider Ramunas Navardauskas lost his temper on the climb up Holme Moss in the South Pennines. Video footage shows Navardauskas knocking a phone out of one spectator’s hand and attempting to do the same to another, after both tried to take close-up photos of the peloton. Many riders have warned that stepping into the road for photos while the fast-moving peloton passes can cause serious injuries. American cyclist Tejay van Garderen called the selfie craze 'a dangerous mix of vanity and stupidity,' and he reported suffering a knee injury after colliding with a spectator. He tweeted, 'Standing in the middle of the road with your back turned while 200 cyclists come at you, just to take a selfie. Think.' Crowds lined the race route as the Tour began in Yorkshire, but some fans’ behavior caused safety concerns among the riders, especially on narrow roads. Some spectators even climbed walls and camped out to get the best photos. Riders, including British Olympic gold medallist Geraint Thomas, noted the risks, saying, 'The worst thing is when people have got their backs to the peloton taking selfies… People don’t understand how fast we go.' Team Sky’s Sir Dave Brailsford praised British fans for their support but echoed concerns about safety. Marcel Kittel of Team Giant-Shimano claimed victory in Stage Three as the race passed landmarks like the Houses of Parliament. Despite general appreciation for the enthusiastic crowds, riders urge fans to maintain a safe distance and prioritize everyone’s safety.

article_content: On Friday, the global cryptocurrency market reversed its earlier gains, declining by 2.62% to approximately $1.4 trillion in total value. By 12:34 p.m., Bitcoin was trading 3.4% lower at $36,338, and Ethereum, the second most popular digital asset, had fallen 4% to $1,981. Sathvik Vishwanath, Co-Founder and CEO of Unocoin, noted that Bitcoin faced a sharp drop after failing to break past the $38,000 resistance level. He cited the US Securities and Exchange Commission’s (SEC) delay in ruling on Hashdex’s bitcoin ETF conversion as a possible driver of the intraday selloff. Vishwanath added that broader economic factors, including the expectation of US Federal Reserve policy tightening in 2024, are influencing the cryptocurrency market. He explained that technical chart patterns indicate a possible bullish trend for Bitcoin if it manages to break through the $38,000 level, potentially setting up a test of $40,000. Parth Chaturvedi, Investments Lead at CoinSwitch Ventures, commented that although the overall crypto market declined due to a market correction phase, positive recent US inflation data has improved sentiment. This has contributed to a shift toward riskier assets, helping cushion selling pressure in the crypto sector. Other prominent alternative cryptocurrencies also experienced significant losses: Solana dropped 12.6%, Polygon sank 8%, and BNB, XRP, Cardano, Avalanche, Chainlink, Toncoin, and Polkadot fell between 3% and 7%. In the last 24 hours, Bitcoin’s market capitalization fell to $709 billion, representing a dominance of 51.01% according to CoinMarketCap. Bitcoin trading volume shrank by 8.6% to $26.12 billion. The CoinDCX Research Team pointed out that, technically, Bitcoin remains resilient on a higher time frame, staying above its 20-day Exponential Moving Average and maintaining support from an upward trendline. WazirX Vice President Rajagopal Menon provided additional technical analysis: Bitcoin’s 10-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA) signaled a 'Buy' at $36,350 and its 200-day EMA at $29,054. Similarly, the 10-day and 200-day Simple Moving Averages (SMA) gave 'Buy' signals at $36,634 and $28,881, respectively. The Relative Strength Index (14) stood at 60 (neutral), Stochastic %K (14, 3, 3) at 68, and Average Directional Index (14) at 64, both suggesting a neutral market outlook. Meanwhile, the MACD Level (12, 26) at 1,372 indicated a 'Sell', while the Stochastic RSI Fast (3, 3, 14, 14) at 17 and William's Percentage at -46 were both neutral. Note: Expert opinions and recommendations expressed are those of the quoted individuals and do not represent the views of The Economic Times.

article_content: MUMBAI: City traffic police have announced traffic restrictions in South Mumbai for the Navy Marathon scheduled on November 19. The following roads—Veer Nariman Road, MG Road, KB Patil Road, MK Road, Walchand Hirachand Marg, DN Road, HT Parikh Marg, Dinshaw Wachha Road, Hotel Oberoi, Hotel Trident, Dorabji Tata Road, Madam Cama Road, Solapur Street, Pune Street, Kalyan Street, Thana Street, Kurla Street, Surat Street, and Ahmedabad Street—will be closed for vehicular traffic from 4am to 10am on Sunday. Additionally, MG Road to OCS Junction will be closed in both directions from 11pm on November 18 until 10am on November 19. Similar urban challenges are taking place in other Indian cities: In Panaji, Goa, activists are urging authorities to prioritize heritage preservation during Smart City works, which they believe threaten historical landmarks and the city's character. There is concern over the construction of buildings that may not align with the city's heritage, and calls to protect trees, art spaces, and signage. In Chennai, inadequate street lighting has raised safety concerns, especially for women. Residents have complained that the Greater Chennai Corporation has been slow in installing and maintaining streetlights under the Nirbhaya scheme, identifying 152 dark spots where improved lighting is needed. In Nagpur, ongoing infrastructure work and the closure of two key roads have led to significant traffic disruptions. Closures near Kadbi Chowk-Mominpura and Kingsway-railway station, as well as ongoing construction at the railway station flyover and bridges over the Nag river, have caused slow traffic and diversions in major areas.

A recent survey suggests that having a rebellious streak could boost your chances of success—and appeal to potential romantic partners. The poll, conducted among 2,000 adults by Sailor Jerry rum, found that 58% believe playing it safe, or being a 'goody two-shoes,' doesn't get you far. One in four women said they're attracted to men who have a rebellious side, while almost twice as many are drawn to strong, independent personalities.

When it comes to famous British rebels, historical figures and celebrities top the list. King Henry VIII was voted the ultimate rebel, followed by former footballer Vinnie Jones and rock singer Ozzy Osbourne. Other notable names include actor Oliver Reed, Sex Pistols musician Sid Vicious, Guy Fawkes, comedian Russell Brand, the pirate Blackbeard, the legendary Robin Hood, and the fictional spy James Bond. Surprisingly, wartime prime minister Winston Churchill did not make the top 10, with others like Sid Vicious and Russell Brand securing higher spots.

The study also ranked fictional rebels, with John McClane (Bruce Willis) from the Die Hard films coming out as the favorite on-screen rebel. JR Ewing from Dallas and Jules Winnfield (Samuel L. Jackson) from Pulp Fiction followed.

Rebellion is a theme in music as well, with Steppenwolf's 'Born to be Wild' voted the top rebellion anthem, ahead of Rage Against the Machine's 'Killing in the Name' and Guns N' Roses' 'Welcome to the Jungle.'

Half of both young adults (aged 18-24) and those over 55 believe that being ruthless and seizing opportunities are key to getting ahead. In contrast, only 15% think following rules is important for success. Meanwhile, 46% of modern men say they're attracted to women who are unique and outspoken.

This year also marks 100 years since the birth of Norman 'Sailor Jerry' Collins, the iconic tattoo artist whose name is behind the Sailor Jerry rum. Among those voted as top British rebels is the hard-living actor Oliver Reed.

article_content: Casey James Fury, a civilian employee at Portsmouth Naval Shipyard in Kittery, Maine, received a sentence of just over 17 years in federal prison for arson. Fury confessed to starting a fire on the USS Miami, a nuclear submarine, in May 2012 to leave work amid an anxiety attack. The blaze, which he began by setting a bag of rags alight with a lighter, quickly escalated, filling the vessel with smoke, injuring seven people, and causing between $400–$450 million in damage. Containing the fire required the efforts of more than 100 firefighters over 12 hours. At age 25 and a resident of Portsmouth, New Hampshire, Fury also admitted to starting a second, less destructive fire several weeks after the first. The court required him to pay $400 million in restitution in addition to his prison time. Prosecutors highlighted Fury’s repeated actions after the initial significant damage, whereas his defense attorney pointed to Fury’s mental health struggles and lack of malicious intent. Firefighters encountered extremely hazardous conditions during the first incident. Shipyard firefighter Eric Hardy described the challenges, likening it to battling a fire in a wood stove with virtually no visibility and limited air supply. The blaze damaged the living quarters, control center, and torpedo room, though the nuclear propulsion area was unaffected. Metallurgists found no critical damage to the hull, and the Navy determined repairs were cost-effective, even as mandatory federal budget reductions slowed progress. The fire’s effects rippled through Navy operations, causing delays in repairs and longer deployments for other crews. Upon release, Fury’s sentence includes five years of probation. He has expressed deep regret, apologizing to those affected and stating he never intended harm or disrespect.

Fury wuxuu qirtay inuu dab ka shiday quusaale nukliyeer ah oo ah USS Miami bishii May 2012, isagoo rabay inuu shaqada ka baxo sababo la xiriira welwel nafeed. article_content: A city councillor has revealed that Barton House in Bristol, evacuated in an emergency, was not built according to its original plans. Over 400 residents left the tower block on Tuesday after the council declared a major incident. Kye Dudd, cabinet member for housing services and energy, explained the issue relates to the building's concrete sections. 'If the building had been constructed to design, we wouldn’t have this problem,' he said. 'The core issue lies within the building’s construction; it wasn’t built to specification.' Bristol City Council declared a major incident after surveys of three of the block’s 98 flats indicated Barton House, built in 1958, would be unsafe during a fire, explosion, or large impact. The council clarified that Barton House does not use reinforced autoclaved aerated concrete (RAAC), which has caused problems elsewhere. Mr. Dudd stated: 'On Monday, I attended a briefing with the structural engineer’s report, and the findings were concerning. I told the team to prepare for a possible emergency evacuation. We also consulted the fire brigade and planned for relocating residents if necessary.' He emphasized, 'We had to make decisions based on the information available, as resident safety is paramount.' The council notified the Department for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities about the structural issue causing evacuation. BCC confirmed this issue does not affect other buildings in Bristol. Residents were asked to pack enough clothes for several days and either stay with friends, family, or rest centres. Many were taken by bus to temporary accommodation, with their belongings in bags and suitcases. Bristol’s mayor, Marvin Rees, said letters have been sent to residents with updates. 'We’re working quickly to complete more surveys to assess the structure and determine when it will be safe to return,' he said. 'This process may take time, so residents must stay away while surveys are ongoing. We are working as fast as possible to arrange suitable temporary accommodation.' Wilfred Stewart, a 10th-floor resident, showed the BBC cracks in his flat’s walls and beams. 'This crack has been here for years, by my back door,' he said. 'The wall is almost separated from the door.' Mr. Stewart said there are many elderly people and children in the building. 'Some people got hotel rooms, but many went to the mosque or local GP clinic. I hope there will be better communication today.' Another resident, living in Barton House for nine years, said she stayed with a friend and her two children after evacuating. 'After tonight, I don’t know where I’m going to go.' Nuh Sharif, another resident, said his family had a difficult night in a hotel and doubts they’ll return, feeling unsafe. 'I don’t want to put my wife and kids at risk,' he said. 'Last night was very hard for us. We didn’t sleep. We’ve come back to get more information about what happens next.' A resident on the first floor, who has lived there six years, decided to remain in the block on Tuesday night despite advice. 'I went to the meeting points, but no one seemed to know what was happening,' she said. 'There is no update yet today, and I’ll be back tonight.' Others in the community reported shock and panic. Khalil Abdi of Bristol Horn Youth Concern said: 'People finished work, picked up their children, and heard the news from the media. The whole area is shocked, not just this building. People had panic attacks—it was very difficult for everyone. The council needs to clearly explain how long people will be away from their homes and in temporary accommodation.' Barton Hill Academy confirmed that 20 pupils were affected. Headteacher Matthew Poulson said: 'When we heard the news, we quickly organized support for families. Some students attended school today, others couldn’t. We’re contacting families to provide practical and emotional support as needed.'
