article_content: Meri Brown, a prominent cast member of TLC’s 'Sister Wives,' stated that she was the one who initiated her legal divorce from Kody Brown, officially ending their marriage from a legal perspective. The development caught the show’s audience off guard, as the series has long chronicled the Brown family’s polygamist lifestyle and their 17 children in Utah. Kody Brown recently confirmed that he and Meri quietly finalized their divorce in the fall of 2014. Soon after, Kody married Robyn, his fourth wife, in a legal ceremony. This maneuver remained private for some time but became a focus in the fifth season’s finale. A promotional clip for the season finale captures an emotional Meri signing the divorce documents and informing her fellow sister wives about the change. The family issued a statement saying the decision to end the legal marriage was mutual and allowed them to ‘legally restructure’ their household. Through his legal marriage to Robyn, Kody obtained the ability to legally provide for her three children from a previous relationship—Dayton, Aurora, and Breanna—offering them enhanced security, health insurance, and other protections. Robyn also shares a biological son, Solomon, with Kody, and all her children refer to Kody as their father. Even after the divorce, Meri remained with the family in a spiritual capacity. This approach, where Kody is legally married to just one wife, helps the family comply with Utah's anti-polygamy laws. His marriages to Janelle and Christine are spiritual, not legal. Since its debut in 2010, 'Sister Wives' has advocated for acceptance of polygamist families and shares the Browns’ faith background as members of the Apostolic United Brethren. With the announcement of a sixth season, viewers will continue to follow the family's changes. Support for Meri surged from fans, while the Browns reiterated the legal divorce was a shared, practical decision to benefit Robyn’s children. Despite the restructuring, the Browns remain a tight-knit unit in their Las Vegas homes and manage their business, ‘My Sister Wives Closet.’ The fifth season finale, airing March 1, will depict Meri signing the divorce papers and feature an in-depth interview with the family led by Tamron Hall. article_content: A cemetery in Sutton Bridge, Lincolnshire, is planning to introduce super-sized graves amid growing concerns about obesity rates. The local parish council has developed plans for 30 extra-large burial plots, located close to the roadway to assist funeral directors who have found it challenging to transport heavier coffins long distances. This initiative follows requests from funeral directors and is being led by Parish Councillor Vicky Hills. The council hopes to open a new three-acre burial ground at Fields Farm North next year to address space shortages at the current churchyard, where standard plots measure 9ft by 4ft. In the new cemetery, additional plots measuring 9ft by 8ft—nearly double the width of traditional graves—will be placed near the entrance. Councillor Hills attributes the need for larger graves to rising obesity, noting that costs will be higher for these larger plots. Exact pricing has yet to be determined. Councillor Hills commented, 'Obesity is becoming more of a problem in today’s climate. The larger graves were requested so undertakers would not have to carry heavy coffins far from the road.' While standard caskets are generally 24 to 27 inches wide, manufacturers are now making coffins up to 52 inches wide, capable of holding individuals weighing up to 1,000 pounds. The price for super-sized graves is still being finalized, but is expected to be higher than for standard plots. Similar efforts have been made in other areas; last year, Rochford Council in Essex announced it would provide larger graves. However, Sutton Bridge’s new site is believed to be the first in the UK to set aside a dedicated section for larger plots. Tam Fry, from the National Obesity Forum, described the council’s plan as sensible but expressed concern that dedicating an area for larger graves could cause stigma for families. Elsewhere in the UK, rising obesity rates have led to changes in funeral services and public infrastructure. Hospital morgues, crematoriums, and ambulance services have had to introduce larger equipment and vehicles. The East Midlands Ambulance Service has added 128 bigger ambulances, each able to carry patients weighing up to 55 stone (about 770 pounds). Recent figures show that 20% of Year 6 children in Lincolnshire are classified as obese, a rate above the national average. The new burial ground is expected to cost over £200,000, with a planning application due to be submitted to South Holland District Council. The cemetery is projected to serve the community for around 100 years.

article_content: Portuguese Prime Minister Antonio Costa announced his resignation on Tuesday after being implicated in a far-reaching corruption investigation. In a televised address, Costa stated he had formally resigned to President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa, saying, “Given the circumstances, I have presented my resignation.” The resignation was announced after police arrested Costa’s chief of staff during raids on government offices and other properties connected to the inquiry. The state prosecutor’s office said the Supreme Court is reviewing how suspects used Costa’s name in allegedly illicit activities. Costa, 62, who has led Portugal’s Socialist party since 2015, denied any wrongdoing and voiced his confidence in Portugal’s justice system. During an emotional address, he publicly thanked his family, stating, “I assure the Portuguese people my conscience is clear and that I am not above the law.” President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa is expected to accept Costa’s resignation soon. Authorities have issued arrest warrants for Vitor Escaria (chief of staff), the mayor of Sines, and three others over concerns about fleeing or tampering with evidence. The Minister of Infrastructure, Joao Galamba, and the head of the national environmental agency are also listed as suspects. The investigation focuses on alleged corruption, official misconduct, and influence peddling. It is linked to lithium mining concessions near Portugal’s northern border with Spain, as well as plans for a green hydrogen facility and a data center in Sines. Police raids included ministries, the Sines town council, and private properties. According to prosecutors, the suspects reportedly invoked Costa’s name when carrying out the alleged offenses. The lithium and green hydrogen projects are considered key elements of the European Union’s environmental initiatives. Costa ended his speech by stating that he had no prior knowledge of the investigation into his conduct, and that this marks the close of his tenure as prime minister.
translated_content: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Portugal António Costa ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inuu xilka iska casilay Talaado kadib markii lagu eedeeyay musuqmaasuq baahsan. Khudbad si toos ah looga daawanayay telefishinka ayuu Costa ku sheegay inuu si rasmi ah iscasilaadiisa ugu gudbiyay Madaxweynaha Portugal, Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa, isagoo xusay, 'Marka la eego xaaladda, waxaan iscasilaadayda u gudbiyay Madaxweynaha.' Iscasilaaddu waxay dhacday kadib markii boolisku xireen madaxa xafiiskiisa intii lagu guda jiray hawlgallo lagu qaaday xafiisyo dawladeed iyo dhismayaal kale oo lala xiriirinayo baaritaanka. Xafiiska xeer-ilaaliyaha ayaa sheegay in Maxkamadda Sare ay eegayso sida magac Costa loogu isticmaalay falal sharci-darro ah oo la tuhunsan yahay. Costa, oo 62 jir ah isla markaana hogaaminayay xisbiga Socialist-ka tan iyo 2015, ayaa beeniyay wax dembi ah inuu galay isagoo adkeeyay kalsoonidiisa nidaamka cadaaladda. Isagoo dareen leh ayuu uga mahadceliyay qoyskiisa taageerada ay la garab taagnaayeen, isagoo yiri, 'Waxaan shacabka Portugal ugu cadeeyay in damiirkaygu nadiif yahay, oo aanan sharciga ka sarreyn.' La filayaa in Madaxweynaha Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa uu aqbalo iscasilaadda Costa dhawaan. Boolisku waxay xabsiga u taxaabeen Vitor Escaria (madaxa xafiiska), duqa magaalada Sines, iyo saddex qof oo kale sababo la xiriira cabsi baxsad ama wax laga badalo caddeymo. Sidoo kale, Wasiirka Isku-xirka, João Galamba, iyo madaxa hay’adda deegaanka ayaa la sheegay inay yihiin eedeysanayaal. Baaritaanka ayaa diiradda saaray tuhunno musuqmaasuq, ku xadgudub xafiiseed iyo ku takri fal awoodeed, kuwaasoo la xiriira rukhsadaha macdanta lithium ee xadka woqooyi ee Spain iyo qorsheyaal lagu dhisayo warshad hydrogen cagaaran iyo xarun xog ururin oo Sines ku taalla koonfurta dalka. Hawlgallada booliska waxay ka dhaceen wasaarado, golaha magaalada Sines iyo guryo iyo xafiisyo gaar loo leeyahay. Xafiiska xeer-ilaaliyaha ayaa sheegay in eedeysanayaasha la tuhunsan yahay inay magac Costa adeegsadeen marka ay fulinayeen falalkan sharci-darrada ah. Mashaariicda lithium iyo hydrogen-ka cagaaran waxay laf-dhabar u yihiin qorshaha deegaanka Midowga Yurub. Costa wuxuu ugu dambeyn sheegay inuusan horey wax war uga hayn baaritaanka lagu hayo, islamarkaana tani ay astaan u tahay dhammaadka xilkiisa ra’iisulwasaarenimo.

article_content: Walking along Prince Street in Old Town Alexandria, Virginia, it’s easy to feel transported to another era. Historic gas lanterns glow on ornate townhouses, cobblestone streets wind toward the waterfront, and the old Torpedo Factory stands as a reminder of the past. Horse-drawn carriages still travel these streets, guided by costumed storytellers. Amid these echoes of history is Curtis Blues, a dedicated musician and preservationist of the Mississippi Delta blues tradition. On many afternoons, his tunes fill the air, drawing curious tourists to his impromptu street performances. Blues demonstrates unique historical instruments, such as the one-string diddley bow—a simple homemade device with roots in early blues music. Using a metal slide, he coaxes distinctive notes from its single wire and explains its origins. Blues’ repertoire also includes a harmonica and a resonator guitar, evoking an authentic blues sound. He has been passionate about blues music since age 14, inspired by encounters with legendary folk and blues musicians. His mission is to preserve the acoustic blues style as it existed before it shifted to the electric, Chicago sound. For the past 14 years, Blues has performed a one-man-band show near the Old Torpedo Factory. He plays multiple instruments simultaneously, echoing the tradition of riverfront street performers. His busking approach invites audience participation, especially from children, by inviting them to join in as a percussion section. These interactive moments not only entertain but educate, cultivating appreciation for live music. Blues often jokes about his 'huge family'—the children helping him as part of his show—when encouraging tips, injecting humor and warmth into his act. Later, he plays a homemade cigar-box banjo and sings classic blues songs like ‘Turkey-Legged Woman,’ personally engaging with spectators. He emphasizes the importance of valuing live, unamplified music, and encourages families to support street performances as cherished cultural experiences. Blues remains optimistic about the future of blues, believing its emotional resonance ensures its ongoing relevance. As the evening falls, the atmosphere shifts but Blues continues to play, committed to entertaining and educating as long as there are listeners.
translated_content: Marka aad ku socoto Prince Street ee Old Town Alexandria, Virginia, waxaa sahlan in aad dareento sidii adigoo waqtiga dib ugu laabtay. Laambadaha gaaska ah ee taariikhiga ah ayaa ifaya albaabada guryaha, waddooyinka dhagaxa ah ayaa u jiheeya biyaha xeebta, halka Warshaddii hore ee Torpedo Factory ay weli taagan tahay sidii calaamad hore. Gawaarida xoolaha lagu jiido ayaa weli soconaya, iyadoo dad xiran dhar dhaqameed ay dadka sheekooyin ka sheekaynayaan. Dhexda taariikhdaas waxaa jooga Curtis Blues, oo ah fannaan iyo badbaadiye hidaha Blues-ka Delta Mississippi. Galabaha qaar, codkiisa ayaa hawada ka yeedha, isagoo dadka socdaalka ah ku soo jiidanaya bandhigyo toos ah oo uu waddooyinka ka sameeyo. Blues wuxuu tijaabiyaa qalabyo muusig oo taariikhi ah, sida diddley bow—qalab fudud oo guriga lagu sameeyo isla markaana asal u ah heesaha blues-ka. Isagoo adeegsanaya bir yar, wuxuu ka abuuraa cod gaar ah xadhiggiisa kaliya una sharaxaya taariikhdiisa. Instrumentiyada Blues waxaa kamid ah harmonica iyo gitaar resonator ah, taasoo soo saarta cod dhab ah oo blues ah. Wuxuu bilaabay xiisaha heesaha blues-da isagoo 14 jir ah, isagoo dhiirrigelin ka helay fannaankii hore ee folk iyo blues. Hadafkiisa waa inuu badbaadiyo qaabka blues-da akustikada ah ee uu kasoo bilowday ka hor intii aan la koronto gelin oo laga dhigay muusig kooxeed oo Chicago ah. 14-kii sano ee la soo dhaafay, Blues wuxuu hal-istaag ku soo bandhigayay bandhig blues ah agagaarka Torpedo Factory. Isagoo marar badan ka duma durbaanno, gitaar iyo harmonica hal mar, wuxuu dib u cusbooneysiiyaa dhaqankii muusigga waddooyinka webiga ka ag dhow. Qaabka uu u busking gareeyo wuxuu dadka daawashada ah, gaar ahaan carruurta, ku dhiirrigeliyaa inay ku biiraan qeybta durbaanka. Kuwaas ayaa kalsooni, farxad iyo aqoon u kordhiya dadka daawada ee la kulmaya muusigga tooska ah. Mararka qaar, Blues wuxuu kaftamaa isagoo sheegay in 'qoys weyn' uu leeyahay—carruurta safkiisa ka mid ah—markuu dadka ku dhiirrigelinayo inay tip sameeyaan. Intaas ka dib, wuxuu qaataa banjo laga sameeyay sanduuq sigaar ah, wuxuuna qaadayaa heeso caadi ah oo blues sida ‘Turkey-Legged Woman’ isagoo si toos ah ula falgalaya dadkii daawanayay. Wuxuu xoogga saaraya in la qiimeeyo muusigga tooska ah ee aan la koronto gelin, wuxuuna waalidiinta iyo qoysaska ku boorinayaa inay taageeraan muusig-yahannada dibadda oo ay kala socdaan qiimaha dhaqanka. Blues wuxuu aamminsan yahay in mustaqbalka blues-ka uu ifaya yahay maadaama ruuxa bini’aadamku uu si gaar ah ula falgalo blues-ka. Marka qoraxdu dhacdo, jawigu wuu is beddelaa laakiin Blues weli wuu sii ciyaaraa, isagoo go’aansaday inuu dadka wacyigeliyo oo madadaaliyo ilaa intay jiraan dad daawanaya.

article_content: A pregnant woman, Kerry Deane, was required to undergo a medical examination on a crowded plane to prove she was fit to fly. Ms. Deane, who was 35 weeks pregnant and not showing symptoms of labor, was asked by staff on the Thomson Holidays flight to be examined at the front of the plane by two doctors in an area used for food preparation. Despite carrying a letter from her GP confirming her fitness to fly, Ms. Deane was eventually escorted off the flight along with her partner and three children. As a result, the family had to take a 19-hour journey home instead of the usual four-hour flight from Tunisia to Glasgow. Ms. Deane described the experience as distressing and humiliating, stating that she did not receive an apology from Thomson. She said, 'The way we were treated was a disgrace. I was upset and crying, but they did not take any notice.' Prior to departure, Ms. Deane had checked with her GP and received confirmation she was under the 36-week cut-off for flying. Thomson Holidays, which was not operating the flight that day, said it was operated by a third-party airline and that policies for pregnant travelers can vary between airlines. According to NHS guidance, flying during pregnancy is usually safe, but the final decision rests with airlines. British Airways does not allow women to fly beyond 36 weeks, with earlier cut-offs for multiple pregnancies. EasyJet allows flying up to 35 weeks, and Ryanair and Emirates have similar policies. Ms. Deane and her family were not provided vouchers for food or water while waiting for an alternative flight, and she incurred additional expenses contacting her relatives. She emphasized her dissatisfaction with how the situation was handled. She had checked with Thomson and her GP multiple times prior to traveling, and provided the necessary documentation. A spokesman for Thomson said the company was sorry for Ms. Deane's experience but reiterated the flight was operated by a third party and that airline policies can differ. As Ms. Deane is seeking legal advice, Thomson declined to comment further.

Maadaama Ms. Deane ay la tashanayso qareen, Thomson kama bixin wax faahfaahin dheeri ah.

article_content: Rebecca Johnson, 30, developed rhabdomyolysis after just one hour with a personal trainer at her local LA Fitness gym in Brighton. During her initial session, Rebecca pushed herself despite difficulty, believing 'no pain, no gain.' Soon after, she was hospitalized with severe muscle damage resulting from overexertion. Doctors diagnosed rhabdomyolysis, a rare condition that could have led to kidney failure if not treated promptly. She spent four days in the hospital on an IV drip and has not been able to return to work as a goldsmith due to ongoing weakness in her arms. Rebecca, an experienced runner, paid £40 for the session and now wants to warn others about the risks of excessive exercise, even with professional help. She explained that she did pull-ups, weights, and bench press-ups, mentioning her struggles to the trainer but was encouraged to keep going. The next day, she was in severe pain, unable to straighten her arms, and noticed her urine was tea-colored, a typical sign of rhabdomyolysis. By evening, her arms were swollen, prompting her to visit a doctor, who admitted her to the hospital immediately. Rhabdomyolysis occurs when muscle tissue breaks down from intense activity, releasing toxins that can damage the kidneys and heart. Although often associated with trauma, it can also result from extreme exercise and can even affect professional athletes. Treatment includes intravenous fluids to help flush out harmful substances. Rebecca feels very lucky to be alive. Three weeks later, her arms remain weak, and doctors expect full recovery may take a month. She has lodged a complaint with LA Fitness, believing trainers should be better aware of such risks. A spokesman for LA Fitness said all trainers are qualified and that after Rebecca's experience, staff have been advised to stay alert to rare conditions like rhabdomyolysis.

Waxay afar maalmood isbitaalka ku jirtay iyadoo la siinayay irbado biyo ah, mana aysan awoodin inay shaqadeeda dahablaha dib ugu laabato sababtoo ah gacmaha oo daciif ah. Fiidkii, gacmaheedu way barareen, waxayna la xiriirtay dhakhtar, kaasoo u diray isbitaalka markiiba. Rhabdomyolysis waxay dhacdaa marka murqaha jaban ee la xad-dhaafiyo ay soo daayaan sun waxyeello leh, taasoo dhaawici karta kalyaha iyo wadnaha. Inkastoo caadiyan lala xiriiriyo dhaawacyada daran, jimicsi xad dhaaf ah – xitaa ciyaartoyda xirfadlayaasha ah – ayaa lagu keeni karaa. Waxay cabasho u qortay LA Fitness, iyadoo ku talisay in tababarayaasha si wanaagsan loo wacyi galiyo qatarta rhabdomyolysis. Afhayeenka LA Fitness ayaa sheegay dhammaan tababarayaashu inay yihiin kuwo aqoon leh, lagana codsaday in ay ka feejignaadaan xaaladaha noocan oo kale ah kadib dhacdada Rebecca.

article_content: Caroline Ellison testified in court on Tuesday that her former partner, Sam Bankman-Fried, believed he could gain influence by donating 'small' amounts of money to politicians. Ellison took the witness stand during Bankman-Fried's criminal trial, where he faces seven counts and has pleaded not guilty. Prosecutors allege Bankman-Fried defrauded customers and investors of FTX, his now-defunct cryptocurrency exchange, by moving their funds to Alameda Research, his hedge fund, without their knowledge or consent. As part of her testimony in Manhattan federal court, Ellison, the former CEO of Alameda Research, said Bankman-Fried donated $10 million to Joe Biden in 2020. Federal Election Commission records show Bankman-Fried personally donated $52,800 directly to Biden's Victory Fund and Biden for President in 2020, but is also accused of making donations under other people's names. Campaign finance data indicates Bankman-Fried also donated millions to state Democratic committees and other progressive groups in 2020. Ellison said the money given to Biden was a small sum for Bankman-Fried and that he believed it brought him important recognition. She added, 'He thought it was very effective, that you could get very high returns for relatively small amounts of money.' Ellison also testified that Bankman-Fried believed he might become US president one day. While compiling a balance sheet for Alameda in 2022, Ellison said she noticed a $35 million loan to former FTX executive Ryan Salame, which she understood was for donations to Republican candidates. Salame, one of Bankman-Fried's political associates, stated in September 2022 that he donated $13.4 million to that year's Republican primary races. Last month, Salame pleaded guilty to defrauding the FEC and making an illegal campaign contribution on behalf of a company. Ellison told the jury, 'He said he really valued Ryan for his loyalty.' In the 2022 campaign cycle alone, Bankman-Fried contributed over $40 million to political donations, primarily to progressive funds, according to FEC data. The Protect Our Future PAC, which supported Democratic congressional candidates, received $27 million from Bankman-Fried, FEC records show. Ellison has pleaded guilty to four criminal counts herself and is testifying as part of a cooperation deal. Ellison also described her on-and-off romantic relationship with Bankman-Fried from 2019 to 2022, which became official in 2020. 'The whole time we were dating, he was also my boss, so that created some awkward situations,' she testified. Representatives for Bankman-Fried did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Insider.

Ellison waxay ku fadhiday kursiga markhaatiga inta lagu jiray maxkamadda dacwadda ee Bankman-Fried, kaasoo wajahaya todobo eedeymo ah oo uu sheegay inuusan galin. Dacwad-oogayaashu waxay ku eedeeyeen Bankman-Fried inuu khiyaaneeyay macaamiisha iyo maalgashadayaasha shirkadda FTX, oo hadda xiran, isagoo lacagtooda u wareejiyay Alameda Research, oo ah sanduuq maalgashi uu leeyahay, iyada oo aan oggolaansho laga helin. Intii ay markhaatiga ka bixinaysay maxkamadda federaalka Manhattan, Ellison, oo ahayd agaasimihii guud ee Alameda Research, waxay sheegtay in Bankman-Fried uu $10 milyan ugu deeqay Joe Biden 2020-kii. Diiwaanka Guddiga Doorashooyinka Federaalka (FEC) wuxuu muujinayaa in Bankman-Fried si shaqsi ahaan ah ugu deeqay $52,800 sanduuqa Biden Victory Fund iyo Biden for President sanadkii 2020, iyadoo lagu eedeeyay inuu sidoo kale bixiyay deeqo oo magacyo dad kale lagu qoray. Xogta maaliyadda ololaha waxay sheegtay in Bankman-Fried uu sidoo kale malaayiin ku deeqay guddiyada dimoqraadiga gobollada iyo kooxo horumarineed 2020. Ellison waxay sheegtay in lacagta la siiyay Biden ay ahayd mid yar oo Bankman-Fried uu aaminsanaa inuu aqoonsi muhiim ah kasoo helay. Waxay tiri, 'Wuxuu u arkay inay aad waxtar u leedahay oo aad ka heli karto faa'iido sare lacag yar.' Ellison waxay sidoo kale marqaati furtay in Bankman-Fried uu rumaysnaa inay suurtogal tahay inuu maalin maalmaha ka mid ah noqdo madaxweynaha Mareykanka. Markii ay diyaarinaysay warbixinta xisaabaadka ee Alameda ee 2022, Ellison waxay aragtay $35 milyan oo amaah ah oo la siiyay Ryan Salame, oo ay markii dambe fahantay in loogu talagalay deeqo lagu taageerayo musharixiinta Jamhuuriga. Salame, oo kamid ahaa xiriiriye-yaasha siyaasadeed ee Bankman-Fried, wuxuu bishii September 2022 sheegay inuu $13.4 milyan ugu deeqay tartamada hordhaca Doorashooyinka Jamhuuriga ee sanadkaas. Bishii hore, Salame wuxuu qirtay dambiga ah inuu khiyaameeyay FEC iyo inuu si sharci darro ah ugu deeqay shirkad. Ellison maxkamadda ayay u sheegtay, 'Wuxuu aad u qadarinayay Ryan daacadnimadiisa.' Ololaha doorashada 2022 kaliya, Bankman-Fried wuxuu bixiyay in ka badan $40 milyan oo deeq ah, badankoodna loo diray sanduuqyada horumarineed sida ay muujinayso xogta FEC. Protect Our Future PAC, oo taageertay musharrixiin badan oo Democrat ah, ayaa heshay $27 milyan oo Bankman-Fried uu bixiyay, sida diiwaanka FEC muujinayo. Ellison waxay qiratay afar eedeymood oo dambiya ah, waxaana ay markhaati u tahay heshiis wadashaqeyn ah. Ellison waxay sidoo kale ka hadashay xiriirkeedii kala go’a ahaa ee Bankman-Fried laga bilaabo 2019 ilaa 2022, kaas oo rasmi noqday 2020. 'Waqtiga oo dhan markii aan is-barbar soconnay, wuxuu sidoo kale ahaa maamulahayga, taasna waxay keentay xaalado xanuun badan,' ayay markhaati furtay. Wakiillada Bankman-Fried kama aysan jawaabin codsi xog-ogaalnimo oo ka yimid Insider.

article_content: On Monday, the Nigerian Presidency attributed the country's current democratic situation to former President Olusegun Obasanjo. Bayo Onanuga, Special Adviser to President Tinubu on Information and Strategy, told The PUNCH that Nigeria’s democracy, as practised today, originated from Obasanjo's direct input, both as military Head of State (1976–1979) and as civilian President (1999–2007). Onanuga remarked, 'Obasanjo should know he was the one who brought this system to Nigeria, making us adopt it in 1979. He must have noticed it was expensive and perhaps unsuitable during his eight years as President, and he even once tried to extend his term in office. The way he speaks now suggests he is seeing things differently after leaving office.' The comments from the Presidency followed remarks made by Obasanjo at a high-level meeting on Rethinking Western Liberal Democracy in Africa, held at the Green Resort Legacy, Olusegun Obasanjo Presidential Library, in Abeokuta. There, Obasanjo criticized Western democracy, suggesting it had not brought good governance or development to Africa. Obasanjo argued for a reconsideration and adaptation of democratic systems to better fit African contexts, citing the Western model's lack of regard for Africa's history and diversity. He proposed an 'Afro democracy,' a new model tailored to the continent’s unique needs. Obasanjo described the flaw in liberal democracy as being not home-grown and failing to take into account African history and multicultural realities. He said Western liberal democracy sometimes results in 'government of a few people over the majority, as these few do not always fully represent all the people.' He suggested the majority are often left out. According to Obasanjo, African nations should not operate a system of government in which they had little input in its definition or design. He said the weakness of liberal democracy arises from its history, content, context, and practice, and once you move from direct rule by the people to representative democracy, issues arise. Obasanjo questioned if minority voices should be ignored, and said any government system must ensure the welfare of all the people. Obasanjo called for Africans to examine the performance of democracy both in its place of origin (the West) and how it has functioned after being adopted post-colonially. The Presidency criticized Obasanjo for not pushing for a better system during his time as leader. Onanuga noted that before the military intervened in 1966, Nigeria practised the less expensive British-style parliamentary system. When democracy was restored, it was Obasanjo who accepted the constitutional assembly’s recommendation for the American-style system. Onanuga claimed Obasanjo implemented the presidential system incorrectly, adopting its form and structure but not its underlying spirit, and that during his presidency he even tried to amend the constitution. The debate highlights ongoing concerns about the design and outcomes of Nigeria’s current democratic system, with both Obasanjo and the Presidency expressing dissatisfaction from different perspectives.
translated_content: Isniinta, Madaxtooyada Nigeria waxay mas'uuliyadda xaaladda dimuqraadiyadda hadda ee dalka saartay Madaxweynihii hore Olusegun Obasanjo. Bayo Onanuga, Lataliyaha Gaarka ah ee Madaxweynaha Tinubu ee Warfaafinta iyo Istaraatiijiyadda, ayaa u sheegay The PUNCH in dimuqraadiyadda Nigeria ee maanta ay kasoo bilaabatay doorkii tooska ahaa ee Obasanjo, isagoo ahaa Taliyaha Ciidamada (1976–1979) iyo Madaxweyne rayid ah (1999–2007). Onanuga ayaa yiri, 'Obasanjo waa inuu ogyahay in isagu keenay nidaamkan Nigeria, lagana dhigay in la qaatay 1979. Wuxuu arki lahaa inuu kharash badan yahay oo laga yaabo inuusan ku habboonayn muddadiisii siddeedda sano ee uu madaxweyne ahaa, xitaa wuu isku dayay inuu xilligiisa dheereeyo. Sida uu hadda uga hadlayo arrimaha waxay muujisay inuu arrimo badan fahmay kadib markuu xafiiska ka noqday.' Hadallada Madaxtooyada waxay ka danbeeyeen jawaab-celin ay siisay hadallo uu Obasanjo ka jeediyey shir heer sare ah oo lagaga hadlayey Dib-u-fikirka Dimuqraadiyadda Reer Galbeedka ee Afrika, kaasoo ka dhacay Green Resort Legacy, Maktabadda Madaxweyne Olusegun Obasanjo ee Abeokuta. Halkaa Obasanjo wuxuu dhaliilay dimuqraadiyadda reer galbeedka, isagoo sheegay in aysan keenin maamul wanaagsan iyo horumar Afrika. Obasanjo wuxuu ku baaqay in dib loo eego oo la waafajiyo dimuqraadiyadda si ay ugu habboonaato xaaladda Afrika, isagoo xusay in nidaamka reer galbeedku aanu tixgelin taariikhda iyo kala-duwanaanta Afrika. Wuxuu soo jeediyay 'Afro-democracy', oo ah nidaam cusub oo la jaanqaadaya baahida gaarka ah ee qaaradda. Obasanjo wuxuu sheegay in dhibaatada dimuqraadiyadda liberal ay tahay in aysan ka imaan Afrika oo aysan tixgelin taariikhda iyo dhaqamada kala duwan. Wuxuu yidhi dimuqraadiyada reer galbeed mararka qaar waxay keentaa 'dowlad ay talo ku lee yihiin dad yar oo aan si buuxda u metelin dadka intiisa kale.' Wuxuu xusay in badi dadka la iska ilaawo. Obasanjo wuxuu qabaa in dalalka Afrika aysan qaadan nidaam dowladeed oo aanay wax ku lahaan qaabeyntiisa ama macnihiisa. Wuxuu sheegay in daciifnimada iyo guuldarrada dimuqraadiyadda liberal ay ka timaaddo taariikhdeeda, nuxurkeeda iyo sida loo dhaqmo, iyo in markad ka leexato talo toos ah oo la siiyo shacabka oo loo wareego matalaad, mushkilado soo baxayaan. Obasanjo wuxuu su'aalay haddii tirada yar la iska indho-tiri karo, wuxuuna xusay in nidaam dowladnimo kastaa ay tahay u adeegida danta dadka oo dhan. Obasanjo wuxuu ugu baaqay Afrikaan inay qiimeeyaan sida dimuqraadiyaddu ugu shaqeyso meeshii asalkeedu ahaa (Reer Galbeedka) iyo sida ay ugu shaqeyso Afrika kadib xornimadii. Madaxtooyadu waxay dhaliishay Obasanjo sababta aanu nidaam wanaagsan ugu ololeynin xilligii uu madaxda ahaa. Onanuga wuxuu xusay in kahor 1966, Nigeria ay lahayd nidaam baarlamaan oo Ingiriisku ka tegay, oo jaban. Markii demuqraadiyada la soo celiyay, Obasanjo ayaa aqbalay taladii golaha dastuurka ee dooratay nidaamka Mareykanka. Onanuga wuxuu sheegay in Obasanjo si qaldan u hirgeliyey nidaamka madaxweyne-nimada, isagoo kaliya qaaday qaabkiisa iyo dhismahiisa asagoo seegan ruuxdiisa, intii uu hayey jagada madaxweynenimo, xitaa wuu isku dayay inuu wax ka beddelo dastuurka. Dooddu waxay muujisay wel-welka jira ee la xiriira qaab-dhismeedka iyo natiijooyinka dimuqraadiyadda Nigeria, iyadoo labada dhinacba ay qireen in ay jiraan cillado kala duwan.

article_content: The BBC newsroom was thrown into disarray when news emerged that the Duke of Edinburgh had fallen ill. Staff hurriedly searched for dark clothing and black ties in anticipation that Prince Philip's Christmas Eve heart scare could take a serious turn. This urgency stemmed from fears of repeating a previous incident in 2002, when BBC newsreader Peter Sissons was criticized for wearing a burgundy tie, instead of a black one, while announcing the Queen Mother’s death. Sissons told the Telegraph that staff working during the holiday period were anxious that the Duke might pass away during their shift, prompting preparations such as readying obituaries and appropriate attire. The festive newsroom atmosphere was dampened by the knowledge that any mishandling might be heavily scrutinized afterward. Tim Luckhurst, a former BBC news editor, was remembered by Sissons as saying, 'Please God, not on my shift,' whenever the possibility arose that a senior royal might pass away while he was on duty. Prince Philip, the Queen’s husband, was airlifted to Papworth Hospital in Cambridgeshire on Friday evening after experiencing chest pains. Doctors found a blocked artery and inserted a stent to restore blood flow to his heart—a routine but carefully monitored procedure given his age. He remained in hospital for four nights, much to his reputed displeasure, before being released yesterday morning. He then returned to the Queen's Sandringham estate and reunited with his family. Shortly after returning, Prince Philip joined a family lunch at Wood Farm in Wolferton, an informal retreat on the estate. He was seen departing the farmhouse in the front seat of a Land Rover to head back to the main house, while the rest of the party resumed their pheasant shoot. Known for his enthusiasm for shooting, Philip was disappointed to miss the traditional event but was pleased to attend the family gathering.

Shaqaaluhu si deg-deg ah bay ugu raad-joogeen dhar madow iyo galmooyin madow, iyagoo ka baqaya in dhaawicii wadnaha ee Prince Philip ee habeenkii Kirismaska uu kasii dari karo. Jahwareerkan wuxuu ka dhashay cabsidii ka timi khalad horey dhacay 2002, markaasoo BBC-da Peter Sissons lagu eedeeyay inuusan xidhin galmo madow markii uu shaacinayay geerida Queen Mother, isagoo halkii ka xirtay galmo guduudan. Sissons wuxuu u sheegay Telegraph in shaqaalihii fasaxa ka shaqeynayay ay aad uga walwalsanaayeen in Duke-ku dhinto intay shaqada ku jiraan, taasoo keentay in la diyaariyo taariikh-nololeedyo iyo dhar ku habboon. Jawigii farxadda lahaa ee warqabadka waxaa hoos u dhigay ogaalka in qalad kasta si buuxda loo eegi doono kadib. Prince Philip, seyga Boqoradda, ayaa si deg-deg ah loogu qaaday Isbitaalka Papworth ee Cambridgeshire fiidkii Jimcaha kadib markuu ka cabanayey xanuun laabta ah. Dhakhaatiirta ayaa ogaaday xidid xidhan waxayna galiyeen bir lagu furo si dhiiggii wadnaha ugu noqdo—waa qaliin caadi ah balse si gaar ah loola socdo maadaama uu da’ yahay. Waxa uu isbitaalka ku jiray afar habeen, isagoo si weyn loo eegayay, ka dibna subaxdii shalay ayaa lasii daayay. Markaas kaddib wuxuu ku laabtay beerta Sandringham ee Boqoradda oo uu qoyskiisa kula midoobay. Markii uu guriga ku laabtay, Prince Philip wuxuu la cunteeyay qoyskiisa Wood Farm ee Wolferton, oo ah meel fasax ay royalku ku nastaan. Waxaa la arkay isagoo fadhiyay kuraasta hore ee Land Rover markii uu ka socday guriga, inta kalena ay ugu laabteen ugaarsigii ugaar. Inkasta oo uu aad u jeclaa ugaarsiga, Philip wuu ka niyad jabay inuu waayay tii sannadkan, balse wuu ku farxay inuu qoyska la joogo.

article_content: Marine Le Pen has dealt a significant setback to Nicolas Sarkozy by announcing he has ‘lost’ the French presidential election and refusing to urge her supporters to vote for him in the runoff. Sarkozy’s hopes of remaining president depend heavily on attracting votes from the six million people who backed Le Pen’s National Front in the first round—a record performance for the far-right party. Le Pen’s strong result has sparked concern throughout Europe, as Sarkozy appears likely to lose in the second round to Socialist candidate Francois Hollande, which has unnerved financial markets. Economic uncertainty followed: the French stock market dropped 2.83%, Germany’s fell 3.36%, and London’s declined by 1.85%. German Chancellor Angela Merkel expressed surprise that nearly 20% of French voters chose the National Front, highlighting the importance of the Berlin-Paris relationship. A defeat for Sarkozy in the May 6 runoff would also be awkward for UK Prime Minister David Cameron, who publicly endorsed Sarkozy. Government sources suggest efforts are underway to build stronger relationships with Hollande’s camp in anticipation. Le Pen’s party secured 18% of the first-round vote, its largest share to date, and announced there will be no agreement with Sarkozy. Le Pen stated: ‘I don’t expect anything except that the system will implode. Sarkozy has already lost the presidential election.’ A senior aide, Bruno Bilde, reinforced that the National Front will not negotiate or urge supporters to vote for Sarkozy or Hollande. A National Front spokesperson added: ‘We will abstain, as we do not wish to endorse either candidate—they are essentially the same.’ Still, polls suggest up to 60% of Le Pen’s voters might favor Sarkozy in the second round. Hollande led the first round with 28.6%, followed by Sarkozy at 27%, making Hollande the frontrunner to become France’s first Socialist president in 17 years. Both contenders have sought to appeal to far-right voters. At a rally, Sarkozy acknowledged the concerns raised by Le Pen voters and promised a tough stance on immigration and border control. In Brittany, Hollande emphasized unity and recovery for France, while his campaign director, Pierre Moscovici, reaffirmed a commitment to legal immigration but a strict approach to illegal immigration. Far-left candidate Jean-Luc Melenchon, who placed fourth with nearly 12% of the vote, has encouraged his supporters to back Hollande in the runoff. Sarkozy, once a reform-minded president promising economic change, has faced criticism for his personal life and connections to wealthy elites. While he enjoyed foreign policy accomplishments and actively participated in European and Libyan affairs, his domestic popularity faded amid France’s worst recession since World War II. Hollande’s steady lead in the polls, despite a low-key campaign, has persisted. Recent polls before the first round showed Sarkozy trailing Hollande both in the first round and by a wide margin in the runoff.
translated_content: Marine Le Pen ayaa Nicholas Sarkozy ku dhufatay dhabar jab weyn iyadoo sheegtay inuu 'lumay' doorashada madaxtinimada Faransiiska, isla markaana diiday inay taageerayaasheeda ku dhiirrigeliso inay codkooda siiyaan. Rajooyinka Sarkozy ee inuu xilka sii hayo waxa si weyn ugu xidhan in uu helo codadka lixda milyan ee taageeray Le Pen’s National Front wareegii koowaad—tani waxay ahayd guul taariikhi ah u ah xisbiga midigta fog. Guusha Le Pen ee wareegii koowaad waxay keentay walaac Europe oo dhan, maadaama ay u muuqato in Sarkozy uu ku waayi doono wareega labaad musharraxa soosaalista ah Francois Hollande, taasoo suuqyada maaliyadeed argagax gelisay. Xasilooni la’aanta dhaqaale ayaa xigtay: suuqa saamiyada Faransiiska wuxuu hoos u dhacay 2.83%, kii Jarmalkana 3.36%, kii London-na 1.85%. Kansalarka Jarmalka Angela Merkel ayaa muujisay layaab ay la kulantay in ku dhowaad 20% codbixiyayaasha Faransiiska ay u codeeyeen National Front, taasoo muujisay muhiimada xidhiidhka Berlin iyo Paris. Guuldarro ku timaada Sarkozy wareega labaad ee 6-da May waxay sidoo kale dhibaato u keeni lahayd Raysal Wasaaraha UK David Cameron, oo si cad u taageeray Sarkozy. Ilo dowladda ka tirsan ayaa sheegay in la wado dadaallo lagu xoojinayo xiriirka lala yeelanayo xisbiga Hollande. Xisbiga Le Pen ayaa helay 18% codadkii wareegii koowaad, waana guushii ugu badnayd ee uu gaaro, wuxuuna cadeeyay inaysan jirin heshiis lala galayo Sarkozy. Le Pen waxay tiri: 'Ma filaayo wax aan ahayn in nidaamku burburo. Sarkozy horey ayuu u lumay doorashada.' Ku-xigeenkeeda Bruno Bilde ayaa xoojiyay in National Front aysan wax wadahadal ah la gali doonin Sarkozy iyo Hollande toona ama taageerayaashooda u baaqi doonin. Afhayeen u hadashay National Front wuxuu intaas ku daray: 'Waxaan codadeena ka aamusnaynaa, sababtoo ah ma rabno inaan midkoodna iftiiminno—labaduba waa isku mid.' Si kastaba, sahanada ayaa sheegay in ilaa 60% taageerayaasha Le Pen ay codkooda siin karaan Sarkozy wareega labaad. Hollande wuxuu wareegii koowaad helay 28.6%, Sarkozy-na 27%, taasina waxay Hollande ka dhigtay musharraxa ugu cadcad inuu noqdo madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay ee soosaalis ah muddo 17 sano ah. Labada musharraxba waxay isku dayayaan inay kasbadaan taageerayaasha faraha badan ee midigta fog. Isku soo bax uu Sarkozy ku qabtay ayuu ku muujiyay inuu fahmay walaaca taageerayaasha Le Pen, isla markaana ballan qaaday inuu adagaan doono xagga socdaalka iyo xadka. Magaalada Brittany, Hollande wuxuu hoosta ka xariiqay midnimada iyo bogsashada Faransiiska, halka agaasimaha ol’oleyaashiisa Pierre Moscovici uu xaqiijiyay in ay xil iska saarayaan socdaalka sharci ah, balse ay si adag ula dagaallamayaan kuwa damacsan in ay si sharci darro ah u galaan dalka. Musharrixii bidixda fog Jean-Luc Melenchon, oo kaalinta afraad galay isagoo helay ilaa 12% codadka, ayaa taageerayaashiisa ugu baaqay inay u codeeyaan Hollande wareega labaad. Sarkozy, oo hore loo arki jiray madaxweyne doonaya isbeddel dhaqaale, ayaa wajahaya dhaliilo la xariira noloshiisa gaarka ah iyo xiriirkiisa dadka dhaqaalaha badan leh. Inkastoo uu guulo siyaasadeed dibadda ah sameeyay oo uu door weyn ku lahaa arrimaha Yurub iyo Liibiya, sumcaddiisa gudaha ayaa hoos u dhacday xili Faransiiska uu galay hoos u dhac dhaqaale oo uusan arag tan iyo Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka. Hollande oo aan ol’ole adag wadin hadana la lahaa guul cad oo tijaabooyinka la qaaday lagu muujinayey, ayaa hormuudka sii ahaa. Sahanadii ugu dambeeyay ayaa muujiyay in Sarkozy uu ka dambeeyo Hollande labadaba wareega koowaad iyo kan labaadba farqi weynna uu jiro.

article_content: It’s November, bringing the usual seasonal events: holiday movies, numerous football games, and sales on items you may not need. It's also the release time for another Marvel movie. The latest, The Marvels, arrives with lower fan enthusiasm and less critical acclaim. While the MCU has experienced a slump lately, fans remain intrigued by the ongoing multiverse storylines and hidden Easter eggs suggesting future plots. The Marvels maintains this trend, featuring a post-credits scene meant to build excitement for both the film and possible sequels. Unusually, there is only one post-credits scene in The Marvels. This differs from past MCU movies, which often include two such scenes. By the film’s end, Monica Rambeau closes a hole in the space-time continuum to prevent a merger between the MCU’s reality and another mysterious one. Monica succeeds in saving the universe, but she becomes trapped in the alternate reality. She disappears from the rest of the movie and only reappears during the post-credits scene. In the scene, Monica is seen lying in a hospital bed, connected to monitors. She notices someone sitting by her side—her mother, Maria Rambeau, played by Lashana Lynch. However, things seem unusual: Maria is supposed to be deceased, having died off-screen in WandaVision and, in a different reality, at the hands of Scarlet Witch in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. Additionally, Maria appears much younger, almost the same age as Monica. Suddenly, an off-screen voice comments on Monica’s uniqueness as a subject from an alternate reality. The camera reveals Dr. Hank McCoy, also known as The Beast, portrayed by Kelsey Grammer. This confirms Monica’s presence in the Fox X-Men universe, now apparently part of the MCU storyline. This Beast character first appeared in X-Men: The Last Stand, also played by Grammer, though here he is depicted using CGI rather than prosthetics. His appearance establishes that the X-Men now exist within the MCU. Maria then rises, and the camera pans back to show her in the red-and-white costume of Binary, an X-Men character originally associated with Carol Danvers—who later became Captain Marvel. Maria, as Binary in this universe, does not recognize Monica or understand why Monica calls her 'mother.' The Marvels is currently playing in theaters across the country.
translated_content: Waa bisha Nofeembar, waxayna la timid xilli ay dhacayaan dhacdooyin caadi ah sida filimada ciidaha, cayaaraha kubadda cagta oo badan, iyo dhimisyo alaabo aad u badan oo aadan laga yaabee u baahnayn. Waa xilligii filim kale oo Marvel ah la sii deyn lahaa. Filimkii ugu dambeeyey ee la yiraahdo The Marvels, wuxuu yimid iyadoo taageerayaashu ay yara daciifeen oo aanay jirin qiimeyn wanaagsan oo laga bixiyey. Inkasta oo MCU ay la tacaalayso hoos u dhac, taageerayaashu wali waxay xiiseynayaan sheekooyinka multiverse-ka iyo siraha qarsoon ee muujinaya waxa mustaqbalka dhici kara. The Marvels wuxuu la yimid dhaqankii caanka ahaa, isagoo leh muuqaal post-credits ah oo loo sameeyay in lagu abuuro xiiso badan oo filimka iyo suurtagalka sequels. Si aan caadi ahayn, filimkan kaliya wuxuu leeyahay hal post-credits scene, halka filimada Marvel horay u lahayd labo. Dhamaadka filimka, Monica Rambeau waxay xiraysaa dalool ku baxay space-time continuum si ay uga hortagto in ay midoobaan xaqiiqadda MCU iyo mid kale oo qarsoodi ah. Monica waxay ku guuleysataa badbaadinta dunida, balse waxay ku xannibantaa xaqiiq kale. Waxay ka baxdaa filimka inteeda kale ilaa ay kasoo muuqato post-credits-ka. Muuqaalkan, Monica waxay jiiftaa sariir isbitaal iyadoo la socoto qalabyo kormeeraya. Waxay aragtaa hooyadeed, Maria Rambeau, oo fadhiya dhinaceeda—oo ay mataleyso Lashana Lynch. Waxyaabo ayaa halkaa ka khaldan: Maria waa inay dhimatay, markii hore off-screen ku dhimatay taxanaha WandaVision, mid kalena waxay ku dishay Scarlet Witch filimka Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. Sidoo kale, Maria waxay u muuqataa mid aad u da' yar, oo la moodo da’da Monica. Cod aan muuqan ayaa markaas hadlaya, isagoo Monica ku tilmaamaya in ay tahay shey xiiso leh oo laga soo dhexdhoofay xaqiiq kale. Kamera markay kor uga qaadayso, waxaa muuqda Dr. Hank McCoy, oo loo yaqaan The Beast, oo uu matalay Kelsey Grammer. Tani waxay caddeyneysaa in Monica ay ku sugan tahay xaqiiqda Fox X-Men, oo hadda qayb ka ah sheekada MCU. Dabeecadda Beast ayaa hore ugu soo muuqday X-Men: The Last Stand, sidoo kalena waxaa matalayey Grammer, balse halkan waa CGI la adeegsanayo halkii uu ka ahaan lahaa la isku qurxiyo. article_content: Karren Brady received the Commander of the British Empire (CBE) award from Prince William at Buckingham Palace, recognizing her influence as a business leader and her advocacy for women in entrepreneurship. As vice-chairman of West Ham United and a familiar face on BBC’s The Apprentice with Lord Sugar, Brady’s achievements have made significant waves both in football and on television. She became managing director of Birmingham City football club at age 23, breaking barriers for women in the sport. Notably, Brady kept her CBE honor private, only for her family to learn about it through the media. After the investiture, she described her conversation with Prince William, who shares her enthusiasm for football and The Apprentice. Brady highlighted the progress and remaining challenges for women in business and stressed the responsibility of established professionals to mentor the next generation.

article_content: Just two hours from Paris, the Loire Valley—once a haven for Renaissance royalty—is now known for its charming, affordable inns set within historic châteaux. These unique accommodations, often run by enterprising couples, artists, or families, combine traditional architecture with modern comforts and personalized touches. In Amboise, Le Clos d'Amboise offers a peaceful retreat within limestone walls. In Chinon, Hôtel Diderot delights guests with breakfasts of local goat cheese, honey, walnuts, and house-made jams, served in a meticulously restored 15th-century home by Laurent Dutheil and his sisters. Le Moulin de la Renne in Thésée welcomes guests with a friendly Bernese mountain dog and lively jazz nights, while Château de l'Isle in Civray-de-Touraine features tranquil grounds, a duck pond, and rooms with original beams and inviting colors. La Roseraie in Chenonceaux, which hosted post-WWII dignitaries like Churchill and Roosevelt, now offers rooms ranging from cozy singles to family suites, just minutes from the acclaimed Château de Chenonceau. At Auberge de Launay in Limeray, François and Hélène Thévard converted a farmhouse into a 15-room inn with modern simplicity and a menu rooted in regional flavors. In Onzain, Château des Tertres merges historic elegance with contemporary art, thanks to artist Bernard Valois. Auberge du Centre in Chitenay tells the story of three generations who have nurtured this inn and its traditional French country cuisine. The Loire Valley is also famous for its cabernet franc wines and magnificent castles, including must-see sites like Chenonceau, Chambord, and Cheverny. Travelers should confirm current rates and details directly with properties before planning a visit.

article_content: Broncos star Peyton Manning’s playing career may be drawing to a close, as the veteran quarterback gave his strongest indication yet that he might not return for another season. Manning struggled in Sunday’s playoff defeat to the Indianapolis Colts, completing just over half of his passes for one touchdown and 211 yards in the Broncos’ 24-13 loss. This defeat ends the Broncos’ bid for Super Bowl redemption after their loss to the Seattle Seahawks last year. Following the game, Colts quarterback Andrew Luck met Manning on the field. The Colts will now face the New England Patriots next Sunday in the AFC Championship Game, with the winner earning a spot in the February 1 Super Bowl in Arizona. At 38, Manning had previously seemed confident about playing another season, but after the loss, he expressed doubt, saying he needed time to process the defeat and decide his future. In the post-game press conference, Manning said, 'Right now, my mindset is just disappointment after today’s game. I need to process this and we’ll meet tomorrow.' Key decisions await the Broncos: Head coach John Fox could depart or be let go, and coordinators Adam Gase and Jack Del Rio are being considered for other coaching jobs. Several key players, including Demaryius Thomas, Julius Thomas, Terrance Knighton, and Rahim Moore, are also approaching contract expiration and could leave for other teams.

Manning ayaa ku dhibtooday guuldarradii Axaddii ee kooxdiisa ka soo gaartay Indianapolis Colts, isagoo dhammeystiray wax ka badan kala badh kubbadihii uu tuuray, isagoo keenay hal taabasho iyo 211 yard, taasoo keentay guuldarro 24-13 ah. article_content: Southampton have made a formal enquiry to Burnley as they look to begin their rebuilding project by signing striker Danny Ings. The England Under-21 international's contract will expire at the end of next season, and Southampton believe they can secure the forward before the new campaign. Burnley manager Sean Dyche currently values Ings at £8 million. Ings scored 26 goals during Burnley's promotion from the Championship last season. Southampton are seeking a striker to replace Rickie Lambert, who recently joined Liverpool, and see Ings as fitting their strategy to recruit young, ambitious English players. However, Burnley's valuation for the 21-year-old is a challenge, as Ings will be available on a free transfer in twelve months unless he signs an extension with the Lancashire club. Everton and Newcastle are monitoring Ings, as are German sides Wolfsburg and Bayer Leverkusen. Southampton understand that foreign clubs will have the right to speak to Ings from January and can negotiate a pre-contract agreement with a reduced compensation rate after the new year. Burnley would prefer to keep Ings but know they risk losing him for nothing if a deal is not reached this summer. Although Southampton are hesitant to meet the asking price, substantial funds from the £31.5 million sale of Luke Shaw to Manchester United and Adam Lallana's expected £25 million move to Liverpool may give them the flexibility to proceed, as new manager Ronald Koeman begins to rebuild his squad.

article_content: A heated U.S. Senate hearing unfolded Tuesday as legislators debated a proposed Constitutional amendment regarding campaign finance reform. Senate Majority Leader Harry Reid (D-Nevada) urged changes to the Constitution that would enable Congress and states to impose stricter limits on independent and corporate spending in federal elections. His aim is to counter the Supreme Court's 2010 Citizens United decision, which lifted several restrictions on election spending by corporations and unions. Democratic Senators Tom Udall of New Mexico and Michael Bennet of Colorado are leading the sponsorship of the amendment, aiming to give lawmakers increased authority over election spending. Reid, sitting beside rival Senate Republican Leader Mitch McConnell, cited McConnell's past openness to spending limits; nonetheless, McConnell insisted he has not supported funding restrictions since and critiqued the current proposal, saying it threatens free speech and could let Congress determine whose voices are heard in politics. With a full audience and overflow rooms required, the hearing indicated considerable public interest. The atmosphere was tense, as senators including Ted Cruz (R-Texas) and Chuck Schumer (D-New York) engaged in pointed disagreements. Cruz argued the amendment could let Congress suppress speech, potentially even banning books or movies. Schumer refuted this, claiming historical figures such as Thomas Jefferson would back reasonable restrictions, and pushed back on Cruz's assertions about censorship. Democrats plan to pursue the amendment even though its future is uncertain. McConnell stressed that there is no vote scheduled and labeled the proposal an unlikely political maneuver. Both parties are using the debate to energize supporters, but the prospects for the amendment remain unclear.

article_content: Scotland's Health Secretary, Michael Matheson, has rejected suggestions that patients may need to pay for some NHS services in the future. While acknowledging the need for reform, Matheson emphasized the health service’s founding principle of being free at the point of use. His comments come after the former head of NHS Scotland, Prof Paul Gray, called for a discussion about private sector involvement. Another senior doctor has warned that without significant change, the NHS may not survive until its 100th anniversary in 2048. Matheson stated that the government’s 10-year plan to ensure the NHS’s sustainability will focus on increased investment in community healthcare. He also dismissed calls for his resignation related to a dispute over an £11,000 data roaming bill charged to his parliamentary iPad. Speaking to BBC Scotland News, Matheson agreed that reform is necessary. He highlighted the importance of expanding primary care—such as GP services—rather than relying mainly on referrals to specialist care. He also stressed the need to improve the management of social care. These measures, which include modernizing treatments and using new technology, are part of a broader package to reform health and social care. Matheson affirmed: 'We are very clear about the principle of access to free healthcare. It is a principle that the Scottish government is firmly committed to, and I have no intention of changing that.' He added: 'My determination is to ensure we have a sustainable and effective healthcare system that delivers high-quality care for years to come, and I plan to outline that vision in the New Year.' Scotland, like the rest of the UK, is experiencing record waiting times and significant staffing challenges. Recent figures from Public Health Scotland show that NHS waiting lists are at an all-time high. Prof Paul Gray has described the NHS in Scotland as 'unsustainable' in its current form. His concerns were echoed by Prof Andrew Elder, President of the Royal College of Physicians of Edinburgh, who called for a 'national conversation' with the public on NHS priorities. Dr Iain Kennedy, chair of the British Medical Association in Scotland, supported this call. He warned, 'Otherwise, I predict Scotland’s NHS will not reach its 100th anniversary.' On BBC Radio Scotland, he highlighted worsening waiting times and increased demand due to the aging population, noting that workforce planning has been inadequate. BBC Scotland previously reported that NHS leaders discussed whether the wealthy should pay for treatment, referencing a possible 'two-tier' health service. The trade union Unison has argued against privatization, attributing NHS problems to poor workforce planning and underfunding rather than structural issues. Wilma Brown, chair of Unison Scotland’s health committee, criticized proponents of private medicine for disadvantaging poorer patients. She stated: 'Low taxes and properly funded public services are mutually exclusive. The real debate should focus on resources, not structure.' Prof Gray first described NHS Scotland as ‘not sustainable in its present form’ in an article for The Herald and Reform Scotland, a non-partisan independent think tank.

Iyadoo uu qirtay in isbeddel loo baahan yahay, Matheson wuxuu adkeeyey mabda’a asaasiga ah ee adeegga caafimaadka ee ah inuu noqdo mid bilaash ah marka la codsado. Hadaladiisa waxay yimaadeen kadib markii madaxdii hore ee NHS Scotland, Prof Paul Gray, uu ku baaqay in laga doodo ka qeybgalka waaxda gaarka ah. Dhakhtar kale oo sare ayaa uga digay in NHS-da aysan gaari doonin sannadguuradeeda 100-aad sanadka 2048 haddii aan wax weyn la beddelin. Matheson wuxuu sheegay in qorshaha dawladda ee 10 sano ah ee lagu xaqiijinayo waaritaanka NHS uu diiradda saari doono maalgelin dheeraad ah ee adeegyada caafimaadka bulshada. Waxa kale oo uu iska diiday baaqyo lagu dalbanayo inuu iscasilayo la xiriira muran ku saabsan biil caddadkiisu yahay £11,000 oo lagu soo dalacsiiyay ku roaming-ga xogta ee iPad-kiisa baarlamaanka. Isagoo la hadlayay BBC Scotland News, Matheson wuu qiray in dib-u-habeyn loo baahan yahay. Wuxuu xusay muhiimada balaadhinta daryeelka aasaasiga ah sida adeega dhakhaatiirta guud halkii laga sugayey gudbinta dheeraadka ah ee daryeelka takhasuska ah. Wuxuu sidoo kale adkeeyay baahida in si wanaagsan loo maareeyo daryeelka bulshada. Tallaabooyinkan oo ay ku jiraan casriyeynta daawaynta iyo isticmaalka tignoolajiyada cusub, waxay qayb ka yihiin qorshe ballaaran oo lagu casriyeynayo daryeelka caafimaadka iyo bulshada. Matheson wuxuu yiri: ‘Waxaan si cad ugu taaganahay in la helo daryeel caafimaad oo bilaash ah. Waa mabda’ ay xukuumadda Scottishku si adag ugu go’an tahay, qorshina uma jiro in la beddelo.’ Waxa uu daray: ‘Ujeedadaydu waa in aan xaqiijiyo in aynu helno nidaam caafimaad oo waara, wax ku ool ah, oo bixiya daryeel tayo sare leh sanadaha soo socda, waana midda aan rabo in aan la wadaago dadweynaha sanadka cusub.’ Scotland, sida qaybaha kale ee UK, waxay la daalaa dhacaysaa waqtiyo sugitaan oo aad u dheer iyo caqabado dhanka shaqaalaha ah. Warbixinta ugu dambayssay ee Public Health Scotland waxay muujisay in liisaska sugitaanka NHS ay gaareen heerkii ugu sarreeyay. Prof Paul Gray ayaa NHS-da Scotland ku sifeeyay ‘mid aan sii socon karin’ sida hadda ay tahay. Aragtidiisana waxaa taageeray Prof Andrew Elder, Madaxweynaha Ururka Dhakhaatiirta Edinburgh, oo soo jeediyay in la bilaabo ‘wada hadal qaran’ oo la wadaago dadweynaha mudnaanta NHS. Dr Iain Kennedy, gudoomiyaha ururka British Medical Association ee Scotland, ayaa fikirkaas taageeray. Waxa uu digay: ‘Haddii kale, waxaan saadaalinayaa in NHS-da Scotland aysan gaari doonin da’deeda 100-aad.’ Isagoo la hadlayay BBC Radio Scotland, waxa uu tilmaamay dhibaatooyinka sugitaanka iyo baahida sii kordhaysa ee ay keentay bulsho sii gaboobaysa, wuxuuna xusay in qorshe shaqaale la’aanta ay jirto. Warbixin hore oo BBC Scotland ay qabatay ayaa sheegtay in hoggaanka NHS ay ka hadleen suurtagalnimada in dadka maalqabeenka ah laga qaado lacag daaweyn, taas oo la xiriirta nidaam ‘laba-tier’ ah. Ururka Unison ayaa si weyn uga soo horjeestay gaarsiinta adeegga caafimaadka ee gaarka loo leeyahay, iyagoo dhibaatada NHS ku sababeeyay qorshe shaqaale xumo iyo maalgelin yari, halkii laga eegi lahaa dhismaha nidaamka. Wilma Brown, gudoomiyaha guddiga caafimaadka Unison Scotland, ayaa dhaliishay kuwa taageera caafimaadka gaarka ah inay saboolka gadaal dhigayaan. Waxay tiri: ‘Canshuuraha hoose iyo adeegyadu si fiican loo maalgaliyo ma wada jiraan. Doodda ugu muhiimsan waa in diiradda la saaro ilaha dhaqaale ee jirta, ma aha qaabka nidaamka.’ Prof Gray markii ugu horreysay NHS Scotland ugu tilmaamay ‘mid aan waarta ahayn sida hadda ay tahay’ maqaal uu u qoray The Herald iyo Reform Scotland oo ah xarun feker oo madax bannaan oo aan dhinacna la safnayn.
